label: Adalberon of Reims
summary: Archbishop supporting Hugh Capet.

summary: Author of The Mole's Work.

label: Aegean

label: Aetius
summary: Roman general at the Catalaunian Fields.

label: Aett

label: Af

summary: Virtue listed in character statistics in this text.

summary: Virtue referenced in this text.

summary: Virtue possessed by Protinus.

label: Africa

summary: Biography of the Prophet by Ibn Ishaq.

summary: Magic Defense from Tueor granting defense vs Terram effects.

summary: Justiciar who squabbled with the Comyns.

summary: Elder member of Harco overseeing mercantile activities.

label: Aldico
summary: Primus of Mercere during the Schism War who helped negotiate peace.

label: Aldo
summary: Minor demon masquerading as a merchant friend of Albert.

summary: Fabled bird with fire-colored, razor-sharp feathers that killed an iaculus.

summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

label: Aleth
summary: Settlement near St. Malo.

summary: Author of the summa On Airy Spirits of Significant Places.

summary: Beings referenced in the rune spell for sensing vis.

summary: King who with his wife Eleanor founded the nunnery of Las Huelgas near Burgos.

summary: Regent of Burgundy.

label: All Saints' Day

summary: Stag of Virtue power neutralizing poison after drinking water.

summary: Jaevert's power to appear as a shining angel.

summary: Creo Imágonem 10 effect in Gabricon's doormat.

summary: The otherworld realm over which Gwynn ab Nudd reigns as king of the faeries.

label: Aralim

summary: Ability rolled to know about Pomerania.

summary: Ability referenced in this text.

summary: A young Flambeau magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

label: Aries of House Flambeau
summary: Lapis Crudus magus who tricked Candidus into protecting the covenant; succumbed to Final Twilight five years ago.

label: Aristaeus
summary: A god who desired Eurydice and advanced on her, causing her to flee and step on the viper that killed her.

label: Aristarcus
summary: Filius of Proctor, a Traditionalist Guernicus who argues cases before Tribunal; familiar a swan.

label: Aristeas
summary: Ancient Greek poet and powerful straying magician serving Apollo, who keeps returning from death via his kolossos.

label: Aristophanes
summary: Greek playwright whose play The Birds describes the founding of Nephelococcygia.

label: Aristotelian Training
summary: A General, Minor Virtue: the character was trained in the New Aristotle, gaining +1 to Artes Liberales rolls for grammar, logic, rhetoric, +1 to Disputatio Totals, and (for magi) +1 to relevant Lab Totals.

label: Aristotle
summary: The ancient Greek philosopher whose newly translated works, the New Aristotle, were central to scholastic learning and embraced by Muslim scholars.

label: Arithmetic Magic
summary: Mystery working numerical influences into general Hermetic magic (Arithmetic Magic).

label: Ark of the Covenant
summary: Relic built to carry the tablets of the Law, lost since 587 BC; Faith 10 for Jews and Divine Might 100.

label: Arkliss
aliases: Arkliss, a Dragon of the Fens
summary: A small but fierce true dragon lairing in a bog, able to dominate people with her gaze and breathe pestilence.

label: Arkona
summary: A ruined Slavic fortress-temple on the northernmost headland of Rugen, one of the holiest pagan Baltic sites where Svantovit was worshipped; destroyed by Bishop Absolon in 1169.

label: Arliandus
summary: A magus of House Tremere whose intact sanctum beneath Trier, specialized in Mentem study, was protected by his enchanted Door of Deimos and held Hermetic treasures.

label: Arm of St. George
summary: Relic with Faith score 2 at Vendôme.

label: Arm of the Infant
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 20) that shrinks a person's arm to half its length and makes it pudgy like an infant's.

label: Arma Magica
summary: 'Magical defenses' based on Bonisagus's Parma Magica ritual, in which the Parma is folded upon itself to produce effects called folds; each fold is a Major Breakthrough.

label: Armagh
summary: Irish town, home of the motherhouse of the canons guarding Lough Dearg and a required stop for pilgrims to the Purgatory.

label: Armenia
summary: Kingdom in conflict with the Templars.

label: Arming the Legion of the Dead
aliases: Arming the Legion of the Dead
summary: Muto Mentem level 70 Ritual (Terram requisite) making the metal gear of up to 10,000 ghosts solid, without granting control over them.

label: Armor of the Giant of Steenvoorde
aliases: Armor of the Giant of Steenvoorde
summary: Huge armor from Charlemagne, possibly magical.

label: Armorica
summary: Roman province that became Brittany.

label: Arn cul-ri Eirin
summary: Cairn on Iona marking where Columba found he could no longer see Ireland.

label: Arne de Spinnen
summary: A childless former head of the de Spinnen family, himself not who he seemed, who accepted Petrus as his heir.

label: Arnev
summary: Great Spirit of Ushant of stormy weather, a serpent with a horse's head.

label: Arno
summary: Benandante companion, a young smith who fights with a club of fennel.

label: Arnold of Torroja
summary: Grand Master (1180-1184).

label: Arnold of Villanova
summary: Stated that spirits could not be coerced and came voluntarily.

label: Aron
summary: A Ba'al Shem who interprets Elizabeth's dreams in an example.

label: Arrée Mountains
summary: Highest part of the duchy.

label: Arras
summary: Seat of Artois, with the Abbey of St. Vaast and a tradition of trouvères.

label: Arrogant
summary: Walter.

label: Ars Fabulosa
summary: The 'fantastic art' of faerie bargaining, developed in the eastern parts of Mythic Europe from ancient spirit-summoning arts.

label: Ars Flambonis
summary: A Summa on Ignem (Level 14, Quality 12) written by Elaine as a tribute to her pater Flambeau, sprinkled with anecdotes about his teachings.

label: Ars Goetia
summary: A sorcerous tradition dealing with the summoning, binding, commanding, ablating, and punishment of spiritual entities of all realms except the Divine; practiced by Guorna and Tytalus and socially tainted.

label: Ars Goetica
summary: Infernal spirit magic rules referenced for gruagachan who command spirits.

label: Ars Grammatica
summary: Book by Donatus (Artes Liberales Summa) held by the Reims coven.

label: Ars Magica
summary: The tabletop roleplaying game system in which this Rhine Tribunal supplement is set; rules references point to Ars Magica 5th Edition.

label: Ars Notoria
summary: Academic, Arcane, Supernatural Ability of divine orations and rituals descended from King Solomon, granting divine wisdom through rings of recitation.

label: Ars Notoria text
summary: Apollonius's text in four languages, a Quality 20 tractatus, the only way to initially learn Ars Notoria.

label: Ars Notoria (Virtue)
summary: Major Hermetic/Supernatural Virtue granting Ars Notoria 1, requiring scores of 4 in Artes Liberales and four languages.

label: Arsenic
summary: Poison found in the soil of the battlefield; valuable to necromancers and a potential metal with Material Bonuses.

label: Arsenical Pseudoelemental
summary: Earth spirit (Magic Might 20 Terram) made cruel by arsenic salts.

label: Arsenical Skeletons
summary: Undead animated by Averna's Ritual, poisonous.

label: Arshaq ibn Kareem
summary: Zahid with Faith Score 1 used as the example for Divine Form and Divine Unity.

label: Art & Academe
summary: Supplement referenced for more details on elemental physics.

label: Art-Aligned Aura
summary: An aura aligned with a Technique or Form that doubles the aura bonus for relevant spells and lab work and reduces power costs for aligned creatures.

label: Art of Memory
summary: An Ability that aids recall; a victim of Chnoubis' bite may add Art of Memory to a Stamina roll to remember what transpired while affected.

label: Artakia
summary: The Greek town on Bear Island whose citizens know of the faerie regio and whose spring has a Magic aura of 2.

label: Arte dei Mercanti
summary: Merchant societies formed in Florence in 1182 in imitation of the noble tower societies, which spread to many other cities.

label: Artemis
summary: The deity to whom Ophia Sirnaus Isle-Warden's shrine on her Aegean island is dedicated.

label: Artemis Lykeie
summary: Thracian wolfish form of Artemis, a faerie known for tearing the sacrilegious apart.

label: Artes Liberales
summary: An academic Ability covering the liberal arts (including the specialty of Rhetoric) favored by the Sophists; used as an Attack Ability in debate and taught to Tytalan apprentices.

label: Artes Mechanicae
summary: The mechanical arts, elevated in the 13th century.

label: Arthritis
summary: A Minor General Flaw: stiff, painful joints giving -3 to rolls involving repetitive sustained movement, with botches potentially locking up a limb.

label: Arthur
summary: A claimant given into Hubert de Burgh's custody by King John, who ordered him killed; Hubert refused and feigned it, but John later took Arthur and he was never seen alive again.

label: Arthur Among the Britons
summary: Tractatus on Area Lore: Britain by Celeres of Welsh Arthur tales.

label: Arthur of Brittany
summary: Son of Geoffrey with a strong claim to England; vanished at Rouen in 1203, rumored to be Gifted and apprenticed.

label: Arthurian Romances
summary: Tractatus, Etiquette, collection of Chrétien's four poems.

label: Artificer
summary: An honorary Durenmar title for the magus, traditionally a Verditius, charged with crafting items for the covenant; currently held by Gudrun Tigurina.

label: Artificers
summary: Tremere makers of ritual objects, banners, sigils and secret items.

label: Artillery Assault
summary: Siege attack using groups of up to five mangonels or trebuchets against castle walls, resolved with Siege Weapon versus Profession Siege Engineer.

label: Artio
summary: Bear goddess worshipped by the ancient Celts of the Berne region.

label: Artist
summary: A covenfolk template for a fey, painter-craftsman in a highly magical environment, with Virtues like Free Expression and Second Sight.

label: Artist Reputation
summary: A flexible Reputation named after an artist's Craft or Profession Ability that grows with the quality of his work and sponsors, conferring social and supernatural benefits as it rises toward 11.

label: Artistic Renown
summary: A Minor General Virtue granting an Artist Reputation of 2 (takeable twice); also a Major Supernatural Virtue version letting a non-Gifted artist study one Hermetic Form.

label: Artorius filius Celeres
summary: Newly Gauntleted Bonisagus magus, Celeres' last apprentice.

label: Artur of Jerbiton
summary: Rellantali magus who maintains relations with Venice.

label: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him
aliases: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him
summary: Invocation Cursing effect imposing a penalty on all the target's actions.

label: As the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers
aliases: As the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers
summary: Debauchery/Malediction 15 Medium Wound.

label: Asaron of Flambeau
summary: A magus of House Flambeau who believes his mission is to repopulate the world for more to kill; he spends seasons healing, and his sigil is a symbolic flame.

label: Ascendant
summary: The sign rising over the eastern horizon at a given time and place, the starting point of a horoscope.

label: Ascendant Form of the Intendant Hierarch
aliases: Ascendant Form of the Intendant Hierarch
summary: Mystery Ritual in which the hierarch constructs a prototype ascendant form, manifesting his abilities in their strongest form during apotheosis.

label: Ascetics
summary: Holy tradition favoring Adjuration, Cursing, Purity and Second Sight, practicing ritual purity of mind and body.

label: Aschlaranda
summary: A maga exiled from Durenmar and House Bonisagus during the Schism War who founded Dankmar in 1052 to oppose Durenmar, bringing her apprentice Schadrit with her.

label: Asen
summary: Elder of two brothers who rebelled against the Byzantine Empire in 1185, raiding Thrace and Macedonia.

label: Asgard
summary: Home of the Norse gods, reached by the rainbow bridge Heimdall guards.

label: Ash
summary: A trusted Redcap from The Broken Covenant of Calebais who may secretly be a Loamwalker.

label: Ash Branch of Muto Vis
summary: Ash-branch vis granting Reserves of Strength and Toughness in battle.

label: Ash Gild
summary: A Rhine Tribunal gild dominated by Flambeau magi who wish to strike aggressively against the Norse wizards beyond the Baltic; led by Philippus Niger and behind the creation of Oculus Septentrionalis.

label: Asha Vahishta
summary: One of the Zoroastrian Immortals (Amesha Spentas): 'Best Righteousness', associated with Brave and Ignem/Imaginem in the Blessing ritual.

label: Ashagalomancy
summary: Divinatory method using casting bones, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

label: Ashenrise
summary: A covenant founded in the Hibernian Tribunal in 1062 by the survivors of Tagelyn after Blackthorn drove them from their caves.

label: Ashkenazim
summary: Jews in Christian lands, mostly France and Germany, socially isolated and turned towards theology and mysticism.

label: Ashmodai
summary: King of Tempters, co-leader of the ninth order with Lilith; eldest child of Adam and Lilith, winged and terrible in aspect.

label: 'Ashura'
summary: Day of fasting and mourning for al-Husayn.

label: Asia Minor
summary: Region whose coast holds the sinkholes Cennet and Cehennem.

label: Asinara
summary: Small island north of Sardinia, site of Rellantali's nearly abandoned fortress.

label: Asiyah
summary: Lowest of the Four Worlds (Action), the mundane material universe.

label: Asp of Virtue
summary: A venomous serpent of several types, easily charmed by music, said to guard a balm-bearing tree or bear a carbuncle gem.

label: Aspect
summary: An agent projected onto Earth by a Daimon, functioning as an independent spirit with its own Might pool that is dispelled when exhausted and returns to the parent Daimon.

label: Asphodel
summary: Plant connected to the dead, used as weapons by mazzeri and sacred to Persephone.

label: Assarting
summary: Carving new cropland or meadow from fertile wasteland; can be done magically, alarming nearby lords.

label: Assassins
summary: Nizari Isma'ili sect founded by Hasan-i Sabbah at Alamut, hierarchically organized and known for political assassination.

label: Assembly of Birds
summary: A mid-winter gathering that all Birds of Nephelococcygia must attend, at which new songs are performed and criticized.

label: Asses' Ears
summary: A Minor Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) that turns the victim's ears into donkey ears, penalizing social interactions by -3.

label: Assessor
summary: Tremere urban diplomats, merchants or spies with the Gentle Gift.

label: Assisi
summary: Italian town where Francis and Clare were born and the Franciscans are centered.

label: Assistant
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: a Gifted assistant such as a Hermetic apprentice helps in the lab, adding their Intelligence + Magic Theory to General Quality.

label: Associate Member
summary: Status at Magvillus granting quarters and labs in return for vis and service.

label: Assume the Form of the Ancestors
aliases: Assume the Form of the Ancestors
summary: GvSh 15 spell making the caster grow to giant size, +5 Size with Strength and Quickness adjustments.

label: Asta
summary: Galdrakona wife of Gunnar Loftursson, targeted by the crusaders, who sustains a Biarg spirit with spell song to keep her daughter alive.

label: Astaroth
summary: One of the Maskim, Prince of the Accusing Angels and once a seraph; Prime Minister of Hell and co-signatory of all diabolic pacts, appearing as an angel astride a dragon.

label: Astasians
summary: Tiny messenger-demons that Imanitos Mendax can use to communicate with his subordinates, easily mistaken for 'airy spirits.'

label: Astera
summary: Mystagogue of Stellus, born under Sagittarius.

label: Astra
summary: Example maga using Laboratory Horoscopes.

label: Astra Planeta
summary: The seven planetary spirits linking the celestial spheres to the Realm of Magic.

label: Astralabe
summary: Son of Abélard and Héloïse.

label: Astrolabe of Jerbiton
summary: Possibly the most brilliant magus in the tribunal, a Jerbiton at Schola Pythagoranis devoted to natural philosophy who critiques magic theory's physics.

label: Astrological Ages
summary: ~2160-year ages defined by vernal equinox sign.

label: Astrological Correspondences
summary: Astrological reference material in the Hermetic Astrology chapter.

label: Astrological Cyclic Magic
summary: Minor Hermetic Virtue or Flaw whose cycles follow astrological periods (male/female, cardinal/fixed/mutable, or elemental signs), with bonus of 3, 5, or 6.

label: Astrological Duration
summary: A spell duration tied to astrological conditions whose calculations can be eased by consulting a magical armillary sphere.

label: Astrological House
summary: One of the astrological houses, e.g. Genitor (fourth) and Valetudo (sixth).

label: Astrological Houses
summary: The 12 divisions of a horoscope chart (Vita, Lucrum, Frates, Genitor, Nati, Valetudo, Uxor, Mors, Pietas, Regnum, Benefacta, Carcer), each with its own province.

label: Astrological Inception
summary: An experimental-philosophy formula learned via Artes Liberales consisting of an astrological chart designed to answer a specific question about a person, object, or event.

label: Astrological Magic
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue adding Artes Liberales to Kabbalah totals.

label: Astrological Magical Foci
summary: Modified Hermetic Virtue referenced alongside Potent Magic in astrological Mysteries.

label: Astrological Modifier
summary: Bonus (+1 to +5) to Lab Total or casting score from a successful horoscope roll.

label: Astrological Spell
summary: Spell cast with benefit of Potent Magic or Focus in a sign, planet, or house.

label: Astrologically Linked Enchantment
summary: Enchantment linked to a target by Nativity Horoscope or to a seasonal astrological cycle.

label: Astrology
summary: The natural principle that the celestial figure of planets at a thing's creation determines its qualities; employed by magi in ceremonial casting and lab work ordering.

label: Astronomical Device
summary: A laboratory Feature: a tool for measuring the heavens such as an astrolabe or armillary sphere, providing Intellego and Vim Specializations.

label: Asturia
summary: Where the Dragon-Maiden lives in a cave.

label: Astuth
summary: Verditius full member of Verdi, aged 93.

label: Asuryal
summary: Asuryal, Herald of Deliverance, a Principality (Divine Might 10) who guards the domain of a mundane lord disguised as a minor advisor.

label: Ataf the Separator
summary: A shapechanging Spirit of Deceit with a serpent's head who separates happily married couples; his Powers fail against True Lovers.

label: Atavism
summary: The acquisition of ancestral characteristics by which a Bjornaer magus learns to adopt the form of a notable animal ancestor (the inner heartbeast).

label: Athena
summary: Guernicus Intéllego specialist and chief Quaesitor of the Alps, who coordinates the Midsummer Fair and favors a greater role for the Tremere.

label: Athenaeus
summary: Second-century author of Edicts of Augustus.

label: Athletics
summary: Athletics: Ability used by holy or divine characters in this text, e.g. in Abbas the Hunted's or the Chalkydri's statistics or divine rules.

label: Athlit
summary: The Pilgrim's Castle, Templar fortress between Haifa and Acre with elevated Dominion ratings; formerly Destroit.

label: Atlantean Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue from exiled Atlantean magic granting the special Range Water-way, Duration Storm, and Target Body-of-water.

label: Atlanteans
summary: A people native to a magic regio; an exiled Atlantean tainted by the surface world cannot return, as detailed in Realms of Power: Magic.

label: Atlantic Ocean
summary: An alternative location for a magical island, averaging over 4000 paces deep.

label: Atlantis
summary: Legendary realm reported by the Greeks and ruled by Poseidon, which Rumael claims to have created and destroyed.

label: Atlantium
summary: One of the six known lands of Arcadia: the land under the sea.

label: Atlax of Tytalus
summary: Fudarus magus who read the Redcap Camille's messages.

label: Atoms
summary: Four varieties of uncuttable building blocks of the universe (earth, water, air, fire), each with two qualities.

label: Atramentum Renatus
summary: Vassal covenant of Fudarus whose magi were ruined by guild politics in Le Conquet and later evicted.

label: Atrox of Tytalus
summary: Magus of House Tytalus who invented the Unsubtle Knife; his sigil makes messages and errors appear in blood.

label: Atsingani
summary: A small mobile Spring covenant, vassal of Montverte, of Brabançon mercenaries in wagons and tents living by brigandage in southern Normandy Tribunal.

label: Atsingani Tradition
summary: A Byzantine tradition of wandering sorcerers, seers and healers who once served the Emperor Constantine IX.

label: Attica
summary: Region ravens flew from, per Pliny.

label: Attract the Doomed Victim
summary: Each uisge power (MuMe 30) lessening a victim's caution so they climb onto its back.

label: Atzilut
summary: Highest of the Four Worlds (Emanation), the eternal Divine realm.

label: Aubert
summary: Bishop of Avranches who built the chapel on Mont St. Michael; his relics include a skull holed by the archangel.

label: Aubeterre-sur-Dronne
summary: Town with a monolithic church.

label: Auctus
summary: Former Sardinian covenant founded by a Bonisagus, a Criamon and a Merinita to unite Enigmatic, Faerie and Hermetic magic; destroyed by Verdi in 937.

label: Auditor litterarum contradictarum
summary: Papal official who receives appeals to petitions and arbitrates compromises.

label: Aufhocker
summary: A faerie hound variant found in German-speaking areas that acts as a kelpie and clings to foes while goring them, adding to their combat Load.

label: Augsburg
summary: Mining city with secret catacombs.

label: Augustan Brotherhood
summary: Magical organization embedded within the courts of Mythic Europe providing intelligence and service to nobility; could be brought into the Order as a new House.

label: Augustina
summary: Ragoneda's apprentice of eight years, a bone maga working in Animál who seeks adventure.

label: Augustina filia Ragoneda
summary: Maga listed in the index, filia of Ragoneda.

label: Augustinian Canons
summary: Regular canons following the Rule of St. Augustine of Hippo who, unlike monks, are not sequestered from the world and undertake pastoral duties.

label: Augustinian Order
summary: Religious order of which the legate James is a member.

label: Augustus
summary: Octavian, invested as Antistes Mercuria in 11 BC, who rebuilt the temple of Mercury as a massive complex.

label: Aura
summary: A regional concentration of one of the Realms of Power that affects magic within it; magic is opposed by both Divine and Infernal auras, and a covenant's Magical aura can fade or strengthen. A Dominion aura can spring up where holiness accumulates.

label: Aura (Duration)
summary: Faerie ritual Duration lasting while the target remains within a supernatural aura; equivalent to Year.

label: Aura Effect Table
summary: Table giving Personality Trait adjustments of +1 to +3 by aura level for emotion-enhancing auras.

label: Aura of Beguiling Appearance
summary: A Muto Imaginem spell (MuIm 10) variant of Aura of Ennobled Presence that makes the target appear more friendly and credible, granting +3 to win trust and to Charm-based Defense Totals.

label: Aura of Childlike Innocence
summary: A MuIm 10 spell, a variant of Aura of Ennobled Presence, that makes the target appear more guileless and naive, granting bonuses to deflect suspicion and to Guile-based debate defenses.

label: Aura of Ennobled Presence
summary: A spell that changes a magus's image so he appears more convincing, granting a +3 bonus to debating Defense Totals using Leadership; basis for related Tytalan debating spells.

label: Aura of Enobled Presence
summary: Effect wrongly believed bestowed permanently by the Holy Oil.

label: Aura of Ice
summary: Phenomenon mentioned in the bibliography, loosely based on beliefs of people near Mount Connor in Australia.

label: Aura of Inconsequence
summary: ReMe 25 spell deflecting casual attention from the recipient, inspired by Veil All Eyes.

label: Aura of Reason
summary: Aura growing from learning and rational thought in Florence, Bologna, Palermo and Literatus, a threat to magic.

label: Aura of Rightful Authority
summary: A Penetration 0 aura extending to Voice Range possessed by Divine-protected religious and secular leaders such as the Pope, cardinals, archbishops, and crowned kings.

label: Aura of Rightful Authority Pendant
summary: A bejeweled golden pendant crafted by Stentorius and worn by his familiar Oswald, imbued with multiple uses of Aura of Rightful Authority and other effects.

label: Aura of the Ennobled Presence
summary: Spell Alexander the Lame casts to retard aging.

label: Aura Strengthening Table
summary: Table rolled when the yearly aura modifier is +4 or more, with outcomes from new regio levels to permanent aura increase.

label: Aura Variation
summary: Rules by which a Magic aura's current score deviates from its base score due to magical activity and impinging foreign auras.

label: Aura Weakening Table
summary: Table rolled when the yearly aura modifier is -4 or less, with outcomes from vanished regio levels to permanent aura decrease.

label: Auram
summary: Form governing air, weather and gases.

label: Auram province
summary: The Auram-aligned province of the Twilight Void: misty and electric, clouds and smoke shine white and can be walked upon.

label: Auram Resistance
summary: Quality and Ability of storm giants.

label: Aurelia
summary: Parens of Latrunculus.

label: Aurelian
summary: Roman emperor from 270, son of a Sol priestess, who proclaimed Deus Sol Invictus the official deity and built a temple and college in Rome.

label: Aureliana
summary: Founding maga of Atsingani from the Byzantine Atsingani tradition, who led her group west from the Theban Tribunal.

label: Aurelius Ambrosius
summary: Brother of Uther Pendragon who defeated Vortigern and the Saxons and had Merlin bring the Giant's Dance to Britain; slain by treachery.

label: Aurochs
summary: Large, powerful wild cattle of Scandinavia, symbol of Uruz; can be summoned by rune spells.

label: Aurulentus
summary: Magus of House Jerbiton, several of whose forefathers were Gifted.

label: Ausculator
summary: A famous living representative of House Guernicus's earth-magic tradition, leader of the covenant of Hedyosmos in the Theban Tribunal.

label: Auspicious Shape
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is formed into a magically beneficial shape such as a hexagon or pentagram, granting +1 Aesthetics and +1 Vim.

label: Austerius Trianomae
summary: Elderly Bonisagus politician and scholar of the Code, one of the Trianomae, who ruthlessly opposes integrating the Order with mundane society and is close to Final Twilight.

label: Austria
summary: Region of Luciferans and Vagi Scholares.

label: Austringer
summary: A specialist falconer who trains non-falcons such as hawks.

label: Authorities
summary: Angelic choir regulating Creation; Infernal regiones form where they no longer visit.

label: Autocrat
summary: A single covenant official combining two specialist roles (commonly steward and chamberlain), contributing the loyalty points of both.

label: Autodictation
summary: A Rego Terram 15 spell that lets a magus write by talking, inscribing a metal stylus across prepared wax boards as he speaks.

label: Automata
summary: A Major House Mystery for constructing mechanized beasts and men of wood, stone, or metal, imbued with Magic Might and enchanted to perform tasks like servants.

label: Autumn Covenant
summary: A covenant in the mature/declining season of life; Oleron and its rivals are Autumn covenants whose battles focus on weak vassals.

label: Autumn Tenens
summary: Tenens Occultorum overseeing the Roman, Rhine and Greater Alps Tribunals.

label: Autumnus
summary: A powerful Autumn covenant housed in a single enormous magically warmed building atop a mountain peak, ruled by a council of its four oldest magi and protecting a smaller covenant in another Tribunal.

label: Autun
summary: Great Roman city in Burgundy with the Cathedral of St. Lazarus.

label: Auvekoejaks
summary: Vicious tribe of northern merfolk, minions of Tursus, seal or walrus from the waist down, who never run out of javelins.

label: Auvergne
summary: Upland region in eastern Aquitaine where Atsingani currently camps and where the Capuchonnes massacred brigands.

label: Auvergne Fire Elemental
summary: Powerful fire elemental dwelling deep underground, source of hot springs.

label: Auxerre
summary: Holy city with the Abbey of St. Germanus.

label: Auxiliaries
summary: Disciplined grogs and companions supporting the Legion, independently commanded.

label: Avallon
summary: Walled hilltop town with a relic of St. Lazarus.

label: Avalon
summary: Manannan's realm, the Land of Promise, also called Emain Ablach, the Isle of Apples or Avalon.

label: Avarice
summary: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

label: Avaricious
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character hoards money or physical things rather than spending or using them.

label: Avarret
summary: Magus elevated to Primus of House Bonisagus in 1191, returning the House to conservative refinement of Hermetic theory; selected Murion as successor before Final Twilight.

label: Avebury
summary: A village within the largest of many mysterious monuments, a stone circle about a thousand feet across with banks, ditches, inner circles and avenues said to lead somewhere not of this world on particular days.

label: Avengers of Evil
summary: Demonic order claiming to be Angels of Punishment doing God's work, appearing as immense angels of fiery chains; Might up to 25.

label: Avenging Angels
summary: Angels in Mathey.

label: Aventine Hill
summary: Hill in Rome near which Bonisagus found a cache of Cult of Mercury rituals.

label: Avenue
summary: The process of spiritual awakening, purification, and testing by which a Criamon magus reaches a new station, requiring a Lore score, a trial or investiture, and insight from a story.

label: Averna of Tytalus
summary: Corporeal necromancer who fought the Diedne at the Mendip site during the Schism War, leaving undead guardians.

label: Averna's Hogs
summary: Small savage humanoid hog faeries with lead in their flesh.

label: Averroes
summary: A twelfth-century Islamic scholar who refuted al-Ghazali's claims in his book The Incoherence of the Incoherence.

label: Averse to Risk
summary: A Minor Ordeal Flaw making a Verditius magus reluctant to undertake risky laboratory activities, forbidding experimentation; incompatible with Prone to Chance.

label: Avicenna
aliases: Abu Ali al-Hussain Ibn Abdallah Ibn Sina
summary: Abu Ali al-Hussain Ibn Abdallah Ibn Sina (b. 980 near Bukhara), Gifted physician and founder of the Tulab Ibn Sina; entombed in Hamadan.

label: Avranches
summary: Small county and diocesan town on Normandy's border with Brittany.

label: Awaken the Leafy Warders
summary: InHe 35 spell of Whitburh's making plants notify the caster of specified events.

label: Awaken the Slumbering Corpse
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 25) that causes a corpse to function at simple verbal commands; the corpse cannot have been buried by Church ceremony.

label: Awakened Items
summary: Magical devices that become magic things through lab accidents or exposure to the Magic Realm.

label: Awakened Trees

summary: Divinatory method using shooting arrows in the air, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

label: Beloved Enemy
summary: Flaw (usually -2) mixing the Enemy flaw and True Friend virtue: an enemy nurtured through conflict whom one never tries to destroy.

label: Beloved Rival
summary: A formally declared lifelong rivalry within House Tytalus, ceremonially issued with a spiral drawn in blood, persisting until the death of one opponent; also a Minor Story Flaw.

label: Beltaine
summary: Rituals that can hex practitioners of magic, including magi lax in renewing their Parma Magica outside their Aegis.

label: Beltane Fire Festivals
summary: Irish fire festivals that dispel minor Hermetic enchantments and curse witches, forcing the Gifted behind the Aegis of the Hearth.

label: Belvilia
summary: Place near Assisi where Elias Bonibarone was born.

label: Ben Nevis
summary: Tallest mountain in Scotland.

label: Bene Elohim
summary: Sons of God who gave rise to the Nephilim.

label: Benedict
summary: Saint whose Rule the monastic orders follow; those devoted to him are protected from Patarus.

label: Benedictine Abbey of Hersfeld
summary: Abbey near Hersfeld whose monks recorded the flying dog as a miracle.

label: Benedictine Monks
summary: Monks following the Benedictine model whose wilderness monasteries created allodial Church land.

label: Benedictine Order
summary: The oldest and most important monastic order, founded on the rule of Benedict of Nursia, whose monks are known as black monks and number around 3,800 in England.

label: Benefactor
summary: A sponsor who agrees to buy a single piece of artwork from an artist; gaining one grants 3 Artist Reputation experience points.

label: Benefice
summary: Church office income; senior clergy may hold several and employ curates.

label: Benjamin of Tudela
summary: 12th-century traveler from Navarre to Jerusalem who recorded Jewish communities and wrote the Sefer ha-Masa'ot.

label: Beowulf
summary: The hero who slew the troll Grendel; Theoderich has been unable to find his remains.

label: Berechiah ben Natronai haNakdan
summary: A Jewish scribe and author of Oxford (born 1162), secretly a highly skilled natural magician considering contact with the Order to defend the Jews.

label: Berenger
summary: An example fellow alchemist, less skilled than Martin, who learns the cement formula from Martin's Laboratory Text and tractatus.

label: Berenguer of Tytalus
summary: Magus acquitted of molesting the fay after rescuing his apprentice from faeries.

label: Bergen
summary: Port from which Hadrianus sailed.

label: Bergenland
summary: Region listed in the Tribunal index.

label: Bergerac
summary: A thriving port barely an hour's walk from Nidi.

label: Berith the Ennobler
summary: A Spirit of Deceit appearing as a red-clad crowned soldier on a red horse, who makes things seem nobler than they are and produces unworthy noblemen; popular with alchemists.

label: Beriyah
summary: Second of the Four Worlds (Creation), associated by Hermetic magi with the Magic realm.

label: Berkanan
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Birch" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the birch, associated with healing, fertility and youth; usually Herbam, Corpus or Animal as a target.

label: Bern
summary: The city of which Dietrich was boy-king after the fall of Rome; conquered by his uncle Ermenrik and later retaken by Dietrich.

label: Bernard
summary: Young novice in the aligned aura example, made more cowardly by a fear aura.

label: Bernard, Bishop of Puy
summary: Uncle of Peter of Montaigu.

label: Bernard of Clairvaux
summary: Saint and founding abbot of Clairvaux Abbey (1090-1153), a dominant Cistercian Church leader who preached the Second Crusade, supported the military orders and opposed heresy.

label: Bernard of Quintavalle
summary: Founder member of the Franciscans whom player characters may meet.

label: Bernard of Trémélay
summary: Grand Master (1152-1153).

label: Bernard Vigilante de Vida
summary: One of the early followers of Francis.

label: Berne
summary: City founded 1191 by Berthold V, named for a bear.

label: Bernice of Thessalonica
summary: The maga who was Flavius of Jerbiton's teacher, collected him from the Alps, and negotiated with Trianoma to bring Eastern Empire magi into the Order; she died in 763 before the First Tribunal.

label: Bernicia
summary: Saxon kingdom whose capital was Bamburgh.

label: Bernoni
summary: Shadow Senator doubting the Senate's leadership.

label: Berserk
summary: A Virtue causing a creature to fight with reckless fury for greater attack at the cost of defense; possessed by the wild boar and an earth elemental.

label: Berthe
summary: Abbess of Fontrevrault in 1220, in charge for two years.

label: Berthold IV
summary: Zähringer who founded Fribourg in 1157.

label: Berthold V, Duke of Zähringen
summary: Founder of Berne in 1191, who named it after a bear he killed.

label: Bertram de Gurdun
summary: Crossbowman who shot Richard at Chalus.

label: Bertrand de Born
summary: Troubadour with supernatural musical gift.

label: Bertrand of Blanquefort
summary: Grand Master (1156-1169).

label: Berwick
summary: Royal burgh and mint.

label: Beserker Rage
summary: Furies Power granting anyone the Berserk Virtue until they calm down.

label: Bestiarius
summary: School of Beasts used by Bjornaer, substituting Heartbeast for Finesse.

label: Bestiary
summary: A medieval book about the characteristics and behavior of beasts, attributing remarkable powers to animals.

label: Besting the Challenge
summary: Summa on Area Lore: Cursewood by Regulus, Level 3 Quality 9.

label: Beth Din
summary: Rabbinic court hearing cases under halakhic law, led by the Rosh Beth Din.

label: Bethlehem
summary: Pilgrimage destination and rumored cult headquarters of the Magoi of the Star.

label: Bethoc
summary: Daughter and heir of Donald Ban torn apart by her own hunting dogs.

label: Betrayal of the Heart
summary: Iurgator power revealing a secret fact about a target.

label: Betraying Whispers of the Jealous Mind
aliases: Betraying Whispers of the Jealous Mind
summary: An InMe 30 spell that lets the caster hear, as muffled repeated whispers, the dominant emotions other people hold concerning him as they come within earshot.

label: Beuthen
summary: A Polish town with a lead mine operated by the demon Szarlen in return for services under a demonic arrangement.

label: Bezalel
summary: Craftsman who built the Ark, with profound understanding of creation through Hebrew letters.

label: Beziers
summary: Site of a massacre in the Albigensian Crusade.

label: Bia
summary: The Daimon of force, power, and compulsion, daughter of Styx and Pallas, who with her sister Peitho represents forceful inducement.

label: Biarg spirits
summary: Healing/protective spirits to whom ond (Creo, Corpus or Vim vis) is offered; one sustains Asta's daughter.

label: Bibliotheca Historica
summary: Work by Diodorus Siculus describing Egyptian shapechangers who carried books to Thebes.

label: Bibracte
summary: Vassal of Fudarus (822-969) on Mount Beauvray that revived a cult of Vercingetorix and was destroyed by Wizard Wars from Montverte magi.

label: Bielowezca Forest
summary: A forest in Poland where Ulf's ancestor Lupercus haunts in the form of an immense wolf Great Beast.

label: Bielowiezca
summary: A forest in whose region the example Bjornaer magus Ulf drives out a village of hunters and becomes leader of the largest wolf-packs as part of his Great Beast's trials.

label: Big and Little Harcar
summary: Islands with Magic aura 2; Big Harcar is a level 4 vestige tethered to Leviathan and the site of many wrecks.

label: Big and Little Scarcar
summary: Two rock pillars in the inner Farnes with a narrow gut where a small boat can be moored safely.

label: Big Angus
summary: A prize fighter whom no one has ever beaten in bare-knuckle fighting; in a story seed, grogs can win back lost money by defeating him.

label: Bigamist
summary: A major Story Flaw where a merchant lives two entirely separate lives with two spouses and households in two cities, raising annual business costs.

label: Bilera
summary: The Prima of House Guernicus, an Archmaga with a neutral stance on the Traditionalist/Transitionalist debate, residing at Magvillus.

label: Binah
summary: Sefirah meaning 'Insight', level 8 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 8.

label: Bind Curse
summary: A Major Inner House Mystery of Verditius developed by Himinis the Mad for instilling powerful curses into items, requiring the Sever the Ties That Bind Ordeal.

label: Bind Magical Creatures
summary: A Major House Mystery developed in the Thebes Tribunal that binds a magical creature's life force to an enchanted device or binds one of its powers to the magus's Gift.

label: Bind the Devil's Hands
summary: PeVi Gen hindering Infernal Powers in a room.

label: Bind The Gift
summary: A Rego Vim 30 enchanted effect in Philippus Niger's Wizard's Bridle that prevents the casting of any spells of level 25 or below as a constant effect.

label: Bind the Living Ghost
summary: Cr(Pe/Re)Me(Co) Mystery Ritual defining a Living Ghost's Haunt, destroying the body and binding the spirit.

label: Bind the Mystical Structure
summary: ReVi Mystery Ritual linking the component devices of a Hermetic Architecture enchantment into one working whole.

label: Bind the Wound
summary: CrCo 10 spell known by Edwin.

label: Bind Wound
summary: A Creo Corpus spell (Level 10) that binds the target's wounds so activity does not worsen them, though wound penalties and inability to heal naturally remain.

label: Binding Oath
summary: Ritual faerie power (Vim) enforcing a solemnly sworn oath; oathbreakers are warned and then suffer a Flaw.

label: Binding the Gift
summary: A Minor House Mystery (Virtue) taught by Merinita that lets a magus share his Gift's social quality through the familiar cords, moderating the Gift's penalties via the Golden, Silver, Bronze Gifts and the three cords.

label: Binding the Hermetic Codex
summary: A Rego Animal 20 ritual variant of Binding the Mundane Codex that incorporates resonant materials into book bindings.

label: Binding the Immortal Memory
summary: CrMe Mystery enchantment that binds studied experience into an immortal's talisman at level 10 x XP.

label: Binding the Magic Spirit
summary: ReVi 51 effect in Regulus' Tablet binding a Magic being in a circle.

label: Binding the Mundane Codex
summary: A Rego Animal 5 spell that binds up to 1,000 prepared bifolds into books and grants readers the +1 quality bonus for sound binding.

label: Bingen
summary: A walled town at the southern edge of the Rhine Gorge where the Nahe meets the Rhine, guarded by Burg Klopp; near the Mouse Tower and home of Hildegard's Rupertsberg monastery.

label: Bingen Hole
summary: A hazardous stretch of the Rhine immediately downstream of Bingen, where rocks, accelerating flow, and treacherous eddies make navigation perilous.

label: Biorn Egilsson
summary: Old galdraman and leader of the galdramen hreppur, slain by Julius on the Night of Tears after requesting a dialog in Latin.

label: Birchwood wand
summary: Wand serving as a young Tremere magus's sigil, used to ignite the funeral pyre.

label: Bird Bane
summary: MuAn 44 harness giving a cat feathered wings.

label: Bird Dog
summary: Dog trained for hawking; the best come from Iberia and are called espagnols or spaniels.

label: Bird Women
summary: Faeries forced to be spouses when their feather cloaks are stolen.

label: Birds of Nephelococcygia
summary: Intelligent birds inhabiting Nephelococcygia, not Beasts of Virtue, playable as magical characters with song-based powers.

label: Birkebeiners
summary: Norwegian political group ('birchfeet') that supported the northern kings in forty years of civil war.

label: Birth Apparitions
summary: Visions or supernatural beings that appear at the birth of important people with realm-linked Virtues or Flaws.

label: Birthing Faerie
summary: Threshold faerie attracted by a pregnant mother.

label: Bishop
summary: Head of a diocese, highest of the major orders; bishops are elected rather than examined and may grant petitions up to Ease Factor 15.

label: Bishop Adam
summary: Bishop of Caithness, possibly a faerie, found as a baby in a basket and killed over a butter tax.

label: Bishop-baron
summary: A bishop who is also a feudal lord, typically with about 50 vassal knights, entangled in feudal disputes and warfare against canon law.

label: Bishop Hatto
summary: The demonic shade (Infernal Might 30, Mentem) of the greedy archbishop Hatto II of Mainz, who haunts the Mausturm island and attacks with a chilling touch and powers of fear.

label: Bishop of Bayeux
summary: Bishop who wielded a mace at the Battle of Hastings.

label: Bishop of Mende
summary: Bishop who is also Count of Gévaudan, holding the Majaridas for the French crown.

label: Bishop of Orléans
summary: Feared not all Orléans heretics had been captured.

label: Bishop of Speyer
summary: Bishop who in 1084 granted land and rights to the Jewish community in exchange for annual rent.

label: Bishop of Toul
summary: Ordered all Waldensians chained and tried in 1192.

label: Bishop Orris
summary: Churchman from Antagonists representing the Church's strong distrust of magic and the Order.

label: Bishop's Platter
summary: A wondrous silver serving tray made by a silversmith that copies the spell Taste of the Spices and Herbs (Craft Level 13).

label: Bishop's Quarter
summary: South-east corner of Bath containing the palace, priory and baths.

label: Bishop Werner of Straussburg
summary: Ancestor of the Hapsburgs who built the castle of Hapsburg in the 11th century.

label: Bitter Taste of Betrayal
summary: InVi 15 spell giving a bitter taste when the caster's Parma is penetrated by new magic.

label: Bjorn Ironside
summary: A deputy of Waddenzee who is the ship's master of the Nebelkönigin.

label: Bjornaer Septs
summary: Divisions within House Bjornaer.

label: Black Boar of the Bog
summary: Beast of Virtue, a huge black boar with Magic Might 20 guarding a swampy wood; powers Protect the Herd and Terror of the Charging Boar.

label: Black Boar Tusks
summary: Enriched tusks of the Black Boar that grant Berserk to their bearer in battle.

label: Black Book
summary: Sacred Yezidi text.

label: Black Cat Wards
summary: Group of protective powers used by Black Cats to defend homes or settlements from minor faeries and demons.

label: Black Death
summary: A demon appearing as a shrouded reaper, invisible to mundane senses, summoned by an Infernal ritual; it does not exist in 1220 Mythic Europe but arises in 1347 in Constantinople if the saga follows history.

label: Black Dog Hide Cowl
summary: Cowl from a Black Dog's Enriched hide granting Puissant Stealth.

label: Black Dog of the Moor
summary: A magical hound with tracking powers who frees mistreated hounds and is hunted by a local noble in a story seed.

label: Black Dogs
summary: Class of solitary black hounds known throughout northern Europe under many names, wrongly thought Infernal.

label: Black Faced Hermes
summary: Faerie that comes down the chimney to take away unnatural children, abducting the Gifted and leaving them at covenant doors.

label: Black Forest
summary: The largest forest in western Europe in the south-west of the Rhine Tribunal, an impenetrable sinister faerie wilderness with a Faerie aura, ruled by the King of the Black Mountain.

label: Black Forest Road
summary: The only road across the Black Forest, built by the Roman 8th legion under Cornelius Clemens between Strassburg and Augsburg, with magical milestones warding away supernatural denizens.

label: Black Horseman
summary: Demon of the third seal bearing balances.

label: Black Lineage
summary: An intelligent lineage of cats descended from House Jerbiton's Founder's familiar that understand human language, often have Second Sight, live around 40 years, and have a parliament that elects a monarch (the King of the Cats).

label: Black Mark
summary: Splinter Criamon society believing the Dominion will destroy all magic; possibly Infernally inspired. La murdered a priest under its precepts.

label: Black Mass
summary: Perversion of the Mass possibly practiced by corrupt Cluniacs.

label: Black Mountains
summary: Mountains in south Wales where the covenant Blackthorn is hidden in a warren of caves and where Goliard once subdued an elemental spirit causing rockslides.

label: Black Sea
summary: Sea between the Theban, Transylvanian and Novgorod Tribunals, with hundreds of faerie islands.

label: Black Serpent of the Barrow
summary: A serpent dwelling in a barrow on the Mournful Mound that kills the sons of the King of Suffering daily and carries a wish-granting gold stone in its tail; slain by Peredur.

label: Black Sheep
summary: A minor Flaw representing estrangement from one's family or social group, likely to inconvenience a principal and lower an agent's Resistance Strength.

label: Black Terrors
summary: Weakest faeries observed: dark shapes on children's walls with 1 Might.

label: Black Truffle
summary: Purplish-black truffle growing on oak and hazel roots in Normandy, Provence and Iberia, best in Périgord.

label: Black Whisper
summary: A spell in which the caster whispers a magic sentence into the target's ear; if completed, the target must resist a Stamina roll or go completely insane.

label: Blackberry Cat
summary: Cat power, also called Feigned Innocence, making a group forget something the cat did.

label: Blackberry God
summary: A powerful faerie harvest deity worshipped in the Worshipful covenant's regio; the magi side with him as a Faerie Landlord and provide him vast amounts of beer.

label: Blacklisting
summary: Informal House Mercere sanction in which Redcaps refuse to recognize a covenant or magus, losing records and messages.

label: Blackmail
summary: A Flaw used to represent coercion of an agent by a principal, such as a priest controlling a knight through blackmail or other leverage.

label: Blackrose
summary: Covenant founded by Blackthorn in 1104 on the North York Moors near Voluntas; recalled in 1107 after persistent mundane troubles.

label: Blacksmith's Son
summary: Sample seven-year-old grog, a bully with Magic Sensitivity and No Sense of Direction.

label: Blacksmithing
summary: Ability listed in the text.

label: Blackthorn
summary: A powerful covenant in caves under the Black Mountains of south Wales that long dominated the tribunal; home of praeco Talion and seat of recent Stonehenge tribunals.

label: Blackthorn of Virtue
summary: Tree whose 13 Enriched thorns grant a Magic-aligned Hex power usable once each; may instead be harvested for 2 pawns of Perdo vis.

label: Blade of the Virulent Flame
summary: A Creo Ignem spell (Level 15) that forms fire along a metal blade, doubling the weapon's damage (or adding +5) and starting fires; repeated castings can melt the blade.

label: Bladud
summary: Legendary Celtic prince and cthonic wizard-king who founded Bath and its hot springs, founded a university at Stamford, and died when his enchanted wings failed over the Temple of Apollo.

label: Bladud's enchanted wings
summary: Wings that failed over the Temple of Apollo.

label: Bladud's Library
summary: A secret cave library of magical lore gathered by Bladud, written in a lost language and invaluable to a covenant if found.

label: Blain
summary: Place where two minor trade routes cross, with a small castle and busy market.

label: Blanca of Navarre
summary: Mother and regent of Theobald IV, loyal to King Philip.

label: Blaringhem
summary: Town in Flanders where Saint Ursmar's relics were humiliated in 1060.

label: Blatant Magic
summary: Flaw gained through Extraction of the Soul.

label: Blatant Magical Air
summary: A Major Supernatural Flaw for characters with a Magical Air or The Gift: a -6 penalty to social actions and being hated and feared by the mundane population.

label: Blautopf Pool
summary: A deep-blue round pool at the southern edge of the Swabian Jura, source of the River Blau, with a Faerie aura and home to the water faerie Schöne Lau.

label: Bleeding Stone
summary: Stone in a cavern below Lapis Crudus's council chamber, source of its name and of Corpus and Terram vis.

label: Blending with Substance
summary: Enchantment letting a magus embed small items in his flesh for talisman attunement, at the cost of Warping.

label: Blessed Cyprian
summary: Penitent magician who may perform a miracle to be recognized as a saint, long awaited by House Jerbiton.

label: Blessed Relief of the Benighted Reins
aliases: Blessed Relief of the Benighted Reins
summary: A Rego Corpus 25 spell that magically removes a kidney stone from a patient's body into the caster's hand, requiring an Intelligence + Finesse roll.

label: Blessing
summary: A gruagach Form that temporarily grants Virtues, Ability bonuses and Characteristic improvements; Take Blessing removes them. All Blessing spells use the Limit Duration.

label: Blessing of Childlike Bliss
summary: A spell that reduces an adult mind to a child's level, so the target reasons and expresses emotion as a three-year-old and cannot cast spells.

label: Blessing of Mercury
summary: CrVi 30 ritual granting +3 to Casting and Laboratory totals for a Year.

label: Blessing of the Swordsman's Expertise
summary: GvBl 20 spell giving the target +2 to Single Weapon (or another Ability in variants) until a Limit is met.

label: Blessing of Urban Wisdom for the Rustic
aliases: Blessing of Urban Wisdom for the Rustic
summary: GvBl 20 spell granting the target the Clear Thinker Virtue with a general Limit.

label: Blight the Household
summary: Fictiles Power spoiling food and blighting crops.

label: Blind
summary: A Major General Flaw: the character has little or no sight, making missile weapons futile and reading impossible; blind magi cannot aim spells without magical aid.

label: Blinding Reflection
summary: Chalkydri power.

label: Blindness
summary: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

label: Blisters of Humility
summary: Saint curse covering the target with boils for a week.

label: Blitild
summary: Daughter of King Clothar claimed as ancestor by the Carolingians.

label: Blizzard demons
summary: Alpine demons that cause blizzards, break travelers' faith and slay them.

label: Blizzard of Down
summary: Miklos's CrAn 20 spell that blinds and buries a group in feathery down.

label: Block voting
summary: Tremere practice of voting as a bloc at Tribunal via free proxies to the Tribune.

label: Blood Feud
summary: Highland clan feud escalating from insults to full-scale raids.

label: Blood Haze
summary: Minor Hermetic Flaw: the maga is crazed by bloodshed, penalizing Formulaic magic and Concentration in combat.

label: Blood Libel
summary: Unfounded accusation that Jews practice human sacrifice.

label: Blood Oath of Becoming a Member of Ikhwan as-Safa'
aliases: Blood Oath of Becoming a Member of Ikhwan as-Safa'
summary: Initiation Script granting Philosophical Refining and Weak Elementalist Resistance.

label: Blood of Heroes
summary: Special free Virtue making a character a Mythic Companion descended from a hero; allows Heroic Virtues and Flaws.

label: Blood of the Bee King
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue for children of Bee Kings: slower aging and the ability to give simple instructions to bees they touch.

label: Blood of the Nephilim
aliases: Major Virtue Blood of the Nephilim
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting angelic descent, increased Size, very slow aging, and Dominion Lore, but heavy food requirements and many restrictions.

label: Blood of the Sun
summary: Listed in the Tribunal index.

label: Blood of the Telechines
summary: Heritage granting +1 Dexterity and an extra Major Virtue (usually Ways of the Waters), with the Supernatural Nuisance Flaw.

label: Blood Rights
summary: Example case of a maga's claim to her own Gifted child against a magus's formal claim of apprenticeship.

label: Bloodcap Blood
summary: Faerie Blood variety from bloodcaps granting a Strength bonus.

label: Bloodcap Faerie
summary: Wicked, violent faeries of battlefields and ruined towers with long teeth and talons who dye their caps in their foes' blood.

label: Bloodline
summary: Gruagach Target affecting a bloodline.

label: Bloodline Target
summary: Hermetic target parameter usable by Merinita for inheritance spells.

label: Bloodstone of Virtue
summary: Stone containing 1 pawn of Creo vis that, when Enriched, grants Rapid Convalescence while the bearer rests in bed.

label: Bloody Flux
summary: A Serious Phlegmatic Disease (excess of phlegm) caused by cold, wet living conditions, common in towns and armies.

label: Bludgeon
summary: Inexpensive crushing Brawl weapon.

label: Blue Apples of Twilight
summary: Poisonous blue apples from a tree rising over a Roman slave grave 13 times a year; fermented, they yield Perdo vis.

label: Blue Springs of the Somme
summary: Enchanted pools with Faerie auras up to 3 inhabited by mischievous water sprites.

label: Bluebeard
summary: Faerie role of a handsome husband who turns hideous when his wife breaks a taboo and sees his victims' corpses.

label: Blunt the Viper's Fangs
summary: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 20) that blunts the natural weapons (claws, teeth, talons) of a beast, halving their damage.

label: Blunted Weapon
summary: Slashing or piercing weapons blunted for tournaments, subtracting 3 from Damage.

label: Blwchbardd
summary: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

label: Boðvar Bjarki
summary: Norse folk hero whose hamr took the shape of a great white bear in battle.

label: Boar
summary: Malicious, dangerous prey hunted from midsummer through autumn with a boar spear.

label: Boar Helm
summary: Coenwulf's enchanted Saxon boar-crested helmet, his magical focus that changes with him.

label: Boar King
summary: A faerie once worshiped by the Gauls who dwells in a wooden fortress in a Faerie regio (aura 7) and claims the forests of the Normandy Tribunal; a former ally of House Diedne.

label: Boar of Virtue
summary: Lesser Magic boars ridden by truffle drones and kept in the truffle fields, possessing The Unimpeded Traveler power.

label: Boar Spear
summary: Special spear with a bar across the haft for boar hunting.

label: Boar Tattoo
summary: Example Give Blessing tattoo Dombnall creates for a Single Weapon bonus.

label: Boating
summary: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

label: Boaz
summary: One of two great hollowed stone pillars ("great strength") of Solomon's temple legend that hold treasures of the ancient Hebrews.

label: Bocage
summary: Norman practice of dividing fields with low stone walls into small allotments.

label: Bocan
summary: A helpful type of Scottish faerie mentioned alongside brownies.

label: Bockman
summary: A horrible goat-headed faerie that lurks on Black Forest paths to ambush travelers using its Unease of the Still Forest and Fear powers; physically weak and cowardly, with Animal and Mentem vis in its horns.

label: Body of Brass
summary: Miser's Pot Power making it immune to fatigue and disease.

label: Body of Fire
summary: Power of fire elementals.

label: Body of Stone
summary: Stoneskinned power improving brawling statistics.

label: Body-of-water
summary: Special Atlantean Target covering an entire lake, river or sea; equal to Structure.

label: Boethius
summary: A Roman statesman, philosopher, and inventor whose notebooks Milo recovered; his philosophical principles were used to refine Verditius Runes, and a ritual was named after him.

label: Boggart
summary: English trickster spirit causing havoc in the home; a brownie that has decided to be malicious.

label: Boglin
summary: A foul, tentacled, primeval swamp spirit (Magic Might 25, Aquam) of northern Germany that lurks underwater, drags prey to its maw, and yields Animal and Perdo vis.

label: Bogomils
summary: Dualist successors of the Manichees.

label: Bohemia
summary: A subject kingdom of the Rhine Tribunal's southeastern lands, ruled by the Premyslid dynasty; a land of forested plains crossed by the River Elbe with few great cities.

label: Bohemian Truffle
summary: Above-ground truffle found in the Rhine, Greater Alps and Normandy Tribunals whose mature gel is a natural dye.

label: Bohemond, Count of Tripoli
summary: Reclaimed Antioch in 1219; supported by the Templars.

label: Bohort
summary: Informal, impromptu tournament with blunted or wooden weapons.

label: Boii Springs
summary: Twelve hot mineral springs in western Bohemia near a Celtic settlement, including a 40-foot geyser; drinking the waters cures digestive disorders and the name derives from the Celtic Boii tribe.

label: Boiled Leather
summary: Tough stiff armor material; cuir boulli is a variant.

label: Boiling River
summary: River of sulfur and blood in Purgatory where traitors are thrown; it flows into the Mouth of Hell.

label: Boiteux
summary: Mastiff son of Affreux and Anacrôn's Magical Animal Companion; pulls his trolley.

label: Bologna
summary: A famous student-run university in northern Italy, the finest legal school in Mythic Europe, organized around student nations and faculties of Law and of Arts and Medicine.

label: Bologna Lore
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

label: Bologna Scholar
summary: Companion vocation: a University of Bologna student taught about the Order by the magi of Literatus.

label: Bologna Way
summary: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

label: Bolos of Mendes
summary: Probable ultimate origin of Pseudo-Democritus' tradition, two centuries before Christ.

label: Bomburkhan
summary: A minor imp demon (Might 5, Vim) appearing as a jet-black bat with a human face who punctures the egos of the prideful by granting talents that contradict boasts; released after the fall of Jerusalem.

label: Boncompagno
summary: The rector of Bologna's Faculty of Arts, a famous rhetorician proposing to erect a dedicated building to house the university's learning.

label: Bond
summary: A Personality Trait expressing why and how strongly an agent is attached to a principal.

label: Bond Cords
summary: The Bronze, Silver and Gold cords linking magus and familiar; Radislav also forged an Enigmatic cord.
