label: Compress of Mallow
summary: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Mild, a cool bandage of mallow and cucumber that soothes burns and heals any Light Wound caused by fire over a week.

label: Compulsion
summary: A Personality Flaw driving a creature toward a behavior; wolves have Compulsion (killing) reflecting their bloodthirsty medieval perception.

label: Compulsion (Lies)
summary: A Flaw compelling Imanitos Mendax to lie.

label: Compulsive
summary: Flaw listed in this text.

label: Compulsive Lying
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw: the character finds it hard to tell the truth and embellishes or invents stories whenever he won't be immediately caught.

label: Compurgation
summary: Canon court ritual in which about a dozen witnesses swear to the defendant's good character, acquitting him.

label: Compurgator
summary: Oath-helper witness; a lord asks peasants to act as compurgators and lie about disputed land.

label: Comraich
summary: The sanctuary lands of a Scottish Church monastery, protected by its Dominion.

label: Comyn family
summary: Powerful Scottish family that squabbled with Alan Durward during Alexander III's minority.

label: Conaing
summary: A Fomóir leader magically put to sleep by Lugh; the Hibernian replacement for Dindyméné.

label: Conall the Gruagach
summary: UnGifted gruagach and hunter, blamed for every mishap, who shapeshifts into a bear and studies under Domhnall.

label: Concealment
summary: Difficulty of seeing a character due to darkness, foliage or invisibility, granting Defense and Attack bonuses.

label: Concentrated Potions
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue allowing a folk witch to use up to four times her Folk Witch Magic Theory in vis when brewing.

label: Concentration
summary: An Ability used to maintain concentration on spells and against disruptions such as sneezing; rolled to release individuals from Coils of the Entangling Plants.

label: Conches
summary: Chartered village outside an abbey in Normandy.

label: Conciatta
summary: Maga of House Bonisagus who expanded Hermetic understanding across the four realms; author of The Application of Vim to the Supernatural Humors, whose lost research may reduce aura penalties including the Dominion.

label: Concierges
summary: Specialist porters of merchant houses who work both sides of the Gates, suffering heavy warping.

label: Conciliarius
summary: Member of the Tremere Council holding his own sigil; councilor and counselor.

label: Concoction of Litharge and Henbane
summary: A Theriac of Level 15, Potency Strong, a poison combining litharge, henbane, cinnabar and other ingredients that inflicts a Heavy Wound unless the imbiber succeeds at a Stamina roll.

label: Concordat of Worms
summary: Charter signed in 1122 dividing rights between Pope Calixtus II and Emperor Henry V over investiture of bishops.

label: Concordia
summary: A short-lived covenant (821–823) in the Lake District that attempted to weld Ex Miscellanea traditions together but fell apart from internal tension.

label: Condensed Notation
summary: Optional way of writing combat scores for weapon and shield combinations.

label: Confarreation
summary: Marriage by contract signed before ten witnesses; binding under Hermetic law if a quaesitor witnesses (dotal contract).

label: Confession of the Penitent
summary: A Power held by the She-Wolf that a lupercus can acquire as a Lesser Power Virtue instead of Scales of the Heart.

label: Confidence
summary: A pool of points a character can spend to add +3 per point to a roll after seeing the result; points are awarded for achievements and good roleplaying.

label: Confidence Point
summary: A point a character can spend (for example) to walk away from a situation that would otherwise increase a Verditius magus's Hubris score.

label: Confirmation
summary: Sacrament in which a Christian receives the Holy Spirit, granting a Faith Point.

label: Confluensis
summary: Quaesitorial covenant of the Normandy Tribunal, founded in 810, which moved to the Orchard of Sour Apples in 1051 and opposes the creation of a Lotharingian Tribunal.

label: Confound the Truth
summary: BaalBaruth's power creating convincing false theological arguments.

label: Confraternity Member
summary: A Minor Story Flaw marking membership in one of the smaller cults of magi in House Verditius, granting access to a confraternity's unique Inner Mystery.

label: Confraternity of Balento
summary: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Balento that produces wood-carved devices imbued with fire spells, with members claiming descent from Vulcan.

label: Confraternity of Himinis the Mad
summary: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Himinis the Mad that produces cursed items and trick devices using the Bind Curse Mystery.

label: Confraternity of Irene the Younger
summary: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by the Byzantine princess Irene that creates magical paintings, statues, and mosaics affecting viewers and surroundings.

label: Confraternity of Roland
summary: A confraternity of House Verditius founded by Roscius that crafts magical swords engraved with an 'R', studying the sword Durendal.

label: Confreres and Consoeurs
summary: Associate members of the Templars.

label: Confuse
summary: Hagbui power (ReMe 15) like Confusion of the Numbed Will.

label: Confuse Predator
summary: White Stag power confusing enemies.

label: Confusion of the Insane Vibrations
summary: A Rego Imaginem spell (Level 30) that makes the target see everything vibrate and hear displaced sounds, imposing -3 on Attack and Defense and extra botch dice.

label: Confusion of the Numbed Will
summary: A spell that confuses a person, who must make an Intelligence roll to take direct action and always strikes last in combat.

label: Conjunction of the Mystic Veils
summary: Re(Mu)Vi 45 Mystery enchantment creating a password-opened gateway between two levels of a magical regio, typically as two pillars.

label: Conjuration of Bread
summary: CrHe 35 ritual creating enough long-lived bread (ciabatta) to feed a moderate covenant for a season, giving +7 to a besieged castle's Supply rolls.

label: Conjuration of the Indubitable Cold
summary: A Perdo Ignem spell (Level 25) that cools the air within ten paces below freezing, chilling nonliving things thoroughly and costing living things a Fatigue level while shrinking fires.

label: Conjuration of the Tasty Tea
summary: Creo Aquam 5 effect of the Potent Pot of Tasty Tea.

label: Conjuration of Wild Thyme
summary: A Creo Herbam 20 Ritual spell that creates ten thousand doses of wild thyme, prepared and dried; a different spell is required for each herb.

label: Conjure
summary: Faerie Power producing solid glamours and transforming targets into glamours.

label: Conjure Spices
summary: Gourmand's Power summoning spices, herbs and plant poisons.

label: Conjure the Sturdy Vine
summary: A Creo Herbam spell (Level 5) that grows 10 paces of strong, pliable vine suitable for use as rope from wood or fertile soil.

label: Conjuring the House of God
summary: A ritual Creo Terram spell (Level 45) that creates an unconsecrated church with vaulted ceilings, towers, and stained glass windows.

label: Conjuring the Mystic Tower
summary: A Creo spell that conjures a stone tower, allowing the caster to determine the layout of its chambers; can also be used by a magus to construct a lab building.

label: Conrad
summary: Inquisitor described in the 1233 letter who suggested names of accused to victims.

label: Conrad II
summary: German emperor who defeated Odo of Champagne at Bar.

label: Conrad of Urach
summary: A cardinal legate present in Montpellier preparing to announce the pope's desired statutes that would make the Bishop of Maguelone the university's sole authority.

label: Conrad the Salian
summary: Emperor whose empire absorbed the Kingdom of Burgundy in 1033.

label: Consecrated ground
summary: Ground protected against Ihwaz corpse-animation and speaking with the dead.

label: Consecration
summary: Blessing of a site or altar, often by interring relics beneath it, required before a Dominion can be created.

label: Consecration of Mercury's House
summary: CrVi 55 ritual consecrating a temple to Mercury and creating a Magic aura 1.

label: Consequences
summary: Story component covering what results from the characters' actions, including political ramifications and rewards such as experience, Confidence Points, and changes in Personality Traits and Reputations.

label: Consolamentum
summary: Cathar ritual laying on of hands substituted for sacraments.

label: Consolations of Philosophy
summary: Boethius' tractatus on Philosophiae (Quality 9).

label: Consolidation of Scotland
summary: Period 840-900 when Pictish culture disappeared and Diedne ascended over Ex Miscellanea.

label: Consors
summary: An acknowledged asset of the covenant, as which a companion lord may receive magical support.

label: Consortes
summary: Trusted non-magi who handle a covenant's day-to-day affairs.

label: Conspiracy
summary: Allying with mundanes in common cause, which the Code forbids. Aid given without the recipient's knowledge is not conspiracy.

label: Constable
summary: Royal officer title; in France the Constable leads the army and may countermand the king in battle.

label: Constance
summary: Lesser Secundus of House Jerbiton at Valnastium, over 130 years old, trained as a Verditius follower and a leading Crafter who builds grand laboratories.

label: Constance filia Vortimer
summary: Secundus of House Jerbiton, a core member of Valnastium.

label: Constance of Brittany
summary: Widow of Geoffrey and mother of Arthur of Brittany.

label: Constant Damaging Effect
summary: Orm Personal Faerie Power emitting noxious slime or toxic breath for +5 Damage.

label: Constant Powers
summary: Greater, Lesser or Personal Powers made to trigger automatically at sunrise and sunset, costing Might each time.

label: Constanta the Tessellatrix
summary: A student of the Jerbiton Primus Andru, extremely active in coordinating her fellow antigones.

label: Constantina filia Andru of Jerbiton
summary: Young firebrand trained by the Primus, currently Mathieus's designated heir.

label: Constantine
summary: Roman emperor who supported Sol Invictus early, then converted to Christianity after seeing a glowing cross in 312 and made it the Empire's religion.

label: Constantine Alexander of Jerbiton
summary: Author of the Terram summa A Material Inspired by the Divine.

label: Constantine IX
summary: Emperor whom the Atsingani seers served in the mid-11th century.

label: Constantine of Mercere
summary: Redcap who entered Dorisa's sanctum to collect a debt of twelve pawns; the charges were dismissed.

label: Constantine V
summary: Byzantine Emperor, son of Leo III, against whom the League of Iconophiles was still intriguing at the time of the First Tribunal as monasteries were sacked and icons burned.

label: Constantinople
summary: The great trading city at the gateway between Europe and the Orient, founded as Byzantium in 658 BC and renamed by Emperor Constantine; captured by the Fourth Crusade in 1204 to become the Latin Empire's seat.

label: Constantinople Street
summary: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. It is currently bricked up due to civic reconstruction city-side.

label: Constitutions of Clarendon
summary: Accepted by Thomas Becket at Templar persuasion.

label: Constrict
summary: Orm natural power encoiling a victim, dealing automatic damage until broken free.

label: Constriction
summary: Optional grapple-based attack by which dragons and worms suffocate victims.

label: Constriction Attack
summary: Grapple-based attack by a larger creature that deprives its victim of air.

label: Constructing the Memory Palace
summary: CrMe 20 Ritual permanent locus.

label: Consumed Casting Tools
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw, only for Verditius magi: the magus's casting tools are magically consumed after use, taking an hour to remake.

label: Consummate Talisman
summary: Major Hermetic Mystery Virtue allowing Muto Vim effects and Names of Power to be enchanted into a talisman to affect the magus's own spellcasting.

label: Contagion
summary: A natural principle (pars pro toto) by which substances acquire second qualities through association or contact, underlying Arcane Connections.

label: Contagious Obsession
summary: Vessels of Iniquity Power making Obsession victims carriers who spread it.

label: Container for Ephemeral Vis
summary: Enchanted seashell or crystal to capture and release insubstantial vis.

label: Contemplative Mysticism
summary: Mystical path of imitating Christ via theosis; its Divine Ascent takes the form of Divine Form and it progresses by Spiritual Paths.

label: Contested Resource
summary: Hook costing exclusive access to a luctatio.

label: Conti Family
summary: One of Rome's great noble families.

label: Continence
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw: the character does not engage in sexual activity, due to a vow of celibacy or personal choice.

label: Continent
summary: Flaw whose restriction the owner of Enriched Fennel of Virtue must observe, or its power fades.

label: Continuous Research
summary: Optional rule granting Lab Total bonuses for uninterrupted seasons on a single project.

label: Contortions
summary: Exceptional Talent.

label: Contra Haereticos
summary: Divine Lore summa by Hugh of Amiens compiled with an Infernal Lore tractatus.

label: Control Environment of Fudarus
summary: Six enchantments of the Rod of the Primus varying light, heat, portals, smells, noises and textures.

label: Control Fertility
summary: A Supernatural Ability that enhances or withdraws the vegetative spirits in living things, affecting fertility, milk yield, conception, and disease; the defining Virtue of the Scinnfolk.

label: Control Human
summary: Typical spirit power of eidolons, lugra, and some genii loci.

label: Control Spirit
summary: Rego Vim 55 power of the Circlet of the Primus commanding spirits.

label: Control the Hungry Beast
summary: Power of awakened truffles to mollify any beast so it no longer finds them interesting, threatening, or edible.

label: Control the Waters
summary: Focus Power.

label: Controlling
summary: Elementalist Technique based on Presence that lets an elementalist dictate the behavior of summoned or encountered targets via gesture and incantation.

label: Conversation
summary: Gruagach Range equivalent to Touch/Eye, requiring conversation within three paces.

label: Converse with Plant and Tree
summary: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 25) that lets you speak with a plant for one conversation, with detail depending on the plant's type.

label: Converse with Plants and Trees
summary: Spell (InHe 25) known by Amberitus.

label: Conversing with the Sea
summary: Auvekoejak power allowing them to ask questions of their local part of the ocean.

label: Convoluted Mind
summary: Minor General Tainted Virtue giving +3 to Infernal Lore rolls to predict demons and a Common Sense-like feeling when dealing with demons.

label: Copper Rooster
summary: Mercere-owned inn in Basel used as a redcap message point.

label: Copper Rooster Inn
summary: An inn at Basel maintained by House Mercere, frequented by Redcaps traveling between the Alps, Rhine, and Normandy Tribunals.

label: Coquillards
summary: A court of Parisian argotiers who carry forged pilgrim certificates.

label: Corazzo
summary: Abbey in Calabria where Joachim took the Cistercian habit.

label: Corbie
summary: Benedictine abbey founded by St. Bathilde, major theological center where Carolingian script developed.

label: Cordovan Cuirbolli
summary: Level 5 Minor alchemical reagent turning hides into superior boiled leather, reducing Craft Ease Factors by 2.

label: Cords
summary: Gold, Silver and Bronze cords measuring a familiar's bond.

label: Corinth
summary: Site of an ancient shrine to Lamia and of Apollonios's wedding confrontation.

label: Cornelius Clemens
summary: The Roman commander of the 8th legion who built the Black Forest Road during the rule of Vespasian, aided by Mercurian priests.

label: Cornu Ammonis of Virtue
summary: Horn of Ammon, a coiled stone with 2 pawns of Intellego vis that, Enriched, grants prophetic dream Visions to one sleeping on it.

label: Cornwall
summary: English county whose people paid King John 5,000 marks to be deforested.

label: Coronation
summary: Elaborate ceremony, involving bishops, a great church and anointing, required to establish a new king.

label: Coronation and anointing
summary: Rite granting kings Magic Resistance, Soak, and Commanding Aura.

label: Coroner
summary: English office of four elected knights per shire who curb sheriffs, collect royal rights, and collect murdrum.

label: Corong Gorge
summary: Gorge with genius loci.

label: Corpse Magic
summary: A Supernatural Ability allowing the character to temporarily revive and command a relatively intact, unburied corpse.

label: Corpus
summary: Form governing the human body.

label: Corpus province
summary: The Corpus-aligned province of the Twilight Void: glowing human figures and remains, with health and age visible.

label: Corpuscles
summary: Building blocks of matter with shape: cubes for earth, icosahedra for water, octahedra for air, tetrahedra for fire.

label: Corrector
summary: Chancery official who approves drafted papal letters; usually two.

label: Correspondence
summary: Letters between magi that grant experience and may serve as debate testimony.

label: Corrguineach
summary: An Irish tradition of wizards controlling elemental spirits who were enemies of House Diedne and joined House Flambeau to exterminate them; a Hermetic Sahir variant.

label: Corrupt
summary: Major Church Hook: corrupt priests give the church an Infernal aura.

label: Corrupt Beast
summary: A compulsory Minor Supernatural Flaw for corrupt beasts granting Infernal Might 5, a sinful Personality Trait at +6, a repellent appearance, and the Tainted with Evil Flaw.

label: Corrupt Traditions
summary: Infernal traditions of knowingly evil people or placatory cults.

label: Corrupted Abilities
summary: A Minor Supernatural Tainted Flaw: one or more Abilities was taught by a demon, giving +3 for selfish use and -3 for selfless use, with use sensed by Divine Powers.

label: Corrupted (Ability)
summary: Flaw granted by the Watchers' Corrupted Knowledge Power, rewarding selfish or sinful use of the Ability.

label: Corrupted Arts
summary: A Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: a Hermetic Art was studied from a corrupted source, giving +3 to Casting Total for sinful use and -3 for selfless use; tainted magic appears unholy.

label: Corrupted Aura
summary: A permanently tarnished Infernal aura of at least 3 with corrupting effects beyond its tarnish; divided into Debauched, Malevolent and Perfidious.

label: Corrupted Knowledge
summary: Watchers Power corrupting taught Abilities, granting the Corrupted (Ability) Flaw.

label: Corrupted Spells
summary: A Minor Hermetic Tainted Flaw: at least 30 levels of formulaic spells learned from a corrupted source, giving +3 to Casting and Penetration for sinful use and -3 for selfless use.

label: Corrupted Tree
summary: Oaks, willows and pines of the Cursewood awakened and corrupted by the Infernal aura that ambush and devour victims; Infernal Might 10.

label: Corrupters
summary: Demon role directly tempting mankind into sin.

label: Corruption of House Tytalus
summary: A recent infernal fall within House Tytalus that reminds the Order how easily magic slips into Infernal sorcery.

label: Corruption of Tytalus
summary: Historical episode during which a Tremere magus botched A Simple Method for Rapid Vallation.

label: Corruption Rite
summary: Rites learned via Infernal Lore that formalize a mortal sin to allow a corruption roll, usually with candles, profane names, obscene acts and sacrifice.

label: Corruption Roll
summary: Storyguide roll (stress die + temporary Infernal aura) made after a major sin to maintain or increase an Infernal aura.

label: Corseul
summary: Site of a temple of Mars in a regio.

label: Corsica
summary: The island where Verditius was born; site of his blood feud and capture, and where the Rings of Verditius were possibly lost.

label: Corvus of Bjornaer
summary: A mature Bjornaer magus of Voluntas with a raven Heartbeast, specializing in Intellego magic and suspected of scrying on other magi.

label: Coryza
summary: A Minor Phlegmatic Disease caused by a cold, damp environment producing an excess of phlegm in the head.

label: Cosm
summary: A world in the Magic Realm connected to a thing in the mundane world; may be a microcosm or macrocosm.

label: Cost of Breaking Convention
summary: Optional guideline imposing a -1 social penalty on magi who dress above their station or flaunt familiars.

label: Cotentin Peninsula
summary: Lightly settled, swampy region of Normandy containing Confluensis and the ruins of Pagus.

label: Cottar
summary: Peasant with ten acres or less, living by hired labor or a trade, such as a blacksmith; half of manorial peasant families.

label: Council chamber
summary: Official meeting place of a covenant used to measure seisins and covenant spacing.

label: Council Mirror
summary: Great mirror at the head of Montverte's council table in which Geirlaug appears.

label: Council of Ancyra
summary: Council of 314 A.D. to which the Canon Episcopi is allegedly attributed.

label: Council of Archmagi
summary: Council that reputedly appoints the Antares and hires Sabastien.

label: Council of Clermont
summary: 1095 council where Urban II called for the First Crusade.

label: Council of Elders
summary: The six-magus governing body of House Bjornaer at Crintera, holding the Seats of the Bear, Wolf, Horse, Stag, Eagle, and Swan, with the Senior Elder holding the casting vote.

label: Council of Four
summary: The ruling council of House Ex Miscellanea representing different facets of the House's interests, instituted by Pralix and re-instated by later Primi.

label: Council of Lyons
summary: Ecumenical councils held at Lyons in 1245 (deposing Frederick II) and 1274 (temporary reunion with the Greek Church).

label: Council of Members
summary: The governing council of a covenant, comprising its probationary and full members, which holds covenant resources in common and decides matters by vote.

label: Council of Pavia
summary: City council of Pavia on which Erimas of Luctatio sits.

label: Council of Regency
summary: Council which runs England on behalf of Henry III, chaired by Pandulf.

label: Council of Tours
summary: A Church council whose decree of 1163 forbade the participation of monks in commercial medical practice and non-monastic university education.

label: Council of Troyes
summary: Council where the Templars officially received their rule.

label: Counselor
summary: A person who gives useful advice in the lord's select councils.

label: Count Gwyridden
summary: A daoine sith count of the Crun Clach faerie court who has played shinty for centuries; proud and conceited, sworn to Caitlin, and a champion shinty player among faeries.

label: Count of Champagne
summary: Example liege.

label: Count of Toulouse
summary: Nobleman whose court supports Henri of Toulouse's petition to found a monastery.

label: Count Palatine
summary: A count with extra powers to deal with a difficult border, as in Durham and Chester.

label: Count Philip of Flanders
summary: Noble whose wealth lured William Marshal to his side on the tournament circuit.

label: Count Thorstein
summary: A flamboyant centaur merchant and guild councilor.

label: Counter-mining
summary: Defensive tunnelling by a castle garrison to collapse enemy mines before they reach the walls.

label: Countess Jeanne of Flanders
summary: The current lord of Brugge, married to Fernando of Portugal and living in Lille, who is without an heir.

label: County of Bayeux
summary: Forested county west of the Seine basin, with the towns of Caen and Bayeux and the ruined covenant Baiocassium.

label: County of Cornouaille
summary: Peninsula county.

label: County of Gévaudan
summary: County in the Auvergne long troubled by bold wolves.

label: County of Nantes
summary: Breton county around Nantes with few Bretons and a Frankish population feeling affinity with Anjou and Poitou.

label: County of Périgord
summary: Region of the Aquitaine producing the best black truffles; a suggested site for the truffle regio.

label: County of Rennes
summary: Eastern Breton region.

label: Courser
summary: Swift light horse like the Andalusian used for hunting and travel, not trained for battle.

label: Court coram rege
summary: The highest court of the land, where the king himself sits in judgment wherever he is; only the most important cases reach it and there is no further appeal.

label: Court of Bright Winter
summary: A Seelie faerie court associated with light, snow, cold, and the hunt, found in midwinter among the high hills of the Westerwald; rival to Dark Summer.

label: Court of Dark Summer
summary: An Unseelie faerie court associated with dark, fire, warmth, and agriculture, found in midsummer in the swampy Hunsruck forest west of the Rhine Gorge; rival to Bright Winter.

label: Court of Piepowder
summary: The court that upholds justice during a fair, named from the French for the dusty feet of itinerant tradesmen; it handles trade-related prosecutions under merchant law.

label: Court of the Alder Prince
summary: A faerie court of the seasons, suggested to be sited in the Odenwald, paired with the Willow Maiden's court in the Swabian Forest.

label: Court of the Bees
summary: A faerie court with which the young Spring in the Woods covenant has developed good relations.

label: Court Wizard
summary: Magus bound as a vassal employee of a mundane lord, forbidden by the 865 Grand Tribunal ruling.

label: Courtauds-de-boutanche
summary: A court of Parisian argotiers who pretend to be out-of-work tradesmen.

label: Courts of Love
summary: Formal courtly tradition to which Minnesang belonged.

label: Courts of Summer and Winter
summary: Seasonal faerie courts that fight battles on the Equinoxes, summer and winter defeating one another in turn.

label: Coutances
summary: Former Venelli capital, burned by Normans in 998.

label: Coven
summary: A group of folk witches (usually three to a dozen) dispersed over a locale, the folk witch equivalent of a Hermetic covenant.

label: Covenant
summary: The home and community of a group of magi, the basic social unit of the Order, with its own resources, charter and politics.

label: Covenant Boon
summary: Covenant benefit, e.g. Mathematicus Ally.

label: Covenant Boons and Hooks
summary: Preexisting boons and hooks for a covenant at the Magic temenos.

label: Covenant Chapel
summary: Example chapel built in a glen near a covenant tower on the site of a pagan temple, with a Divine aura of 3.

label: Covenant Charter
summary: The written constitution of a covenant defining membership, governance, resources, rights, responsibilities, and censure; a sample based on Arae Flaviae is provided.

label: Covenant Lore
summary: An Ability concerning knowledge of a covenant; under the Stuck in Your Ways Flaw the character uses the lower of an Ability and his current Covenant Lore for certain Stress Rolls.

label: Covenant of Calebais
summary: A covenant that fell under mysterious circumstances and has lain undisturbed since, suggested as a place to explore (referenced via the supplement Calebais: The Broken Covenant).

label: Covenant of Crisp Winds
summary: A constantly mobile covenant living on a flotilla of ships that follows a route around the Mediterranean collecting vis and trade goods.

label: Covenant of Lycaneon
summary: Tremere covenant holding the House's amber deposits and lodging hired Verditius magi.

label: Covenant of Tarragon Vale
summary: Unterwalden covenant of metaphysical geographers whose four magi and covenfolk vanished twenty-two years ago; its vis income is held by the Quaesitores.

label: Covenant of the Castle of Fees
aliases: Covenant of the Castle of Fees
summary: A covenant where, by Unnatural Law, glass is as durable and hard as iron and used as building material and armament.

label: Covenant of the Icy North
summary: A covenant founded in 771 by magi of different Houses, now a loose affiliation of nine autonomous chapters across the Alps that meet annually at the Motherhouse in Bavaria.

label: Covenant of the Monkey's Reed
summary: A covenant on a floating island whose aura, warping to a pattern, is slowly twisting its people and structures into an ancient Egyptian village.

label: Covenant of the Redbreasted Warriors
summary: A fallen covenant whose aura a faerie king is said to hold captive in a wine bottle.

label: Covenant of the Solemn Scholars
summary: A covenant where, by Unnatural Law, children are able to fly until they lose their virginity.

label: Covenant on the Isle of Arran
aliases: Covenant on the Isle of Arran
summary: Covenant of Criamon magi studying regiones who can show the path to Manannan's realm.

label: Covenant Registration
summary: Mercere tradition whereby covenants register their address with the House to be visited by Redcaps, agreeing to shelter any member of the Order for three days a year.

label: Covenant Season
summary: Life stage of a covenant (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter).

label: Covenant Seasons
summary: Life stages of covenants: Spring, Summer, Autumn.

label: Covenant Ship Captain
summary: Companion vocation: captain of a covenant's ship who smuggles on the side.

label: Covenant Townhouses in Venice
summary: Townhouses every Roman covenant maintains in Venice as centres of intrigue, information and learning.

label: Covenant trophy
summary: Hibernian tradition that a covenant losing its trophy for a year and a day is no longer a covenant.

label: Covenant Upbringing
summary: A Flaw (and background) reflecting a character raised within a covenant, granting Latin and Order of Hermes Lore; held by the Scribe, Minstrel, Washer-woman, and Weapons Instructor templates.

label: Covenant Where Journeys End
summary: Merinita and Bjornaer covenant in a frigid faerie regio on Mont Joux, founded 817, known for kidnapping travelers and its ice-distorted covenfolk.

label: Covenants (supplement)
summary: Supplement describing castles in detail.

label: Coventry
summary: An English town near which the Redcaps' base, Mercer House, is situated.

label: Cover
summary: Terrain protecting against attacks, giving +3 to +12 Defense.

label: Covet Device
summary: A Personality Trait left in an attuned item that makes its owner crave the device, building up over seasons of ownership.

label: Cow and Calf
summary: Agreement protecting copies of books.

label: Cow and Calf Oath
summary: An agreement, originating in a Hibernia Tribunal ruling, under which a book purchaser will not sell or freely give copies without the seller's permission.

label: Craford's Gut
summary: The only safe water between Longstone End and Little Harcar.

label: Craft
summary: The skill governing a craftsman's production; a character's Craft Ability score determines Workshop Totals and how many items can be produced in a season.

label: Craft Amulets

summary: Ability listed in the text (e.g. in character statistics or rolls).

label: Craft: Charm

label: Craft Greater Charm

label: Craft Guild Training
summary: A Minor General Virtue granting 50 experience points in Craft, Profession, Bargain, or Guild Organization Lore from above-average apprenticeship.

label: Craft Hex Toys
summary: Releganta's craft of making cursing wax figurines.

label: Craft Illuminations
summary: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

summary: Craft Ability whose Ease Factor Cordovan Cuirbolli reduces.

label: Craft Lesser Charm
summary: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

label: Craft Magical Trinket
summary: Faerie power creating a glamour object letting its holder use a particular Virtue once.

label: Craft: Potter

label: Craft: Runes
summary: Ability to carve or inscribe runes, affecting durability and hiding.

label: Craft School
summary: Hermetic movement prizing beautiful and functional objects, whose members (Crafters) are mostly mage-smiths.

summary: Craft Ability rolled with Dexterity to carve figurines for Figurine Magic.

label: Craft: Smith
summary: Ability referenced in creature statistics or rolls in this text.

label: Crafter of (Form)

label: Crafter of Herbam
summary: Common non-Hermetic power of nature spirits that can animate trees.

label: Craftsman
summary: A free Social Status Virtue for a general craftsman practicing a trade not represented by a guild, who may be male or female and live rurally or in town.

label: Craftswoman
summary: Virtue listed in this text.

label: Cralian of Tremere
summary: A magus of House Tremere whose version of Disguise of the New Visage always produces a visage as unassuming as possible.

summary: Large bird hunted by paired hawks.

label: Cranequin
summary: Mechanical device for spanning a heavy arbalest.

label: Crantel
summary: Criamon who proposed the Graveyard of the Arch-Magi at their first meeting.

label: Crateuas
summary: The greatest herbalist of antiquity, author of the first pharmacopoeia and herbal, the original Root-Cutter, and ancestor of the Pharmacopoeians.

label: Craving for Travel
summary: A Minor General Flaw: the character suffers loneliness and boredom penalties if he does not expose himself to new experiences, getting worse the longer he stays in one place.

summary: GvVs 10 spell covering a small group with an illusion of boulders or bushes affecting sight only.

summary: A CrMe 20 spell that creates a new category of thing in the viewer's mind, granting unconscious familiarity with a broad range of its instances.

label: Creation of the Walls of Simple Cottages
aliases: Creation of the Walls of Simple Cottages
summary: CrTe 20 ritual creating a series of identical stone cottage enclosures linked by thin stone so they count as an Individual target.

summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus has problems creating new things in the lab, taking -3 to Lab Totals unless using a Laboratory Text or being taught.

summary: Mechanism by which a character with unspent fable points makes a creative offer to alter Faerie's environment, symbolism, or a faerie's attitude.

label: Creature of Virtue
summary: Magic animals such as Ravens, Stags, Hares and Mice of Virtue that inhabit the truffle regio.

label: Credenza di San Ambrogio
summary: The popolo of Milan in 1202, which chose its own council.

label: Credo au Ribaut
summary: Goliard poem quoted as the Goliard Credo.

label: Creep
summary: Great leather glove worn by a hawker.

label: Creeping Chasm
summary: A Rego Terram spell that creates a chasm running from the caster's feet toward a target, growing wider as it travels.

label: Creeping Oil
summary: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 15) that saturates a porous material with flammable oil which, if ignited, causes fire damage.

label: Cremona
summary: One of the famed southern schools of medicine with access to the corpus of Arabic medical texts, where many Greek and Roman texts were translated from Arabic.

label: Creo
summary: Technique meaning 'I create'. Creates things and brings them to a more perfect state; the Art of healing and creation.

label: Crest of the Earth's Wave
summary: ReTe 20 spell known by Iasper.

label: Crest of the Earth Wave
summary: A Rego Terram spell that creates a wave in the earth traveling outward, tossing aside those caught in its path for +10 damage.

label: Criamon Primi
summary: The ghosts of the Primi of House Criamon, ritually bound as genii loci to the Axis Magica, who habitually predict the doom and rebirth of the Order.

label: Criminal Brand
summary: Flaw listed in character statistics in this text.

label: Crintera
summary: The domus magna of House Bjornaer, located on the island of Rügen in the Eastern Marches, organized around six council seats of Elders and divided into six clans. Its turb is the fiercest and most bestial of the Rhine covenants.

label: Cripple the Howling Wolf
summary: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 25) that cleanly breaks one of a target animal's legs, with damage healing as a Medium Wound.

label: Crisis of Faith
summary: The loss of True Faith, when God turns His gaze away and the character must remain steadfast to regain it.

label: Cristiana
summary: Companion of Clare who co-founded the Foligno community in 1217.

label: Critias
summary: A Sophist and leading member of the Thirty Tyrants of Athens, quoted in the Analects of Tytalus; he held that virtue could be imposed by force and religion was a human invention to control the masses.

label: Croatia
summary: Part of the Transylvanian Tribunal.

label: Crodh
summary: Highland cattle, smaller and more intelligent than lowland cattle, which scatter when startled.

label: Croesus
summary: Namesake of The Wealth of Croesus spell.

label: Cronos
summary: Fabled opponent of Zeus with faerie versions in the Faerie Realm.

label: Cronus
summary: Titan whose sickle was created by the telechines.

label: Cross Baths
summary: Baths of Bath used by lepers.

label: Cross of Saint Oswald

label: Crossbow
summary: Missile weapon spanned with a belt hook; Strength does not add to Damage.

summary: Weapon Ability used for crossbows and arbalests; untrained use does not add the usual extra botch dice.

label: Crossroads
summary: Places of faerie power where two borders cross.

label: Crossroads Faerie
summary: Faerie governing the transition between life and death that afflicts Iasper.

label: Crossroads (Range)
summary: Infernal Range letting the caster affect a target on a road intersecting his own; equal to Range Voice.

label: Croton
summary: Where Pythagoras founded the Society.

label: Crow of Virtue
summary: A magical crow said to know the paths of treachery and predict the future.

label: Crow's Voice
summary: A Minor Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) causing the victim to caw throughout speech, penalizing communication rolls and spell casting by -3.

label: Crown of Forgetfulness
summary: A crown Morgana placed on Ogier's head; dislodging it let him escape Avalon.

label: Crown of Poplar Leaves
summary: Enriched crown of Poplar Tree of Virtue leaves granting the Long-Winded Virtue to one wearer for about two weeks.

label: Crown of Thorns
summary: Relic displayed flowering in the grand master's hands every Holy Thursday.

label: Crozon
summary: Peninsula.

label: Crucifix
summary: Adds +1 to exorcism.

label: Crucifixio
summary: Andru's black cat familiar, a member of the Black Lineage, who could talk before he was bound.

label: Crucifixo
summary: The current Jerbiton Primus's familiar, a cat of the Black Lineage who is not yet the King of the Cats but may become so when the current king (his mentor) dies.

label: Cruel
summary: A Minor Flaw making a character cruel, taken by the Familiar Cat as a species Flaw.

label: Cruithne
summary: Ancestor of the Cruithni.

label: Crumbling
summary: Church Hook for a church that is very old and in a bad state of repair.

label: Crumstone Rock
summary: Outer islet of the Farne Islands whose mysterious inhabitant is one of the archipelago's mysteries.

label: Crun Clach
summary: Covenant in a faerie hill in Kintyre, won at shinty from the Prince of the Grey Jerkin, led by Caitlin and inhabited largely by faerie retainers.

label: Crusade
summary: Church-raised war; crusaders may gain freedom, and crusades are hugely expensive for lords and peasants.

label: Crusades
summary: Church-sanctioned holy wars to regain the Holy Land, of which four have struck by 1220.

label: Crush
summary: Obligatory Greater Power of earth elementals, a clubbing attack that can pin and damage equipment.

label: Crushing Doubt
summary: Demon of Futility power preventing victims from spending Confidence.

label: Crushing the Will
summary: Bordelon's Power sapping a target's will and vitality.

label: Crystal Castle
summary: Castle of faerie knights at Lake Comper.

label: Crystal Custodian
summary: An invested magical item invented by Gudrun Tigurina of Verditius at Durenmar.

label: Crystal Geodes
summary: Vis site: a cave under the highest hill where crystals grow, giving up to 4 pawns of Terram vis sordida yearly.

label: Crystal of Imaginem Vis
summary: Rock crystal vis granting invisibility as Veil of Invisibility.

label: Crystalomancy
summary: Divinatory method using crystal-gazing, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

label: Cserwenitsa
summary: Hungarian site of Europe's only significant opal deposits, secured by a Tremere covenant.

label: Ctesiphon
summary: Persian capital in Iraq.

label: Cu Chulainn
summary: Irish legendary hero.

label: CuChulainn
summary: Gaelic hero of Highland stories.

label: Cu (Greyhound)

label: Cu Sith
summary: Green faerie dogs whose bark presages death if heard three times; wild in the Highlands and kept by the good folk in the South.

label: Écuage
summary: Payment in lieu of a knight's military service.

label: Cubic Fluorite
summary: Cubic Fluorite listed in the Tribunal index among minerals and substances.

label: Cucurbit
summary: Flask with a still head attached.

label: Cudgel
summary: Inexpensive two-handed crushing weapon.

label: Cuelebre
summary: A sort of dragon.

label: Cuenca
summary: An Iberian town whose fuero of one thousand clauses, granted by Alfonso VIII of Castile in 1190, regulates inheritance, criminal law, and Christian-Jewish relations.

label: Cuir Boulli
summary: Boiled leather made by boiling in oil.

label: Cuirass
summary: Breastplate and backplate.

label: Culhwch Ex Miscellanea
summary: A mature magus at Cad Gadu, Gwrhyr's former apprentice turned bully fond of tormenting mundanes; particularly skilled with Ignem.

label: Culmerland
summary: Territory given to the Teutons by Frederick II.

label: Cult of Ancestors
summary: House Bjornaer's tradition of revering ancestral spirits and Great Beasts, taught through House Bjornaer Lore alongside the House's Exoteric Mystery.

label: Cult of Diana

label: Cult of Dionysus
summary: Lost Roman-era cult sought by Bonisagus and Iozheza.

label: Cult of Dyssynergy
summary: House Criamon's bugbear, believed to oppose humanity's acceleration into Twilight; may not exist.

summary: An ancient Greek Mystery Cult of smiths and artificers founded by the god Hephaestus, ancestral to House Verditius.

summary: Societas Merceris seeking reborn heroes of antiquity to adopt as Redcaps and elevate through rituals.

summary: Roman cult whose high priest was the Pontifex Maximus.

label: Cult of Mithra
summary: Roman army cult with temples along the walls lacking magical power.

label: Cult of Osiris
summary: Egyptian wizards whose incubation rite made Iozheza disappear.

label: Cult of Saints
summary: Christian veneration of saints in which relics play an important part.

label: Cult of the Boar King
summary: A newly revived pagan cult attempting to re-consecrate a temple to the Boar King.

summary: An alleged cult blamed by medieval writers for the rise of the restless dead; its existence, identity, and responsibility are left to the storyguide.

label: Cult of Thoth
summary: Ancient Egyptian cult Fenicil identified as a forerunner of the Order.

label: Cult of Twilight

label: Cult of Wyzwanie

summary: Letter of approval from Pope Honorius commanding prelates to receive the Little Brothers as Catholic faithful.

label: Cumae
summary: Abandoned Greek colony where the Cumaean sibyl Carmentis guards a gate into Purgatory.

summary: Covenant of magi and Cistercian monks in Champagne, a Mercer House with a Magic regio and Portal to Dragon's Rest.

label: Cunning-folk
summary: Rural, mostly unGifted magicians close to faeries who use charms to aid peasants.

label: Cup of Truth
summary: Manannan's cup which breaks if a lie is told by one who drinks from it.

label: Curate
summary: Local priest appointed by the bishop to care for souls in a parish; temporary curates serve perpetual curates.

label: Curazzo
summary: Monastery Joachim was made abbot of.

label: Cure Blindness
summary: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

label: Curious Nun
summary: Example character from Realms of Power: The Divine who could join a covenant as a refugee.

label: Curse Fetish Weaving
summary: Weaving a curse fabric on a loom over a season with an Arcane Connection.

summary: GvCu 35 curse at Voice range that blinds the target until the condition is fulfilled or the wound heals.

label: Curse of Coughing Fits
summary: VuSa 10 curse causing uncontrollable coughing.

label: Curse of Disease
summary: Folk witch curse (EF 9) inflicting fevered disease and a Medium Wound.

label: Curse of Emotion
summary: Folk witch curse (EF 12) making the target feel strong emotion toward someone.

label: Curse of Fortuna
summary: VuFa 20 curse adding a botch die and minor misfortunes.

label: Curse of Mars
summary: Greater ReMe ritual cursing a nation to internal strife.

label: Curse of Miscarriage
summary: Folk witch curse (EF 9) that may make a pregnant woman miscarry.

label: Curse of Paralysis
summary: Folk witch curse (EF 15) preventing movement of limbs.

label: Curse of Quotidian Fever
summary: VuSa 25 curse inflicting quotidian fever.

label: Curse of Reduction
summary: Folk witch curse (EF 18) reducing target Size monthly.

label: Curse of Rheumatism
summary: Cat power giving rheumatism in the limb of anyone who touches (kicks) the cat.

label: Curse of Rotting Wood
summary: PeHe 5 spell known by Edwin.

label: Curse of the Aged Swordsman
summary: VuSa 15 curse causing hand cramping, -2 to affected activities.

label: Curse of the Baby's Bladder
summary: ReCo 4 cantation that makes the target release his water; unfortunately popular with apprentices.

label: Curse of the Beast
summary: Folk witch curse (EF 18) turning the target into a small animal.

label: Curse of the Desert

label: Curse of the Evil Humors

label: Curse of the Faerie Forest
summary: Enchantment/Conjure (Dream) 45 ritual changing a group into animals suited to their surface thoughts until they make amends.

label: Curse of the Festering Bruise
summary: Evocation/Woe 20 rite cast on a weapon so the struck target's wound heals as Incapacitating.

summary: A Muto Herbam ritual (Level 60) with a Perdo requisite that turns a normal small forest into a haunted, conscious, and cruel dangerous place.

label: Curse of the Ravenous Swarm
summary: A Creo Animal Ritual spell (Level 50) with a Rego requisite that calls a swarm of locusts or destructive insects to devastate an area's plant life and fields.

label: Curse of the Rhine Gorge
summary: A purported long-term doom causing every covenant and noble dynasty of the Rhine Gorge to fail within roughly seven decades; attributed to one of four supernatural realm causes.

label: Curse of the Rotted Wood
summary: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 5) that causes a non-living wooden object up to the size of a door to rot and fall apart into dust.

label: Curse of the Tongue
summary: Folk witch curse (EF 15) making the target forget all languages.

label: Curse of the Unportended Plague
summary: A Perdo Corpus ritual (Level 55) that starts a plague within a city or boundary; its use or transcription is rigorously discouraged by most of the Order of Hermes.

label: Curse of the Unruly Tongue
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 5) that causes the target to stutter and slur words, penalizing communication and spoken spellcasting.

label: Curse of Thoth
summary: Greater PeVi ritual cursing a magical group with misfortune and Twilight Prone; cast against Diedne in the Schism War.

label: Curse of Venus
summary: A Major Story Flaw: the character is attractive to unwanted people and falls in love with inappropriate people in inappropriate circumstances.

label: Curse of Weakness
summary: VuFa 25 curse giving -1 to Strength rolls.

label: Curse the Sinful Foe
summary: Abbas' power, as Spasms of the Uncontrolled Hand.

label: Curse-Throwing
summary: A cultural variant of Curse-Throwing in which a sin-eater takes on the sins of the dying via a ritual meal, preventing the spirit from becoming a ghost; common among Saxon-descended cultures.

label: Cursed
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab suffers a supernatural curse with appropriate Characteristic penalties.

label: Cursed (Duration)
summary: Infernal conditional Duration that triggers an effect under a stated uncommon circumstance; equal to Duration Sun.

label: Cursed Guile
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw, the boy-who-cried-wolf curse likely from Infernal influence: three extra botch dice with Guile and rarely being believed even when honest.

label: Curses and Corruption
summary: Mara's Tractatus on Area Lore: Cursewood, Quality 8.

label: Cursewood
summary: A cursed forest in a barren valley in Pomerania, about 30 miles across, home of the daimon Wyzwanie and site of Regulus' sanctum, covered by a Malevolent Infernal aura of 5.

label: Cursing
summary: Major Supernatural Virtue / Supernatural Ability letting a folk witch cast curses via fetishes or potions; Form depends on the curse.

label: Cursor
summary: Athletic grog who proves in a trial run that a vis source is a seisin.

label: Curtain Wall
summary: Crenelated wall around a bailey about thirty feet high, protected by mural towers.

label: Curtilage
summary: Unroofed land enclosed within the messuage's wall, used for orchards or holding court.

label: Custodian
summary: Custodial Redcap who escorts others through danger, guards Portals, collects fines and debts, and hunts bounties.

label: Customary Marriage

label: Customized Covenant Creation
summary: Build Point rules for designing covenants, used to design covens.

label: Custos
summary: A social-status Virtue denoting a trusted covenant servant or guard, taken by the glass-blower, lore-master, and political agent templates.

label: Cutting the Cords
summary: PeVi ritual used as a Tribunal punishment to permanently sever a magus's bond with his familiar.

label: Cweorth
summary: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Fire twirl", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

label: Cybelle
summary: A goddess of the wilderness honored in a True Merinitae Initiation festival held from the 15th to 27th of March, with rites including ritual castration beneath a sacred pine.

label: Cyclic Magic

label: Cyclic Magic (Astrological)
summary: Astrological variant of Cyclic Magic listed among the Curious Common Magics.

label: Cyclic Magic (negative)
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw: the magus's magic is attuned to a cycle of nature and is less potent at specific times, giving -3 to Lab Totals and Casting Scores then.

label: Cyclopes

label: Cymar
summary: Forked stick resembling a distaff carried by each member of House Diedne.

label: Cymena the Redcap
summary: Nonmagical redcap living at Tarragon Vale, whose grandparents were from there; carries a lickstone and wears dragonette-skin boots.

label: Cynewulf Gryreleoth
summary: Horsingas magus who completed Jehan's training.

label: Cyprus
summary: Island bought by the Templars from King Richard, ruled by the Lusignans.

label: Cyrian
summary: Blessed figure whose fingerbone relic Andru carries.

label: Cyrillus of Argentoratum
summary: A ghostly gladiator (Magic Might 20) of the Trier amphitheater, a wiry retetarius armed with trident and net and wearing a mask of Poseidon.

label: Cyrus the Great
summary: Persian king who returned the Jews to Israel in 539 BC.

label: Czech

label: Dabbler
summary: Type of magus Bonisagi playing with Range, Duration and Target; a Magic Theory specialization.

label: Dachstein
summary: Mountain home of the Frost Giants, allies of the Covenant Where Journeys End.

label: Dacia
summary: Origin of another necromantic remnant group allied to Tremere.

label: Dacians
summary: People who ruled Transylvania before the Romans, fighting under wolf-headed dragon banners.

label: Daduchos
summary: Second rank of magi Bonisagi ('torch-bearers'), expected to attend the Grand Tribunal.

label: Daevas
summary: Seven Zoroastrian evil spirits opposing the seven spentas; Naonhaithya is one.

label: Dafydd
summary: Faerie prince who carried Isabelle through the air.

label: Dagaz

label: Dagger
summary: Piercing/slashing Brawl weapon.

label: Dagger Attack
summary: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

label: Dagger of Ice
summary: A Cr(Re)Aq 10 spell that creates and hurls a foot-long icicle inflicting +5 damage if it penetrates Magic Resistance, then shatters.

label: Dagobert I
summary: Founder of the monastery of St. Denis in the 7th century.

label: Dagverdara
summary: Vindolanda's farmstead.

label: Dahut
summary: Gradlon's daughter, seduced by the Devil, who became the siren Marie-Morgane.

label: Daimon of Vengeance

label: Daimon Summoning Points
summary: Points accumulated by Invoke Pact castings toward summoning a Daimon's Aspect.

label: Daimon (Virtue)
summary: Free Social Status Virtue of all Daimons.

label: Daimonic Adjuration of Pukis
summary: Andrilikes's Hermetic ritual that summons Pukis to a sanctum.

label: Dairmuid of Ex Miscellanea
summary: Author of the Vim tractatus Unravel That Which is Cast.

label: Dajjal
summary: The Antichrist in Islamic belief, to be slain by Jesus.

label: Dalmatia
summary: Coast whose islands' vis rights are claimed by House Mercere.

label: Dalmatian Coast
summary: Coast where Francis' ship to the Holy Land was wrecked in 1212.

label: Dalquiel
summary: Ruler of Shehaqin.

label: Dalriada
summary: The old kingdom in the West of Scotland where some people keep pigs.

label: Dama
summary: The Praeco of the Provençal Tribunal, a House Merinita maga born in 993 who fell into Twilight and emerged, and is rumored to lead a Mystery Cult not part of House Merinita.

label: Damage Levels
summary: How many damage levels a weapon or shield sustains before breaking; most have two, spears and lances one.

label: Damaged
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is partially damaged, e.g. from an accident, taking one season to repair (-2 General Quality, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Damages
summary: Hermetic penalty paid directly to the victim, including costs; in a March the victim gets a quarter of the outcast's estate.

label: Damaging Effect
summary: Faerie power increasing the damage of a weapon or bite by +5, possessed by Auvekoejaks, icthyocentaurs and death sharks.

label: Damascus
summary: Syrian city claiming the head of John the Baptist.

label: Damhadh-Duidas
summary: A Gaelic hedge wizard from the same magical tradition as Damhan-Allaidh who joined Pralix's crusade against the warlock; eponym of the Damhadh-Duidsan tradition.

label: Damhadh-Duidsan
summary: A tradition of House Ex Miscellanea descended from Damhadh-Duidas who carve Ogam runes to curse, wound, and heal; they try to escape their Infernal past, with Giant Blood common.

label: Damhan-Alladh
summary: Figure whose war centuries ago eliminated the vitkir from the British Isles.

label: Damhan-Allaidh
summary: Scottish wizard ('the Spider') who practiced blood and sacrifice magic, refused to join the Order, and fought Pralix; his body vanished after his defeat and he is thought to survive.

label: Damietta
summary: A city whose fall to the Crusaders the previous year resulted in slaves purchased into Levantine and Theban Tribunal covenants.

label: Damme
summary: Harbor for Bruges.

label: Damp
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is waterlogged or moist, spoiling parchment and ingredients (+1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Aquam).

label: Damsel's Tresses
summary: Rare golden spice growing on an ancient oak.

label: Dan O'Thunder
summary: Flambeau magus who co-wrote a letter complaining about Horsingas.

label: Dance of the Staves
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 5) that causes a long thin non-living wooden object to lash about wildly and strike its holder for +4 damage.

label: Dance That Heals
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue from some Sufi traditions granting the ability to dance objects to wholeness, like Path of Walking Backward magi.

label: Daniel
summary: Biblical figure who fixed a weigh-in with the help of God, whose miracle the abbot hopes to repeat.

label: Daniel Tonatris
summary: Author of Unveiling the Tempest.

label: Danket
summary: Gravis's faerie caricature, a grumpy, stick-thin dwarf with a perpetual scowl contrasting Gravis's sunny disposition.

label: Dankmar
summary: A wilderness Rhine covenant occupied by Aschlaranda and her apprentice Schadrit; recognized as a Rhine covenant in 1067 and later accused Durenmar of faerie molestation.

label: Danse Macabre
summary: Dread Host practice of possessed troupes dancing to death.

label: Dante
summary: Author of the Divine Comedy, to be written later in the thirteenth century.

label: Danu
summary: A faerie elemental spirit of the River Danube, formerly worshiped as a goddess by many peoples before the Romans; her presence remains strong at the river's source.

label: Danube
summary: A river embodied in ancient times as a faerie goddess whose nymphs guard treasure grottos and gateways to Arcadia.

label: Daoulas
summary: Abbey.

label: Dareth of Tytalus
summary: 63-year-old Rellantali magus jealous of Evoco, considering plotting with Verdi.

label: Daria la Gris
summary: Co-leader of the Apple Gild and princeps of Triamore, a follower of House Tremere who favors forming the Lotharingian Tribunal; a stern 67-year-old Master.

label: Darius
summary: A magus of House Flambeau with a Warping Score of 6 who, while hunting a Renounced magus, botches a spell, enters Twilight, and gains a Twilight Scar making dead meat he touches seem rotten.

label: Dark Faerie
summary: Faeries of a dark kind, including vampires, not strictly infernal spirits, with widely varying vulnerabilities.

label: Dark faeries
summary: Malevolent faeries who care only that stories end in screaming and blood; can enter houses via holly invitation and hunt bean kings.

label: Dark Gnostics
summary: Corrupt Infernal tradition of Gnostic heretics who preach that sinful acts have moral value, often using the serpent as their symbol.

label: Dark Jerbiton
summary: A group associated with the covenant of Oculus Septentrionalis that may be dovetailed with the demonic schemes of Radegast and Gymir.

label: Dark Mother
summary: A chthonic spirit of the deep forest and fertile earth who resents the Church; Lise is her only priestess.

label: Dark Secret
summary: A Flaw gained at the lupellis Initiation, reflecting membership in a secret murderous cult; for magi it represents knowingly flouting the Hermetic Oath.

label: Dark Secret (Diedne Magic)
summary: Flaw not appropriate for Tremere characters, since the House would react violently to a druidical lineage.

label: Darkness has power over all things general / Weather and wind and all courses variable
aliases: Darkness has power over all things general / Weather and wind and all courses variable
summary: Debauchery/Effusion 20 flying winds.

label: Dart
summary: Light javelin about three feet long used by Highlanders.

label: Das Goldene Kalb
summary: Upmarket tavern and brothel in Lübeck owned by a Jerbiton magus, with an Infernal aura 3 tarnished with Lust.

label: Das Heldenbuch
summary: Collection of German romances containing the legend of Dietrich.

label: Dasim
summary: Son of Iblis with dominion over discord.

label: Data communis
summary: Public reading of petitions performed by the vice-chancellor and notaries.

label: Daughter of Branded Criminal
summary: Social Status Flaw of the Urchin.

label: Daughter of Zephyrs
summary: Kentigern's CrAn(Re) 45 spell creating a magical horse that gallops through the air.

label: Daughters of Erictho
summary: Non-Hermetic Thessalian wizards who did not join the Order, dwelling in the Cambunian Mountains; suspected of diabolism and demon worship.

label: Daughters of Four Fathers
summary: An all-female magical tradition found in north Africa, particularly associated with the Skinchanger (Dove) Virtue.

label: Dauphiné
summary: The domain of Lord Guigues, who commissioned a mechanized magpie automaton.

label: Dav'nalleous
summary: The foe against whom Pralix waged war; her final battle with him was at the site where Cad Gadu was founded.

label: Davan
summary: Tremere member of Postestas.

label: Dave
summary: Example player with faerie knight.

label: David ben David
summary: A wealthy, devout Jewish merchant of Trier who manages a wine shop above the former covenant of Treverorum; suggested as a companion character.

label: David de Soulis
summary: Hereditary seneschal of Scotland rumored to ride with demon dogs seeking souls for his demonic master.

label: David I
summary: King of Scotland from 1124 who molded the kingdom on the Anglo-Norman model, founded royal burghs and Melrose Abbey.

label: David of Dinant
summary: A heretic Paris master whose pantheistic, infernal teachings were discovered in 1215; author of the Quaternuli describing the Infernal Virtue Incantation, who fled the city.

label: Days of Trembling
summary: February, when Alpine apprentices are tested and archmages declare which challenger they will receive.

label: Dazzling Appearance
summary: Scitalis power (ReMe) stupefying all who look at it.

label: De Aluminibus et Salibus
summary: Alchemical work attributed to Rhases.

label: De Amore
summary: Book by Andreas Capellanus (1174) setting the rules of fin' amors; full title Incipit liber amoris et curtesie.

label: De Anima in Arte Alchimiae
summary: Work attributed to Avicenna supporting transmutation.

label: De Congelatione
summary: Avicenna's work denying real transmutation.

label: De'dee
summary: One of the Three Sisters.

label: De Initio Creaturae
summary: 11th-century treatise by Aelfric on Lucifer's rebellion and the gap it left among the angelic choirs.

label: De Lapii
summary: The Branch of Terram in 1220, a Summa on Terram of Level 17 and Quality 14, written by Jeremias filius Guernicus.

label: De Laude Sanctorum
summary: Theology summa (Quality 11, Level 5) by St. Victricius kept at Rouen Cathedral.

label: De Magia Sympathetica
summary: A Tractatus on Magic Theory (Quality 11) by Elaine covering Arcane Connections and sympathetic connections.

label: De Operationes Daemonum Dialogos
summary: Book by Michael Psellos; a Latin copy is a Summa on Infernal Lore Level 5 Quality 10.

label: De Operationes Daemonum Dialogus
summary: Summa on Infernal Lore (Level 5, Quality 12) by Michael Psellos on the nature of demons.

label: De Ordinis Hermetici
summary: An encyclopedia by Quaertus of Bonisagus comprising five Quality 9 tractatus on the Code of Hermes and Order of Hermes Lore (history and geography).

label: De Potestate et Obligatione
summary: A Tractatus on Philosophiae (Quality 11) by Elaine discoursing on the responsible and ethical practice of magic, influenced by Saint Augustine's City of God.

label: de Spinnens
summary: A fictional old farming family maintained by the magi of Florum as landlords and public face of the covenant.

label: De Theoria Magica
summary: Bonisagus' authority on Magic Theory, often chosen as the basis of a Numerologist's Book.

label: Deacon
summary: Major order symbolized by a stole over the left shoulder; serves as parish clerk, canon, or archdeacon.

label: Dead god
summary: Eight-foot magical skeleton shackled beneath Sinews of Knowledge whose regrowing flesh slows aging.

label: (Dead Language)
summary: An Academic Ability for speaking a language no longer used natively, such as Latin, available only to educated characters.

label: Dead Language: Gothic
summary: An Academic dead-language Ability used in all the rituals of House Bjornaer and essential to members of Clan Ilfetu, with little use outside ritual contexts.

label: Deadly Dance
summary: Nain power compelling victims to dance until sunrise.

label: Deadly Gaze
summary: Gorgon power transforming into stone any person or animal making eye contact.

label: Deadly Scream
summary: Greater Power of the mandrake root, deadly to all who hear it when pulled from the soil.

label: Deaf
summary: A Major General Flaw: the character cannot hear at all; magi with it roll two extra botch dice when casting spells with a spoken component.

label: Deals with the Devil
summary: Pacts with demons sealed by oath or contract, often with curses to deter repentance; demons often cheat the supplicant.

label: Dean
summary: Either a rural dean heading a deanery of up to two dozen parishes, or the head of a chapter of canons responsible for its discipline.

label: Dean of Order
summary: Monk, one per ten, responsible for keeping good order among his brethren.

label: Deanery
summary: Group of up to two dozen rural parishes under a rural dean.

label: Death of A Thousand Nightmares
summary: Penalty for intruders into the Vermilion Temple: nightly death by one's personal nightmare for a thousand nights.

label: Death of Familiar
summary: The most severe punishment short of a March, in which the convicted magus's familiar is killed.

label: Death Prophecy
summary: A Major General Virtue placing a supernatural condition on a character's death so that, until met, they cannot die of wounds or old age.

label: Death's head moth
summary: Moth believed to be a form of the moro.

label: Death's Vengeance
summary: Fimus's Power exploding his body upon death.

label: Death Shark
summary: Psychopompic faerie shark, white with red eyes, that waits in the shallows until a sea-connected person dies.

label: Debatable Land
summary: Borderland between England and Scotland where Patrick of Dunbar acts as judge.

label: Debate
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

label: Debauched Aura
summary: A corrupted aura arising from self-indulgence, tarnished with Sloth, Lust or Gluttony and seductive to mundanes.

label: Debauchery
summary: Unholy Method requiring the infernalist to corrupt her body through sin, suffering Fatigue or a Wound; uses Stamina.

label: Debilitation
summary: Condition inflicted on those killed in a night battle.

label: Decadence
summary: Fat golden demon with heavy chains and a giant mouth, dressed as a monk.

label: Decani
summary: Thirty-six Angels of Punishment of Master rank, demons of disease, three per zodiac sign, each balanced by a specific angel; listed in the Testament of Solomon.

label: Decans
summary: Three sub-periods into which each sign of the Zodiac is divided, revealing different aspects of the sign's influence.

label: Decay
summary: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Perdo Animal and Corporem; characteristic Stamina.

label: Decay Fur and Hide
summary: A Perdo Animal spell (Level 10) that destroys an object made of animal fur or hide, including wool and leather.

label: Decay of Eleven Score Years
summary: Pasiel's power aging non-living objects to dust.

label: Decaying
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab's equipment, furnishings, and materials are neglected or gone bad (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Deceiver's Boost
summary: Enervator Power boosting a mortal's spell Casting Total while letting the demon manipulate it.

label: Decem Libri Historiarum
summary: History of the Franks by Gregory of Tours with several summae.

label: Decennial
summary: Ten-yearly meeting of the Tremere Council at Coeris.

label: Decennials
summary: Every second Quinquennial, open to turbs from surrounding tribunals.

label: Decimus
summary: A House Tytalus faction member who supports Harpax, the tenth Primus; Decimi wear revolutionary green as their badge.

label: Decreased Might
summary: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie has only 1 point of Might instead of 5.

label: Decree of the Atlantean
summary: Atlantean power summoning a water creature within the same water-way.

label: Decrepitude
summary: A score that increases like an Ability as a character accumulates Aging Points; at 4 the character is frail and must roll on the Crisis Table, and at 5 is bedridden.

label: Decretum
summary: Gratian's compendium of papal decrees; Civil and Canon Law Summa Level 5 Quality 11.

label: Decumanus
summary: The 500-pace north-south main street of the temple town.

label: Dedicated Building
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is in its own building shared with no one else, reducing distractions (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Rego).

label: Dedicated Vis
summary: Rare vis tied to a Technique and Form combination, counting double for spells, study, and enchantment.

label: Dedication
summary: Legal recognition of a covenant as a place given a particular task, drawing specialists from across the Order.

label: Deed of London
summary: Title deed for London, kept in a regio guarded by demons or faeries.

label: Deep Cover Disguise
summary: Tytalus practice of assumed identities.

label: Deep Sleeper
summary: Flaw appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

label: Defective Heating
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab has inadequate or missing heating and is too cold in winter (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Defective Lighting
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is poorly lit, dingy and gloomy (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep, -1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Defenders as Interceptors
summary: Optional defender rule requiring the defender to win action priority to intercept attackers.

label: Defense Bonus
summary: Castle rating derived from Defense Quality that, multiplied by a size modifier, gives each wall's damage levels.

label: Defense of Sodales
summary: The right of magi to act in a fellow magus's defense, for example by rescuing prisoners or avenging Redcaps.

label: Defense of the Art
summary: The right to treat as an enemy anyone who publicly vows to purge wizards.

label: Defense of the Herd
summary: White Stag power giving deer +2 defense as a trained group.

label: Defenses
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab has a sturdy defense such as a portcullis or battlements (+1 Aesthetics).

label: Deficiency
summary: A Hermetic Flaw imposed when a master opens an apprentice's Arts while having a score below five in an Art; inflicting it is normally a Low Crime.

label: Deficient Arts
summary: A Hermetic Flaw afflicting Sebastian, who learned Hermetic magic despite several Deficient Arts, leading him to fight using his one strong Form, Aquam.

label: Deficient Technique
summary: A Hermetic Flaw weakening a magus in a particular Form; Philippus Niger is deficient in Imaginem and Imanitos Mendax in Animal and Ignem.

label: Defixio Magic
summary: Magic practiced by Roman chthonic cults, descended from cartouche magic.

label: Defixione
summary: Lead curse-tablet necromancy practiced by descendants of Guorna the Fetid.

label: Deformed
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: part of the structure has subsided or warped, e.g. a partially collapsed wall (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Deft Art
summary: A Virtue, here Deft Art (Herbam), possessed by Ioannes Acer.

label: Deft Characteristic
summary: Minor Child Virtue halving the age Characteristic Modifier for one Characteristic.

label: Deft Form
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue removing Casting Total penalties for non-standard voice/gestures with one Form.

label: Deft Rune
summary: Minor Virtue: no penalty when omitting name.

label: Degenerative
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the equipment and ingredients decay unnaturally quickly (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +1 Warping, -2 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +2 Perdo).

label: Degree
summary: A rank of status or Initiation within a Mystery Cult; each degree typically teaches a distinct Mystery Virtue.

label: Degree of Jupiter
summary: Second degree of the Magoi of the Star, granting Potent Magic in the Initiate's birth house; robes deep blue.

label: Degree of Mars
summary: Third degree of the Magoi of the Star, in red robes, opposing infernalists and initiating Periapts.

label: Degree of Mercury
summary: Degree of the Magoi of the Star requiring teaching and travel, granting a Major Magical Focus relating to the Potent house.

label: Degree of Saturn
summary: First degree of the Magoi of the Star, requiring Artes Liberales 4+ and initiating Planetary Magic; members wear black gowns.

label: Degree of Venus
summary: Fourth degree of the Magoi of the Star, in emerald robe, teaching the Major Virtue Celestial Magic.

label: Deheubarth
summary: An ancient Welsh principality in the south, centered on the fort of Dinefwr; once nearly unified under Lord Rhys.

label: Delay the Serpent's Venom
summary: Stag of Virtue power delaying poison until sunrise or sunset.

label: Delayed Action
summary: Choosing to act later in the round in response to events.

label: Delayed Sustenance of Fire
summary: Delayed ReVi(Ig) container ritual.

label: Deleterious Circumstances
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw that halves all of the magus's magic totals (excluding Magic Resistance) under certain uncommon circumstances of state, target, or place.

label: Deliverance of the Righteous
summary: Thrones power instantly transporting endangered worshippers to safety.

label: Della Scala
summary: Family ruling Verona.

label: Della Torre
summary: Milanese family, many corrupted by pacts with Peris, defeated by the Visconti in 1277.

label: Delos
summary: Aegean island once floating, tethered by Zeus; meeting place of the Theban Tribunal.

label: Deluders
summary: Order of demons, appearing as slashes of darkness filled with eyes and teeth, who make magic seem stronger; includes Aqrab, enervators, Watchers and the Spirits of Solomon.

label: Deluge of Rushing and Dashing
summary: A Creo Aquam spell that causes a stream to flood into a raging torrent, sweeping along and damaging anyone caught nearby.

label: Delusion
summary: A Flaw representing false belief; Criamon magi do not have it because their cosmological errors cannot be demonstrated within the game setting.

label: Demesne
summary: Land reserved for the lord's own use, farmed on his behalf by villeins as part of their rent; usually the most fertile land of the manor.

label: Demeter
summary: A powerful nature-oriented Greek deity whose name eumolpids of the Huntress may learn through the Mysteries of Names of Power and Invocation Magic.

label: Demetrios of Athens
summary: Mairi Sean's pater, a master of spirits in Greece, who sent Diana nam Grechanach to Mairi when his familiar died.

label: Demetrius
summary: An alchemist Criamon magus, teacher of the current Prima Muscaria, whose carnal urges are embodied in the captured adulteration called the Carnal Wolf.

label: Demiurge
summary: God's intermediary per theurgists, seen variously as good or as an evil spirit creating Divine and Infernal auras.

label: Demon
summary: Infernal beings made of the essence of deception; summoning and dealing with them is forbidden in the Order, they cannot be reliably detected, and they can be fought with Vim magic.

label: Demon Blood
summary: Major Supernatural Virtue.

label: Demon families
summary: Groups of demons within an order sharing traits, including a common weakness.

label: Demon Horse of Lord Goulis
summary: Demon bound in horse form with fiery breath.

label: Demon-Hunter
summary: Magi who push the Code to seek out and destroy demons.

label: Demon of Avarice
summary: Demon that aids magi hoping to create a merchant class whose souls he can claim.

label: Demon of Greed
summary: A local demon, disguised through an agent as a taverner, who wants the characters to ease a baron's overworked peasants so they can freely sin again.

label: Demon of Scrofula
summary: A demon with Infernal Might that uses the Diseased Possession power to inflict the disease scrofula on a possessed victim.

label: Demon of Vendée
summary: Demon trapped by a Magical ward in a sea cave at Vendée.

label: Demon's Visage
summary: A Major Curse (Muto Corpus Animal effect) transforming the victim's head into a demon-like beast shape, penalizing communication, social rolls, and spell casting by -6.

label: Demon Weakness
summary: Each demon's vulnerability, knowable with Infernal Lore, which forces flight or prevents harm to a protected group.

label: Demonic Blood
summary: A Major Supernatural Tainted Virtue making a character a half-demon with Infernal Might, Infernal Powers, no need to eat, immunity to Warping, and a drastically shortened lifespan.

label: Demonic Familiar
summary: A Minor Story Flaw binding the character to a famulus, a familiar demon possessing an animal, which is not loyal and pursues its own goals.

label: Demonic Might
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue (requires Demonic Blood) increasing a character's Infernal Might by 2 points.

label: Demonic Orders
summary: The nine orders of demons mirroring the nine angelic choirs, grouping demons by function and Might.

label: Demonic Powers
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue for demon-blooded characters granting an extra 20 levels of Infernal Powers.

label: Demonic Steed
summary: A corrupt beast (Might 7, Animal) appearing as a fearsome black stallion with iron hooves, unimpeded by poor terrain; one of three created by an Infernalist magus using a tainted Steed of Vengeance spell.

label: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
summary: A Perdo Vim spell that damages or destroys demons and other infernal beings.

label: Demons of Futility
summary: Evil spirit demons (Infernal Might 5 Aquam) imprisoned on Megstone who drown sailors and encourage despair; appear as short black hooded creatures riding goats.

label: Demons of the Air
summary: Class of demons warded off by an Enriched Thunderbolt of Virtue.

label: Demons of the Fifth Trump
summary: Elite Furies under Abaddon, horse-like with men's faces, bat wings and scorpion tails, who will burst forth at the End of Days.

label: Demonstrating Harm
summary: The part of a plea in which harm to a magus's interests must be shown.

label: Dendrophori
summary: Fourth rank of magi Bonisagi ('tree-bearers'), from which Primi are chosen.

label: Denique of Quaesitor
summary: Full member of Magvillus and Transitionalist.

label: Dent Coccinus
summary: Giuseppe Del Mato's mastiff familiar, armored on raids.

label: Deny Them the Bridge
summary: ReTe 30 spell that lifts a stone bridge with its foundations clear of the river and sets it elsewhere.

label: Deodand
summary: A stolen donkey that caused a death and holds a fragment of the dead man's angry ghost, able to turn into a spectral centaur-like creature with donkey hindquarters.

label: Dependant
summary: A minor Flaw representing someone who depends on the character; can be used as a hostage or leverage to dominate an agent.

label: Dependence
summary: Minor Child Personality Flaw: uncomfortable without a trusted mentor, -3 when alone.

label: Dependents
summary: Flaw that ties a caballero villano to his town through his family.

label: Depiction of the Waking Dream
summary: An InCrMeIm 35 enchanted effect in the Mirror of Dreams that makes a subject's thoughts visible as images around his head, aiding Mentem lab work.

label: Deployment Total
summary: Intelligence + Area Lore + stress die, generated by commanders to determine Territorial Advantage.

label: Depraved
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw where the character seeks to undermine religion and avoid the Dominion whenever possible.

label: Depressed
