summary: A Minor Personality Flaw giving the character a dark outlook on life, seeing little point in acting and taking no pleasure in events.

label: Deprivation
summary: Rules for lack of food or air (ArM5 p.180) invoked for besieged characters and constriction victims.

label: Deriten
summary: Demon who made a pact with Frederick Barbarossa and sought to claim Peris' lands.

label: Desert of al-Meraya
summary: Desert north of al-Meraya in southeast Iberia, inhabited by a thirsty spirit.

label: Desert Truffle
summary: Above-ground truffle of arid Mediterranean lands, believed to be created where lightning strikes the sand.

label: Desiderius of Verditius
summary: An old Verditius magus of Voluntas who is a necromancer, smelling of rotting flesh, lately becoming sociable despite poor social skills.

label: Desires Rest
summary: Ghost trait measuring how driven it is to conclude its earthly business.

label: Despair of the Quivering Manacles
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that makes the target shake vigorously side to side, penalizing physical movement and other rolls.

label: Desperata
summary: Example alchemist maga who achieves the Great Elixir aged 161.

label: Despot
summary: Leader of a Byzantine successor state who grants pronia.

label: Destiny
summary: Virtue appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

label: Destrier
summary: Noble warhorse of the highest status, often Spanish and often aligned with a realm.

label: Destroy Fur and Hide
summary: PeAn 5 spell known by Edwin.

label: Destroyers
summary: Demon role winning souls through torment, death and disaster.

label: Deteriorating Power
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw that reduces the effectiveness of one of the character's powers over time, linked to age, Might, or Warping Score.

label: Determinata
summary: Example maga seeking her missing shield grog via sympathetic divination.

label: Determine the Location of the Absent Volume
aliases: Determine the Location of the Absent Volume
summary: An Intellego Animal 25 spell (based on The Inexorable Search) that locates a missing book by showing the magus's sigil on a map, with an optional Creo requisite to project the location on a mirror.

label: Deus Sol Invictus
summary: The 'unconquered sun', the name of the one God worshipped by the Sol Invictus cult, proclaimed official deity of Rome under Elagabalus and Aurelian.

label: Dev
summary: Armenian giants with up to seven one-eyed heads; some can change into dragons or other monsters.

label: Deventer
summary: A modest-sized city and early missionary-bishopric on the right bank of the Rhine, surrounded by marshland, with a church named after St. Lebuinus and at the center of a struggle against pirates.

label: Devil Child
summary: A type of Mythic Companion created by powerful demons as weapons in the conflict between Heaven and Hell; tragic figures with Hellish powers but free will.

label: Devil's Bridge
summary: Bridge in Saint Gotthard's Pass, said to be built by the Devil.

label: Devil's Chamber
summary: Cave.

label: Devil's Lane
summary: A small Faerie regio (aura 6) housing a faerie toy market, whose central looping lane has many alleyway entrances to cities throughout Mythic Europe.

label: Devil's Lane Covenant
summary: A Merinita covenant opposite Florence Avenue, founded by Bartholomew after his Gauntlet, home to him and Julia.

label: Devil's Lane Workshops
summary: A labyrinth of candle-lit basements beneath Devil's Lane where worker elves create the magic toys.

label: Devil's Mind
summary: Mengalaz's power making him aware of everything in Devil's Lane.

label: Devon
summary: English county whose people paid King John 2,200 marks and 20 palfreys to be deforested.

label: Devoted Parent/Child
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is extremely attached to a parent or child, suffering anxiety and penalties when separated.

label: Devotion
summary: Theological virtue (normally called Faith); at True Faith 2 grants Premonitions and the ability to dispel illusions and glamour with a Faith Point.

label: Devotion (Duration)
summary: Holy magic Duration lasting as long as a religious observance continues; equal to Sun.

label: Devotion Point
summary: Point of devotion to a saint listeners may gain from preaching.

label: Devotion Points
summary: Dedicated experience points used only to raise Devotions, gained through pilgrimage, endowments, guilds, miracles, etc.

label: Devouring Regio
summary: Rumored roaming Infernal regiones attracted to evil souls that swallow people and may deliver them to Hell.

label: Devouring the Heat of the Fire
aliases: Devouring the Heat of the Fire
summary: Salamander power extinguishing any fire it touches.

label: Dexithea
summary: A telechine, the last surviving of the titan smiths, who dwells deep in the sea and can craft magic items; Magic Might 45.

label: Dexter
summary: Follower of Bonisagus who co-trained Regina.

label: Dhampir
summary: Major Supernatural Virtue: a half-vampire child with slowed aging, Second Sight and darkvision; Tremere recruit dhampirs as guards but forbid training them as Hermetic magi.

label: Dhikr
summary: Sufi group meditation in which the names of God are intoned with bodily movement until closeness with Him is achieved.

label: Dhimmi
summary: A Minor General Flaw marking a non-Muslim living under Muslim rule, who must pay the jizya head tax and abide by social restrictions in return for tolerance and protection.

label: Dhu'l-Fiqar
summary: Two-pointed sword of the Prophet given to 'Ali; relic with Divine Might 70 that puts out enemies' eyes.

label: Diabetes
summary: A Minor Sanguine, Lifelong Disease from rich food and gluttony, named by Aretaeus after the Greek word for a siphon.

label: Diablerie
summary: Unholy Power over supernatural realms and creatures, used to summon, resist and command demons.

label: Diabolic pact
summary: Pact with the devil granting Virtues, signed by corrupt Vallumbrosans.

label: Diabolic Past
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character was once associated with diabolists and is still haunted and watched by former associates.

label: Diabolist (Virtue)
summary: Free Special Virtue required of diabolists.

label: Diamond Mines of Solomon
summary: A legendary treasure-site the Expedition covenant was founded to discover, following a map used by two prior expeditions that never returned.

label: Diana
summary: The mater of Theoderic; the last magus to attempt to reach the Lunar Sphere, she was blasted into fragments of glass in a laboratory accident, and a Fallen Temple at the covenant is dedicated to her.

label: Diana nam Grechanach
summary: Young Greek girl from the Isle of Boetia training under Mairi Sean, sent by Demetrios of Athens; skilled in medicine.

label: Diana of Ex Miscellanea
summary: A Mystagogue of the Disciples of the Worm.

label: Diana of Tremere
summary: A Tremere maga of Blackthorn who declared a Wizards' War in 873 against William of Jerbiton of Rosalba.

label: Diaspora
summary: The dispersal of the Jews after the fall of the Second Temple.

label: Diatribe
summary: A text written to oppose a polemic, subtracting its Quality from the Argument Total.

label: Dibbukim
summary: Disembodied human spirits from Jewish lore (Furies) that possess sinners and are exorcised through the little toe.

label: Diceless Defense
summary: Option replacing the Defense stress die with a constant 6.

label: Dick Whittington's Cat
summary: Helper cat who makes his master undeservedly rich.

label: Dictionarius
summary: A famous 13th-century craft manual by John de Garlande about various trades that adds +4 to a craftsman's Workshop Total.

label: Didyma
summary: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal linked to the city of Miletos by the Sacred Way, a mundane road that is also a major route from the faerie realm to the mundane world.

label: Diedne Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Virtue from the druidic House Diedne lineage granting superior Spontaneous magic, requiring the lineage to be hidden via a Major Story Flaw.

label: Diet of Roncaglia
summary: Assembly defining Imperial rights, prompting a Tribunal decree against Literatus interfering.

label: Dietrich III
summary: The duke of Upper Lorraine who dies in 1220 and is succeeded by Matthew II.

label: Dietrich of Bern
summary: A Daimon (Magic Might 35, Corpus) of the German hero and boy-king of Bern, whose tomb in the Lessini Mountains holds dragon-blood-enchanted arms; he animates his corpse to test those who enter.

label: Dietrich von Bern
summary: Daimon of the German hero-king of Bern who guards his dragon-blooded tomb in the Lessini Mountains.

label: Difficult Arts
summary: Hedge Arts that advance as Abilities, preventing easy high Penetration.

label: Difficult Longevity Ritual
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw making it difficult to create an effective Longevity Ritual for the character, halving the Lab Total of anyone who tries.

label: Difficult Spontaneous Magic
summary: A Hermetic Flaw referenced as combinable with Weak Spontaneous Magic to create a magus who cannot cast spontaneous magic at all.

label: Difficult Terrain
summary: Terrain halving movement and adding a botch die.

label: Difficult Underlings
summary: A Story Flaw representing a fractured relationship with one's agents; acquired when a non-magus principal recruits an agent of higher social standing, applying to dealings with that agent.

label: Dijon
summary: Town near a small forest suggested for the truffle regio.

label: Dimicatio
summary: A dangerous Flambeau tournament event where competitors cast real spells using forceless casting and fast-cast defenses, the first to reach the opponent's Parma winning.

label: Diminutive
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is configured for an especially small magus, causing difficulty for normal-sized users.

label: Dinan
summary: Port with the Basilica of St. Savior.

label: Dindyméné
summary: A titaness and kosmokrator Daimon of the Magic Realm, mother of Zeus, imprisoned asleep beneath Mount Dindymon; embodies fertility, mountains and wild beasts, with Magic Might 75.

label: Diocese
summary: Ecclesiastical territory of a bishop; about 800 in Mythic Europe, grouped into provinces and split into archdeaconries and deaneries.

label: Diocese of Bayeux
summary: One of the oldest dioceses in Mythic Europe, founded by St. Exuperius.

label: Diodorus Siculus
summary: Ancient author of the Bibliotheca Historica describing Egyptian shapechanger priests.

label: Dione of Quaesitor
summary: Full member of Magvillus and Traditionalist.

label: Dionysios
summary: God whose vineyards exist only in stories about him in the Faerie Realm.

label: Dionysius the Areopagite
summary: Greek convert of St Paul believed to have written The Celestial Hierarchy.

label: Dionysus
summary: A god originally worshipped alongside Hermes by Orpheus's society but who fell out of favor after Orpheus's death; the Maenads who killed Orpheus were devoted to him.

label: Dionysus Exiguus
summary: Collector of Church canons banning names of non-scriptural angels.

label: Dionysus the Areopagite
summary: Authority who lists the archangels as Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Uriel, Chamuel, Zadkiel and Jophiel.

label: Diplomacy
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

label: Direach
summary: A gigantic version of the Fachan found in the Scottish Highlands.

label: Direction Sense
summary: Minor magical talent a Redcap's apprentice might show.

label: Dirk
summary: Main Highland weapon, a large knife sixteen to twenty inches long, sometimes used with the targe.

label: Dirne-Weibl
summary: A wood-wife who dresses in a red frock and carries a basket of apples that turn to gold if she is treated courteously; her apples are Creo vis sought by magi.

label: Dirty
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is not kept to basic cleanliness, leaving the owner smelly (-1 Health, -2 Aesthetics, +1 Perdo).

label: Disarm
summary: Non-lethal special effect making the opponent's weapon fall; retrieving it requires an action and disengaging.

label: Disceptator
summary: The chairman and spokesman of a covenant's Council of Members, a rotating mandatory office held by full members serving seven-year terms.

label: Discern Own Illusions
summary: An Intellego Imaginem spell that makes the caster's own illusions appear largely transparent but still discernible.

label: Discern the Images of Truth and Falsehood
aliases: Discern the Images of Truth and Falsehood
summary: An Intellego Imaginem (General) spell that lets the caster tell whether an image was created or altered by a spell, seeing both original and false images.

label: Disciples of the Worm
summary: A necromantic Mystery Cult founded by Vespillo that binds spirits into spells and seeks the tombs of ancient wizards.

label: Discipline Roll
summary: A reaction roll (leader's Presence + Leadership + stress die) required when a group is tempted to break formation; failure makes the group disordered.

label: Discovery
summary: Extraordinary Results Chart result required for original research, which must then be stabilized.

label: Discredited Lineage
summary: Negative quality for Alpine recruitment.

label: Disease Recovery
summary: Hermetic or setting concept referenced in the description of the Mythic Locations sites.

label: Diseased Possession
summary: An infernal power, a variety of Possession, by which a demon enters a victim and spends Might to inflict a disease's contagion.

label: Disenchant
summary: A Perdo Vim ritual that permanently strips a Hermetic magic item of all its powers, destroying its enchantment and invested vis.

label: Disengagement
summary: Reaction contest of Defense against opponents' Attack totals to move away while engaged.

label: Disfigured
summary: A Flaw earned by a single visible tattoo, considered uglier than a scar by medieval people; commonly afflicting tattooed Criamon magi.

label: Disguise
summary: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

label: Disguise of the New Visage
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 15) that transforms the target's facial features to any approximately human configuration the caster chooses.

label: Disguise of the Putrid Aroma
summary: A Rego Animal spell (Level 5) that makes a targeted animal take no interest in the caster as long as concentration is maintained.

label: Disguise of the Transformed Image
summary: A spell useful for creating a persona with specific physical characteristics such as a particular sex, hair color, or stature.

label: Disguise of the Transformed Wizard
summary: A Muto Imaginem 15 spell known by Imanitos Mendax.

label: Disguised
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab or its entrance is concealed mundanely, such as by a hidden door (-1 Aesthetics).

label: Disguised Casting
summary: Cult of Mercury mastery ability to suppress or alter one's sigil.

label: Disibodenberg
summary: Benedictine abbey in the Rhineland where Hildegard and Jutta joined the nuns.

label: Disjointed Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw preventing the magus from using prior knowledge of similar spells or enchantment bonuses to aid his magic.

label: Dismissing
summary: Bargaining art undoing effects of beings with Might and releasing them from bargains.

label: Disorder
summary: Alpine term for intercovenant warfare, technically legal but seen as deeply immoral.

label: Disordered Group
summary: A group that failed a Discipline or Morale check; trained groups function as untrained, and untrained disordered groups hit only half as often.

label: Disorganized
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is organized haphazardly, though some magi prefer it (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Muto or Experimentation).

label: Disorientating Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw requiring the magus to spend a round recovering his mental faculties after casting a spell.

label: Disorienting Magic
summary: Supernatural Flaw available to vitkir.

label: Disparagement
summary: Illegal selling of a ward's marriage or marriage to unsuitable persons.

label: Dispassionate
summary: A new Minor Personality Flaw making one unable to express strong emotions; the first Sacrifice on the Arcadian Path.

label: Dispel Fortuna Belli
summary: VuFa 5 curse forcing re-rolls of positive Attack Advantage.

label: Dispel the Phantom Image
summary: A Perdo Imaginem (General) spell that destroys the image from any one Creo Imaginem spell whose level the caster matches or exceeds on a stress die plus spell level.

label: Dispensation
summary: Exception granted by bishop or pope, e.g. for priests not meeting ordination criteria.

label: Disputants
summary: Tremere certamen specialists.

label: Disputatio
summary: A formal academic debate resolved much like certamen, using paired totals (Attack, Defense, Weakening, Resistance) and symbolic Fatigue Levels to determine a winner across deliberative, epideictic, and forensic forms.

label: Dissolution
summary: Air elemental power making matter lose cohesion and melt.

label: Dissolving the Wall of Shields
summary: A PeMe 20 spell that removes the procedural memories letting a group of soldiers fight as a unit, or destroys other simple group skills.

label: Distaff
summary: Implement whose enchantment is rare due to anti-Druidic prejudice.

label: Distance Level
summary: Measure of line length used as Ease Factor for Line Range calculations.

label: Distant Eidolon
summary: Manannan's power to create an illusory form to converse and deliver messages, giving him Arcane Connections.

label: Distillation of the Purest Stream
summary: A Rego Vim 15 spell (R: Touch, D: Mom, T: Ind) that concentrates the essence of exceptionally pure stream water into a pawn of Aquam vis.

label: Distorted Ghosts
summary: Ghosts of miners bound and warped by Averna (Magic Might 6 Mentem).

label: Distraction of the Magpie
summary: A Muto Mentem spell that alters the target's estimation so shiny objects become highly desirable and distracting.

label: Divide the Gathered Essence
summary: ReVi 25 spell transferring raw vis from an item into one or more containers.

label: Dividing the Enemy
summary: Alpine policy of rewarding one party for betraying its allies in a coalition against the Alps.

label: Divination and Augury
summary: Separate Mystery magic replacing Augury, where several methods share one Divination Ability; Lasa Vegoia helps initiate it.

label: Divination & Augury
summary: A supernatural Virtue allowing the performance of auguries; Chnoubis' Augury power functions as this Virtue, granting ten levels of success per Might point.

label: Divination (Numerology)
summary: Numerological divination for which Hermetic Numerology is prerequisite; the Numerologist's Book adds to it as ceremonial bonus.

label: Divine Aid Bonus
summary: Bonus of up to +3 to rolls furthering an objective, gained by invoking God's aid.

label: Divine Ascent
summary: Unique form of Warping experienced by holy characters, codified by Dionysus the Areopagite, taking the forms Divine Gloom, Divine Form or Divine Unity.

label: Divine Authority
summary: Authority power giving absolute knowledge and command over one aspect of creation.

label: Divine Balance
summary: Potentate power creating a virtuous thought to oppose a devil's sinful suggestion.

label: Divine Being
summary: Any creature with Divine Might.

label: Divine Comedy
summary: Dante's great medieval work, not yet written in 1220.

label: Divine Direction
summary: Domination power to command beings of equal or lesser Divine Might or those aligned to the Divine.

label: Divine Elections
summary: Procedure for electing a grand master.

label: Divine Form
summary: Form of Divine Ascent transforming the character toward pure holiness, functioning like The Commanding Aura but punishing sin severely.

label: Divine Gloom
summary: Form of Divine Ascent in which the character loses knowledge of the mundane while gaining comprehension of the Divine; akin to Hermetic Twilight.

label: Divine Guidance
summary: Angel power modifying Personality Trait rolls toward virtue.

label: Divine Heaven's Aspect
summary: Spell used to learn astrological conditions at a distant location so the armillary sphere can be adjusted.

label: Divine Insight
summary: Cherubim power granting Clear Thinker, Free Expression or Inspirational until the target sins.

label: Divine Justice
summary: Thrones power to learn the truth and most just judgment of a case.

label: Divine Lore
summary: Lore Ability for a specific realm that caps Magic Theory when inventing realm-aligned spells and reduces botch dice.

label: Divine magic
summary: Holy magic taught to guardians of Purgatory.

label: Divine Office
summary: The daily prayers recited at the canonical hours, also called the Opus Dei or Liturgy of the Hours.

label: Divine Warping
summary: Warping from Divine sources such as auras, powerful Divine effects and Divine botches, producing visions, stigmata and angelic transfigurations.

label: Divining
summary: Elementalist Technique based on Perception used to locate and commune with elements and elemental targets; costs no Fatigue.

label: Divining the True Heir
summary: InCo 20 spell revealing the relationships of a group of claimants to a target bloodline.

label: Djinn
summary: Spirits accompanying Moslem sorcerers attacking Palermo.

label: Djinni of Aladdin
summary: The djinni from Aladdin and the Wonderful Lamp who grants wishes and lets Aladdin fly.

label: Doctor
summary: The title held only by graduates of a university faculty of medicine (or those with Clerk and Medicine 3+), the only physicians with formal claim to it.

label: Doctrine of Foreshadowing
summary: Doctrine justifying pagan mysteries as presaging Christianity.

label: Doctrine of Origen
summary: Origen's heretical teachings including the Perfectibility of Man and that stars are living beings and signs rather than causes.

label: Dodge
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

label: Dog of Virtue
summary: A magical dog that may heal wounds by licking them; its body parts are useful in warding.

label: Dog that Flew
summary: A Warped hunting dog with grey feathered wings, able to glide, hiding near Hersfeld.

label: Doge
summary: The leader of the city of Venice, who annually casts a vis-bearing engagement ring into the sea to symbolize the city's espousal to and dominance over the waters.

label: Dogger Bank
summary: Shallowest part of the North Sea and a rich fishing ground whose destruction would cause famine and war.

label: Dogrose School
summary: A regio covenant claimed by House Bonisagus that draws Gifted children via their possessed toys and teaches them before sending them to masters.

label: Doissetep
summary: A powerful covenant in the Provençal Tribunal where the dark Jerbiton magus Imanitos Mendax was apprenticed.

label: Dol
summary: Town with a cathedral to St. Samson.

label: Doliónes
summary: Original Greek inhabitants of Bear Island, ruled by King Kyzikos.

label: Dolmen of Bagneux
summary: Largest dolmen in the Samur region with a low Magic aura.

label: Dolmen of Kerguntuil
summary: Petrified giant dolmen.

label: Dolomites
summary: Region in whose inaccessible valleys lies Jerbiton's family villa, now Valnastium.

label: Dolorosa
summary: Example maga who makes a staff talisman with multiple components.

label: Dolphin of Virtue
summary: The fastest fish in the ocean, friendly to man, fond of music, and a harbinger of storms.

label: Dombnall
summary: Example gruagach with an External Soul who creates a Boar Tattoo.

label: Dome of the Rock
summary: Shrine in Jerusalem housing the rock from which Muhammad ascended; Dominion aura 10.

label: Domesday Book
summary: Record that lists English manors, including one manor that had no inhabitants.

label: Domestic Animal
summary: A Free Social Status Virtue (animals only) for an animal that is the property of a covenant or character.

label: Domestic Work
summary: Focus power performing household tasks from a distance, including kindling fires and hurling objects.

label: Domhnall the Gruagach
summary: A gruagach character.

label: Domhnall the Gruagach Master
summary: Gifted gruagach master from a Scottish highland village, a large cudgel-wielding man who fought the English and seeks to rebuild a collective.

label: Dominate Canine
summary: Black Dog power making canines obey its voice.

label: Domination
summary: Arkliss' gaze power to bend a person to one command.

label: Dominations
summary: Choir governing the Divine realm and ordering lesser angels.

label: Dominia the Ascetic
summary: Example character with True Faith 1 who experiences Divine Ascent and Divine Gloom.

label: Dominican
summary: One of the two major new mendicant friar orders of the early thirteenth century, growing rapidly in popularity.

label: Dominicans
summary: An orthodox religious Order whose friars at Paris live in private hospices, strictly adhere to papal authority, and criticize teachers of possibly heretical ideas.

label: Dominicus
summary: A magus of House Jerbiton exonerated by the Normandy Tribunal of 898 for using Wizard's War to avenge a slain amicus, establishing legal precedent for avenger pledges.

label: Dominicus of House Jerbiton
summary: Magus who slew Gravis in 891 AD and was acquitted of seeking retribution by Wizard War in 898 AD.

label: Dominion Lore
summary: A supernatural Ability covering knowledge of the Divine realm; the angels Seferiel (Divine Lore 10) and Nasir (Dominion Lore 8) both have it with a specialty in angels.

label: Dominion Rite
summary: Ritual by a celebrant with an appropriate Social Virtue before a congregation of ten, used to consecrate an area and allow the Dominion to enter it.

label: Dominion (Target)
summary: Holy magic Target affecting everything within a divine aura whose source is in range; equal to Boundary.

label: Dominus
summary: Term meaning master or lord used by an apprentice for his master; domina for a maga.

label: Domleschg
summary: Valley with 21 castles and a vis-bearing oak grove.

label: Domleschg druids
summary: Community of 15 druids at Domleschg who resisted Díedne.

label: Domnhull Beg
summary: Magus of House Bonisagus, son of the clan chief, trained at Durenmar to integrate gruagach magic with Hermetic magic; holds the covenant's Hermetic title and dreams of founding a new House for the gruagach.

label: Domnhull's Oak Staff Talisman
summary: Domnhull Beg's talisman with bonuses to destroy, control, project bolt, repel and protection from storms.

label: Domnu
summary: Chthonic titan of darkness and fertility, mother of the Fomoire.

label: Domovoi
summary: Slavic brownie living beneath the threshold or stove, a hairy little man with tail and horns who predicts the future.

label: Domus Magna
summary: The principal covenant of a Hermetic House, many of which have excellent libraries focused on their House's interests; examples include Durenmar and the Cave of Twisting Shadows.

label: Domus Magna of House Tytalus
summary: Tytalus headquarters that floats smugly off the coast of Normandy and causes strife in neighboring Tribunals.

label: Domus Magnus
summary: The central covenant of a House; Harco, Magvillus and Verdi are Domus Magni.

label: Donald Ban
summary: Malcolm Canmore's brother who resisted English influence and was twice king before being blinded by Edgar.

label: Donald Dubh
summary: Young gruagach used as an example of learning new Exceptional Talents such as Magic Sensitivity and Transform.

label: Donation of Constantine
summary: Document recording Constantine's gift of the Western Empire to the Papacy; those who saw it died within a year.

label: Donatism
summary: Ancient heresy that sacraments are invalid when performed by unworthy priests.

label: Donatus
summary: Author of Ars Grammatica.

label: Donegal
summary: Region of Ireland where Saint Patrick preached his ministry.

label: Donestre
summary: Lion-headed human faerie using Faerie Speech to lure travelers off roads to be eaten, then weeping beside their heads.

label: Donncadh Mac Calum
summary: Chief of Clan Mac Gruagach, a former hell-raiser now worn down by old wounds, who dreads passing the clan to his son Raibert and struggles to check his brother Lachlan.

label: Donning the Corporeal Veil
summary: She-Wolf power creating and animating a physical she-wolf body for the spirit.

label: Donning the Mask of Another
summary: A Tytalan MuMe 35 Ritual spell that creates a persona from the identity of a donor, granting the caster the donor's memories and personality as a deep cover disguise; it can also steal or transfer a persona.

label: Donor
summary: Dramatic role of one who grants the hero a magical gift or power vital to his task, not necessarily willingly.

label: Doolin
summary: A guild master clothier living in Paris, a man of inexhaustible energy who makes excellent quality clothing and dreams of monopolizing the formal attire of wizards.

label: Doorkeeper
summary: Lowest minor order, held by young boys training for the Church, who receive a pair of keys at ordination.

label: Dorana
summary: A master maga of House Bonisagus at Fengheld, foremost of the lineage of Irmele filia Trianoma in the Tribunal, who argues for rationality but cannot stand her prima Murion.

label: Dordogne River
summary: River in Périgord.

label: Dorisa
summary: Maga of Ex Miscellanea who charged Redcap Constantine with taking twelve pawns of vis from her sanctum.

label: Doué-la-Fontaine
summary: Site of rock containing Creo vis with power to preserve flesh.

label: Douai
summary: City with a great keep of the Counts of Flanders.

label: Doublet of Impenetrable Silk
summary: A Muto Animal spell (Level 15) that changes an item of silk, wool, or leather so it cannot be cut or penetrated by weapons, granting a Soak bonus.

label: Doubt
summary: A Major Curse (Rego Mentem effect) filling the victim with doubt, requiring Intelligence rolls before undertaking any activity.

label: Douglas
summary: One of the three towns on the Isle of Man.

label: Dousing
summary: Exceptional Talent (MR) for finding water or lost objects.

label: Dovecote
summary: Small building housing several hundred doves or pigeons that tenants may not harm; attracts familiars and magical animals.

label: Dover Castle
summary: Castle whose octagonal three-story archery Bell Tower (built 1189) exemplifies the archery-tower extreme of mural-tower design.

label: Dover Strait
summary: Strait averaging 33 paces deep.

label: Dower
summary: Payment by a husband's family to an heiress's father or guardian.

label: Down Tor
summary: A group of stones on Dartmoor with a circle around a barrow and a long line of stones said to bind and channel a powerful ghost that can be summoned along the line by those who know the rituals.

label: Downpatrick
summary: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

label: Downside
summary: The other end of Devil's Lane; on Walpurgis Night an entrance to Hell briefly appears there.

label: Dowry
summary: Money or goods paid by the bride's family to the bride upon marriage.

label: Dowsing
summary: A Supernatural Ability to find things nearby using a dowsing rod and an intuitive sense, requiring a sympathetic connection to the thing sought.

label: Dowsing Rod
summary: Fetish for Dowsing; enchanted with 1 pawn of Intellego vis.

label: Dozens of Eyes
summary: Gorgon power of omnidirectional eyes granting extraordinary Perception.

label: Drachenfels
summary: Dragon's Rock, a famous legendary site (Magic aura 3) with catacombs where the hero Siegfried slew the dragon Fafnir; crowned by Schloss Drachenfels owned by the archbishop of Cologne.

label: Dragon
summary: A class of predominantly faerie dragons ('worms'): vast venomous snakes that crave vital things such as cows' milk or virgins and often poison their surroundings.

label: Dragon banner
summary: Enchanted wolfish dragonhead battle banner carried for each exarch.

label: Dragon Hill
summary: A small hill near the White Horse of Uffington with a flat top on which nothing will grow.

label: Dragon of Assisi
summary: Dragon seen prowling Assisi's walls in Sylvester's dream, put to flight by a cross from Francis' mouth.

label: Dragon of Brand
summary: Dragon listed in the Tribunal index.

label: Dragon of the Pyrenees
summary: Powerful creature used as a scale comparison with magical Highland giants.

label: Dragon of the Sauerland
summary: A dragon that must be conquered and its heart eaten as the second Quest of the Path of Energy.

label: Dragon's licking stone
summary: Rock in a dragon cave that ends hunger when licked; House Mercere would pay handsomely for it.

label: Dragon's Rest
summary: Mercer House vassal of Confluensis on its original Seine site, hub of the Tribunal's Mercere Portal network.

label: Dragonet
summary: Small, quick fire-breathing dragon with corrosive blood.

label: Dragons and Dragonets
summary: Creatures listed in the Tribunal index; Vorarlberg dragon myths are cited as a source.

label: Drain Energy
summary: Cat power similar to Invocation of Weariness at Touch or Eye range.

label: Drake
summary: Misshapen, less intelligent caricatures of dragons with legs and often stunted wings and dangerous breath.

label: Drake images
summary: Lesser dragon images Pan Caudarax sends to assess the strength of the armada.

label: Dram of the Lion
summary: MuCo(An) 35 ritual charged potion turning the drinker into a lion for a year.

label: Dramatic Elements
summary: The breakdown of a story's structure into dramatis personae (roles) and acts, following the structure common to folktales.

label: Dramatis Personae
summary: The specific roles characters play in fairy tales and myths (hero, villain, donor, helper, princess, task-setter, false hero); one character can combine several roles.

label: Draper
summary: Great official responsible for clothing.

label: Drawing Down the Moon
summary: Thessalian sexual sorcery now summoning Selene.

label: Drawing Up the Siege Ladder
summary: A Rego Herbam 15 spell originally for hauling siege ladders over castle walls, used by librarians to rearrange wooden furniture and move groups of wooden objects.

label: Dreadful Bane of the Fae
summary: A general Perdo Vim spell invented by Philippus Niger, like Demon's Eternal Oblivion but working on creatures with Faerie Might.

label: Dreadful Howl
summary: Black Dog power like Weight of a Thousand Hells.

label: Dream
summary: A realm of the sleeper's mind where navigation is associative, time is non-linear, and magic is governed by Imaginem for spiritual travelers.

label: Dream Calling
summary: Dream interpreter ability to make a touched sleeper dream about a chosen subject (Ease Factor 6).

label: Dream Duration
summary: New Duration lasting for an actual dream, equivalent to Concentration.

label: Dream Interpretation
summary: Method of divination by interpreting dreams, popular but of mixed repute; basis of Hermetic Dream Interpreter.

label: Dream Magic
summary: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue allowing magi to travel spiritually into dreams and cast dream spells; the first degree of the Volshebnii Mechtateli.

label: Dream of the Artifice
summary: InTe 50 spell like Dream of the Mind that Sits for artificial stone.

label: Dream of the Forged
summary: InTe 55 ritual like Dream of the Mind that Sits for metal objects.

label: Dream of the Mind That Sits
aliases: Dream of the Mind That Sits
summary: An Intellego Terram spell (with Creo requisite) that lets the caster probe and perfect the memories of a spirit within a natural stone object.

label: Dream Portal
summary: Portal within dreams, created by physical travelers or occurring naturally, leading to memory, imagination, the dreamscape, or back to the real world.

label: Dream Rituals
summary: Ritual magic in dreams cast spontaneously via Ceremonial Magic rules, requiring dream vis.

label: Dream Target
summary: New Mentem Target allowing travel into one sleeper's dream, equivalent to Individual.

label: Dream vis
summary: Vis found or existing within a dream; usable there but unable to sustain objects or effects outside the dream.

label: Dreamer's Eternal Oblivion
summary: Level 10 dream variant of Demon's Eternal Oblivion used by a diabolist dream traveler against Morphea.

label: Drekavac
summary: Serbian faerie drawn to Christmas celebrations.

label: Drinking
summary: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

label: Dripstone
summary: A brownish wax-feeling enchanted stone (chalcedonius) harvested from Pfalz Island; worn around the neck it lets the wearer perceive illusions, discern truth, and resist the Loreley's song, and is worth 1 pawn of Imaginem vis.

label: Driven
summary: A Personality Flaw compelling a character to pursue a particular goal relentlessly; Darius is Driven to hunt enemies of the Order.

label: Driving Goal
summary: Flaw, e.g. the Prince's to regain Crun Clach or Domnhull's to integrate gruagach magic.

label: Drogo Invigilor
summary: A Tremere magus of Fengheld closely associated with the Welfs, investigated by House Guernicus over suspicions he arranged accidents for the emperor's heirs.

label: Drop of Spring Water of Aquam Vis
aliases: Drop of Spring Water of Aquam Vis
summary: Drop of vis creating a spring on bare earth.

label: Drown
summary: Elemental Spirit of the Waves power to engulf a smaller target after a melee hit, forcing deprivation rolls.

label: Drowned Man
summary: A person who died at sea and was returned to life by a mysterious sea power, like Osgood.

label: Drowned Men
summary: Sailors drowned and returned by a magical force as creatures of magic.

label: Druia
summary: A succubus of the Tempters with Infernal Might 5 who appears as a young woman with beautiful long hair and works in the sex trade between missions.

label: Druid Lore
summary: Lore in which the White Ladies are steeped.

label: Druidism
summary: Tradition from which Hermetic magic arose; anti-Druidical prejudice persists.

label: Druids' Circle
summary: A stone circle on a moor overlooking the Irish Sea whose entrance stones are sensitive to oaths and move nearer to swearers; dark tales say druids practiced human sacrifice there.

label: Druids' Dale
summary: Diedne covenant sponsored by the Well of the Head in 956; destroyed in the Schism War.

label: Druon Antigon
summary: A giant who plagued the Scheldt estuary cutting off hands; slain by Silvius Brabo.

label: Drusela of Blackthorn
summary: Maga who trained and then cast out Jehan.

label: Drusus
summary: Roman who conquered Bavaria in 15 BC.

label: Dry Rot of a Hundred Years
aliases: Dry Rot of a Hundred Years
summary: PeHe 15 spell of Whitburh's destroying ten paces of wooden structure.

label: Dryad
summary: Beings tending trees in a primeval forest tether.

label: Dryades
summary: Greek genii loci of forests.

label: Dublin
summary: City seized by Godred Crovan along with the Sudreys.

label: Duck
summary: Large bird brought down by paired hawks.

label: Dudo of St Quentin
summary: Historian (960-1025), author of History of the Normans.

label: Duel for love
summary: Certamen fought without a political issue, without vis.

label: Duguth
summary: Old Saxon term Horsingas uses for its band of weardmenn instead of turb.

label: Duke
summary: The highest class of French vassal (dux, duc), sometimes more powerful than the king. The title is not used in Britain.

label: Duke Francio
summary: Legendary ancestor of the Frankish kings who fought alongside Priam at Troy.

label: Duke Leopold of Austria
summary: Duke insulted by Richard on crusade who imprisoned him.

label: Duke Mark
summary: Ruler who refused St. Paul a bell.

label: Duke of Aquitaine
summary: Founder of Cluny who made the monastery free from secular authority and subject only to the pope.

label: Duke of Purgatory (power)
summary: Pasiel's constant power boosting Might against control within Purgatory.

label: Duke Simon
summary: Example noble with many vassals.

label: Duke William of Aquitaine
summary: Father of Eleanor who died on pilgrimage in 1137.

label: Dulia
summary: Honor due to a man or power according to its dignity, such as veneration of a saint.

label: Dull Weapon
summary: Hagbui power (PeTe 5) reducing a weapon's damage bonus to zero.

label: Dumah
summary: One of the Maskim, Chief of the Avengers of Evil, the Angel of the Silence of Death, a thousand-eyed angel armed with a fiery rod.

label: Dumping Ground
summary: Covenant Hook: covenant cares for old and infirm nobles, risking interference charges if magic restores them.

label: Dunadd
summary: Former capital of the Scottish kingdom.

label: Duncan Bad Blooded
summary: MacBeth's predecessor, claimed ancestor of the Earls of Dunbar.

label: Duncan I
summary: Grandson of Malcolm II who became King of Scots in 1034; killed by MacBeth.

label: Duncan II
summary: Malcolm's son raised in the Norman court, made king by William Rufus, then murdered.

label: Duncan the Bold
summary: Example clan warrior who suffers a Geas and Curse from Brude Deathless, is Gifted by the Old Woman of the Heather, and has his Geas lifted by Domnhull Beg.

label: Dunkeld
summary: Cattle market city with a large cathedral.

label: Dunoding
summary: A region of Wales near an island where the swynwyr established Pralix's military headquarters, later renamed Cad Gadu.

label: Duplicate the Magi's Control
summary: Jaevert's power duplicating Rego spells.

label: Duplicate the Magi's Creation / Perception / Transmutation / Destruction / Control
aliases: Duplicate the Magi's Creation / Perception / Transmutation / Destruction / Control
summary: Deluders Powers duplicating Hermetic spells of one Technique.

label: Duplicate the Magi's Spell
summary: Deluder Powers duplicating Hermetic spells of a given Technique (Creation, Perception, Transformation).

label: Duplicate the Magi's Transmutation
summary: Jaevert's power duplicating Muto spells.

label: Duplicate the Mechanism
summary: Cr(In)Te 35 Ritual creating an exact duplicate of an existing mechanism.

label: Duplicate the Noble Mechanism
summary: Level 45 ritual variant creating a precious-metal mechanism.

label: Durable External Soul
summary: Major Virtue kolduni must purchase so their External Soul can only be destroyed in a very specific manner.

label: Durand
summary: A freeman who founded the Capuchonnes in the 1180s.

label: Durendal
summary: Roland's magic sword, forged by Wayland Smith with Verditius as apprentice, later stolen by Roscius and studied by the Confraternity of Roland; used in their Initiations.

label: Durenmar
summary: A leading Rhine covenant in the Black Forest that sponsors new covenants; it offered resources to bring Roznov into the Rhine, its leadership decides to recolonize the Rhine Gorge, and its Forum hosts initiations into the Order.

label: Durenmar Lore
summary: An Ability reflecting a magus' familiarity with the contents of the Great Library, addable to study rolls there with a cumulative penalty.

label: Duresca
summary: Iberian covenant raided by Children of Hermes; rumored Guernicus conspiracy center.

label: Duresca Scrolls
summary: Letters purportedly between Guernicus and his filii revealing a plan to dominate the Order, declared fraudulent by the Iberian Tribunal.

label: Durham
summary: The site of the cathedral of St. Cuthbert on a high hill in a loop of the river Wear; a palatinate center of pilgrimage and resistance to the Normans.

label: Duro
summary: Youngest magus of Literatus, wishing to pursue the Dark Arts in seclusion.

label: Dust Devil
summary: A Minor Supernatural Skinchanger variant letting a character become a Size +1 dust devil whirlwind, focused through a glass amulet of Magic-aura sand.

label: Dust Devil of Auram Vis
summary: Small whirlwind of vis keeping air breathable.

label: Dust to Dust
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 15) that turns a dead body or mindless undead to dust in two rounds; does not affect undead possessed by spirits.

label: Dutiful Movement
summary: A common automaton power (base effect 20) letting the automaton walk and follow its creator around.

label: Dutybound
summary: A Flaw binding a character to a sense of duty; those with this Flaw who partake of Honos' Centurions' Feast are instantly cured of Light and Medium Wounds.

label: Dvergar
summary: Norse dwarves originally maggots in the corpse of Ymir, given intelligence by the gods; they flee sunlight and crafted the treasures of the gods.

label: Dwarf
summary: Faeries living in communities guarding the entrances to the earth (caves, barrows, mines); cunning smiths with access to the Earth's treasures who can grant External Vis to other faeries.

label: Dwarf (Faerie)
summary: Faerie with typical Might 5 that may seek to become a dwarf king.

label: Dwarf (Flaw)
summary: Flaw suggested for dwarf-blooded characters.

label: Dwarf-forged warhammer
summary: Gull's magical battle hammer, head over 1000 lbs, with the Break Wards power able to shatter the Aegis of the Hearth.

label: Dybbukim
summary: Spirits cut off from heaven that possess the living.

label: Dyer's Guild
summary: Small Parisian guild infiltrated by Fudarus, producing magically enhanced dyes.

label: Dying Giant
summary: A giant pinned to the earth by rocks near Anne's manor, whose blood yields Corpus vis.

label: Dying Master
summary: Mengalaz.

label: Dyscrasia
summary: The imbalanced state of humors producing a patient's symptoms, which a physician must understand to bring the humors back into balance.

label: Dysenteric Infliction
summary: Saint curse destroying the target with fatal dysentery.

label: 40 (Duration)
summary: Holy magic Duration of forty days and forty nights; equal to Moon.

label: Each Sith
summary: Faerie horse bred for high faeries of the seelie court, able to run over water; Caitlin keeps about a dozen at Crun Clach.

label: Each Uisge
summary: The water horse, a dark faerie of beach and sea-loch that shifts between black horse and handsome man, with sticky skin that traps victims to be devoured.

label: Eadric Wilde
summary: A lord who captured and married a faerie woman, becoming famous and being summoned to London by King William Rufus; he lost her when he reproached her about her sisters.

label: Eagle Clan
summary: A Crintera clan of the nimblest, keen-eyed grogs who are expert archers, acting as spies, hunters, and an informant network across Europe.

label: Eagle of Virtue
summary: A magical eagle with wondrous eyesight that rejuvenates itself by flying to the sun and diving into a fountain.

label: Ealwynn
summary: Bjornaer maga of Horsingas with a stoat/ermine heartbeast whose arts shift with the seasons.

label: Ear
summary: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Grave", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

label: Ear of Truth
summary: InMe 30 spell letting the caster tell whether he hears the truth; used to endorse testimony.

label: Earl
summary: English and Scottish equivalent of a count (comes, comte). An earl has the Great Noble Virtue and spends at least 1000 pounds a year.

label: Earl Harald
summary: Earl of Orkney (Harald Maddaderson) who invaded Moray and Ross from 1197; his family was cursed to be bellicose.

label: Earl of Norfolk
summary: Powerful English noble facing the North Sea, husband of William Longespee's mother.

label: Early Punishment for the Sinful Witch
aliases: Early Punishment for the Sinful Witch
summary: MuVi(Ig) Gen destroying an Infernal effect on an infernalist in white flame.

label: Earring of Whispering Voices
summary: A silver earring scrying device letting its wearer hear a distant person's voice.

label: Ears of the Hare
summary: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

label: Earth Elemental
summary: An ancient elemental summoned by a now-fallen covenant to tend a cavern rock garden; mourning his lost water-elemental love, he yearly carries an engraved rock outside that yields Aquam and Terram vis.

label: Earth Shock
summary: A Terram spell that mimics an earthquake, cited as an example where the material cause (earth) determines the Hermetic Form.

label: Earth That Breaks No More
summary: A Muto Terram spell that turns a volume of packed dirt up to ten cubic paces into stone.

label: Earthly Paradise
summary: Home of the boni non valde where purged souls wait in bliss for Judgment Day; a Celestial regio of level 8 ruled by the Archangel Shamshiel.

label: Ease Factor
summary: Target number for casting Geasa, Gifts and Curses.

label: Easing the Strain of Childbirth
summary: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

label: East Anglia
summary: Region where peasants maintain dykes and lords of marshy manors run large sheep flocks.

label: East Prussia
summary: Region whose forests hide the regio castle where a maiden told Gunnar of the Green Stone.

label: Easter
summary: The most important Christian holy day, celebrating Christ's resurrection, on the first Sunday after the first full moon after the spring equinox.

label: Eastern Christendom
summary: A cultural society of Mythic Europe centered on the Byzantine empire and Constantinople, defining its own Social Statuses.

label: Eastern Church
summary: The Eastern Church centered in Constantinople and Jerusalem, holding sway only on the eastern peripheries of Mythic Europe.

label: Eastern magic
summary: Arab and Persian magical technology channeled through spirits and sometimes powered by demons.

label: Eastern Patriarch
summary: Head of the Eastern Church.

label: Eastern Priest
summary: Minor Status Virtue like Priest but without required celibacy.

label: Eastern Roman Empire
summary: The cosmopolitan eastern realm ('Romania') whose Greek-cultured cities produced House Jerbiton's founding members and the League of Iconophiles.

label: Eastern Tribunal
summary: One of the Tribunals named in 865.

label: Eavesdrop with the Eyes
summary: TaVs 10 spell letting the gruagach's fetch relay conversations of anyone within the caster's field of vision.

label: Eberhardini
summary: A clan of vagantes from northern Italy forming one chapter of the Ordo Vagorum.

label: Eboris
summary: A small neutral covenant in Paris, the House of the Ivory Carvers, led by Mathieus, hosting young Jerbiton magi and the Itinerarium rather than research.

label: Ebroin
summary: The relatively young current Primus of House Ex Miscellanea, elected after Immanola entered Final Twilight, with ambitions to revitalize the House from Cad Gadu.

label: Eccelino da Romano
summary: Tyrant of Verona and Lombardy, possessed by the demon Peris until Magi drove it out in 1259.

label: Echeneis, the Remora
summary: Fish of the Farne Islands.

label: Echo filia Gribbinus
summary: Criamon Mentem specialist with an affinity for ghosts, secretly in love with a Criamon ghost three centuries dead.

label: Ecumenical Council
summary: Special synod called and presided over by the pope; twelve have been held.

label: Eden
summary: The biblical paradise from which man was expelled; noxious plants are said to have acquired harmful qualities after the expulsion.

label: Edessa
summary: Crusader city whose fall in 1144 triggered the Second Crusade.

label: Edgar
summary: The newest Redcap of the Stonehenge Tribunal, in his early twenties, good-looking with light brown hair and gray eyes, with no magical items yet.

label: Edgar Atheling
summary: Saxon heir-apparent whom Horsingas originally sought to restore.

label: Edge of the Razor
summary: A spell that sharpens a weapon to improve attacks; disfavored by the School of Ramius because Magic Resistance can stop the enchanted weapon. Its damage bonus can combine with Hardness of Adamantine.

label: Edicts of Augustus
summary: Athenaeus' second-century tractatus on Civil and Canon Law recording Augustus' investiture.

label: Edifice
summary: Church Boon representing a notable building feature, such as a church tower.

label: Edifice Boon
summary: A covenant Boon that troupes may select instead of paying Build Points for a Great Work.

label: Edinburgh
summary: Capital of Scotland, a royal burgh with about 1,500 inhabitants.

label: Eduardus
summary: Tytalus magus apprenticed in Jerbiton, steward of Montverte under the persona Edward; a member of the purple Fideli.

label: Educated
summary: A Minor General Virtue for education in a beit ha-midrash or yeshivah, granting Academic Abilities and 50 experience points in Hebrew, Aramaic, and Judaic studies.

label: Educated (Bardic)
summary: A Minor General Virtue for attending a Hibernian bardic school, granting 50 experience points in storytelling and lore Abilities.

label: Educated (Islamic)
summary: Minor General Virtue for characters educated in a mosque or Qur'an school, granting 50 experience points in Arabic, Persian, Greek, Latin, Theology: Islam, Islamic Law and Artes Liberales.

label: Educated (Vernacular)
summary: A Minor, General Virtue representing secular instruction given by tutors to scions of merchant houses, granting Academic Abilities and 50 extra experience points for practical business skills.

label: Edward I of England
summary: English king who arbitrates the Scottish succession and conquers Scotland.

label: Edward of Milton
aliases: Edward of Milton, follower of Jerbiton
summary: A Jerbiton archmagus and nominated head of the covenant Schola Pythagoranis in Cambridge, friend and former teacher of the scholar Robert Grosseteste.

label: Edward the Confessor
summary: English king at whose court Malcolm Canmore grew up.

label: Edward the White of Jerbiton
summary: A magus skilled in the magic of the sea, famed for unsuccessful attempts to find Atlantis, who leads The Single Ocean league from his enchanted ship.

label: Effica
summary: Example maga with Mutable Puissant Terram.

label: Efficient & Permanent Wall of Protecting Stone
aliases: Efficient & Permanent Wall of Protecting Stone
summary: CrTe 20 ritual creating a permanent stone wall of 10,000 cubic paces, the maximum at no extra cost for a fourth-magnitude ritual.

label: Effigy of the Errant Image
summary: A small wooden statue letting the user project his image to a connected location for two-way communication.

label: Effusion
summary: Unholy Power Ability wielding power over the physical world, inorganic materials and natural forces.

label: Efnisien
summary: A Welsh hero claimed by some as the first of the Nemthengacha, the bitter-tongued Ex Miscellanea tradition.

label: Egbert
summary: Brother of Elizabeth of Schönau who helped with and influenced the reports of her visions.

label: Egg of Animal Vis
summary: Snake egg of vis that releases poisonous snakes when warmed.

label: Eginhard filius Caspar
summary: Bjornaer magus with a lammergeir heartbeast, pair-bonded to Kamilla; glacially patient schemer.

label: Eginolf
summary: A magus of House Flambeau of Rudiaria covenant against whom charges of diabolism were brought (unproven) in 962 AD.

label: Egyházasfalu
summary: Future Templar site in Hungary.

label: Egypt
summary: A region of Mythic Europe near the Pyramids and the great Sphinx where magi established a desert laboratory.

label: Egyptian days
summary: Inauspicious days whose observation was a forbidden practice for inquisitors.

label: Ehwaz
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Horse" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the horse, mobility in combat and the bond of horse and rider; associated with Animal.

label: Eiael
summary: Eiael, Aid to the Wise, an angel (Divine Might 20) tasked with guarding lovers of wisdom who pursue magical arts; he teaches practitioners of Ars Notoria and may be summoned via Psalm 36.

label: Eibingen
summary: Place across the Rhine where Hildegard founded a nunnery in 1165.

label: Eider Duck of Virtue
summary: Magic Animal eider ducks aligned to both Magic and Divine, whose Quell the Savage Waves power calms waves.

label: Eidolon
summary: Common spirit power used to create illusions and communicate, e.g. an oasis illusion or phantom noises.

label: Eidolons
summary: Airy Spirits of emotions created by humans near strong magic.

label: Eildon Hills
summary: Hollow hills near Melrose containing a faerie community led by the Queen of Elfland, with regio leading to Arcadia; split into three by Michael Scot's demon.

label: Eilean Beg
summary: Covenant where Uierna met the young gruagach Chearlach Mac Caolin.

label: Ein Sof
summary: The infinite and unknowable counterpart to the Sefirot; hubristic kabbalists who strive for it risk temptation.

label: Einhard
summary: Historical author of The Life of Charlemagne, listed among the period works in the bibliography.

label: Einherjar
summary: Spiritual warriors awaiting Ragnarok, into whom Valkyries transform the worthy dead chosen from battle.

label: Einsiedeln
summary: Benedictine abbey town, the tribunal's most important pilgrimage site.

label: Eirik
summary: Example vitki.

label: Eirik Svennson
summary: 29-year-old Norwegian warrior vitki serving the king of Norway under his uncle Sven Svennson, a member of the birkebeiners stationed near Trondheim.

label: Eisenstadt
summary: Settlement marking the tribunal border.

label: Eisheth Zenunim
summary: One of the four demon wives of Iblis, a demon of prostitution.

label: Eithne
summary: Prophetic member of the Fomoire.

label: Čejkovice
summary: Future Templar preceptory in Moravia.

label: Ekstasis
summary: The magical power defining nightwalker traditions, also called straying, which lets a magician send forth his spirit while unconscious; it has no corresponding Ability.

label: El Cid
summary: Iberian hero whose tales Flambeau magi love.

label: Elagabalus
summary: Roman emperor who declared Sol Invictus the State religion in the early third century and was removed four years later.

label: Elaine
summary: Flambeau's second apprentice, a Frankish girl who became a Hoplite, Archmage, and scholar; she trained four apprentices and authored several enduring books.

label: Elbe
summary: A river haunted by a Wild Hunt led by Frau Wode and by shadowy boatmen carrying invisible passengers.

label: Elbruz Mountains
summary: The mountains where Baghl the earth jinni haunts a dark cave formerly used as a quarry.

label: Elder Futhark
summary: The original 24-rune alphabet used by the vitkir in their earliest spells, the strongest form of rune magic.

label: Elder Gild
summary: A gild that split from the Hawthorn Gild to pursue a fae-focused agenda, concentrating on preserving faeries and friendly contact with them; led by Iacob of Irencillia and made up mostly of Merinita magi.

label: Eleanor of Aquitaine
summary: Overlord of Aquitaine who attended the Second Crusade with a guard of female knights dressed as Amazons; her scandalous behavior led to a Papal Bull barring women from the Third Crusade. An example of inheritance-based female power.

label: Eleanor of England
summary: Daughter of Henry II and Eleanor of Aquitaine who married Alfonso VIII and co-founded Las Huelgas in 1187.

label: Eleanor Sworder
summary: The woman who has led Nigrasaxa's turb for five years and aspires to be a knight; bears an ugly scar on her left cheek.

label: Electus
summary: Third degree of the Fraternity of Samos, which teaches the esoteric principles of astrology and grants Planetary Magic.

label: Elegans
summary: Magus of Mercere at Harco who makes longevity potions and magic items.

label: Elemental
summary: Magical creatures composed of pure elemental matter (earth, water, air, or fire) formed through rarefication under a magical impetus; not truly alive, they do not age, eat, or reproduce and recover Might only slowly in a Magic aura.

label: Elemental Affinity
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving Elementalist Form xp when studying a chosen Ability.

label: Elemental Control
summary: Power common to all Aerial Powers controlling an element (fire, earth, air).

label: Elemental kings
summary: Powerful spirits of the Magic realm whose favor Archmage Vinaria of Merinita must win for her archmage challenge.

label: Elemental Magic
summary: A Major, Hermetic Virtue letting a magus manipulate the elemental Forms (Aquam, Auram, Ignem, Terram) as a connected whole, sharing experience among them.

label: Elemental Medicine
summary: Major background Virtue of elemental physicians; acquired through the Ritual of Improving the Physician's Character.

label: Elemental Philosopher
summary: Elementalist of the Philosophical type who conjures natural phenomena, matter and animals.

label: Elemental Philosophiae
summary: Major background Virtue of elemental philosophers, acquired through the Ritual of Making the Soul Actually Knowledgeable.

label: Elemental Physician
summary: Elementalist of the Medicinal type who manipulates bodily humors.

label: Elemental spirit
summary: A spirit that broke free of an ancient binding and caused rockslides in the Black Mountains in revenge on humanity; Goliard restored its binding and took control of it.

label: Elemental Spirit of the Waves
summary: Potent water elemental possibly penned inside the island's wall, dying and furious; Magic Might 35.

label: Elemental spirits
summary: Primordial spirits of fire and water that retreated underground, revealed in hot and cold springs.

label: Elemental Theurgist
summary: Elementalist of the Theurgical type who summons and commands elementals.

label: Elemental Theurgy
summary: Special background Virtue of elemental theurgists that could be converted into a Hermetic Virtue with a Minor Breakthrough.

label: Elemental Warping
summary: Elementalist warping as elemental Personality Traits that add to Soak and can cause madness.

label: Elementalist
summary: Hedge tradition that controls the four elements through Elementalist Techniques and Forms; in 1220 they tend to look like academics.

label: Elementalist Air
summary: Difficult Elementalist Form of air, affecting sanguine humors, weather, birds and air elementals.

label: Elementalist Air (Virtue)
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Air 0 and a Sanguine trait.

label: Elementalist Arts
summary: The Techniques and Forms of elementalist magic, traditionally said to have been developed by Apollonius of Tyana and his followers.

label: Elementalist Earth
summary: Difficult Elementalist Form of earth, affecting melancholic humors, minerals and earth elementals.

label: Elementalist Earth (Virtue)
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Earth 0 and a Melancholic trait.

label: Elementalist Fire
summary: Elementalist Form for fire; associated with choleric temperament and produces Ignem vis when Refining.

label: Elementalist Fire (Virtue)
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Fire 0 and a Choleric trait.

label: Elementalist Societies
summary: Groups of likeminded elementalists sharing particular Techniques and Forms; initiating members via Mystery Cult rules.

label: Elementalist Water
summary: Difficult Elementalist Form of water, affecting phlegmatic humors, liquids and water elementals.

label: Elementalist Water (Virtue)
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Water 0 and a Phlegmatic trait.

label: Elementary
summary: A Major laboratory Outfittings Flaw: a cut-down lab with extremely limited equipment allowing only one category of lab activity, cheap to maintain (-2 General Quality, -3 Upkeep).

label: Elephant of Virtue
summary: A wise magical elephant that lives three hundred years and never forgets; it must eat mandrake root to mate.

label: Eleutherius
summary: Assistant of St. Denis, martyred with him.

label: Elevated
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab is at least four floors up or atop a tower, commanding a view (+1 Aesthetics, +1 Auram).

label: Elf
summary: Possible baby thief who forgot to leave a changeling.

label: Elias Bonibarone
summary: Minister General of the Little Brothers, born 1180 at Belvilia; handles active leadership as Francis' health fails and is tempted by acquiring land and money.

label: Elijah
summary: Patriarch who almost destroyed the archangel Azrael.

label: Elisavet
summary: Apostle of Apollonius elemental theurgist, 51, exiled daughter of a Hermetic advisor, living on a Mediterranean island with a bound air elemental.

label: Elisha
summary: Old Testament prophet whose 'Death in the Pot' story is thought to involve desert truffles.

label: Elixir Points
summary: Points from extra ingredients determining Elixir Level for the Lesser Elixir.

label: Eliza
summary: Old unGifted folk witch living in the Reims townhouse, a healer of the poor whose rooster is her familiar.

label: Elizabeth of Schönau
summary: Benedictine nun and mystic (born 1129) at Schönau who recorded her visions in the Books of Visions and corresponded with Hildegard.

label: Ellyon
summary: Welsh brownie-like faeries that vanish forever if they learn they are being spied upon.

label: Elohim
summary: Angelic messengers.

label: Eloi of Cunfin
summary: Pious Jerbiton magus of Cunfin, Jerome's filius, liaison to the Church.

label: Eloi of Jerbiton
summary: Founder and prior of Cunfin, a pious Gentle Gifted magus bridging Order and Church.

label: Elpis
summary: Hope, the only being remaining in Pandora's jar.

label: Elsa
summary: The young widowed duchess of Brabant rescued by the Knight of the Swan Lohengrin, whom she wedded and lost when she broke her vow not to ask his name.

label: Elspeth
summary: Example tainted midwife dedicated to a demon at birth, devoting newborns to her demon.

label: Ely
summary: An abbey and bishopric, site of the tomb of St. Etheldreda and a pilgrimage destination; setting of Bricstan's miraculous deliverance.

label: Elysian Guardian
summary: Guardian of the Path of Destiny, usually of the kerberos type, conferring a hero symbol with a boon and prohibition.

label: Elysian Quest
summary: Reenacting a legend on the Path of Destiny to gain insight or a boon of faerie nature.

label: Elysium
summary: The world of the Faerie Realm holding myths and tales of great deeds, where characters meet heroes, villains and faerie gods; reached by the Path of Destiny.

label: Ember Days
summary: Four seasonal fasts of the western Church whose Thursdays are when the benandanti fight; kresniks also battle then.

label: Embitterment
summary: A Major Non-Hermetic Supernatural Ability of the Nemthengacha allowing a speaker, through conversation, to make a listener hostile to a chosen target, up to the level of murder.

label: Embodying the Light
summary: Cumulative powers of divine light gained at True Faith Scores 2, 3 and 5, based on the theological virtues Devotion, Hope and Charity.

label: Embrace of Boethius
summary: A Perdo Mentem 35 ritual spell that damages a magus's mind, heart, and Gift, forcing reliance on casting tools, used to initiate other Hermetic magi into House Verditius.

label: Emerald Coast
summary: Northern coast near Mont St. Michel.

label: Emerald of Charlemagne
summary: A 28-pound 'emerald' of glass at Reichenau, among many spurious relics.

label: Emerald of Virtue
summary: Gem containing 2 pawns of Animal vis that, Enriched in a snake's nest, grants Animal Ken restricted to serpents.

label: Emeralds
summary: Emeralds listed in the Tribunal index among minerals and substances.

label: Emesa
summary: Syrian city where the Sol cultists kept a hidden temple with relics from Elagabalus' reign; liberated by Crusaders in 1110.

label: Emet
summary: Word meaning 'truth' written on a golem's forehead; erasing the aleph makes it 'met' (death) and returns the golem to clay.

label: Emir
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue equivalent to Knight but for Muslim emirs, who are skilled in hunting, religious teachings, and culture as well as martial pursuits.

label: Emotion-Enhancing Aura
summary: A Magic aura that grants or modifies Personality Traits of those without Magic-derived supernatural abilities, e.g. Aggressive, Carefree, Communicative, Respectful.

label: Emotion Theft
summary: A Supernatural Ability granted by the Thief of Emotions Virtue, allowing one to steal an emotion from a person and transfer it to another by touch.

label: Empathy
summary: Faerie Method (Stamina) drawing Faerie power within the caster through a trance ritual costing Fatigue, doubling Sympathy for effect limits.

label: Empedocles
summary: An ancient philosopher whose teaching underlies Criamon thought; the Gorgiastics are named for a student who turned against him, and one Sufi school reveres him as a hierophant.

label: Emperor Aurelian
summary: 3rd-century emperor who built Rome's walls.

label: Empire of Nicea
summary: Possible location for the Cursewood in the Theban Tribunal variant.

label: Empiricus
summary: A character specializing in one surgical or medical procedure, often itinerant; a derogatory term used by the literate medical profession for the unlearned.

label: Employed by Company
summary: A minor Story Flaw for salaried employees answerable to an employer but backed by the company's resources; suits characters working primarily for a salary.

label: Empowering Prison of the Declining Spirit
aliases: Empowering Prison of the Declining Spirit
summary: Re(Mu)Vi(Forms) general Mystery enchantment that traps a spirit in a device and drains its Might to power Ritual effects.

label: Empress Helena
summary: Empress who originally discovered the bodies of the Three Wise Men on her pilgrimage to the Holy Land.

label: Empty
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab has a large amount of unused space, costlier to maintain; taken per two points by which Size exceeds occupied Size.

label: Empyreal Aura
summary: A Divine aura untouched by worldly matters, radiating from relics, saints, miracle sites or divine creatures rather than a congregation; manifests as a sphere.

label: Empyreal realm
summary: Realm to which Nerius could travel through his greater regio spell.

label: Emrys
summary: A Welsh seer who made a pact with faeries to trade his life for his son Ambrosius's, serving as magical advisor to a faerie court; his spirit could be seen watching over the boy.

label: Enais
summary: The Peacock Angel revered by the Mulhidun, who extinguished Hell's fires and released its demons.

label: Enbarr
summary: Manannan's horse, Splendid Mane, which runs faster than the wind and trots across water.

label: Encased Vis
summary: The most common faerie vis: Magic vis over which a faerie has laid glamour to claim it.

label: Enchant Casting Tools
aliases: Enchant Casting Tools — Minor House Mystery
summary: A Minor House Inner Mystery of Verditius allowing a magus to enchant his casting tools to mirror mastered spell effects and grant casting bonuses.

label: Enchanted Anchor of Verdi
summary: Iron anchor keeping Verdi's lake clean and fresh.

label: Enchanted Baron's Chair
summary: Centuries-old high chair enchanted with a Mentem effect to ensure the baron's compliance; slightly Warps its occupants.

label: Enchanted birthing chair
summary: An enchanted chair at Voluntas's village that ensures almost all mothers and children survive childbirth, giving Wilton unusually high life expectancy.

label: Enchanted Brooch
summary: Hermetic enchanted item lost by a Redcap that makes travel easier, found by a Franciscan friar.

label: Enchanted Caman of Count Gwyridden
summary: Gwyridden's enchanted shinty stick.

label: Enchanted Devices
summary: Hermetic enchantments forming the basis of magical technology.

label: Enchanted Item
summary: Magic device that can be triggered as a combat action.

label: Enchanted Items
summary: Magic items churches may possess, costing 1 Build Point per level.

label: Enchanted Priest
summary: Story element: local priest held by a disgruntled faerie.

label: Enchanting (Ability)
summary: A Minor Supernatural Ability Virtue applying to a particular artistic expression (dance, drawing, storytelling, craftwork) that in Faerie auras can control events through art.

label: Enchanting Music
summary: A performance Ability; a Music score of six or higher is required for Imaginem vis to accumulate in Reginald's Rebec, and the rebec grants a +3 bonus to Music rolls.

label: Enchantment
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab itself has been enchanted as a magic item, granting Virtues, Flaws, or Specialization changes.

label: Enchantment of Detachment
summary: A spell that calms and greatly lowers the intensity of the target's current emotions.

label: Enchantment of the Magnified Regio
summary: MuVi(Te) 39 Mystery enchantment doubling the size of a Magical regio up to 200 paces across.

label: Enchantment of the Pedestrian Pigeon
summary: A MuMe 15 spell that occludes a person's memory of told information until a key phrase unlocks it, used for secure transfer of information between conspirators.

label: Enchantment of the Scrying Device
summary: In(Forms) general Mystery effect enchanted into a divinatory device, giving a magical bonus of effect level/10 to divination.

label: Enchantment of the Scrying Pool
summary: An Intellego Aquam Ritual spell (Level 30) with an Imaginem requisite that turns a body of water into a scrying pool; an old Mercurian ritual known throughout the Order.

label: Enchantment to Block the Assault of Iron
aliases: Enchantment to Block the Assault of Iron
summary: Rego Terram 20 spell by Domnhull Beg, focused on an iron ring, enchanting an item that blocks attacks with substantial metal components.

label: Enchantment to Block the Assault of Wood
aliases: Enchantment to Block the Assault of Wood
summary: Rego Herbam 20 spell by Domnhull Beg, focused on a wooden ring, blocking attacks with substantial wooden components.

label: Enclosure Movement
summary: Post-game-period English movement that popularized the tragedy-of-the-commons idea and gave greens to landed gentry.

label: Encroaching Dominion
summary: Scenario presented in Tales of Power, apt for approaching the Apple Gild.

label: Encumbrance
summary: A penalty derived from the Load of carried equipment, calculated through Burden and offset by Strength, that subtracts from athletic and spellcasting rolls.

label: End of the Mighty Castle
summary: A Perdo Terram (PeTe 25) spell that collapses a building; since non-magical stone falls due to gravity, Magic Resistance does not protect against it.

label: Endless Wine
summary: Faun power filling vessels with wine.

label: Endor
summary: Home of the woman with a familiar spirit.

label: Endorsing Testimony
summary: Process by which a Quaesitor magically verifies a witness's testimony after the witness lowers Parma.

label: Endow the Servant of Retribution
summary: She-Wolf ritual power imposing the Spiritual Pact Virtue on a target.

label: Endurance of the Berserkers
summary: A Rego Corpus spell (Level 15) that makes the caster's body act as though unwounded and unfatigued while concentrating, with deferred Fatigue loss.

label: Endurance of the Enraged
summary: Furies Power ignoring wound penalties except on Defense.

label: Endurance of the Flame Dancer
summary: Flame Dancer power to feel unwounded and unfatigued until sunrise or sunset.

label: Endurance of the Gluttonous
summary: Mahonin's Power making the possessed oblivious to pain while eating.

label: Enduring Constitution
summary: A Minor, General Virtue allowing a character to withstand pain and fatigue, reducing Fatigue and wound penalties and granting +3 to resist pain.

label: Enduring Magic
summary: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue causing the magus's spells to last longer than usual, with the storyguide secretly multiplying durations by a die roll.

label: Energumen
summary: A human possessed by a demon, targeted by Exorcise the Filthy Spirit.

label: Energy Magic
summary: Minor Hermetic Virtue from breaking the Limit of Energy, granting new Creo and Perdo Corpus Fatigue guidelines.

label: Energy Sense
summary: InCo(Me) 20 spell sensing a target's Fatigue status.

label: Enervators
summary: Deluders that lurk around magicians making their magic appear stronger and promoting overconfidence, via the Deceiver's Boost Power.

label: Enfeebled
summary: A Major General Flaw preventing the character from exerting himself for more than a few seconds, rendering him helpless in combat or chases.

label: Enfolding
summary: Angelic power (Vim) rendering the soul, or at greater cost the body, of the pious wholly protected for a brief moment.

label: Engadine valley
summary: Valley from which Josephine hails.

label: Engagement
summary: State of being within reach or line of fire of an enemy; engaged characters must disengage to move.

label: Engelbert I
summary: The current archbishop of Cologne, a tall, fair, and just man holding the status of Archchancellor of Italy, martyred in 1225 if the saga follows real history.

label: England
summary: A kingdom of Mythic Europe where women have fewer rights than in most other parts (partly an effect of the Norman Conquest) and large areas are set aside as noble hunting ranges; its king has sworn fealty to the king of France for mainland possessions.

label: English Channel
summary: Northern boundary, with a regio of Viking wrecks.

label: Enhance the Memory Palace
summary: CrMe 20 locus spell.

label: Enigmatic Cord
summary: Special familiar cord forged by Radislav with Volya granting the Visions talent.

label: Enigmatic Magic
summary: Criamon magic Auctus sought to integrate.

label: Enigmatic Wisdom
summary: A House Criamon Ability that grants far-reaching perception of strange phenomena, aids comprehension of Wizard's Twilight (while making it more likely), and can substitute for Chirurgy and Medicine on the Path of the Body.

label: Enlighten
summary: Gabriel's power to implant Knowledge.

label: Enliven the Gross Earth
summary: Ritual power used by truffle daughters and the Matron to create an Earth Elemental.

label: Enliven the Gross (Elemental Form)
summary: Ritual Power creating and controlling an elemental from raw elemental matter.

label: Enliven the Gross Fire
summary: Ritual power letting a fire elemental spawn more fire elementals.

label: Enliven the Gross Water
summary: Phorcys' ritual power to create and control a water elemental of Might up to 39.

label: Enliven the Gross Waters
summary: Anne's Ritual Power creating water elementals.

label: Ennoble the Base
summary: Berith's Power making a target see something as more noble than it is.

label: Enriched Objects of Virtue
summary: Objects enriched using Magic Lore that could spread in Mythic Europe.

label: Enrichment
summary: The process of treating a Thing of Virtue (herb, object, tree) through a ritual procedure, usually over a season, so it confers a Virtue or power instead of being harvested for vis.

label: Enslave the Mortal Mind
summary: A spell that lets the caster completely control the loyalty, emotions, desires, and activities of any person.

label: Enter the Faerie Forest
summary: Gegenes power to pass between the faerie forest regio and mundane forest on Bear Island.

label: Enter the Sylvan Glen
summary: Daktyl power to enter any Faerie regio.

label: Enthralling Sound
summary: Faerie power producing fear or infatuation through sound, used by Lamashtu, gorgons and the Lesser Nymph.

label: Enthrallment
summary: Special gruagach ability of Damhan-allaidh. Like Rego and Perdo Mentem; used to take over minds of nobles, magi or churchmen.

label: Enticer of Multitudes
summary: A Minor, General, Tainted Virtue giving a corrupt version of Inspirational usable only to manipulate people toward evil acts.

label: Entisimon
summary: A Primus of House Flambeau who rallied the House during the Schism War but was disgraced and forced to resign during the Normandy Crisis.

label: Entrancement
