summary: A Supernatural Ability (always Range Eye, Duration Special, Target Individual) using Rego Mentem guidelines to control a human's emotions and thoughts; the defining magic of the Malocchi.

label: Entreat the Divine Powers
summary: Minor Virtue gained via Initiation, invoking Divine powers.

label: Entreat the Faerie Powers
summary: Required Virtue for cunning-folk.

label: Entreat the Powers
summary: Major Supernatural Virtue letting a learned magician minimize negative effects of Divine or Infernal auras on magic.

label: Enumerus
summary: A renowned Jerbiton magus who wrote a treatise on covenant economics held in the Great Library of Durenmar; he gave his name to the Pound of Enumerus, the unaccountable yearly petty expenditure.

label: Envied Beauty
summary: A Major Story Flaw whose character's beauty draws revulsion and jealousy, especially from vain persons of the character's gender.

label: Envious
summary: A Major or Minor Personality Flaw in which the character believes others undeservedly have it better and tries to ruin their lives.

label: Environmental Magic Condition
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw halving all of the character's Casting and Lab Totals in certain common environmental conditions.

label: Environmental Sensitivity
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is unusually sensitive to an uncommon environmental feature, suffering a Stamina penalty when exposed.

label: Envisioning
summary: Demonic Power to appear in dreams or cause waking visions; the only way a spiritual demon communicates.

label: Envy
summary: One of the capital vices, opposed by a holy temper.

label: Eosophoros
summary: Planetary spirit of Venus, ruling romance, poets and jewels.

label: Eostre
summary: Sabbat held at the Spring Equinox.

label: Ephesus
summary: A site in the Theban Tribunal holding a statue of Diana that Huntress initiates may anoint with sacred oil during the Eumolpid initiation.

label: Epic of Charlemagne
summary: Collection of chivalric tales about Charlemagne and his paladins.

label: Epimetheus
summary: Hariste's devoted pupil who contracted leprosy while consoling her after Tytalus's disappearance, thereby founding the leper magi lineage.

label: Epiphany
summary: Feast ending the kallikantzaroi's time on the surface, with the Blessing of the Waters.

label: Epirus
summary: Seat of a claimant to the Byzantine Empire.

label: Epistles of the Brethren of Purity and Loyal Friends
aliases: Epistles of the Brethren of Purity and Loyal Friends
Rasa'il Ikhwan as-Safa' wa Khillan al-Wafa
summary: 52 letters in four books serving as tractatus and, with the Comprehensive Epistle, summae on Elementalist Arts.

label: Equine Charisma
summary: Kelpie power making itself alluring to victims.

label: Equine Metamorphosis
summary: Kelpie power transforming it into a black stallion.

label: Equine Shape
summary: Personal Power letting the character transform into a horse until sunrise or sunset.

label: Equipment Availability
summary: Classification of weapons and armor by historical period (ancient, early, high, late medieval) or region.

label: Equipment Without Encumbrance
summary: Faeries suffer no Encumbrance for traditional props, which are made of glamour and can be reconstituted.

label: Er Lanic
summary: Isle with stones.

label: Eratosthenes
summary: Devised the armillary sphere in antiquity.

label: Eremite
summary: Major Supernatural Flaw: exploring the divine alone, unable to learn Supernatural Abilities from any tradition; requires True Faith.

label: Erfurt
summary: The oldest and largest settlement in Thuringia, an episcopal city under the archbishopric of Mainz, deriving wealth from the export of woad.

label: Eric
summary: A reckless magus of House Tytalus and co-founder of Waddenzee, a Danish generalist who favors Aquam and Auram and embraces the pirate lifestyle.

label: Erictho
summary: Legendary Thessalian witch described in Lucan's Pharsalia, namesake of the Daughters of Erictho.

label: Erik von Ribe
summary: A magus of House Tytalus, filius of Tasgillia, quoted remarking that a magus lacking a disgraced ancestor shows a distinct lack of enterprise.

label: Erimas of Tytalus
summary: Luctatio magus on the Council of Pavia.

label: Erin
summary: Former young Quaesitor who joined the Blessed One and serves in the Inner Circle.

label: Erinnyes
summary: Chthonic Leti who avenge crimes against the natural and moral order.

label: Eris
summary: Figure in The Iliad who pitched the world into war for amusement.

label: Erispoë
summary: Nominoé's son, who took the title King of Brittany.

label: Eristic Moot
summary: A public dispute between competing speakers used by House Tytalus to settle differences, announced by Redcap; includes special forms such as the Apprentice's Gauntlet and the contest for Primus.

label: Ermenrik
summary: Dietrich's uncle, German ruler of Rome, who conquered Bern.

label: Errant Knight
summary: Knight who makes his living from the tournament circuit rather than a fief.

label: Errantus
summary: Criamon magus who kept a staff stolen from Justina and was injured by Bartholomew.

label: Erratus
summary: Example magus who miscalculates an Astrological Duration.

label: Errina
summary: Ancient Greek writer who described the tortoise game.

label: Ertholmene Archipelago
summary: Uninhabited Baltic archipelago lacking sea room.

label: Eruv
summary: Boundary temporarily set up to define the community a golem protects.

label: Erysipelas
summary: A Minor Choleric Disease of morbid choler from excessive heat and dryness, causing a maddening rash on the extremities.

label: Erythravis
summary: An Archmage of House Guernicus who executed Tasgillia for diabolism in 961 AD.

label: Es-Sindibad
summary: Sindbad of the Sea and of the Land from A Thousand and One Nights.

label: Escalade
summary: Direct assault in which attackers scale castle walls with towers, ladders and ropes, resolved with battlefield event rules.

label: Eschenfrau
summary: A very evil wood-spirit who must be appeased with a sacrifice on Ash Wednesday by those unfortunate enough to live near one.

label: Esoteric Magic
summary: Secret variations on standard Hermetic magic practiced by those who belong to Mystery Cults.

label: Espera of Merinita
summary: A Merinita maga of Ungulus who offended a faerie lord and devotes herself to survival, never leaving the Aegis and wearing enchanted iron items against faeries.

label: Esperance
summary: Follower of Verditius whose diary describes the history of Whitlams.

label: Espurgatoire seint Patritz
summary: A widely circulated tract describing a knight's vision of the torments of Hell.

label: Essedarius
summary: Charioteer certamen techniques that intimidate foes.

label: Essential Flaw
summary: Major or Minor General Flaw giving a detrimental Essential Trait tied to a Characteristic.

label: Essential Nature
summary: A character's intrinsic, magically defining nature, which can make certain Flaws impossible to remove even with Hermetic magic.

label: Essential Traits
summary: Traits possessed by some creatures of the Magic Realm that are part of their essential nature, marked with an asterisk; magic cannot make such creatures act against them.

label: Essential Virtue
summary: Virtue granting a beneficial Essential Trait; every Beast of Virtue must take one to represent how it typifies its species.

label: Establishment
summary: Kennels, stables or mews with a quality, capacity, maintenance and Living Conditions modifier.

label: Estampie
summary: Stamping dance.

label: Esther filia Gribbinus
summary: Criamon Imaginem specialist petrified by faeries whose ghost-like form may be a juno created by Twilight.

label: Estor
summary: Signal to charge in the tournament melee.

label: Estrid Danesson
summary: A magus Ex Miscellanea (age 36) of Oculus Septentrionalis, a Danish former hedge wizard specializing in sailing and weather magics who gathers vis around the Baltic; cousin and enemy of Eric Ribecus.

label: Esztergom
summary: Future Templar site in Hungary.

label: Eternal Repetition in a Bottomless Pool
aliases: Eternal Repetition in a Bottomless Pool
summary: A Creo Imaginem 35 spell that uses enchanted mirrors to display the text of a book the magus has an arcane connection to, navigable by vocal command.

label: Eternal Sleeper
summary: Mysterious being in whose mind the Vermilion Temple is said to be a dream; rumored to be an old one, the sleeping king, or Tytalus.

label: Ethelwald
summary: The seneschal and autocrat of Voluntas who plays lord of the manor to the outside world and avoids becoming a knight to escape military service.

label: Ethereal Fisherman Spiders
summary: Social spiders that trap and breed in ghosts; farmed for silk.

label: Ethiopia
summary: The location of a cave complex that is the perfect site for the Microcosm ritual on the Path of the Body, discovered in North Africa.

label: Etin Bride
summary: A female Jotun who has taken a human husband and teaches Trollskap to her descendants.

label: Etiquette
summary: The Ability central to Jerbiton 'tasteful living,' used to convey symbolic messages, make individual impressions at events, and force rivals into faux pas.

label: Etruscans
summary: Ancient people whose burial shafts Vespillo explored and whom Lasa Vegoia taught theurgy and divination.

label: Ettin
summary: Brutish Germanic giants (also called ogres or trolls) of Size +3 to +5, harmed by sunlight; their females are troll-wives.

label: Ettin Blood
summary: Faerie Blood variety granting Stamina, with sunlight vulnerability.

label: Ettrick Forest
summary: Lowland forest whose inhabitants use bows.

label: Etzel
summary: The king of the Huns in the Nibelungenlied, who marries Kriemhild; historically Attila, the dreaded chieftain checked at the Battle of Chalons.

label: Euclid
summary: Greek philosopher whose teachings the Brethren of Purity combined in their encyclopedia.

label: Eucrasia
summary: The state of perfect balance of the humors that prolongs life and negates bodily suffering, the goal of a medical regimen, represented as a Living Conditions Modifier.

label: Eudokia
summary: The world of the Faerie Realm where one's personal story, moral dilemma, or life transition is told; reached by the Path of Choice.

label: Eule
summary: An aged master of House Bjornaer at Fengheld with the heartbeast of an owl and the honorary rank of Quaesitor; she may have entered Final Twilight and her wisdom is faked by Gunther.

label: Eule's Wisdom Item
summary: A low-level but very high-Penetration Perdo Mentem magic item hidden in the floor of Eule's receiving room that calms minds and removes emotion, used by Gunther to fake her wisdom.

label: Eulogius of House Ex Miscellanea
summary: Decrepit founder of the Donatores who runs Requies Aeterna; a master of Perdo, Corpus and Mentem.

label: Eunuch
summary: Minor General Flaw for a castrated male character, often made so for work in a harem or military school; grants freedom of movement among the sexes.

label: Euric
summary: Visigoth king campaigning across Western Europe 470-485.

label: Europa
summary: Phoenician princess carried off by Zeus.

label: European Wildcat
summary: Wild cat with thicker shaggy coat and bushy tail.

label: Eurybia
summary: Titaness, mistress of the weather.

label: Eurydice
summary: Orpheus's beloved wife who died of a viper's bite and whom he tried to recover from the Underworld.

label: Eurynome
summary: A sea nymph who, with Thetis, rescued and raised Hephaestus after Zeus cast him into the sea.

label: Eustace, Abbot of Flay
summary: An abbot sent by the Pope in 1200 to lead a mission against Sunday trading in England, whose preaching and miracles caused many Sunday markets to close or move.

label: Eustace de Faukenberg
summary: The treasurer of England, who heads the Exchequer.

label: Eustace the Monk
summary: The leader of the French reinforcement fleet of eighty ships; defeated by Hubert de Burgh's fleet and beheaded against the rail of his own ship.

label: Eustorage
summary: Uncle of Peter of Montaigu, Archbishop of Nicosia.

label: Evaluate Luxury Goods
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

label: Evaluate Vis
summary: Ability possessed by Domnhull Beg.

label: Evander
summary: Son of Mercury and Carmentis who founded Pallantium and brought the wolf-cult from Arcadia.

label: Evangelium
summary: Normandy Tribunal officer, always a Redcap, reporting Tourney results.

label: Evasion
summary: Optional combat score for dodging, based on Quickness, Brawl or Ride, Size and Encumbrance.

label: Evasion Total
summary: Prey's Dexterity + Athletics + Terrain Bonus + stress die minus fatigue.

label: Eve
summary: The first woman, whom Satan caused to eat the forbidden fruit, bringing about man's fall.

label: Event Total
summary: Stamina + Leadership + Territorial Advantage + Weight of Numbers Bonus + Event Bonus (Maneuver + Enemy + Size).

label: Everard of Barres
summary: Grand Master (1149-1152), retired.

label: Everlasting Boots
summary: Boots gifted to Charlemagne by Yan den Houtkapper.

label: Everstorf Forest
summary: A forest north of Schwerin in which the Giant's Grave lies.

label: Evil Destiny
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the Infernal realm has taken an unexplained interest in the character, who must guard against dark forces.

label: Evil Eye
summary: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the uncontrolled potential to harm others; those making stress rolls in the character's presence roll an extra botch die, warded off by amulets, rituals, or magic resistance.

label: Evisceration of a Thousand Knives
summary: A Perdo Corpus 30 spell invented by Philippus Niger that inflicts an Incapacitating wound on one target.

label: Evisceration of Ten Thousand Knives
summary: A Perdo Corpus 35 enchanted-item effect in Philippus Niger's talisman, a Group-targeted version of his Evisceration of a Thousand Knives.

label: Evocation
summary: Faerie Method (Communication) that ritually calls on faerie gods, costing a Warping or Confidence Point, and allows spending vis on rites.

label: Evoco of Tremere
summary: Mercatora's second-in-command and lover at Rellantali.

label: Evreux
summary: County granted to Rollo.

label: Ex Miscellanea Shapeshifter
summary: Magus template: a feral magus who takes the forms of wolf, goat, hare, raven and golden eagle.

label: Ex Miscellanea Storm Witch
summary: Magus template: a Highland weather witch who calls or dispels storms by whistling, disdained by other Hermetic magi.

label: Exactly to Scale
summary: Rego Aquam level 10 spell (Mentem requisite) designed by a Tremere Artificer to draw precise pictures of a magus's ideas in ink, used for diagrams and mapmaking.

label: Example Childhoods
summary: Ability packages (Athletic, Border, Covenant Bred, Exploring, Feral, Fighting, Mischievous, Shy, Social, Traveling, Wilderness) for spending 45 experience points by age 5.

label: Exarch
summary: Senior Tremere magus commanding House operations in one or more Tribunals; six exist.

label: Excalibur
summary: Arthur's sword, guarded by a Lady of the Lake.

label: Exceptional Communication
summary: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

label: Exceptional Servant
summary: A type of faerie related to the mentor that takes an adolescent on an adventure, leaving them with excellent prospects, then feeds on the vitality of the family.

label: Exceptional Strength
summary: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

label: Exceptional Talent
summary: Class of Virtues representing supernatural talents; gruagach magic is represented by them.

label: Exceptional Talent (Virtue)
summary: Virtue granting an Exceptional Talent.

label: Excessive Heating
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is kept far warmer than necessary with extensive facilities (+2 Upkeep, -1 Safety, +2 Ignem).

label: Excessive Lighting
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is lit far more than necessary with hundreds of candles or lamps (+2 Upkeep, +2 Imaginem).

label: Exchange of the Two Minds
summary: A ritual spell that switches the minds (but not the souls) of two creatures.

label: Exchequer
summary: A branch of the royal court headed by the treasurer Eustace de Faukenberg, responsible for checking and receipting all moneys owed to the crown; staffed by Barons of the Exchequer.

label: Exciting Experimentation
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw causing the character's experiments to have dramatic flair, rolling two dice on experimentation tables with the storyguide choosing the more amusing result.

label: Excommunicate
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character has been cast out of the Church for crimes against God, gaining a bad reputation and losing access to the sacraments.

label: Excommunication
summary: Cursing of those who fail to pay tithes; its widespread use calls demons to an area seeking an easy harvest of souls.

label: Exertion
summary: Spending effort (Fatigue) to boost Attack or Defense.

label: Exeter
summary: The seat of a bishop and the most important town of southwest England, a sea-port on the river Exe with a Norman cathedral dedicated to St. Peter and a wine trade with Gascony.

label: Exilarch
summary: Notional head of all diaspora Jews, based in Baghdad, able to extend Holy Influence.

label: Exiled Atlantean
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw marking the character as an Atlantean tainted by contact with the surface world and unable to return to her native magic regio.

label: Exileratus
summary: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the University of Law.

label: Exorcise the Filthy Spirit
summary: PeVi Gen reducing a possessing demon's Possession Might Pool.

label: Exorcism
summary: Christian rite costing a Confidence or Faith point that helps a possessed person break free of infernal influence.

label: Exorcist
summary: Minor order whose members receive a scroll of exorcism rites and gain +1 to exorcisms.

label: Exotic Casting
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to cast Hermetic spells using non-Hermetic methods, making it hard for others to recognize the spell being cast.

label: Expanded Armor Rules
summary: Rules expanding ArM5 armor with more materials and a component system of body armor, surcoat/greaves and helmet.

label: Expel Demons
summary: Saint power expelling a demon back to Hell, like Demon's Eternal Oblivion.

label: Experience Points
summary: Game reward characters may gain from completing a story.

label: Experimental Philosophy
summary: A system of 'natural' magic that produces wondrous effects through the intrinsic power of the subject rather than any arcane force, using contagion, affinity, similarity, hidden virtues, astrology, ligatures and formulae.

label: Experimental Scripts
summary: Process by which a Mystagogue devises a new Initiation Script through risky experimentation using the Extraordinary Results chart and a validity roll.

label: Experimentation
summary: Risky laboratory practice of pushing beyond known limits, adding a simple die to the Lab Total but requiring a roll on the Extraordinary Results Chart each season.

label: Experimentation Table
summary: Table rolled on when using hazardously copied Laboratory Texts.

label: Expert Potion Brewer
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue doubling the Supernatural Ability in the Lab Total when brewing potions.

label: Exposed
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the building is partially exposed to the elements, e.g. unroofed or wind-cracked (-1 Safety, +1 Upkeep, -2 Health, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Auram).

label: Expositio Sybillae et Merlini
summary: Tino's corrupt Church Lore summa claiming to discuss prophecies of the sibyls and Merlin.

label: Exposure
summary: Experience gained by an apprentice assisting the parens when not being taught.

label: Exposure Experience
summary: Experience points gained from casual attendance at preaching, even in unknown Abilities.

label: Exquiro of Quaesitor
summary: Full member of Magvillus and Traditionalist.

label: Exspectatio
summary: Vassal of Fudarus in the Arrée Mountains, occupied by six Tytalan magi who left Fudarus during the Primi feud.

label: Extended Action
summary: Action taking a full round or longer, which cannot be delayed and requires Concentration if distracted.

label: Extended Glamor
summary: Faerie power granting awareness of everything within a chosen domain and producing vis; lets faeries extend auras.

label: Extended Glamour
summary: Personal power granting awareness of everything within a domain; the faerie is coterminous with its landscape feature and extends an aura.

label: Extended Material and Size Table
summary: Table extending enchantment sizes to rooms, structures and boundaries for Hermetic Architecture.

label: Extensive Stores
summary: A Minor laboratory Structure Virtue: large stores let the lab withstand shortages and store vis and dangerous materials more safely (+2 Safety).

label: External Defenses
summary: Optional rule for outlying fortifications that must be taken before the main castle can be assaulted, using their own Defense Bonus.

label: External Soul
summary: A soul kept outside the body; a gruagach dies if it is scratched, while kolduni can learn to have one that must be destroyed in a specific way.

label: External Vis
summary: Minor or Major Supernatural Virtue placing the faerie's anchor in a traditional prop that can be carried far from its body.

label: External vis source
summary: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

label: Extra Arts
summary: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

label: Extractions of the Soul from its Husk
aliases: Extractions of the Soul from its Husk
summary: Gifted gruagach initiation placing the soul in a stone; grants External Soul and Blatant Magic.

label: Extractor of (Form) Vis
summary: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to extract vis of a chosen Form from a Magic aura whose features exemplify that Form.

label: Extraordinary Results
summary: Chart used for botched spell-binding with Modified Effect, Side Effect and Disaster tables.

label: Extraordinary Results Chart
summary: Experimentation chart on which a Discovery must be rolled.

label: Extraordinary Vis
summary: Vis from places of great power that emulates a magical device or replicates a spell.

label: Extreme Unction
summary: Last Rites absolving mortal sins and protecting the soul from supernatural powers for three days after death.

label: Eye of Hell
summary: Infernal location in the island chapter.

label: Eye of Hephaestus
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a craftsman innately tell the quality of a manufactured item by touch, including whether it is flawed or magical. Called the Eye of St Dunstan for Christian characters.

label: Eye of the Eons
summary: An Intellego Terram spell (InTe 5) known by Tabanus.

label: Eyes for the Prince
summary: InVi 15 spell detecting Faerie creatures of Might 40+ despite disguise or invisibility.

label: Eyes of Stone Demons
summary: Architectus's Power using gargoyle-like demons as spies.

label: Eyes of the Bat
summary: A Hermetic spell whose vision is mimicked by the Eyes of the Bat creature Quality, letting a beast see as magi do under that spell.

label: Eyes of the Cat
summary: A Muto Corpus spell (Level 5) with an Animal requisite that gives the target a cat's eyes, allowing sight in near darkness.

label: Eyes of the Eagle
summary: An Intellego Imaginem spell (Level 25) that lets the caster see distant things clearly, making out details as if they were a foot away while still judging distance accurately.

label: Eyes of the Eons
summary: An Intellego Terram spell that determines the age of any nonliving target to within 10% of its actual age.

label: Eyes of the Flame
summary: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 35) that lets the caster see a fire to which they have an Arcane Connection, plus all things the fire illuminates.

label: Eyes of the Owl
summary: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

label: Eyes of the Past
summary: Scrying spell that runs into anti-scrying defenses in the Mac Gruagach murder story.

label: Eyes of the Treacherous Terrain
summary: An Intellego Terram spell that lets the caster intuitively tell if any natural terrain they see is treacherous, such as a rock field prone to sliding.

label: Ezekiel
summary: Prophet whose vision of the divine chariot inspired Merkavah.

label: Fürst
summary: German title meaning prince, in the sense of the first member of a family.

label: Fabia
summary: An ancient Roman family (genus) that ran the Luperci and gave its name to the Fabiani college.

label: Fabiani
summary: One of the two colleges of the Luperci, named after the ancient Roman Fabia family; it is led by its own magister luperci.

label: Fable Points
summary: Measures accumulated vitality spent in Faerie; determines time dilation and warping on leaving and lets characters swap Virtues and Flaws for faerie ones.

label: Fabric Ripper
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue granting the power to tear any manufactured object made from plant or animal fibers, as a PeAn(He) 25 effect.

label: Fabricor of Verditius
summary: A young Verditius magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

label: Fabulae
summary: Hyginus' work summarizing the Golden Fleece legend.

label: Face of the Count
summary: Berith's Power transforming a volunteer into a facsimile of a nobleman; dispelled by sacraments.

label: Fachan
summary: One-eyed, one-armed, one-legged faerie of distant lochs and valleys in Ireland and Scotland that hates humans and fights with club or poisoned flail.

label: Facilitate the Stifled (Form) Spell
summary: A Muto Vim general spell cast alongside a formulaic spell to remove the casting penalty from reduced or absent gestures and voice; has ten versions, one per Hermetic Form.

label: Factor
summary: A minor Social Status Virtue for a character who manages the interests of a trading house in a single city; also used for independent traders with capital but lacking other-city connections.

label: Faerie Advancement Through Change
summary: Rules for faeries altering their roles to gain powers via cognizance, vitality and a creative human.

label: Faerie Ally
summary: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Faerie Ally).

label: Faerie Ancestor Spirit
summary: Powerful faerie that kidnaps a child to pose as a false heir.

label: Faerie Animal
summary: Mengalaz.

label: Faerie Animal Companions
summary: Animal-shaped faeries who take children on adventures.

label: Faerie Antipathy
summary: Major or Minor Supernatural Flaw giving a negative Sympathy Trait.

label: Faerie Background
summary: Free Supernatural Virtue granting a positive and negative Sympathy Trait from an unusual birth or childhood.

label: Faerie Bargaining
summary: Branch of faerie hedge wizardry concerned with bargains between mortals and fay, using Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, and Dismissing.

label: Faerie Beast
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue: the character appears to be an animal with all advantages of a faerie body.

label: Faerie Blood
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue granting natural longevity, faerie eyes (Second Sight and sight in darkness), Faerie Lore, and the benefits of a particular type of fay heritage; cannot be combined with Faerie Blood.

label: Faerie Blood (Spinnen)
summary: New Minor Virtue letting a character convert their body weight of fiber into cloth per day by touch, or unweave cloth.

label: Faerie Blooded
summary: Virtue referenced in this text.

label: Faerie Boons
summary: Blessings or maledictions gained from Eudokian journeys: Virtues balanced by Charm Flaws, or fading Flaws.

label: Faerie Calling
summary: Dream-like experience when a faerie-aligned character gains 2+ Warping Points at once; resolving it grants or reduces Sympathy Traits, and at high Faerie Rank the character is transformed and lost to Faerieland.

label: Faerie Chains of the Familiar Slave
aliases: Faerie Chains of the Familiar Slave
summary: A CrVi ritual spell (R: Touch, D: Until) that binds a supernatural creature as a temporary familiar to the caster until an incorporated condition comes to pass.

label: Faerie Champion
summary: Faerie with typical Might 25.

label: Faerie Court
summary: Gatherings of faeries usually located in semi-settled land between wilderness and Dominion, sometimes near vis sources.

label: Faerie Court of Faeries' Rock
summary: Faerie court that assembles at Faeries' Rock before the winter solstice to try transgressors.

label: Faerie Doctor
summary: A Mythic Companion type: a faerie-trained healer who removes blights, banes, and diseases via Curse-Throwing, dowses for water and lost things, and keeps a faerie companion. They swear oaths to remain apart from humanity.

label: Faerie Doctor Special Virtue
summary: Special Virtue that makes a character a Mythic Companion faerie doctor, granting free Dowsing and 2 Virtue points per Flaw point, with compulsory Virtues and Flaws.

label: Faerie Doctor (Virtue)
summary: The Free Mythic Companion Virtue defining a character as a faerie doctor, required of all faerie doctors.

label: Faerie Dog
summary: Faerie with typical Might 5.

label: Faerie Drake
summary: Potent faerie drake that slumbered in the forest and attacked Raisa's covenant; defeatable only by tears of a rhinoceros.

label: Faerie (Duration)
summary: Faerie ritual Duration lasting while target or caster has Faerie Might and is in Mythic Europe.

label: Faerie Enmity
summary: A Flaw cursing the exsules's line, stemming from Quendalon's ancient curse, causing faeries to instinctively hate them.

label: Faerie Eyes
summary: Faerie ability that allows seeing through glamour, e.g. to find the door of Crun Clach.

label: Faerie Familiar
summary: A faerie bound as a magus's familiar; at Irencillia magi such as Glesig make their caricatures (e.g., the troll Humnel) into faerie familiars.

label: Faerie Flight
summary: Faerie power letting Count Gwyridden fly for 3 miles.

label: Faerie Friend
summary: A Flaw taken as an Ordeal in the sample Line of Quendalon Initiation, representing a befriended faerie appropriate to the Initiate's highest Technique and Form.

label: Faerie God Blood
summary: Faerie Blood from old gods, granting points in Sympathy Traits.

label: Faerie Godmothers
summary: Protector faeries who guard and gift godchildren.

label: Faerie Gruagachan
summary: Knee-high long-haired faeries in gentleman's clothes to whom Scottish farmers pour milk; they curdle milk or dry cows if disrespected.

label: Faerie Hedge Wizardry
summary: Traditions of faerie magic enabled by sympathy; each tradition has four Favored Abilities.

label: Faerie Heritage
summary: Story Flaw a player taking Brown Wullie as character would have.

label: Faerie Homunculus
summary: A faerie homunculus whose bond grants a Homunculus Wizard a Faerie version of The Gift.

label: Faerie Hounds
summary: Huge faerie dogs (Might 5, Animal) that haunt the roads of Mythic Europe, terrifying and sometimes killing travelers, often with shining eyes and powers like Enthralling Sound and Fearful Flaming Eyes.

label: Faerie Ingredients
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: some lab stores are supplied by faeries with beneficial if unpredictable properties, e.g. faerie silver.

label: Faerie Instructor
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie store human Abilities taken in bargains and give them to favored humans.

label: Faerie Kidnapper
summary: A faerie satyromaniac who, disguised as the girls' beau, kidnapped three village girls at Hocktide and fathered their children.

label: Faerie King
summary: Faerie rulers able to enter treaties in accordance with their roles.

label: Faerie Knight
summary: Faerie warriors (Might 10, Corpus or Terram) bound to the rules of chivalry, found on lonely roads and guarding bridges, who seek defeat by humans to gain additional combat Pretenses.

label: Faerie Lands
summary: Lands where giants and titans are imprisoned; described as a ring between Dominion and wilderness.

label: Faerie Legacy
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue enhancing the benefit of Faerie Blood.

label: Faerie Lord of the Shrine
summary: Faerie lord to whom a shire's site was sacred before Christianity; guards the border between profane and sacred and whose followers poison pilgrims.

label: Faerie Lore
summary: An Ability representing knowledge of faeries; used to navigate faerie regiones in Initiations and combined with Magic Lore to inform Faerie Magic.

label: Faerie Magic
aliases: the Outer Mystery of Faerie Magic
summary: An Arcane Ability and the Outer Mystery learned by Merinitae representing how their magic differs from normal Hermetic magic, governing charms, faerie vis, and faerie-magic botches.

label: Faerie Metamorphosis
summary: Flaw required to acquire a glamour through Warping if the character experiences Warping through other means.

label: Faerie Method
summary: Supernatural Ability describing what a faerie wizard does to draw upon Faerie power to perform a rite; examples are Evocation, Enchantment, and Empathy.

label: Faerie Monarch
summary: Ruler of a faerie court; the most powerful have Faerie Might around 60 and Penetration to challenge senior magi.

label: Faerie Noble
summary: Faeries serving as monarchs of lesser courts or principal agents of great monarchs or pagan gods.

label: Faerie Patron
summary: Source of bequeathed Might that grants a bonus to offers under Art & Academe rules.

label: Faerie Power
summary: Supernatural Ability describing a faerie rite's effect, each vulnerable to a chosen uncommon circumstance; examples Beguile, Conjure, Dream, Grant, Portage, Ware, Weal, Woe.

label: Faerie Queen
summary: A vengeful faerie queen who curses a knight's fertility and lands for rejecting her in a story seed.

label: Faerie Queen of Avalon
summary: Faerie who permanently woke Oberon.

label: Faerie Queen of Irencillia
summary: A faerie queen used as an example target in the Symbolic Magic ritual, affected at Symbol Range via 'queen,' 'winter,' and 'faerie' charms.

label: Faerie Queen of Oleron
summary: Faerie queen embodying the Apple Mile, succeeded by her daughter at each challenge.

label: Faerie-Raised Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Virtue conditioning a character to invent spells very quickly, allowing self-teaching of spells outside the lab; common in the Line of Quendalon.

label: Faerie Rank
summary: The character's highest positive Sympathy Trait modified by the lowest negative one, measuring strength of connection to Faerie.

label: Faerie Regio of Dindyméné
summary: A Faerie regio (aura 6) above the temenos on Mount Dindymon, home to the ten Idaian Daktyls in stone and log huts.

label: Faerie Rites
summary: Spontaneous faerie spells requiring a Faerie Method, Faerie Power, and applicable Sympathy Trait; effects are never permanent.

label: Faerie Rival
summary: A faerie given form by a character's emotionally charged injury, which must be overcome for the character to claim his birthright or adult role.

label: Faerie Road
summary: Paths used by faeries with 'right of way', commonly corpse roads to churches; the most common type of trod.

label: Faerie Role
summary: The story role a faerie fulfils and cannot easily change.

label: Faerie Sensitivity
summary: Ability of magical giants.

label: Faerie Sight
summary: The ability to read glamour, allowing the holder to see magical things and tell what other faeries want simply by looking at them.

label: Faerie Speech
summary: A faerie ability to converse in the language of one's audience, speaking any language someone has used to speak to them without needing to Penetrate.

label: Faerie Speech (Ability)
summary: Ability or Pretense used in faerie statistics (Faerie Speech (Ability)).

label: Faerie Spider
summary: A poisonous faerie spider befriended by Lutisse that protects her treehouse lab, though its cobwebs infest the dwelling.

label: Faerie Spouse
aliases: Faerie Spouses Trapped by a Trinket
summary: Faerie role of selkie women trapped by a trinket (their seal skin).

label: Faerie Sympathy
summary: A Trait describing a character's faerie relationship to a class of subjects, usable as a specialization bonus; negative Traits impose penalties and botch dice.

label: Faerie Tarantula
summary: A faerie creature whose bite afflicts victims with tarantism, an excess of yellow bile causing an irresistible urge to dance.

label: Faerie Time Dilation
summary: Time passes faster in the mortal world relative to Faerie, based on the final fable score.

label: Faerie Toy Market on Devil's Lane
aliases: Faerie Toy Market on Devil's Lane
summary: Faerie regio with entrances in many cities selling magical toys made by hidden elves, containing a Merinita covenant.

label: Faerie Trainer
summary: Free Supernatural Virtue: the faerie has real human Abilities and can train humans conventionally.

label: Faerie Trods
summary: Hermetic term for areas of space connecting places, like paths between regio levels, used by Portage.

label: Faerie Upbringing
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character was raised by faeries, gaining enhanced understanding of magic and faeries but finding human society bizarre.

label: Faerie Wizard
summary: Characters with Faerie Sympathy who practice faerie rites or faerie bargaining, organized into traditions.

label: Faerie Wolf
summary: Creature of local superstition said to lick a newborn left in a clearing and bequeath supernatural powers.

label: Faeries' Cave
summary: Dolmen northwest of Tours with a Faerie aura of 3 rising to 5 when fae feast there.

label: Faeries' Rock
summary: Megalithic chamber where a faerie court meets.

label: Fafnir
summary: The great dragon slain by the hero Siegfried at Drachenfels, in whose blood Siegfried bathed to become invulnerable; his brood or his brother Regin's may still endure.

label: Failed Apprentice
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for someone once apprenticed to a mage who never completed studies, familiar with magi's lives and possibly retaining Supernatural Abilities.

label: Failed Journeyman
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a character expelled from his guild for illegal practices, unable to practice his trade legally, with a bad Reputation of 2 in town.

label: Failed Master
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a character who ran his workshop into the ground and must work as a journeyman, with a bad Reputation of 4 in town.

label: Failed Monk
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which the character was cast out of a cloistered order, gaining a poor reputation but freedom from monastic vows.

label: Failed Student
summary: A Minor Story Flaw for a character who studied for a university license but failed the final examination, gaining a Bad Academic Reputation of 2.

label: Fair Haven
summary: Artakia's harbor, the island's sole commercial port, site of Jason's shrine to Athena.

label: Fairy Loaves of Virtue
summary: Flat bun-shaped formed stones containing 1 pawn of Muto vis each; Enriched, they keep milk fresh as a Lesser Power.

label: Fairy Ring
summary: Ring of the faeries, the subject of an anonymous verse warning against disturbing it.

label: Faith, Love and Truth
summary: Three swords by Ubertino of Verditius, each designed to inspire an emotion.

label: Faith (Target)
summary: Holy magic Target affecting only those who worship God, or only those who do not; equal to Group.

label: Faith (Virtue)
summary: Theological virtue of firm assurance and conviction in things unseen; the acceptance of God.

label: Falchion
summary: Heavy one-handed machete-like weapon used by common soldiers; late medieval.

label: Falcon of Virtue
summary: Rare falcon with burning feathers sought as a tournament prize in a story seed.

label: Falconer
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for a character who trains hawks and falcons for a noble patron, granting Profession: Falconer and extra experience points.

label: Falconer (Virtue)
summary: Minor Social Status Virtue for a character training hawks and falcons for a noble patron; grants 50 extra experience points.

label: Falke
summary: The Prima of House Bjornaer who seeks to end animosity with non-Hermetic shapeshifters and admit them to the House; leader of the Harmonist faction who becomes besieged on Rügen during the Crintera Schism.

label: Falkes de Breaute
summary: A powerful commoner-noble who professes loyalty to the king while disregarding central government; holds custody of the earl of Devon's lands and disputes manors with the earl of Pembroke.

label: Falkirk
summary: Where Wallace was defeated in 1298.

label: Fall of Darkness
summary: Hagbui power (PeIg 25) creating a circle of darkness.

label: Fallen Temple
summary: Church Hook for a church or chapel built on the site of a former pagan temple.

label: Falling from Horseback
summary: Rule for damage taken when a rider falls or is unseated.

label: Fallow Deer
summary: Rare deer.

label: Falls Like a Cat
summary: A Minor, General Virtue protecting a character from injury when falling up to three (or six) times his height.

label: False Faerie Blood
summary: Faerie-affiliated false version of Faerie Blood.

label: False Gift
summary: Corrupted version of The Gift, described in Chapter 12: Black Magic, for apprentices or magi marked by Hell.

label: False Gods
summary: Demonic order usurping God's name by demanding worship; appear as pleasing human forms accompanied by an animal; Might up to 30.

label: False Hero
summary: Infrequent dramatic role of one who tries to claim credit for the hero's actions, always uncovered in time.

label: False Lover's Rock
summary: Where Guyomart was trapped.

label: False Power
summary: A Major (or repeatable Minor) Supernatural Tainted Flaw in which one of the character's Supernatural Virtues is also associated with the Infernal realm, making it appear unholy.

label: False Prophecy
summary: Muto Mentem level 30 spell that alters a victim's memories of dreams into a persistent crafted nightmare meant to influence decisions.

label: False Window
summary: A CrIm 5 miniature spell that traces a door or window frame to create an illusion of something beyond it, requiring a Perception + Finesse roll.

label: Famhair a'falach
summary: Magical Highland giant up to forty feet tall with hidden heart (External Soul), originators of gruagach magic.

label: Famhair Laidir
summary: Non-magical Highland giant up to 60 feet tall, dim-witted; many aided Damhan-allaidh.

label: Familiar
summary: A magical companion bonded to a maga through Merinita's enchantment using three cords; Merinita summoned the first familiar, a great stag, and faerie familiars have special powers and decaying cords.

label: Familiar Bond
summary: A Hermetic enchantment binding a magus to a familiar; it can be dispelled by Perdo Vim and is automatically re-sustained when a magus enters an Aegis.

label: Family Law
summary: Area of law listed in the Tribunal index.

label: Famine Demons
summary: Demons that attack a covenant that creates bountiful crops.

label: Famous
summary: A Virtue that cannot be used for an Artist Reputation, since characters with Famous are known for something other than their artwork.

label: Famuli
summary: Least of the False Gods, demonic familiars given to diabolists, appearing as small animals containing a detachable homunculus; they hide the taint of Infernal Powers.

label: Famuli Matters
summary: Story seeds giving a below-stairs view of servants, such as cleaning up after crises.

label: Fanning the Infernal Flames
summary: CrVi Gen restoring a demon's Might Pool; known among infernalist magi.

label: Fantastic Beast Lore
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

label: Farid al-Din 'Attar
summary: Persian mystical poet and author of Tadhkirat al-Awliya'.

label: Farm Implement
summary: Improvised two-handed weapon.

label: Farmhouse (Kilkenny)
summary: Farm in a Faerie-aura dell where Janine and Anne were taught; home of Agnes.

label: Farming (Renting)
summary: Period English term for renting out land or manors, convenient for the Order of Hermes since paying for land use is not against the Code; falling from favor in 1220.

label: Farne Islands
summary: Small archipelago in the Stonehenge Tribunal off Northumberland, with a saint's influence on the inner islands and wilder forces, selkie courts and demons on the outer ones.

label: Farne Meditations
summary: Book by the hermit Bartholomew; a Summa on Divine Lore, Level 3, Quality 6, recording his spiritual insights.

label: Farrago Bonisagi
summary: A maga of House Bonisagus in the late 1000s who joined House Merinita to research faerie powers and discovered the three faerie cords (leaden, iron, and tin) for binding faerie familiars.

label: Farrier
summary: Maker of horseshoes, overseen by a marshal.

label: Fascination
summary: Caitlin's faerie power making people desire her praise and follow reasonable requests, equivalent to ReMe 25.

label: Fast Action
summary: An optional combat action type; issuing orders, designating a vanguard, or shooting a loaded crossbow with Ready Missiles can be fast actions.

label: Fast-Cast Defense
summary: Rapid defensive spell used in dimicatio.

label: Fast Caster
summary: A Minor, Hermetic Virtue granting +3 to Initiative for casting spells in combat and +3 to fast-casting speed rolls.

label: Fast Casting
summary: Casting a spell as a reaction to resolve before an attack; an optional rule uses Action Priority as its Ease Factor.

label: Fast (Duration)
summary: Holy magic Duration lasting as long as the caster fasts; equal to Moon.

label: Fast Learner
summary: Virtue appearing in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

label: Fast Might Recovery
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie restore its entire Might Pool in six hours.

label: Fast Runner
summary: A heartbeast Quality example that, applied via Theriomorphy, gives the magus the legs of his heartbeast.

label: Fasti
summary: Ovid's poem on festivals, a summa on Organization Lore: Roman Empire (Level 3, Quality 8).

label: Fasting
summary: Penitential abstinence lasting a season, giving +1 to Petitioning a Saint but a constant Fatigue level.

label: Fata
summary: Faeries who inconspicuously join weaving and gossip sessions among elderly village women, using Pretenses to weave.

label: Fatal Menses
summary: Lamashtu's constant poison power that poisons wells, kills crops and fetuses as she flies.

label: Fatal Register
summary: A Muto Animal 20 spell that changes a book's bookmark ribbon into a venomous serpent (traditionally a cobra), typically vested in a single-use charged object activated when a book is stolen.

label: Fatalism
summary: Belief that destiny is written in the stars; fashionable in the Roman Empire.

label: Fathach
summary: An ugly saw-toothed two-armed giant replacing the Gegenes in the Hibernian variant.

label: Father of Serpents
summary: Focus power duplicating non-Ritual Creo, Intellego, Muto or Rego spells pertaining to snakes.

label: Father of the Legion
summary: Highest rank of the Legion of Mithras, clad in black; whispered to be a Living Ghost.

label: Father Theophagus
summary: Priest of St Helix who decorates the church with bones and secretly summons demons in his crypt.

label: Father Tino of Gradara
summary: Aged Cistercian abbot and diabolist, illuminated while reading Joachim's books, who leads the secret Illuminati within the Cistercian order to immanentize the eschaton.

label: Fatigue
summary: A measure of tiredness with six named levels (Fresh, Winded, Weary, Tired, Dazed, Unconscious), lost through strenuous activity and recovered with rest.

label: Fatigue Mastery
summary: Major Quality letting a character spend Fatigue levels as Might Points.

label: Fatima
summary: Daughter of the Prophet, entombed at the Mosque of the Prophet.

label: Fatimids
summary: Isma'ili dynasty ruling North Africa and Egypt from the 10th century until 1171, claiming to be imams and rightful caliphs.

label: Fauho
summary: The filius of Midusulf and second primus of House Bjornaer, with a fox heartbeast; the Seat of the Fox is named after him.

label: Fauld
summary: Lamellar hip protection.

label: Faun
summary: Lustful faeries; twisted fauns prowl the borders of Infernal spaces and are virtually indistinguishable from demons; they hold bacchanalian parties with nymphs.

label: Fauni
summary: Airy Spirits attending creatures, appearing as male animals or hybrids; sometimes called satyroi.

label: Faustrecht
summary: 'Club law' in Rhaetia where rights go to the strongest.

label: Faux de Verzy
summary: Sinister grove of twisted beeches with a Faerie aura of 4, where dark dwarf-like folk take villagers captive.

label: Faux Feudalism
summary: A Free covenant governance choice modeling hierarchical, feudal-style rule over residents.

label: Favarone di Offreduccio
summary: Noble father of Clare of Assisi.

label: Favila
summary: Jerbiton magus of Literatus teaching at the school of Medicine.

label: Favorable Aura
summary: Minor Site Boon: a covenant aura aligned to favor one activity.

label: Favorable Hour
summary: Hour identified via horoscope granting a casting bonus.

label: Favored Abilities
summary: The few Abilities, usually Methods and Powers, that a holy tradition favors; characters with True Faith may study them without the Supernatural Ability penalty.

label: Favors
summary: A Story Flaw representing being an agent who is periodically contacted by a principal or factor to provide information or assistance; also a minor inconvenient flaw on the Resistance table.

label: Favors Owed
summary: Covenant Boon for lieges.

label: Fear
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw gained as an Ordeal in the sample Wayfarers Arcadian Travel Initiation, representing dread of something encountered on the path.

label: Fear (Flaw)
summary: Flaw; Abbas the Hunted has a fear of fire after being burned by a hell-hound.

label: Fear of the Mouse
summary: Cat power similar to Panic of the Trembling Heart, making people afraid of the cat.

label: Fear of the Wilderness
summary: Mazzikim Power inflicting overwhelming dread.

label: Fearful Aura
summary: Hagbui power (ReMe 20) panicking one opponent a round.

label: Fearful Flaming Eyes
summary: Faerie power (Corpus) paralyzing a human who makes eye contact.

label: Fearghus Mac Mungan
summary: Magus Ex Miscellanea, cousin of Mungan Mor and apprentice of Mairi Sean, who studies the sluagh; lost a foot to a brollachan and has a secret drinking problem.

label: Fearsome Bark
summary: Black Dog power like Panic of the Trembling Heart.

label: Feast of Fools
summary: Celebration on January 1 reversing traditional roles such as bishop and jester.

label: Feast of St. John
summary: Holiday of a feast story.

label: Feast of the Dead
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie recover 2 Might after draining a Long Term Fatigue level or causing a Medium Wound to a human.

label: Feast of the Fae
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie recover 5 Might by receiving traditional sacrifices from humans, once per day.

label: Feather Messenger
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue for a bird-shifter who can separate a feather and telepathically control it as a self-inking quill, associated with the Daughters of Four Fathers.

label: Febris Semitertiana
summary: A Major Choleric Disease (Severity 18) from water corrupted by Saturn and Mars, capable of killing thousands in summer.

label: Fedoso
summary: The protagonist of Verderis's epic poem The Travels of Fedoso, a young man who travels a strange landscape facing mystical obstacles, believed by some Criamon to be a map of the House's future.

label: Feeding the Font of the Covenant
aliases: Feeding the Font of the Covenant
summary: CrVi Ritual causing an immediate Aura Strengthening roll.

label: Fehu
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Wealth" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of common wealth such as cattle, silver and grain; as a target it is associated with Animal or Terram (domesticated animals).

label: Feldberg
summary: The highest peak of the Black Forest, the bare-topped seat of the King of the Black Mountain, reached only via the haunted Höllental, with a multi-level regio of Faerie aura 3 to 8.

label: Felianthrope
summary: Personal cat power to take human shape, a version of The Beast Remade.

label: Felicia
summary: A freshly Gauntleted journeyman maga, filia of Dorana of Fengheld and a descendant of Trianoma in the lineage of Irmele, who works weather magic and travels the Tribunal.

label: Feline Lullaby
aliases: Keeping the Humans Safely Tucked Away
summary: Cat power, also Keeping the Humans Safely Tucked Away, a version of The Call to Slumber.

label: Felix the Wolf
summary: A black wolf guild member who enforces the guild rules.

label: Fen Ague
summary: Disease contracted in the Cotentin swamps causing a Heavy Wound, chills and fever.

label: Fengheld
summary: One of the two most powerful Rhine covenants, founded in the Harz Mountains in 1039 by veteran Tremere and Flambeau magi; rival to Durenmar and keen to found a chapter house in the Rhine Gorge.

label: Fenicil
summary: The Primus of House Guernicus and the Order's most famous historian, who claimed the tradition of magic was eternal and reputedly rediscovered some lost Mercurian rituals.

label: Fenicil's Library
summary: Library within Magvillus holding books on the Abilities of Fenicil's rituals.

label: Fenicil's Rituals
summary: The secret rituals of House Guernicus, translated from ancient Mercurian, Egyptian, Greek and Babylonian texts; one involved human sacrifice during the Schism War.

label: Fenistal
summary: The hidden 'covenant' base of the exsules, located in the southern Bohemian Forest in the upper level of a powerful magic regio (aura 8); the original temple of Diana where Merinita served, occupied by renegade House Merinita exiles.

label: Fenistour
summary: A figure who invented casting tools allowing Verditius magi to cast Formulaic spells; her filii later developed methods of enchanting those tools.

label: Fennel
summary: Potently magical herb that repels disease demons and witches; the weapon of the benandanti.

label: Fennel of Virtue
summary: An herb of virtue containing 2 pawns of Vim vis; when Enriched its hardened stalk wielded as a wand drives away evil spirits as a Greater Power.

label: Fenris wolf
summary: Wolf to which Tyr sacrificed his hand so it could be bound.

label: Feoderee
summary: The most physically imposing brownie, of the Isle of Man; a courtly faerie cursed to become a giant hairy monster.

label: Fer Caille
summary: An Irish fachan-like creature that acts as a faerie herdsman and is accompanied by a hag.

label: Feral Scent
summary: A Minor General Flaw giving a character the strong natural smell of a wild animal, imposing a social penalty and an Unclean Reputation but doubling Scent Target spell areas if Sensory Magic is Initiated.

label: Feral Upbringing
summary: A Flaw representing a wild, untamed childhood; a required Flaw of all Beast Masters due to their abandonment in the wilderness.

label: Ferdinand II of Leon
summary: Founded the Order of Santiago in 1170.

label: Ferdinand of Flanders
summary: Count of Flanders captured at Bouvines, held for ransom in Paris; husband of Joan.

label: Ferilan
summary: Transitionalist leader at Magvillus and one of the foremost Transitionalists in the Order; former master of Adria.

label: Feritel
summary: Unrecognized independent covenant founded 1117, officially a subject commune of Genoa, whose magi live as nobility and aid the Genoese.

label: Fermentation Cycle
summary: Competition at the Green Cockerel Great Convocation for the best breakthrough.

label: Ferocity
summary: A Minor Virtue for beasts only, granting confidence points usable when the animal's natural ferocity is triggered, such as defending its den; possessed by many of the Beasts of Legend.

label: Ferragus
summary: A giant who fought Roland in the pseudo-Turpin romance; the basis for Barcas.

label: Ferramentum of Verditius
summary: A magus of House Verditius whose wizard's sigil makes his spells very orderly, seen in his versions of The Cloudless Sky Returned and Curse of the Rotted Wood.

label: Ferrara
summary: Diocese subject to Rome.

label: Ferrymen
summary: Travelers who navigate the waters between insulae; theorists of the Magic Archipelago.

label: Fertility Battles
summary: Battles in spirit form that nightwalkers fight, usually four times a year, determining the harvest, hunting and fishing of their area.

label: Fertility Magic
summary: Magic linked to Carnac and St. Cado's pillar.

label: Fertility Runes
summary: Vitkar magic focus carved on coins.

label: Festival of All Souls
summary: Feast on November 2nd created by Odilo; on it the Dominion weakens and Infernal auras increase.

label: Fetch
summary: The gruagach's spirit companion, sent out by Vision spells to scout; visible to those with Second Sight. Trollsynir call it a fylgja.

label: Fetiales
summary: Redcaps from Rorschach traveling in threes to deliver declarations of Wizard's War, carrying salt, coal and the complaint.

label: Fetish
summary: Item a folk witch must hold to use an Ability, prepared in a season of lab work.

label: Fettered Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw making all of the character's spells and activated magic item effects Arcane Connections to him.

label: Feud
summary: A major Flaw representing an ongoing feud likely to inconvenience a principal, lowering an agent's Resistance Strength.

label: Feudal System
summary: Vassal-liege relationships of mutual obligation running through society.

label: Fi'noa
summary: One of the Three Sisters.

label: Fiacail Geur
summary: Aonghus Lamh Iarran's deerhound familiar (Sharp Tooth), feuding with Mungan's familiar.

label: Fiance
summary: Submission of a defeated knight, securing a ransom.

label: Fickle Nature
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw causing the character to swing between two directly opposite personality behaviors with no middle ground.

label: Fictiles
summary: Aerial Power demons of wet clay that shapechange into domestic animals and corrupt families through minor calamities.

label: Fidaʾi
summary: A Minor, Social Status Virtue for an assassin of the Nizari Isma'ilis trained in daggers and disguise, prepared to die on the sect's orders.

label: Fidchell
summary: Celtic protect-the-king board game.

label: Fidelus
summary: A House Tytalus faction member who is a loyalist of Buliste, the ninth Prima; Fideli wear royal purple as their badge.

label: Fief
summary: Land or another valuable right loaned by a lord to a vassal in exchange for military support, counsel and other benefits.

label: Field of Chains
summary: First field of Purgatory where the slothful lie chained face down while Iurgatores walk on them.

label: Field of Hooks
summary: Field of Purgatory where perpetrators of fraud hang from hooks over flames.

label: Field of Nails
summary: Field of Purgatory where sinners of self-indulgence are pinned with red hot nails and bitten by adders.

label: Fields of Asphodel
summary: Where the Greeks thought most spirits in Hades dwelled.

label: Fiery Breath
summary: Polymathes' power belching fire 50 paces long.

label: Fifth Crusade
summary: Crusade that set off in 1217, at Damietta in 1220.

label: Fifth Ring of Solomon
summary: Allows sensing the realm affiliation of beings; recited in Summer.

label: Fifth Trump
summary: Trumpet sounded at the End of Days releasing the Demons of the Fifth Trump.

label: Figures Through Fire and Fumes
aliases: Enchantment of the Figures Through Fire and Fumes
summary: InIg 15 spell of Whitburh's invention.

label: Figurine Magic
summary: An ancient non-Hermetic tradition, integrated via a Major Breakthrough as a Supernatural Ability, of enchanting wax or wood figurines for a specific recipient with Minor Virtues or Hermetic spells.

label: Fila specialis
summary: Dioceses directly subject to Rome rather than to a province.

label: Filioque
summary: 'And the Son' added by the West to the Nicene Creed, a cause of schism.

label: Fill the Capacious Silo
summary: Spell or effect listed in the contents of Transforming Mythic Europe.

label: Fimus, Warrior Demon
summary: A warrior demon (Might 10, Terram) made of solid rock with one eye, controlling earth and exploding on death; one of many identical brother-demons used as foot-soldiers by other demons.

label: Fin' Amors
summary: Courtly love: elaborate rules of romance between noble suitors and married ladies, condemned by the Church.

label: Findabair Ex Miscellanea
summary: A young, stunningly beautiful maga at Cad Gadu who uses magic to preserve her looks and dresses to seduce, while whining about the covenant's decay.

label: Finding Hidden Loot
summary: A Minor, General Virtue granting +9 to Awareness rolls when searching a confined space for hidden items.

label: Fine Aura
summary: Major Site Boon: a covenant aura with an alignment benefiting most within it.

label: Fines
summary: Hermetic penalty compensating the Tribunal and prosecution, split one third to the prosecutor and two-thirds to Tribunal coffers.

label: Fines for Being Fined
summary: Rule that a peasant fined outside the manor court owes his lord equivalent compensation since the money was the lord's.

label: Fines for the King
summary: Story seed where the king of England claims reparation when magi in England are fined by Tribunals.

label: Finesse
summary: The Ability governing precision and control when directing a spell's effect.

label: Finesse roll
summary: A roll using the Finesse Ability that controls the quality of craft magic and substitutes for mundane Craft rolls when using craft spells or devices.

label: Finger Bone of Saint Odilo
summary: Relic acquired by Marco the Student.

label: Fingerbone of Cyrian
summary: Relic of Cyrian sewn into white silk, carried by Andru.

label: Finistere
summary: Far western coast of Brittany where Nolwenn grew up.

label: Finland
summary: Land containing Akkala, a place name borrowed for the spirit Akkala.

label: Finn Mac Coul
summary: Gaelic hero of Highland stories.

label: Finz-Weibl
summary: A wood-wife who wears a wide-brimmed hat and is very hairy.

label: Fionn
summary: Pictish god, protector of man and destroyer of giants and monsters.

label: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word
aliases: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word
summary: Invocation Wonders effect (Level 35) summoning and controlling a powerful force of nature.

label: Fire Damp
summary: A Level 10 Alteration Reagent kept in a stoppered flask that releases a heavy gas which dampens the intensity of flames, removing 10 points of fire damage.

label: Fire Elemental
summary: An elemental being of fire that can be created from elemental matter via a Creo Ignem ritual and controlled, transformed, or destroyed via Ignem magic by reducing its Might.

label: Fire giants
summary: Norse giants dwelling in Muspelheim with Greater Immunity to fire.

label: Fire Hawk
summary: Small magical raptor that ignites objects.

label: Fire Step
summary: Hermetic fortification: raised step behind a solid wall letting defenders cast then take cover.

label: Fireheart
aliases: The Lost Talisman of the Founder
summary: Flambeau's lost talisman, an oval-cut flawless fire opal the size of a walnut into which he invested several fire and mind effects; serves as an Arcane Connection to its creator.

label: Firmicus Maternus
summary: Writer on astrology whose works are used extensively.

label: First Crusade
summary: Crusade from 1095 that found the Holy Lance, took Jerusalem and founded the Latin Kingdom of Jerusalem.

label: First Flautist
summary: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, treated equally to the other Firsts.

label: First Footing
summary: Tradition that the first person to cross a house's threshold at New Year brings luck.

label: First Inscription
summary: Inscription providing guaranteed Insight for Original Research.

label: First Lyrist
summary: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, treated equally to the other Firsts.

label: First Ring of Solomon
summary: Grants 100 experience points in Philosophiae and +3 Communication; recited in Spring or Autumn.

label: First Singer
summary: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, hosting the next competition at her covenant.

label: Fish
summary: Generic template for fish of the Farnes, with variants crab, dogfish, dolphin, eel, grey mullet, mackerel, octopus, salmon, sole.

label: Fish Out of Water (Terrain)
summary: A Minor General Flaw giving the character an affinity for one terrain type and penalties when away from it.

label: Fisher King
summary: Perceval's wounded host who guards the Grail.

label: Fist of Shattering
summary: A Perdo Terram spell that breaks apart an object of stone or weaker material, cited as an example affected by the Harmless Magic Flaw.

label: Fitz-Hubert Family
summary: Norman family hostile to the magi of Horsingas.

label: Five Angels of Punishment
summary: Five angels of punishment Moses encountered in the Second Heaven per the Midrash Tehillin: Af, Hemah, Meshabber, Hesmed and Mashith.

label: Five Fairs of Flanders
summary: A fair cycle of Lille, Mesen, Ypres, Torout, and Bruges held between February and November, built on the fine woolen and linen cloth trade.

label: Five Great Lieges
summary: The five major liege covenants of the Normandy Tribunal, of which Montverte is one.

label: Five Great Lines
summary: The five liege-vassal lines of Fudarus, Confluensis, Florum, Oleron and Montverte dominating Normandy politics.

label: Flabbergast the Impertinent
summary: A sample relic power (2 points, Init +3, Mentem) that curses the target into a deep, snoring sleep for the night from which no magic can prematurely wake them.

label: Flagellant movement
summary: Movement of pious Christians who publicly flagellated themselves expecting the Last Judgement, in which Templars later become prominent.

label: Flail
summary: Two-handed crushing weapon.

label: Flame Dancers
summary: Magic kin possessed by the power of fire who love fires and flesh and dance tirelessly around bonfires.

label: Flame Shape
summary: Taltós phantastic form as a ball or wheel of flame, physically like an elemental of Might 10.

label: Flamen
summary: The title ('priest') for a Mercurian magus, who performs ceremonial duties such as leading ritual magic, reading omens, and officiating Hermetic events.

label: Flames of Sculpted Ice
summary: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 35) with an Aquam requisite that turns a fire up to the size of a small house into ice sculptures of leaping flame; the flames return as the ice melts.

label: Flanders
summary: Densely populated industrial province of the Normandy Tribunal famed for woollen cloth.

label: Flaren of Flambeau
summary: Luctatio magus aiding Erimas in Pavia.

label: Flash of the Scarlet Flames
summary: A Creo Ignem spell that explodes a brilliant red flash in the air, able to temporarily or permanently blind a target who fails a Stamina roll; Rose of Jerbiton's version smells of roses.

label: Flashbacks
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which combat or tense situations may trigger hallucinatory flashbacks to past battles, causing panic.

label: Flauberto the Difficult
summary: Parens of Hagen.

label: Flavia of Jerbiton
summary: A Jerbiton maga trained by Jerbiton himself who founded Rosalba in 820 and wrote philosophical tractatus before her mysterious Final Twilight in 890.

label: Flavius Ex Miscellanea
summary: A frustrated old magus of Ungulus, trained there in its glory days, who clings to the failing covenant and hopes to rebuild it with young magi after the others pass.

label: Flavius Philostratus
summary: Third-century biographer of Apollonius of Tyana.

label: Flawed Opening of The Gift
summary: If the master lacks a score of 2 in each tradition power, the apprentice gains Flaws such as Deficient Art.

label: Flawed Parma
summary: Flaw.

label: Flawed Parma Magica
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character's Parma Magica provides only half the normal Magic Resistance against a certain Form.

label: Flawed Powers
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw applying the effects of a Major Hermetic Flaw (such as Restriction or Necessary Condition) to a character's Supernatural Virtues rather than to Hermetic magic.

label: Flawless Equipment
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab's outfittings are flawless, perhaps too perfect for mortal hands (+2 General Quality, +2 Vis Extraction).

label: Flawless Magic
summary: A Major, Hermetic Virtue that automatically masters every spell learned at Spell Mastery 1 and doubles Spell Mastery Advancement Totals.

label: Flawless Tools
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab's tools are legendarily perfect (+2 Items).

label: Flaws of the Weaponsmith
summary: A Perdo Terram 25 spell invented by Philippus Niger that rusts away up to 100 metal objects, such as the arms and armor of 30 men.

label: Flee to Safe Refuge
summary: ReCo 44 effect transporting the wearer to the place designated by the Arcane Connection in the Phylactery; linked-triggered with Acquire the Connection.

label: Fleet of Foot
summary: Kelpie power letting it travel three times a normal horse's speed in stallion form.

label: Fleet of Woodchips or Rushes
summary: Manannan's power creating an illusory fleet of a hundred crewed vessels to scare away invaders.

label: Fleets of Venice
summary: Heavily oversubscribed Venetian trading-fleet investments assumed unable to fail, whose occasional loss of ships to weather or piracy can cascade into an unraveling city economy.

label: Flemish Cloth Fairs
summary: Cycle of cloth-trade fairs in Lille, Mesen, Ypres, Torhout and Bruges.

label: Flemish Pikemen
summary: Specialist mercenary troops.

label: Fleury
summary: Abbey on the Loire at a former druidic assembly grove, resting place of St. Benedict.

label: Flexible Casting
summary: Gruagach Mastery Ability increasing spell variation per 5 Mastery points.

label: Flexible Formulaic Magic
summary: A Major, Hermetic Virtue allowing slight variation of Formulaic spell parameters (Range, Duration, Target) while still casting known magic.

label: Flexible Gruagach Magic
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a gruagach vary formulaic spells by 3 magnitudes.

label: Flickering Aura
summary: Church Hook under which the church's Divine aura drops (e.g. to 3 for a year) unless certain rites, such as carrying relics on the perambulation, are observed.

label: Flight
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue / Supernatural Ability to fly, using Stamina and Auram, via fetish (broom) or potion.

label: Flight (Benediction)
summary: Example Greater Benediction allowing wingless flight with a prop.

label: Flight Broom
summary: Flying aid fetish (broom, bucket, etc.) enchanted with 1 pawn of Auram vis.

label: Flight (Faerie Power)
summary: Personal Faerie Power of gwibers and flying orms.

label: Flight of the Hummingbird
summary: Constant Personal Power letting the character fly by concentrating.

label: Florae
summary: Airy Spirits attending plants, appearing female with vegetative features; also called nymphae.

label: Florence
summary: A great Italian city founded by Julius Caesar in 59 BC, with a developed cloth and banking industry, dominated by noble tower societies and the feud between the Guelphs and Ghibellines.

label: Florence Avenue
summary: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. The Devil's Lane covenant stands opposite it.

label: Florilegium
summary: A category of compiled Hermetic book noted by dedicated students of a subject, rarer than the Roots and Branches and found in libraries specializing in its theme.

label: Florum
summary: A Normandy Tribunal covenant in Ghent disguised as a suburb owned by the fictional de Spinnen family; it employs the Spinnen and leads support for the Lotharingian Tribunal.

label: Fluctuating Fortune
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character alternates yearly between the Wealthy Virtue and the Poor Flaw in opposition to his needs.

label: Fluid Vis
summary: The magical energy leaking from the Magic Realm that pools in magical areas to form auras; also called radiant vis or tellurian vis.

label: Flumen of Tremere
summary: A Tremere magus, parens of Goliard and former leader of Blackthorn, who captured the Wild Hunt in 1154 and passed into Final Twilight in 1187.

label: Flying Ships
summary: Ships held aloft by magic used for transporting passengers and cargo in a transformed Mythic Europe.

label: Focus (Certamen)
summary: House Tremere's House Virtue, expressing Insight into nightwalking.

label: Focus Character
summary: The participant in an Infernal Ceremony who possesses the required Supernatural Ability.

label: Focus (Domestic Work)
summary: Brownie focus power creating domestic effects up to level 15.

label: Focus (Duration)
summary: Faerie Duration lasting until the caster performs another supernatural effect; equivalent to Concentration.

label: Focus Faerie Powers
summary: Virtue granting a Focus Power of 25 spell levels.

label: Focus of Flambeau
summary: A Flambeau magus at Burnham, Scintilla's filius, about whom little else is known.

label: Focus Power
summary: A Major, Supernatural Virtue granting a supernatural power with a narrow range of effects, like a magical focus, with a 25-point pool for effect level and Penetration.

label: Focus Powers
summary: Broad faerie powers costing Might equal to the effect's magnitude, with Initiative of Quickness minus maximum magnitude; cannot be reduced by intricacy points.

label: Fog of Confusion
summary: A Muto Auram ritual (Level 45) that turns a bank of fog into a silvery mist too thick to see through, harassing and confusing those within it.

label: Foldcourse
summary: A piece of land over which the right to graze sheep has been granted.

label: Foligno
summary: Town where Marsebilia and Cristiana founded a Poor Sisters group in 1217.

label: Folio
summary: Compilation of Lab Texts and tractatus assembled by the Colentes Arcanorum after each Colloquium and copied at Durenmar.

label: Folk Charm
summary: A crafted charm made by a character with Faerie Lore and a Sympathy Trait that can end a faerie effect.

label: Folk Charms
summary: Trinkets and signs made to repel faeries, such as the Italian finger sign or Greek painted eyes; a class of faerie taboo.

label: Folk Dancer
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue: members of a troupe of a dozen or more who perform pagan dances creating minor magical effects such as a harvest blessing reducing storms.

label: Folk Ken
summary: An Ability used (with Awareness) to recognize hidden social or behavioral patterns, such as identifying the mushroom circle as dance steps.

label: Folk Magic
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue allowing minor magic via a chosen (Realm) Lore in one of four areas: Abjuration, Divination, Healing, or Evil Eye.

label: Folk Witch
summary: A hedge wizard tradition of (mostly female) witches who brew potions, bind familiars, and organize into covens; both Gifted and unGifted members exist.

label: Folk Witch Apprenticeship
summary: Ten-year training by a coven granting 200 experience points.

label: Folk Witch Casting Methods
summary: Potion, Incantation, and Fetish methods folk witches use for Supernatural Abilities.

label: Folk Witch Gift Opening
summary: Minor Hermetic Flaw: a Gifted folk witch's Opening failed to favor one of the seven folk witch Supernatural Abilities.

label: Folk Witch Magic
summary: The supernatural magic of folk witches, including potion brewing in the kitchen, familiars, Openings and initiations.

label: Folk Witch Magic Theory
summary: The folk witch equivalent of Magic Theory, used to brew potions, investigate potions and open the Gift; familiars can also learn it.

label: Followers of Belin
summary: Societas Merceris of Belin's descendants and adoptees who serve as elite, humble messengers.

label: Followers of Pendule
summary: A House Merinita lineage and Mystery Cult descended from Pendule's followers who Initiate the illusion Mysteries of Spell Timing, Glamour, and Perpetuity.

label: Folly Spirit
summary: Alpine spirits inhabiting buildings that drive castle-building to lay eggs, perhaps eating ghosts.

label: Fomóir
summary: Magic giant roused at the summit of the Isle of the Sleeping Fomóir.

label: Fomoire
summary: The first inhabitants of Celtic lands, children of the chthonic titan Domnu.

label: Fomoreach
summary: Seafaring people of Irish legend from the North and East, possibly the Broch-builders.

label: Fomorii
summary: Mythic opponents of the Tuatha De Danann.

label: Font of Knowledge
summary: A Supernatural Ability allowing a creature to attempt a task with any untrained ability as if it had a score of 2 by succeeding in an Ability check.

label: Fontevraud
summary: Fashionable convent where Eleanor resided.

label: Fontevrault
summary: Abbey founded in 1100 by Robert of Arbrissel in the Forest of Bart, Anjou; a double house headed by an abbess and royal burial place.

label: Fool's Cap Bell
summary: Proctor's talisman, a brass bell enchanted against Infernal influence.

label: Fool's Fire
summary: Tiny flickering faerie lights, also called will o' the wisps, that guide lost travelers into dangerous marsh terrain.

label: Fool's Light
summary: Ignis fatuus, a mysterious light on the Northern Hares that causes wrecks.

label: Fooling the Eye
summary: A CrIm 10 miniature spell creating species of a swift bright object that makes the target's eyes track toward the magus, enabling Eye Range spellcasting.

label: Footsteps of Slippery Oil
summary: A Creo Aquam spell (Level 5) creating nonflammable grease from the caster's footsteps, leaving a slick area that forces Dexterity rolls.

label: Footwashing Bowl Cross
summary: Cross made from the bronze bowl Christ used to wash the apostles' feet.

label: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills
aliases: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills
summary: Invocation Wonders effect (Level 40) creating an obedient mammal.

label: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles
aliases: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles
summary: Incantation/Phantasm 10 seeing through Infernal deception.

label: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform
aliases: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform
summary: Meditation Transcendence effect making the caster untargetable by weaker supernatural effects.

label: For thou hast power of life and death
aliases: For thou hast power of life and death
summary: Purity/Intervention miraculous effect (Level 40) opening a doorway into Purgatory.

label: Forcas
summary: A Watcher and Duke of the Deluders, Duke of Rhetoric, who teaches natural magicians and hedge wizards rhetoric, logic, mathematics and Unholy Powers while claiming to be an airy spirit.

label: Forceless Casting
