label: Holy Tradition
summary: A group of like-minded holy people organized around favored divine Abilities, through which Methods and Powers are learned.

label: Holy Tradition: Franciscans
summary: Treatment of the Franciscans as a Holy Tradition with favored Abilities Intervention, Meditation, Purity, and Understanding, open only to friars or Poor Sisters.

label: Holy Unicorn
summary: Divine being.

label: Holy Vehm
summary: An organization whose pious leader, the archbishop of Cologne, is murdered in 1225, which the demon Gymir is infiltrating and corrupting to use as a surrogate against Radegast's pagan followers.

label: Holy Vis
summary: Vis extracted by holy magi in the Dominion, with unusual, miraculous side effects and doubled botch dice.

label: Holy War
summary: Christian doctrine of religiously sanctioned war, developing from Augustine's just war into crusade doctrine.

label: Holy water
summary: Adds +1 to exorcism.

label: Holyrood
summary: Abbey at the end of Edinburgh's Royal Mile.

label: Holzfrau
summary: German wood-wife faeries with Faerie Might 20, spirits of vegetation usually beneficial to mankind, able to control plants and heal; associated with particular plants like dryads.

label: Homage
summary: Act in the commendation ceremony in which the kneeling vassal-to-be places his joined hands within the lord's hands and asks to become his vassal.

label: Home Village Lore
summary: Ability used by nightwalker characters in this chapter.

label: Homer
summary: Author of The Odyssey, quoted on the Cyclopes.

label: Homilia Leonis
summary: Church Lore Tractatus Quality 8 by Pope Leo IV listing visitation articles.

label: Homing Instinct
summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue letting a character always know the way to a number of known locations and have fixed Arcane Connections to them.

label: Homobonus
summary: A patron saint of merchants and of cloth and tailoring; a citizen of Cremona who died in 1197 and was canonized in 1199.

label: Homunculus
summary: Tiny faerie born from the dreams of magi, living on the boundary of Magic and Faerie, that bonds to the first person it sees and grants him faerie power in exchange for daily blood.

label: Homunculus Wizard
summary: A hedge wizard whose faerie version of The Gift derives from a bond with a homunculus; experiences Faerie Calling rather than Twilight.

label: Homunculus Wizard Flaw
summary: Flaw taken with The Gift to play a homunculus wizard; may be the inherent Flaw of an Ex Miscellanea magus.

label: Honor Among Thieves
summary: Valefar's Power preventing a thief from revealing a secret.

label: Honos
summary: A Roman Daimon (Magic Might 30, Corpus) of morality and military honor, appearing as a young warrior with a lance and cornucopia, able to instill Leadership and produce a magical feast.

label: Hooks
summary: The story component that drags the characters into the action, often connected to a Story or Personality Flaw of a key character.

label: Hooks and Boons
summary: Covenant-level story features (e.g. Castle, Road, Urban) that draw covenants into mundane affairs.

label: Hoopoe
summary: Bird suggested as a Vim familiar.

label: Hoopoe of Virtue
summary: A foul bird nesting near cemeteries whose blood and heart are powerful ingredients in black magic.

label: Hope
summary: Theological virtue of unshakable confidence in divine providence; at True Faith 3 Faith Points add 6 and Magic Resistance against Mentem is doubled.

label: Hoplite
summary: An informal group of combat magi, many from House Flambeau, who work with the Quaesitores to hunt down and slay magi cast out of the Order for crimes.

label: Hoplite Quaesitor
summary: Guernicus magi able at both investigation and combat, often sent to lawless Tribunals.

label: Hoplomachus
summary: A defensive certamen style named for warriors armored like Greek hoplites; it trades attack and initiative for greatly increased Defense.

label: Hopolites
summary: A group of warrior magi, many of them Flambeau Arch-Magi, who enforce the rulings of the Quaesitores.

label: Horizon
summary: Example new spell Range invented by Tillitus as a Minor Breakthrough.

label: Horkos
summary: Oath, a child of Eris most damaging to men who swear falsely.

label: Horn of the Champions
summary: An invested magical horn kept at Castra Solis that can alert and instantly summon senior Flambeau magi from anywhere in Mythic Europe via Arcane Connections.

label: Hornet Fire
summary: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 10) with a Rego requisite that turns a fire into a swarm of insect-sized fireballs that harass a target, imposing a penalty and extra botch dice without dealing real damage.

label: Horobael
summary: Authority guarding a grove.

label: Horoscope
summary: The natal chart of an Electus Initiate, kept by the Initiators; together with a lock of hair it gives a Penetration bonus against the Initiate.

label: Horrid Wilting
summary: A Herbam power of the basilisk Sordus that kills every living plant within 5 paces and rots vegetable matter; he cannot control it.

label: Horrifying Appearance
summary: A Major Supernatural Flaw for corrupted beasts making the creature hideously deformed and unable to pass as a member of its original species.

label: Horrifying Appearance – Snake Legs
summary: A Major Supernatural Flaw in which the character has snake-like tails instead of legs, a deformity that can be hidden under clothing but not while moving.

label: Horse Bow
summary: Compact composite bow suited to horseback.

label: Horse Clan
summary: A Crintera clan that maintains the covenant's wild steeds, possesses the Animal Ken Virtue, provides provisioning, and acts as a messenger service.

label: Horse Collar
summary: New device allowing a horse to outperform an ox in draught work.

label: Horse Courser
summary: English term for a horse dealer, a profession with a bad reputation.

label: Horse Gaits
summary: Walk/amble, trot, canter and gallop, each with a movement rate and combat effects.

label: Horse-Headed Serpents
summary: Great water serpents with the heads or forequarters of horses, red or yellow eyes and fangs.

label: Horse of Virtue
summary: Exceptional horse; many destriers are Horses of Virtue.

label: Horses of Virtue
summary: Herd of magical horses (Might 10) of the Camargue led by the Great Stallion.

label: Horsingas
summary: A covenant in the Loch Leglean Tribunal founded by Saxon magi determined to oppose the Normans, using Mentem magic to cover their tracks.

label: Horst
summary: A 68-year-old master Redcap of House Mercere at Fengheld, a famed encyclopedic author (despite having no Gift) and the senior Redcap of the Rhine Tribunal.

label: Hospice of Saint Bernard
summary: Benedictine hospice saving lost travelers, with Hermetic ties.

label: Hospital of Saint John the Baptist
aliases: Hospital of Saint John the Baptist
summary: Hospital inside Bath for the infirm poor, whose inmates in blue robes are called the Blue Alms.

label: Hospitaller Knights of St. John
summary: A military order present in Acre that controls its own section of the city.

label: Hospitallers
aliases: Order of the Knights of Saint John
summary: The Order of the Knights of Saint John, a crusading order that began as a charitable hospital for pilgrims in Jerusalem; rivals and allies of the Templars.

label: Hostile Gruagach Collective
summary: Major Covenant Hook in which a nearby gruagach collective spreads rumors and harvests the covenant's vis.

label: Hostillar
summary: Monk in charge of the guest house, not bound by silence; most often dealt with by visitors.

label: Hosting Covenant's Choice
summary: Tourney event chosen by the hosting covenant.

label: Hosvir Goatlegs
summary: A Clan Wilkis magus of the Sept of Orn obsessed with rebelling against the Norman nobility of England; trained Ealwynn and Coenwulf.

label: Hot Baths
summary: One of the three main public baths of Bath.

label: Hot-trod
summary: Right to pursue a cattle thief across the border.

label: Hothama
summary: Islamic degree of Hell for Jews.

label: Hound
summary: Faerie power letting a faerie know the direction and distance to its human quarry; Lamia's version detects unattended babies.

label: Hounds of Anwyn
summary: Faerie hounds said to leave the faerie court to chase the dead across Wales by night.

label: Hour + 1 (Duration)
summary: Faerie Duration lasting an hour and a day; equivalent to Sun.

label: House Acclaim
summary: An informal Hermetic Reputation system by which Flambeau magi measure relative prestige, gained for deeds of valor and lost for ignoble acts or inactivity.

label: House Bjornaer
summary: A Mystery House whose magi each possess a heartbeast, an animal soul into which they can transform; organized into clans and septs.

label: House Bjornaer Lore
summary: The Organization Lore Ability giving knowledge of House Bjornaer's legends, history, structure, magics, and its Exoteric Mystery and Cult of Ancestors; primarily orally transmitted.

label: House Bonisagus
summary: The lineage of the founders who created the Order; devoted to magic theory, original research and the leadership of the Order. Its members freely share breakthroughs with all magi.

label: House Council
summary: Council of Tremere magi holding their own sigils, meeting every ten years at Coeris; lacking formal powers since the Schism.

label: House Criamon
summary: An enigmatic Mystery House devoted to the Enigma and the mysteries of Twilight, seeking enlightenment over worldly power.

label: House Criamon Lore
summary: An Ability quantifying a magus's understanding of House Criamon's task, strategy, paths, stations, and clutches; required at increasing scores to reach higher stations.

label: House Diedne
summary: One of the Twelve Founders, a woman cast out from the druid religion, who brought spontaneous magic to Bonisagus and founded House Diedne; in modern accounts her name is sometimes replaced with Trianoma's.

label: House Ex Miscellanea
summary: The largest and most diverse House, a refuge of hedge traditions and minor lineages gathered under Hermetic protection.

label: House Flambeau
summary: A martial House of magi who excel at combat magic, heirs to the fiery legacy of their founder.

label: House Guernicus
summary: The Quaesitores: judges and investigators who uphold and enforce the Code of Hermes, slowing the wheel of fate that would tear the Order apart.

label: House Jerbiton
summary: A House that values mundane civilization, art and beauty, and engages thoughtfully with the world beyond the covenant.

label: House Jerbiton Lore
summary: Ability appearing in character statistics in this text.

label: House Mercere
summary: The Redcaps: heralds, messengers and merchants who bind the Order together by carrying communication and trade between covenants.

label: House Merinita
summary: A Mystery House deeply tied to the Faerie Realm, practicing faerie magic and guarding the secrets of the Fae.

label: House Merinita Lore
summary: The Ability Merinitae use to Initiate their House Mysteries, representing knowledge of all the House's secret rites, mysteries, and legends; common to all members.

label: House Mysteries
summary: The Bjornaer Mysteries (Heartbeast, Secret Name, Sensory Magic, Theriomorphy) Initiated by Clan Ilfetu that allow magi to emulate their ancestors.

label: House of Canmore
summary: The royal line of Malcolm Canmore and Margaret that ruled Scotland in the 12th and 13th centuries.

label: House of Flambeau
summary: (Not present)

label: House of Flames and Smoke
summary: Stone hall in Purgatory with pits of molten metal punishing perverse appetites and violence against God.

label: House of Savoy
summary: Noble family of Savoy, rival of the Zähringers, which also founded new towns to attract settlers.

label: House of Wisdom
summary: The most famous madrasah, in Baghdad, a center for translating Syriac, Persian, and Greek texts into Arabic; historically destroyed by Mongols in 1258.

label: House of Zähringen
summary: Now-extinct noble family, founders of Berne and Fribourg, who tried to unite the Alps.

label: House Tremere
summary: A disciplined, hierarchical House that prizes cooperation and preparation; masters of certamen who gather influence to meet crises before they arrive.

label: House Tytalus
summary: A House that seeks out conflict and challenge of every kind as the path to growth and power.

label: House Tytalus Lore
summary: A Hermetic lore Ability concerning the history and customs of House Tytalus, exemplified by the Analects of Tytalus summa.

label: House Verditius
summary: A Mystery House of magical craftsmen who enchant items through Verditius magic, bound by oaths of secrecy and rivalry in their contests of craft.

label: House Virtue
summary: The free Minor Hermetic Virtue each magus receives from his House, gained through 10 seasons of one-on-one interaction or Outer Mystery initiation.

label: Houses of Hermes
summary: The twelve Houses that organize the Order of Hermes, now split into three groups of four: Mystery Cults, True Lineages, and Societates. They remain the same Houses as in earlier editions.

label: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults
summary: The sourcebook covering the four magical Houses built around specific Mysteries (Bjornaer, Criamon, Merinita, Verditius).

label: Houses of Hermes: Societates
summary: An Ars Magica sourcebook whose Tytalus chapter details House Tytalus' debate system.

label: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages
summary: An Ars Magica sourcebook referenced for fuller treatment of the use of magic to support the Redcap network.

label: Hovel
summary: A Major laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is cramped, neglected, and filthy, little more than a stinking dump (-1 General Quality, -2 Upkeep, -2 Safety, -3 Health, -4 Aesthetics).

label: Howls of Confusion
summary: Power (PeMe 15) of Lord Goulis's demon dogs that confuses victims, resisted by Int roll of 9+.

label: Hrools
summary: Intelligent ferret-like creatures dwelling in warrens near the ruined Calebais laboratory of Ierimyra, who still protect the lab.

label: Hrothgar
summary: Former king of the Danes whose hall site is now occupied by the covenant Heorot; he was terrorized by the troll Grendel until the hero Beowulf slew it.

label: Huarwar
summary: A Welsh faerie who helped complete Offa's Dyke in 787 in exchange for cattle; now eats parts of the dyke and villages when not paid.

label: Hubert de Burgh
summary: The justiciar (since 1215) and third member of the regency, responsible for day-to-day administration; an astute politician and brave military leader who defended Dover and won the sea battle against Eustace.

label: Hubert filius Lorenz
summary: Bonisagus magus researching hedge-magic longevity methods, such as inverting the familiar bond.

label: Hubris
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw inflicted on Verditius magi through Inner Mystery Ordeals; it grows like an Ability with success and is mystically coupled to a Verditius's Gift to boost enchantment Lab Totals.

label: Hudud
summary: Canonical penalties for five major crimes.

label: Huelgoat
summary: Boulder site.

label: Huge
summary: Major General Virtue (faeries only) making the character far larger, adjusting Size, Characteristics and Body levels.

label: Hugh
summary: Local lord at Blaringhem moved by Saint Ursmar's relics to pardon a murderer.

label: Hugh Capet
summary: Took Laon from the Carolingians and established his capital in Paris.

label: Hugh de Cressingham
summary: Hated Treasurer of Scotland flayed after Stirling Bridge.

label: Hugh de Lusignan
summary: The count of Marche, a powerful vassal of the king in Poitou and husband of Queen Isabella.

label: Hugh Foliot
summary: The archdeacon of Shropshire who became bishop of Hereford in 1219 and was an employer of Robert Grosseteste.

label: Hugh IV of Burgundy
summary: Eight-year-old Duke of Burgundy.

label: Hugh Neret
summary: Canonist bishop of Coutances, elected 1208.

label: Hugh of Amiens
summary: Theological writer (1130-74), author of Contra Haereticos.

label: Hugh of Forcalquier
summary: Hospitaller commander in Aragon, close to King James.

label: Hugh of Lincoln
summary: A former bishop of Lincoln who began the rebuilding of the minster in 1192 and is being considered for canonization; associated with the miracle of St. Hugh's Swan at Stow.

label: Hugh of Payns
summary: Founder and first Grand Master of the Templars (1119-1136); visited London in 1128.

label: Hugh of Saint Victor
summary: Author of a list of seven mechanical arts.

label: Hugh the Great
summary: Effective ruler of France under weak Carolingian kings.

label: Hugh X of Lusignan
summary: Count of La Marche, betrothed to Isabella.

label: Huldra
summary: A Scandinavian nymph, beautiful in front but hollow-backed with a cow's tail, able to vanish when unobserved; male form is huldu or huldrekall.

label: Huldra Blood
summary: Faerie Blood variety allowing invisibility when still.

label: Hulikang
summary: A Merry Devil (Vessel of Iniquity) and rabble rouser who turns public celebrations and sporting contests into violent mobs; captain of the Red Devils.

label: Human Ally
summary: Flaw of Aillwee.

label: Human Figment of the Waking Mind
aliases: Human Figment of the Waking Mind
summary: A Creo Mentem spell that places a hallucinatory person, seen and heard only by the target, into the target's common sense.

label: Human Form
summary: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

label: Human Shape
summary: Personal Power transforming a creature into a normal human shape.

label: Humanities
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

label: Humanoid Faerie
summary: Virtue granting a glamoured faerie body; must be taken before Increased Might and requires a Traditional Ward.

label: Humans are Easily Misplaced
summary: Cat power, a version of Inexorable Search using scent-marked Arcane Connections.

label: Humble
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character always believes others are more skilled and better than himself.

label: Humiliation of Relics
summary: Practice of physically humbling relics to prompt a saint's action or persuade the laity to piety.

label: Humility of Caesar
summary: Saint curse throwing a rider from his horse or felling him on his face.

label: Humnel
summary: Glesig's faerie caricature, which has taken the seeming of an immense troll and become her faerie familiar, very protective of his mistress.

label: Humors
summary: The four bodily humors (blood, black bile, yellow bile, phlegm) manipulated by elemental physicians.

label: Hunchback
summary: A Minor General Flaw giving the character a deformed body with a grotesque appearance and penalties to agility, balance, and looks.

label: Hungary
summary: Kingdom known for the quality of its riding horses such as palfreys and jennets.

label: Hunger for (Form) Magic
summary: A Major Supernatural Flaw in which the character has become dependent on consuming 1 pawn of vis of a particular Form each season or lose Fatigue Levels.

label: Huns
summary: Invaders from Asia whose last coming was presaged by trade disruption.

label: Hunt
aliases: the Capture of the Wild Hunt
summary: A group of faeries that terrorized Wales and the Marches in the early twelfth century, sweeping down on moonless nights; trapped behind enchanted cold-iron doors near Blackthorn by Flumen in 1154.

label: Hunt for the Wild Herb
summary: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 5) that lets you smell one sort of plant and follow its scent, requiring a sample of that plant.

label: Hunted by Wolves
summary: This chapter's rules for wolf hunts in five phases: stalk, encounter, rush, chase and kill.

label: Hunter's Lethal Arrow
summary: PeAn40 Tethered spell giving an animal a fatal wound, often tethered to an arrow.

label: Hunter's Sense
summary: An Intellego Animal spell (Level 30) letting the caster sense the shapes and primary motivations of all animals above a chosen size that can be heard.

label: Hunter's Tracks of the Faerie Glow
aliases: Hunter's Tracks of the Faerie Glow
summary: Performance Duration variant of Tracks of the Faerie Glow, lasting while the caster hunts.

label: Hunting with Hounds
summary: The most prestigious form of hunting: quest, assembly, relay, finding, chase, kill, and unmaking.

label: Huntingdon
summary: English town where Christina of Markyate was born.

label: Huntress in the Wood Lore
summary: The Ability required to Initiate the grades of the Huntress in the Wood cult, with set thresholds for advancing from kerykes to eumolpids.

label: Huntsman
summary: Dog handler who seeks out prey with lymers during the quest and positions hounds in the relay; grogs perform the role well.

label: Huon of Bordeaux
summary: Hero of a song aided by Oberon.

label: Hurling the Droplet of Lye
summary: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

label: Hutins
summary: A court of Parisian argotiers who pretend to be bitten by mad dogs.

label: Hutriel
summary: The 'Rod of God', one of the Malakhe Habbalah (Avengers of Evil), forged from chains of fire, who punishes the profligate and those extravagant with wealth.

label: Hybrid Form
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving a body mixing human and animal elements.

label: Hydra
summary: A many-headed monster whose teeth provide Shape and Material bonuses of +6 Creo and +8 regeneration.

label: Hydromancy
summary: Divinatory method using observing water, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

label: Hyginus
summary: Author of the Fabulae, which summarizes the Golden Fleece legend.

label: Hygwald Veritas
summary: A devious magus of House Tremere and co-founder of Waddenzee, a specialist in Rego Mentem who is scrupulously honest with the Quaesitores and aspires to join them.

label: Hyperboreans
summary: Ancient people who founded the Temple of Apollo in London.

label: Hypereia
summary: An island of the Thebes Tribunal inhabited by cyclopes.

label: Hyperion
summary: Titan who establishes day and night.

label: Hypernestoria
summary: Mysterious lands reached via the regio where the Axis Magica emerges from the other side of the Earth's sphere, few of whose contents are known to Criamon magi.

label: Hypnotic Gaze
summary: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

label: Hywel Dda
summary: The legendary lawgiver who created the laws of Wales many centuries ago, laws still known by wise men across Wales.

label: I conjure this, by foul decree / In its same likeness unto me
aliases: I conjure this, by foul decree / In its same likeness unto me
summary: Incantation/Effusion 25 summoning an object to the hand.

label: I delight to do thy will, O my God; yea, thy law is within my heart
aliases: I delight to do thy will, O my God; yea, thy law is within my heart
summary: Meditation Understanding effect (Level 35) revealing whether an action is God's will and preventing botches while pursuing it.

label: I, Eirik Svennson, Bound This Wound
aliases: I, Eirik Svennson, Bound This Wound
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Berkanan 15, Method I script: +9 to recovery rolls from combat injuries.

label: I, Eirik Svennson, Call My Helmet Alu
aliases: I, Eirik Svennson, Call My Helmet Alu
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Algiz 25, Method I script: +5 to Soak via his helmet.

label: I, Eirik Svennson, Invoke Tyr's Cunning
aliases: I, Eirik Svennson, Invoke Tyr's Cunning
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Tiwaz 25, Method I script: +5 to Defense rolls.

label: I, Eirik Svennson, Invoke Tyr's Power
aliases: I, Eirik Svennson, Invoke Tyr's Power
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Tiwaz 25, Method I script: +5 to Attack rolls.

label: I, Eirik Svennson, Strengthen the Sword of My Ancestors
aliases: I, Eirik Svennson, Strengthen the Sword of My Ancestors
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Othila 25, Method I script: +5 Initiative, Attack and Defense with his inherited sword.

label: I, Eirik Svennson, Will Work Well This Day
aliases: I, Eirik Svennson, Will Work Well This Day
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Eirik Svennson's Dagaz 15, Method I script: +3 to all-day activities.

label: I saw three unclean spirits, like frogs, out of the mouth of the dragon
aliases: I saw three unclean spirits, like frogs, out of the mouth of the dragon
summary: Incantation/Phantasm 20 ominous vision.

label: I, the Runemaster, Am Thrice Blessed
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Am Thrice Blessed
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Gebo 15, Method I: +3 to meeting and influencing others, offsetting The Gift.

label: I, the Runemaster, Ask for Freya's Blessing
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Ask for Freya's Blessing
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Fehu General, Method I: bonus to rolls in the pursuit of wealth.

label: I, the Runemaster, Bless the Fields
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Bless the Fields
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Jera 5, Method I: buried runed stone ensures a healthy, disease-resistant harvest.

label: I, the Runemaster, Bless the Work
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Bless the Work
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Jera General, Method I: bonus to year-long activities such as study or harvest.

label: I, the Runemaster, Call the Serpent from the Brambles
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Call the Serpent from the Brambles
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Thurisaz 30, Method I: turns a twisted branch into a venomous snake.

label: I, the Runemaster, Can Sense the Liar's Craft
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Can Sense the Liar's Craft
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Tiwaz 30, Method I: sense whether people believe they tell the truth.

label: I, the Runemaster, Carve Runes to Close the Flesh
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Carve Runes to Close the Flesh
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Berkanan 20, Method I: heals a Light Wound, permanent if the amulet lasts a week.

label: I, the Runemaster, Carve the Runes of Giants
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Carve the Runes of Giants
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Dagaz 20, Method I: the vitki grows with the sun, up to Size +2 at noon.

label: I, the Runemaster, Dedicate Helmet-Destroying Hail
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Dedicate Helmet-Destroying Hail
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Hagalaz General, Method I: weapon Damage bonus equal to magnitude.

label: I, the Runemaster, Feel My Hearth and Home
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Feel My Hearth and Home
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ingwaz 20, Method I: sense the direction, distance and mood of family.

label: I, the Runemaster, Fight for My Companions
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Fight for My Companions
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Tiwaz General, Method I: bonus to Attack rolls in battle.

label: I, the Runemaster, Give Eight Legs to My Horse
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Give Eight Legs to My Horse
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Raido 30, Method I: the horse covers ten paces per step.

label: I, the Runemaster, Give Understanding of the Hollow Voices
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Give Understanding of the Hollow Voices
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ansuz General, Method I: target hears spirits and distinguishes illusory noises as if with Second Sight.

label: I, the Runemaster, Hear the Thunder of the North
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Hear the Thunder of the North
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Raido 20, Method I: sense which way is north.

label: I, the Runemaster, Kiss the Treacherous Deep
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Kiss the Treacherous Deep
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Laguz 20, Method I: the vitki breathes in water.

label: I, the Runemaster, Make Men Sure and Steady
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Make Men Sure and Steady
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Mannaz 30, Method I: increases Dexterity by 1, to no higher than 0.

label: I, the Runemaster, May Speak with the Shades of the Past
aliases: I, the Runemaster, May Speak with the Shades of the Past
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Ihwaz 35, Method I: communicate with the spirits of a grave.

label: I, the Runemaster, Need Strength for My Trials
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Need Strength for My Trials
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Uruz General, Method I: bonus to Strength-based rolls.

label: I, the Runemaster, Paint the Runes of Frenzy
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Paint the Runes of Frenzy
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Wunjo 30, Method I: a warrior ignores Fatigue and Wound Penalties.

label: I, the Runemaster, Protect Against Beings of Fire and Pain
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Protect Against Beings of Fire and Pain
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Algiz (Kauno) General, Method II: wards fire creatures and disease spirits.

label: I, the Runemaster, See Through the Darkness
aliases: I, the Runemaster, See Through the Darkness
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Kauno General, Method I: bonus to eyesight rolls, improving night vision.

label: I, the Runemaster, Sense the Sleeping Alfar
aliases: I, the Runemaster, Sense the Sleeping Alfar
summary: Sample vitkir rune spell. Perth 20, Method I: sense and identify vis within ten paces.

label: I, the Runemaster, Sharpen My Axe

summary: Common Infernal Blessing enhancing Soak, Damage, Initiative, Attack or Defense.

label: Infernal Relics
summary: Objects binding the dead, sold by the Dread Host as false relics.

label: Infernal Reputation
summary: Reputation among demons and infernalists of a demon's perceived power in Hell, affecting summoning.

label: Infernal Sentries
summary: Guardians of Hell who fight the Hounds of God with iron batons.

label: Infernal Sleep of the Damned
summary: Re(In)Me 25 effect of a hand of glory, rendering people in a building unconscious until sunrise.

label: Infernal Smoke of Death
summary: A Muto Auram spell (Level 40) that turns fire smoke into a thick corrosive cloud inflicting +25 corrosion damage to anyone immersed in it.

label: Infernal Supernatural Abilities
summary: Also Supernatural Virtues takable at creation or initiated via corrupt Mystery Cults.

label: Infernal Taint
summary: Taint afflicting a magus who takes a demon as spirit familiar.

label: Infernal Talisman
summary: Talisman at Verdi destroyed by Nerius.

label: Infernal Traditions
summary: Optional groups of like-minded infernalists defined by Methods, Powers and Favored Abilities.

label: Infernal Witches
summary: Servants of the Infernal who curse villages and battle nightwalkers in the night battles, often as the malandanti.

label: Infested
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab has an animal or plant infestation, e.g. mice, a vine, or fungi (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics, +1 Animal or Herbam).

label: Infiltrator
summary: Minor or Major Social Interaction Virtue for a faerie that lives as a human, costing as the mimicked Social Status.

label: Infinite Divisibility
summary: Archangel power to split into many self-aware copies to attend to all duties at once.

label: Infirmarer
summary: Chief surgeon of the Templars.

label: Infirmarian
summary: Religious who cares for the sick and elderly and the health of the community.

label: Infirmary
summary: Room or detached building of a monastery where sick, elderly and indigent people are cared for by the monks.

label: Inflexible Magic
summary: Minor Supernatural Flaw limiting spell variation to 1 magnitude.

label: Ingasia
summary: A covenant in the Theban Tribunal of which Verditius Primus Stouritus is a member and which he would like to become the domus magna.

label: Ingolstadt
summary: Town listed in the Tribunal index.

label: Ingwaz
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Lord" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of peace, family and a secure home; targets buildings and household members.

label: Inhabitants
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is shared with other creatures who consider it their home (-1 Safety, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Inherent vis
summary: The vis contained in a magic character's body, typically Might Score / 5 pawns.

label: Inherited Virtues and Flaws
summary: A Flaw chosen at character generation that develops later in the character's life, such as Suppressed Gift.

label: Initiate
summary: A member of a Mystery Cult, or one undergoing the rite to become such.

label: Initiation
summary: The ritual process by which a magus acquires a Mystery Virtue, governed by an Ease Factor, Script Bonus, Quest, Ordeal, and Sacrifice; central to Bjornaer's heartbeast Mysteries and Criamon's stations.

label: Initiation into the Blessing Form
summary: UnGifted gruagach script requiring permanent aid to a hopeless person; grants Blessing and Weird Magic.

label: Initiation into the Curse Form
summary: UnGifted gruagach script requiring poetic punishment of a wicked person; grants Curse and Vow.

label: Initiation into the Give Technique
summary: UnGifted gruagach script requiring a quest for justice; grants Give and Restriction.

label: Initiation into the Shape Form
summary: UnGifted gruagach script requiring defeat of a shapechanger; grants Shape and Weak Tattoo Magic.

label: Initiation into the Take Technique
summary: UnGifted gruagach script requiring oblations to Gruagach; grants Take and Dark Secret.

label: Initiation into the Vision Form
summary: UnGifted gruagach script requiring fasting at a Pictish site; grants Vision and Transformation Prone.

label: Initiation Ordeal
summary: A terrible rite such as branding or walking through fire that permanently marks the Initiate with a new Flaw and reduces Target Levels of later Initiations.

label: Initiation Quest
summary: A story-based requirement of an Initiation Script involving a journey, danger, and challenges; takes at least one season.

label: Initiation Sacrifice
summary: The least taxing Initiation requirement: a sacrifice of time, wealth, books, a talisman, or even an apprentice or familiar.

label: Initiation Total
summary: Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore + Script Bonus, compared against a Target Level (15/21 for known Minor/Major Virtues, 18/30 for new ones) with no die roll.

label: Initiative
summary: Roll determining order of action in combat rounds; spellcasting has weapon initiative modifier 0.

label: Ink of Hermes
summary: An alchemical ink mentioned in many alchemical texts, made from myrrh, Karian figs, Nikolaus dates, pine cones, wormwood, wings of the Hermaic ibis, and spring water.

label: Ink of Noblest Metals
summary: A Muto Terram 20 spell with Aquam requisite that transforms gold into a liquid applied as ink, reverting to solid metal when it expires.

label: Inmost Companion
summary: A Muto Mentem spell (Level 40) with an Animal requisite that makes the target's mind physical as a bird; if the bird is killed the target dies, as their mind has been killed.

label: Inner Circle
summary: The Blessed One, Cleopatra, Erin and four other magi leading the Children of Hermes.

label: Inner Council of Montverte
summary: Secretive council of five elder magi ruling Montverte, led by Geirlaug.

label: Inner Farne
summary: The largest Farne island (16 acres), also called House Island, with Divine aura 2 rising to 4 in Saint Cuthbert's chapel and hermitage.

label: Inner Hebrides
summary: Island group close to the Scottish mainland with deeply cut sealochs and slightly better weather.

label: Inner Mysteries of House Bjornaer
summary: Mysteries by which a Bjornaer magus, through atavism, gains an inner heartbeast (epitome, chimera, or anima) modeled on a Great Beast ancestor.

label: Innocentia
summary: Daughter of Saint Severus of Ravenna and Vincentia.

label: Innocu
summary: Parens of Phalene.

label: Inoffensive to Animals
summary: A Virtue often possessed by Donatores who received a vision from Saint Gertrude of Nivelles.

label: Inoffensive to (Beings)
summary: A Minor General Virtue whereby the character's Gift does not bother a chosen class of beings (animals, faeries, or magical beings); known among Merinitae as the Bronze, Silver, and Golden Gifts.

label: Inquisition
summary: Newly formed Church body against heretics, strengthened by Frederick II.

label: Insatella
summary: The Prima of House Mercere, an unGifted Redcap who inherited the role from her father and manages the House from Harco in the Roman Tribunal.

label: Inscribed Memories
summary: Memories that power one's Arts and non-physical Abilities, which magic cannot transfer or create.

label: Inscribed Shadow
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw causing a character's stigmata to be reflected as glowing symbols in their shadow, alarming nonmagicians and easing stigma-reading.

label: Inscription on the Soul
summary: Spirit Magic Mystery (Chapter 8) letting a magus use body or spirit as talisman; it can substitute for Great Talisman as prerequisite to Consummate Talisman.

label: Inscription Target
summary: A new Hermetic Target from integrating rune magic, working like Circle but not requiring penetration.

label: Insight
summary: A way to convert vis gained in the Magic Realm into knowledge of a single Magic Realm effect.

label: Insights from Twilight
summary: Summa on Magic Theory by Perpauca Bonisagi.

label: Insignificance
summary: Bomburkhan's Power preventing any power forcing him to use his Powers.

label: Inspirational
summary: A Minor, General Virtue making a character a stirring speaker or heroic figure, granting targets +3 to appropriate Personality Trait rolls.

label: Inspirato
summary: The flux of harmony and strife from which spiritually nourished Criamon magi draw sustenance instead of food, and through which path-of-seeming magi swim to view distant places.

label: Instant Loyalty of the Rebellious Turb
aliases: Instant Loyalty of the Rebellious Turb
summary: A CrMe 50 ritual cast at a midwinter gathering that grants up to 100 people a 'Loyal to Covenant' score of +4 while inflicting Warping Points each year.

label: Instant Transportation
summary: Magical transport rules with new guidelines by magnitude of distance.

label: Institutiones Capituli Generalis
summary: 1203 statutes of the Cistercian general chapter, a kind of Peripheral Code.

label: Insubstantial Vis
summary: Vis in forms like breezes, sound, or light requiring special containers.

label: Insula
summary: In the Magic Archipelago theory, an island-like location of the Magic Realm, resembling a high-level Magic regio.

label: Intangible Flesh
summary: Major Supernatural Flaw: the character is immaterial and cannot physically influence the world.

label: Integration
summary: Hermetic research incorporating aspects of hedge magic into Hermetic theory, measured in Breakthrough Points.

label: Integration Breakthrough
summary: Research to incorporate non-Hermetic magic into Hermetic theory.

label: Intellego
summary: Technique meaning 'I perceive'. Gathers information and reveals hidden truths.

label: Intelligence
summary: Characteristic used in ordination and argument rolls.

label: Intelligence of the Heroes
summary: CrMe 55 spell known by Austerius Trianomae.

label: Interdict
summary: Act in which the hero is issued a command by an authority figure which is then violated, sending him on adventure.

label: Interference
summary: Meddling with mundanes that brings ruin on the Order, forbidden by the Code. Its definition varies by Tribunal.

label: Interference in the mundane
summary: Hermetic crime a magus may be prosecuted for.

label: Interference with the Church
summary: Hermetic crime; certain church sites in the Alpine Peripheral Code treat even minor violence as interference.

label: Interfering with the mundanes
summary: Hermetic crime the crusaders commit by killing mundanes.

label: Interim lease
summary: Provisional lease on a newly found vis source granted by a Quaesitor.

label: Interlaken
summary: Town between Lakes Thun and Brienz.

label: Interloping Wolves
summary: Pack of Magic wolves (Might 13) that followed roe deer into the truffle regio intending to gorge on its magical creatures.

label: Interplanetary Magic
summary: Theurgic magic of celestial spirits from Realms of Power: Magic.

label: Interpretatio Romana
summary: Roman practice of identifying native deities with Roman gods, which identified a Auvergne wolf goddess with Luperca.

label: Interrupting Actions
summary: Optional rule letting a delayed character resolve his action before the triggering action via Action Priority.

label: Intervention
summary: Confrontation by a powerful realm entity when a learned magician gains 2+ Warping Points from a botch; may yield boons or punishments.

label: Intervention Prone
summary: Major Supernatural Flaw: the magician must resist intervention on a single botch rather than a double botch.

label: Intestinal Suffering
summary: PeCo 40 arcane-range spell creating a lethal bone shard in the victim's intestines.

label: Intimidation
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

label: Intricacy Points
summary: Points representing complex portions of a faerie's glamour, used to raise a power's Initiative or reduce its Might cost.

label: Intrigue
summary: An Ability factors use to hire skilled criminals and to find allies or spread gossip against noble targets; combined with Communication or Intelligence in skullduggery and indirect action.

label: Intuition
summary: A Minor, General Virtue giving a natural sensitivity to make the right luck-based decisions on a secret die roll of 6+.

label: Intuition of the Forest
summary: An Intellego Herbam spell (Level 10) giving an intuitive sense of how to get along in a forest, granting +3 to nature-oriented rolls there.

label: Inundation
summary: The Red Knight's power to generate Creo, Muto or Rego-like Aquam or Terram effects that break sea defenses or raise waves.

label: Inventive Genius
summary: A laboratory Virtue that, when held by an assistant or researcher, applies to the primary researcher's efforts; it also adds three to insight-investigation rolls.

label: Inverness
summary: Area with standing stone circles.

label: Inverse Auction
summary: Auction at the Midsummer Fair where bids start high and descend; bids taken in Vim vis.

label: Inverted Water Wheel
summary: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

label: Invested Device
summary: An enchanted item prepared with Vim vis and then instilled with magical effects in the laboratory; variants include lesser enchanted devices and charged items, and an invested device lasts years as an Arcane Connection.

label: Investigation Immunity
summary: Limited immunity from scrying charges granted to Quaesitors and their agents while pursuing justified investigations.

label: Investiture Controversy
summary: Conflict between pope and emperor in which Matilda of Tuscany was the pope's main supporter.

label: Invisibility
summary: Ability/power of cu sith and Gliocas to vanish when followed.

label: Invisibility of the Standing Wizard
summary: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 15) that makes the target invisible, but the spell breaks if the target moves and the target still casts a shadow.

label: Invisibility (Sir Giles)
summary: Sir Giles' power to make himself and his horse invisible except to Second Sight.

label: Invisible
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: the lab interior and outfittings are invisible, requiring magical means to see them (+1 Warping, halve Aesthetics, +2 Imaginem).

label: Invisible Sling of Vilano
summary: A popular indirect Rego Terram (ReTe 10) spell that hurls a stone as a projectile; bypasses Magic Resistance with a successful aiming roll, inflicting +5 damage.

label: Invisible to Magic
summary: Major Heroic Virtue to become temporarily invisible to magic by concentrating.

label: Invisible World
summary: The world of spirits, known to magi and wizards.

label: Invitation Token
summary: Token letting a magical being or apprentice work magic within the Aegis of the Hearth; may be given to apprentices.

label: Invocation
summary: Method of calling holy effects by addressing God and His servants by name; usually Communication-based and requires investing Confidence.

label: Invocation Magic
summary: Major Mystery Virtue requiring Names of Power, letting a magus cast Names of Power as Muto Vim spells to boost a following spellcasting, limited by Magic Theory.

label: Invocation of Weariness
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 20) that causes the target to lose a Fatigue level, often via singsong melodies that lull the victim into drowsiness.

label: Invoke
summary: Hermetic theurgy spell type summoning a spirit, which can incorporate Names of Power.

label: Invoke the Pact of (Daimon)
summary: ReVi Mystery Ritual forming a pact with a powerful named Daimon, which sends an Aspect to answer and perform services; grants the Daimon Daimon Points.

label: Invoke the Pact of Zelos
summary: A ReVi general-level Ritual spell that forms a pact with the Daimon Zelos by targeting one of his Aspects to perform a specific service.

label: Invoke the Spirit Akkala for a Day
aliases: Invoke the Spirit Akkala for a Day
summary: Gunnar's CrIg 30 Invoke spell summoning the spirit Akkala until sunset to cast Pilum of Fire.

label: Invoke the Spirit Nissila
summary: Gunnar's Invoke spell with 15 added levels for a +30 Penetration bonus, summoning Nissila to cast Pilum of Fire.

label: Invoke the Spirit of (Form)
summary: Generic Mystery spell forming a pact with a named spirit that performs effects as if casting Spontaneous Magic in a given Art combination.

label: Invoke the Spirit of (spell)
summary: Generic Mystery spell forming a pact with a named spirit that casts a single Formulaic spell as a power on the magus's behalf.

label: Invoking a Saint
summary: Communication + Charm + Devotion Total roll vs 15 + die to have a saint use a Divine power on one's behalf.

label: Invoking God's Aid
summary: Uttering a prayer and spending a Confidence or Faith point to gain a Divine Aid bonus (stress die + Communication + Dominion Lore).

label: Involvement
summary: Contact with mundanes that does not breach the Code, such as proportionate self-defense.

label: Invulnerability to Metal
summary: Barcas's power making him immune to metal weapons except one vulnerable spot.

label: Ioanna
summary: A Redcap follower of Mercere murdered in the city of Trier in 1151 AD, prompting a Quaesitorial investigation; she had earlier recorded directions to Treverorum and Rheinstein.

label: Ioannes Acer
summary: A young journeyman follower of Merinita at Irencillia, a knight with the Gift and Flawless Magic who specializes in Herbam and rides his stag caricature Kervus; youngest apprentice of Archmage Vinaria.

label: Iola of Guernicus
summary: Magus who in 1047 distinguished court wizards as vassals rather than economic dependents.

label: Iona
summary: Holy island where St. Columba founded his first church; has a Dominion aura of 8 of the Scottish temper.

label: Ionic Sea
summary: Pirated southern sea.

label: Iopontes
summary: Faun-like creatures with the lower parts of horses.

label: Ior
summary: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Water monster", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

label: Iozheza
summary: Conjurer who trained Bonisagus and vanished during an Osiris rite.

label: Ipswich
summary: The chief town of Suffolk with about 300 burgesses, granted a charter in 1200 by King John giving it a court, toll exemption, and a merchant guild monopoly on milling.

label: Iqta'
summary: Muslim land grant similar to a feudal fief entrusted to a muqta'.

label: Irencillia
summary: The domus magna of House Merinita, an Autumn covenant hidden deep in faerie woods of the Bohemian Forest, founded by Quendalon; it appears differently to each visitor due to faerie glamour and has a patchy Faerie aura.

label: Irene the Younger
summary: A Byzantine princess who became a Verditius maga and famous inventor of magical paintings and figurines, founding her confraternity.

label: Iris
summary: One of Harco's three young Redcaps.

label: Irish Sea
summary: Sea around which faeries claiming Manannan's role are found.

label: Irmele
summary: The third filia of Trianoma, a tempestaria who recruited in German lands and founded the wandering weathermage lineage that still persists in the Rhine.

label: Irnerius
summary: A charismatic jurist at Bologna, the first to teach the Corpus Iuris Civilis, who put the university on the map through the study of Roman law.

label: Iron
summary: A supremely magical metal woven into many faerie stories as a ward, though miners, crafters and urban faeries often tolerate it.

label: Iron Cap
summary: Helmet protecting the crown of the head.

label: Ironwood
summary: The traditional abode of the hag, filled with her wolfish children, in the Perilous Forest story element.

label: Irregularity
summary: Divine punishment of clergy who commit grossly immoral crimes, preventing use of Faith Points until confession.

label: Irresistible Light
summary: Archangel power radiating Divine Light doing +40 damage to non-Divine beings and stripping Might.

label: Is
summary: Drowned city.

label: Isa
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Ice" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of ice, cold and cold emotions; associated with Aquam, Ignem or Mentem.

label: Isaac
summary: A Jewish shopkeeper, nephew of David ben David, who runs the wine shop in Trier above the former Treverorum covenant and knows nothing of magi.

label: Isaac Angelus
summary: Byzantine Emperor forced to send forces north against the Bulgarian rebellion.

label: Isaac Ben Solomon Israeli
summary: Tunisian physician (850-932), monist and accomplished kabbalist.

label: Isaac (golem)
summary: Golem created by Moshe ben Isaac with Divine Might 23, empowered to instill Divine anxiety in a greedy tax collector.

label: Isabella II
summary: Seven-year-old Queen of Jerusalem in Outremer, a possible sovereign for the island.

label: Isabella of Angouleme
summary: Wife of King John, suspected of bewitching him.

label: Isabella of Hainault
summary: First wife of Philip Augustus and mother of Louis.

label: Isabelle
summary: A woman living at the covenant of Semita Errabunda, named in an example command of a Psychomachia maleficium.

label: Isabelle of Angoulême
summary: Countess of Angoulême, widow of King John, betrothed to Hugh X of Lusignan.

label: Isaiah
summary: Prophet whose enthronement visions inspired Merkavah.

label: Iseult
summary: Lover in the romance of Tristan and Iseult.

label: Ishim
summary: Choir of white fire in the Fifth Heaven.

label: Ishtar
summary: Babylonian goddess of love and war who transformed unfaithful lovers into wolves.

label: Isis
summary: Pagan goddess in whom True Faith is not possible.

label: Isis Cord
summary: Spirit familiar cord corresponding to the silver cord, adding to Lab Totals and Casting Scores involving spirits.

label: Islam
summary: One of the three Divine religions in Mythic Europe; Muslims live within a Dominion aura indistinguishable from the Church's, and a significant number of magi are Muslims.

label: Islamic Caliphates
summary: Earthly Islamic institutions of the faithful.

label: Islamic Law
summary: An Academic Ability, the Muslim version of Civil & Canon Law, drawn from the Qur'an and the Sunna.

label: Islamic Lore
summary: Lore Ability possessed by Golab.

label: Islamic Virtues
summary: Virtues inspired by the Qur'an such as Righteousness, Generosity, Gratitude, Humility, Mercy and Patience.

label: Islamic wizards
summary: Mystical groups beyond the Order, especially of the Levant, whom House Tremere studies and Poena seeks to counter.

label: Island of Man
summary: Vis-rich island visited by many covenants including Crun Clach.

label: Island of the Magicians
summary: Artificial island in the North Sea created by Creo Terram rituals from a circular stone wall jacketing an earth infill, letting magi found their own country.

label: Island of the Sleeping Fomóir
summary: Variant renaming of Bear Island when moved to the Hibernia Tribunal.

label: Islands
summary: The islands west of Scotland, called the Sudreys by the Norse, divided into the Outer and Inner Hebrides.

label: Islay
summary: Southern island group granted to Somerled in 1156.

label: Isle of Arran
summary: Island where a faerie once held Manannan's court; now claimed by a covenant of Criamon magi studying regiones.

label: Isle of Boetia
summary: Greek home of Diana nam Grechanach.

label: Isle of Man
summary: Island of which Manannan was god until cast out by Saint Patrick; subject of a Grand Tribunal ruling on Tribunal membership.

label: Isle of the Blessed
summary: Fabled isle west of Ireland sought by Brendan the Navigator.

label: Isle of the Sleeping Fomóir
summary: Alternative version of Bear Island relocated west of Ireland in the Hibernian Tribunal and tied to St. Brendan's voyage.

label: Isle of Ushant
summary: A flat-topped island off Brittany with vertical cliffs and treacherous reefs, on which the Tytalus Domus Magna Fudarus is built.

label: Islestone Shad
summary: Islet entrance (with Glororum Shad) to a regio with a Magic aura of 3 containing a half-living tree.

label: Isma'ili
summary: Sect of Shi'i Islam to which the founders of the Brethren of Purity belonged; oppressed in many areas.

label: Ismail
summary: Son of Abraham whom he was prepared to sacrifice; ancestor of the Arabs.

label: Isolated from the Order
summary: Flaw common among Highland magi.

label: Isra' and Mi'raj
summary: Muhammad's night journey to Jerusalem and ascent to heaven.

label: Israel
summary: Ruled by Abimelech for three years with Berith's help.

label: Israel Lore
summary: Area lore of Israel.

label: Israfel
summary: Seraph and Angel of the Trumpet and of Last Judgement, who will end the world by blowing his trumpet in Jerusalem; recognised as an archangel in Islam.

label: Israfil
summary: Angel who will blow the trumpet twice on the Day of Judgment.

label: Istria
summary: The region in the Transylvanian Tribunal from which the Flambeau magus Vilano hailed.

label: Istrian Peninsula
summary: Peninsula near the Brijuni Islands, home to the oppidum of Histria.

label: Istvan Padas
summary: A master of House Bjornaer holding the Seat of the Horse at Crintera, with a stallion heartbeast; the youngest and most willful Elder, a Wilderist descended from Magyars and lover of Zora.

label: Italian
summary: Language Ability.

label: Italian Sailor
summary: Grog vocation: a fisherman's son who sailed Venetian merchant ships and now serves on a magi-owned ship.

label: Italy
summary: Peninsula comprising the Roman Tribunal, divided among communes, Papal States and the Kingdom of Sicily.

label: Itching Thumbs
summary: Valefar's Power granting a thief +3 on a single stealing roll.

label: Item Attunement
summary: A Major House Mystery letting a magus attune a greater enchanted item like a talisman, then sever the connection, leaving a Covet Device personality trait in the device.

label: Items of Quality
summary: A Minor House Inner Mystery of Verditius for creating non-enchanted items whose latent magical bonus is drawn to the surface via runes, not resisted by Magic Resistance.

label: Itinerarium
summary: A House Jerbiton tradition of a sponsored tour undertaken by apprentices near the end of training, mirroring young Romans' tour of Greece, Ephesus, Troy, and Egypt; originated accidentally with Anna of Naples.

label: Iudicium of Guernicus
summary: The ancient senior quaesitor of the tribunal who presides at meetings from Blackthorn; bears a tattoo of a scarlet serpent and favors Intellego and Mentem magic.

label: Iurgatores
summary: Quarrelsome bullying demons of the order of Accusers who torment sinners in Purgatory.

label: Ivan Asen II
summary: Current Tsar of Bulgaria, claiming the title Emperor of the Bulgars and Greeks, enemy of the Latins in Constantinople.

label: Ivory Ball
summary: Ball given by the White Fox that rolls toward a hermit.

label: Jörmungandr
summary: The Midgard Serpent, with a Might of 75.

label: Ja'far al-Sadiq
summary: Sixth Shi'i imam (d. 765).

label: Jabir Ibn Hayyan
summary: Arabic alchemist who stressed mercury and the four qualities.

label: Jabniel
summary: Ruler of Shehaqin.

label: Jacinda of Flambeau
summary: Author of Subtle Knives.

label: Jacinta filia Nicoli
summary: Archmaga of the line of Apromor, follower of Flambeau, the most competent Perdo magus in the Order and leader of the Rowan Sisterhood.

label: Jacinta filia Romana
summary: Archmaga of the Tower of Ashes who writes to her apprentice Ash about the economics of Alpine peace.

label: Jacinth of Oleron
summary: Magus convicted of damaging Infelicitas; later accused Lothaire of partisanship.

label: Jack
summary: Brigandine jerkin, late medieval.

label: Jack-of-All-Trades
summary: A Minor, General Virtue letting a character attempt Ability rolls without a score and without extra botch dice.

label: Jack's Beanstalk Giant
summary: A hammy giant who knowingly lets a boy become famous by killing him, assisted by a wife who gives magic beans; the most anachronistic faerie in the book.

label: Jacob
summary: Patriarch who wrestled through the night with an angel, identified as Camuel.

label: Jacobus de Voragine
summary: Author of The Golden Legend.

label: Jacques of House Flambeau
summary: Former Brabançon warrior turned Flambeau magus who leads Atsingani's mercenaries and seeks revenge on the Capuchonnes.

label: Jacques Vert
summary: Merinita magus who speculated the Nains were dreams of dead Diedne and vanished at Carnac.

label: Jael
summary: Biblical heroine of Jael and Sisera.

label: Jaevert
summary: Demon Duke of the Deluders (Watchers), Duke of the False Millennium, who appears as an angel of light to false prophets and is behind Tino's deception.

label: Jahm of Alexandria
summary: Ex Miscellanea magus who rediscovered Hermetic Alchemy in the tenth century (956 AD), origin of the Green Cockerel.

label: Jakin
summary: One of two great hollowed stone pillars ("he establishes") of Solomon's temple legend that hold treasures of the ancient Hebrews.

label: Jambes
summary: Plate armor covering the legs.

label: James of Vitry
summary: Bishop of Acre (1216-1228), close Templar ally.

label: James the Legate
summary: Papal chaplain linked to Saint Victor in Paris, appointed legate to Scotland and the Isles in 1220; an Augustinian.

label: Jami' al-Bayan 'an Ta'wil al-Qur'an
summary: Massive commentary on the Qur'an by al-Tabari; Summa on Theology: Islam and Islamic Law.

label: Jami'at al-Qarawiyyin
summary: A madrasah in Morocco described as the oldest madrasah in existence.

label: Jane, the Fifth Primus
summary: Ghost of the fifth Primus of House Criamon at the Cave of Twisting Shadows, the youngest Primus who knew Criamon in life; friendly and willing to tutor outsiders.

label: Janine Kyteler
summary: Older Gifted Kilkenny witch, merchant's wife who shapeshifts into a pig and seagull, rival of her cousin Anne.

label: Janine's House
summary: Kilkenny townhouse with a secret basement kitchen with Magic aura 4 and a vis spring.

label: Janis
summary: Leader of Crintera's Swan Clan and volkv (priest) of the Forest Brothers, the covenant's contact among the pagan people of Rügen, often consulted by the magi on island matters.

label: Janna
summary: Paradise, the blissful gardens.

label: Janus
summary: A dead titanic god of doorways whose ghost pours wisdom into the ears of those who sleep on his grave, near a Merinita portal to Arcadia.

label: Jar of Pandora
summary: Jar that imprisoned the lugra; sought to bind them.

label: Jarane of Quaesitor
summary: Highly respected Quaesitor who plans to lead a triad of Quaesitoris into Italy to fix the Roman Tribunal's problems.

label: Jart
summary: The master of Tabanus and the leading Traditionalist within House Guernicus, favoring a strict interpretation of the Code.

label: Jason
summary: The leader of the Argonauts who, on Chiron's advice, brought Orpheus on the voyage to retrieve the Golden Fleece.

label: Jasonian Way
summary: A permanent path leading from the Temenos of Dindyméné to the Faerie regio through the faerie forest.

label: Javelin
summary: Thrown piercing weapon.

label: Jean and Jeanne
summary: Petrified betrothed couple, two menhirs on Belle-ile, who could be freed by ritual.

label: Jean de Brienne
summary: Emperor of Constantinople who, after dreams of friars, gave up his throne to live as a friar until his death.

label: Jean de la Porte
summary: Bailli of Rouen, appointed 1219.

label: Jean the Wise
summary: UnGifted Orleans witch and court clerk who uses Dowsing for the magistrate; his magic causes a ringing noise.

label: Jehovah
summary: Name used by pagan polytheists for the god they consider merely the most powerful deity.

label: Jennet
summary: A palfrey ridden by a lady, always a mare.

label: Jennis
summary: Richenda Spinosa's faerie caricature, a male version of the Polish maga who is helping her come to terms with her fae side.

label: Jenny Greenteeth
summary: Nursery terror who drags children into wells.

label: Jera
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Year" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the harvest and year-long bounty; mostly associated with Herbam.

label: Jerbiton Gauntlet
summary: Gauntlet of House Jerbiton, which Carmine has passed.

label: Jeremias filius Guernicus
summary: A magus, author of De Lapii, the Branch of Terram summa, in 1220.

label: Jerkin
summary: Short sleeveless jacket.

label: Jerome of Confluensis
summary: Jerbiton magus, Tribunal liaison to French nobility who secretly rescues 'troublesome heirs'.

label: Jerome of Jerbiton
summary: Parens of Eloi at Confluensis who supported Cunfin's founding.

label: Jerome the Scribe
summary: A scribe for whom Victor of Mercere is tasked with purchasing particular pigments in town.

label: Jersey
summary: Channel Island where Venelli relics and mercenary graves may be found.

label: Jerusalem
summary: A major city of Mythic Europe suggested as a covenant location; casting a spell in its Church of the Holy Sepulcher carries the maximum botch dice.

label: Jerusalem Hospital
summary: The most famous hospital instituted for those injured on Crusade, built by the Order of St. John.

label: Jesses
summary: Leather or silk cords securing a hawk to its perch.

label: Jesus Christ
summary: The Son of God who became human, whose death (the Crucifixion) paid the penalty for all human sins and who rose from the dead in the Resurrection; in the Mass the bread and wine become His Body and Blood.

label: Jet of Virtue
summary: Jet containing 1 pawn of Perdo vis that when Enriched grants Puissant Stealth, lost if anyone but the owner sees it.

label: Jewish Instruction
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

label: Jewish Lore
summary: Lore Ability possessed by Golab.

label: Jewish Mysticism
summary: Jewish occult tradition encompassing Gematria, Kabbalah, golems and Merkavah.

label: Jewish Temple in Jerusalem
aliases: the last remnants of the Jewish temple in Jerusalem
summary: The remnants of the Jewish temple in Jerusalem, cited as an example of a place with a Divine aura of 10.

label: Jezinkas
summary: Bohemian faeries who steal eyes after lulling men to sleep.

label: Jihad
summary: Struggle, greater (inner) and lesser (against evil, warfare).

label: Jinn
summary: A Free Virtue marking a category of spirits associated with the Islamic lands, who are all vulnerable to Sahir magic and may belong to the Magic, Faerie, or Infernal realms.

label: Jinnistan
summary: Subterranean homeland of the jinn conquered by Iblis.

label: Jinxed
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is a magnet for bad luck, being biased to be the one affected whenever chance determines misfortune.

label: Jiphella
summary: An immense Ex Miscellanea maga of Dankmar (age 73), biological daughter of Schadrit and master of Mentem magics who keeps the covenfolk under her spell.

label: Jizya
summary: Head tax paid by adult male dhimmis.

label: Joachim of Flora
summary: Charismatic Sicilian-born Cistercian abbot and prophet (d. 1200) who taught the Three Ages of the World; some Trinitarian ideas were condemned by the Fourth Lateran Council.

label: Joachim of Jerbiton
summary: Early Legion theorist who formulated the doctrine of foreshadowing and found an Initiatory manual of Christianized Mithras rites.

label: Joachimites
summary: Followers of Joachim of Flora who have adopted strange beliefs about the Antichrist and the end of the age in 1260.

label: Joan
summary: Daughter of King John of England, betrothed to Alexander II.

label: Joan of Flanders
summary: Commissioned Perceval continuations.

label: Joan of Hainault
summary: Ruler of Flanders since 1205, niece of Philip II.

label: Joan the Wad
summary: Will-o-the-wisp Queen of the Pisgies in Devon and Cornwall.

label: Job
summary: Biblical figure of the Testing of Job.

label: Jocelin
summary: A Redcap in his late twenties with brown hair and green eyes; favors new covenants and carries a ring of magic resistance and an enchanted shield.

label: Jochim
summary: Example tainted noble's son conceived by incubus for a pointless war before the Mongol invasion.

label: John Balliol
summary: King chosen by Edward of England who proved unpopular, sparking rebellions.

label: John Cassian
summary: Early writer whose works inspired the first rules for nuns.

label: John Comyn
summary: Leader who rivals Robert the Bruce and attacks him in Selkirk forest in 1299.

label: John de Garlande
summary: Author of the famous 13th-century craft manual Dictionarius, covering moneychangers, clasp makers, cup makers, jewelers, and harness makers.

label: John de Warrenne
summary: Earl of Surrey and Governor of Scotland who advances against Wallace.

label: John II
summary: Married the daughter of Andrew II in 1218, partly due to Tremere influence.

label: John IV of Montoire
summary: Count living in Vendôme castle who owns one of the spears.

label: John Marshal
summary: William Marshal's father. He held a castle for Queen Matilda against King Stephen, broke a truce and offered his son as a hostage he would not ransom.

label: John of Capella
summary: Early follower of Francis who, while Francis was away, gathered lepers and began to develop a new religious order for them.

label: John of Frankfurt
summary: Stated with Arnold of Villanova that spirits come voluntarily.

label: John of Mirfeld
summary: English writer giving techniques for prognosis by magical means, including onomancy.

label: John of Salisbury
summary: Twelfth-century writer (1115-1180) whose Policraticus complains of diviners at court; he crystal-gazed as a pupil.

label: John of San Costanzo
summary: One of the early followers of Francis.

label: John of Tours
summary: Physician and Bishop of Somerset who moved his seat to Bath and built its priory.

label: John Scottus
summary: A scholar who in the ninth century corrected the error of two predeterminations, one good and one evil.

label: John the Baptist
summary: Precursor to Jesus (Yahya in Islam), beheaded by King Herod; several churches claim his head.

label: John Wascelin
summary: Current constable of Bamburgh Castle with nominal suzerainty over the Farne Islands.

label: Join or Die
summary: The Order's nominal policy toward other workers of magic, problematic because mundane authorities see such killings as murder.

label: Joining the Navy
summary: Story seed where a nobleman demands ship carriage from a port town near a covenant.

label: Jolarsveniar
summary: Norwegian faeries drawn to Christmas celebrations.

label: Jon Arnsson
summary: A 98-year-old master of House Bjornaer holding the Seat of the Stag (protector) at Crintera, with a lion heartbeast; a devout Christian Harmonist with divided loyalties.

label: Jon Baudin
summary: Guildmaster of the Dyer's Guild and Fudarus spy who plays two Daniel impersonators against each other.

label: Jon Haraldsson
summary: Mormaer of Caithness and Earl of Orkney, holding land from Scotland and Norway; implicated in burning a bishop.

label: Jonaquil of Merinita
summary: A young Merinita magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

label: Jonathan Carpenter
summary: Example character who gains the Reputation Patron (Clergy) by building a nave for a parish church.

label: Jonathan Tweet
summary: Ars Magica co-creator who wrote the game's preface; an in-world author note rather than a setting figure.

label: Jongleurs
summary: Lower-born minstrels.

label: Jophiel
summary: An archangel listed by Dionysus the Areopagite among the archangels.

label: Josce fil' Isaac of London
summary: An important London usurer who currently holds the office of archpresbyter, the crown-appointed Jewish representative.

label: Josce of London
summary: Presbyter Judaeorum of England in 1220.

label: Joscelin of Wells
summary: Bishop of Bath since 1206 who wishes to move his seat to Wells and build a cathedral; a potential ally of magi.

label: Joseph d'Arimethie
summary: Tractatus by Robert de Boron on the Holy Grail.

label: Joseph of Arimathea
summary: The companion who came to Britain with Christ and later carried Christ's blood in a vessel, traveling west with eleven companions to found the first church at Glastonbury.

label: Joseph of Napoli
summary: Reforming churchman from Antagonists keen to bring the Order into the Church; ideal counterpart for a Hermetic proctor at the papal curia.

label: Josephine
summary: Larta magus chef at Valnastium from the Engadine valley, whose food is as good as magical.

label: Josephine filia Theodore
summary: Lartan Jerbiton maga at Valnastium.

label: Joshua
summary: Conqueror of Canaan.

label: Josiah
summary: Prophet who rendered the Vale of Hinnom ceremonially unclean, ending child sacrifice there.

label: Josselin
summary: Castle town.

label: Jotun Language
summary: The ancient language of the giants, magical language of the trollsynir, replacing Pictish.

label: Jotun Lore
summary: Lore universally taught to trollsynir.

label: Jotunheim
summary: The land of the Norse giants, perhaps within the Magic Realm.

label: Jotunn Affinity
summary: Giant magical ability to work with Jotunn spirits; Gull's is with Fire.

label: Jotunn Spells
summary: Gull's power to invoke fire magics directly using Stamina.

label: Jotunn spirits
summary: Spirits called upon by giants through Jotunn Affinity.

label: Jotunnar
summary: The Norse giants spawned from Ymir, including frost, mountain, sea, storm and fire giants; affiliated with elemental Forms and all possessing magical powers.

summary: Tractatus on Area Lore: Cursewood, Quality 9, revealing Wyzwanie, the diabolists, vis sources and Significatos.

label: Journeyman
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a trained guild craftsman who may practice his trade in town under guild supervision and work for a master for a wage.

label: Joust
summary: Tourney's most dangerous event, a knightly joust between mounted magi.

label: Jove
summary: A pagan deity cited as an example of an earth-shakingly important figure with a Might score in the 51-60 range.

label: Jovius
summary: Filius of Bonisagus whom Bonisagus was forced to March in 812.

label: Joyous Garden
summary: Garden Merlin conjured for Viviane.

label: Judah
summary: Southern kingdom with Jerusalem as capital.

label: Judah Halevi
summary: Toledo-born poet (1075-1140) who held Israel the only place for true prophecy; murdered outside Jerusalem.

label: Judaic Lore
summary: A General Ability covering knowledge of Jewish cultural practice such as poetry, folklore, and songs.

label: Judaism
summary: One of the three Divine religions in Mythic Europe; Jews live within a Dominion aura, and a scattering of magi are Jewish.

label: Judas Iscariot
summary: Betrayer of Christ who hanged himself at Aceldama; his conspiracy is why Infernal auras rise the Wednesday before Easter.

label: Juden of Verditius
summary: Magus of Verdi who murdered clergy on Sardinia to restore magic and was killed under a Wizard's March.

label: Judged Unfairly
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which people universally distrust and underestimate the character, preventing him from gaining a positive Reputation.

label: Judges of the Dead
summary: Figures of the Underworld negotiated past in the Orpheus story.

label: Judgment Day
summary: The Last Judgement, when archangels will war against Hell and Israfel will sound his trumpet.

label: Judgment of the Glowing Iron
summary: Ordeal of carrying red-hot iron; innocent if wounds are uninfected after three days.

label: Judith
summary: Biblical widow whose story Joachim used to calculate 1260.

label: Julia
summary: The de facto leader of Voluntas and one of the tribunal's best politicians, a mature Jerbiton maga specializing in Corpus and Mentem who orchestrated the breaking of Blackthorn's dominance at the 1201 tribunal.

label: Julia of Jerbiton
summary: Example maga who enchants stone columns to increase her covenant's aura and close its regio.

label: Julia's Laboratory
summary: The ground-floor sanctum of the Devil's Lane covenant, a spooky chamber filled with bleached bones and skulls.

label: Julian of Flambeau
summary: A magus of House Flambeau whose version of The Beast Remade gives transformed beasts bright red hair in their new form.

label: Juliasta filia Criamon
summary: Criamon's successor as Primus and the first follower of the Winding Path; she shared the House's knowledge with outsiders and prepared the House for its journey.

label: Julius
summary: Archmagus of House Flambeau and Ignem specialist who, with Lavinia, leads the Hermetic crusade against Iceland and kills Biorn Egilsson.

label: Julius Caesar
summary: Roman figure who in a Jerbiton parable accidentally destroyed the library of Alexandria.

label: Jumayl, A Jinni Guide
summary: A faerie jinni of the jann (Might 15, Vim), a mercenary caravan guide wandering the Levant and beyond, able to change into a white Bactrian camel and susceptible to mundane alcohol.

label: Jumieges
summary: Benedictine abbey on the Seine founded 634 by St. Philibert, a major center of scholarship with over 1,000 monks.

label: Jumieges Abbey
summary: Normandy abbey which received lost Viking-era books.

label: Jungfrau
summary: Region with St Beatus' caves.

label: Juniper
summary: One of the early followers of Francis.

label: Junius of Verditius
summary: An old, powerful Verditius magus of Semitae who makes the covenant's enchanted wagons and works secretly on an unrevealed project.

label: Juno
summary: Externalized conscience created from the spirit of a morally-conflicted being; Esther may be one.

label: Juno's Spire
summary: Chapter house of the Covenant of the Icy North serving as the personal demesne of Archmagus Pietro, linked to the Motherhouse by a defended Hermes Portal.

label: Jupiter Pennius

label: Jupiter's Resounding Blow
summary: A Creo Auram spell (Level 10) that creates a thunderclap that may deafen anyone directly underneath.

label: Jupiter's Tears
summary: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

label: Jupiter's Touch
summary: Air elemental power causing lightning for +30 damage.

label: Jura Mountains
summary: Forested range northwest of the French Alps.

label: Jurade
summary: Citizen assembly governing St-Èmilion.

label: Jurisdiction
summary: Major Church Hook: the church has jurisdiction over many subordinate churches.

label: Jurist
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character who is a judge, advocate, or procurator, able to purchase Latin, Artes Liberales, and Civil and Canon Law.

label: Jury of Inquisition
summary: Group appointed by the court to investigate a matter and report at the next session.

label: Jus Primae Noctis
summary: The legend of the lord's right to a bride's first night, noted as not medieval.

label: Just an Instant
summary: A Minor, General Virtue letting a character who briefly looks about a room detect and remember anything of interest without Awareness checks.

label: Just Temper
summary: A temper of the Dominion that could favor the innocent in ordeals.

label: Justice
summary: Moral (Cardinal) virtue creating respect toward others, source of piety, gratitude and duty.

label: Justin of Tremere
summary: A young Tremere magus, one of the newly arrived members of Libellus.

label: Justina of Criamon
summary: Filia of Errantus whose staff he stole; awarded twelve pawns in damages.

label: Justinian
summary: Emperor whose sixth-century imperial adventure left cataphract ghosts in the West.

label: Jutta
summary: Anchoress who taught the young Hildegard reading and writing and was the only person she confided her visions to; died 1136.

label: König
summary: German title for king. Within the empire, kingdoms are usually held by the emperor.

label: Ka'aba
summary: A holy site in Mecca cited as an example of a place with a Divine aura of 10 where God intervened directly.

label: Ka'ba
summary: Shrine of the Black Stone in Mecca built by Abraham and Isma'il; Dominion aura 10.

label: Kabbalah

label: Kabbalah Shimmush
summary: Practical kabbalah, the relatively new pragmatic, ritualistic application of the forces of creation.

label: Kabbalist
summary: Free Mythic Companion Social Status Virtue required of all kabbalists.

label: Kabbalist (companion)
summary: Mythic Companion template, a rabbi and kabbalist.

summary: Dwarf-like faeries of the Low Countries who made bells for missionaries and sang the first carillon; Florum sits above their ancient workshop.

label: Kaerbadon
summary: Capital of King Bladud, suggested as the site of the Battle of Mons Badonicus.

label: Kaeso
summary: Founder of the Mithraic tradition within House Flambeau; a hedge wizard of the Cult of Mithras recruited by Apromor who founded the covenant of Castra Solis.

label: Kalazonta
summary: The Chastiser, an example angel.

label: Kalevipoeg
summary: Hero who sailed toward the Underworld and found an island of peaceful koerakoonlased.

label: Kalkriese
summary: Site of the Varus disaster skirmish where Tremere necromancers routed Diedne magi with ghosts.

label: Kallikantzaroi
summary: Small Greek faeries living under the Earth sawing at the World Tree, allowed on the surface from Christmas until Epiphany.

label: Kalliope filia Bibliophilus
summary: Middle-aged magus, latest in an intermittent line of librarian-magi at Valnastium.

label: Kalliste
summary: Filia of Tasgillia who exposed her mater's diabolism and became the fifth Prima of House Tytalus; Tytali regard her exposure of Tasgillia as the "Betrayal" of the Founder's principles.

summary: Ancient Greek sorcerers' name for the good spirits used in their magic, contrasted with kakodaemones.

label: Kalshedra
summary: An Albanian fire-breathing dragon that can take hag shape, pollutes water, causes drought and feeds on human vitality.

label: Kamillia filia Bamber
summary: Bjornaer maga with a lammergeir heartbeast, the dominant partner of the pair-bonded couple with Eginhard.

label: Kapparah
summary: Ritual of transferring sins to a chicken before Yom Kippur.

label: Kara
summary: The kolduni term for a geas or curse.
