summary: An Ars Magica supplement containing 15 fully statted magi at various ages, usable as NPCs or player characters.

label: Magi Orbi
summary: Magi who began in a different House but were exiled and found refuge in House Ex Miscellanea; they retain their former House's rules but lose its privileges and secrets.

label: Magi Trianomae
summary: Politically focused branch within House Bonisagus to which Austerius belongs.

label: Magian Lineage
summary: A Minor or Major General Virtue making the character a true blood descendant of the Median tribe of Magians, the original priestly caste of Persia, granting bonuses to aging and disease resistance.

label: Magians
summary: The original priestly caste of Persia, of which the Median tribe of Magians were the true blood ancestors granting the Magian Lineage Virtue.

label: Magic Addiction
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the magus craves casting magic and struggles to stop casting spells until he drops from exhaustion.

label: Magic Affinity
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

label: Magic Animal
summary: Special Virtue for a magical animal, such as a Beast of Virtue, designed with Magic Might under the Magical Animal rules.

label: Magic Archipelago
summary: Theory of the Magic Realm as a physical chain of islands (insulae) separated by the waters of the Twilight Void.

label: Magic as Technology
summary: Chapter Four proposal recasting magi as inventors and enchantments as technology.

label: Magic character
summary: A character with a Magic Might Score, created with Magic Character Creation rules or via a Virtue such as Transformed (Being).

label: Magic Character Creation
summary: Rules in Realms of Power: Magic for designing magic animals, humans, spirits and things.

label: Magic Hound
summary: Sample magic animal character guide (Might 0-10 Animal) with the Inexorable Hunter power.

label: Magic Human
summary: Special Virtue for a magical human born with Magic Might and the Monstrous Appearance Inferiority, possibly descended from ancient magical beings.

label: Magic Humans
summary: Humans or human-form beings affected by the realm of Magic: giants, Spirit Votaries, Magic Kin, and the transformed.

label: Magic Inferiority
summary: Detrimental trait of magic characters that grants extra Magic Qualities.

label: Magic Item Merchant
summary: Magus vocation (Verditius) from Verdi who sells magic items to nobles.

label: Magic Item (Virtue)
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: a magic item is installed in the lab, granting Virtues, Flaws, or Specialization changes; treated as Minor if very large.

label: Magic Items
summary: A Minor General Virtue granting a Redcap 25 extra starting levels of magic items plus accelerated improvement, reflecting devotion to the House.

label: Magic Kin
summary: Families or groups of characters aligned with Magic sharing inherited qualities and powers.

label: Magic Lore
summary: An Ability concerning knowledge of magical creatures and phenomena; used to resist Vulnerable-to-Folk-Tradition magi and to attempt re-entry against Banishing.

label: Magic Monster
summary: Flaw referenced in this text.

label: Magic Quality
summary: Beneficial trait of magic characters bought with Might; can be gained by Transformation.

label: Magic Realm Magic
summary: Extensions to Hermetic magic enabling manipulation of vestiges, boundaries and travel in the Magic Realm, gained via a Minor Breakthrough.

label: Magic Regio of Dindyméné
summary: An uninhabited Magic regio (aura 6) that is an enlarged copy of the temenos, producing Herbam and Terram vis annually and granting Calm +2 to visitors.

label: Magic Resistance
summary: The capacity to ward off magical effects, granted to magi chiefly by the Parma Magica.

label: Magic Sensitivity
summary: A supernatural Virtue that lets a character sense magical auras and presences; held by the Scribe template and offered as an option for the Minstrel.

label: Magic Spirit
summary: Special Virtue for a mind, memory, image or idea brought to life by Magic; insubstantial and always having the Magical Air Flaw.

label: Magic Susceptibility
summary: Flaw possessed by Calum Mac Lachlan.

label: Magic-Taming
summary: Mutantes view of 'taming' wild magic, giving it direction and binding it to service.

label: Magic Theory
summary: The Ability that governs understanding of Hermetic magic: inventing spells, enchanting items and studying from books.

label: Magic Theory roll
summary: Library trap mechanic: a magus following uncorrected deliberate-error lab notes who fails an Intelligence + Magic Theory roll against Ease Factor 12 rolls as if he botched an experiment.

label: Magic Thing
summary: Inherited Virtue of magical beings that are things rather than creatures, such as the mandrake, Amiculum, kelpies and elementals.

label: Magical Affinity
summary: Virtue granting affinity with an Art (Domnhull's Vim); unavailable to gruagachan.

label: Magical Animal Companion
summary: A useful minor Flaw giving a character a magical animal companion; listed as a resource increasing an agent's Resistance Strength.

label: Magical Animal Companions
summary: Magical animals for which the pet statistics can serve as templates.

label: Magical Armillary Sphere
summary: An enchanted armillary sphere that continually tracks astrological time and planetary influences, halving the Ease Factor of Astrological Duration calculations.

label: Magical Beast
summary: A creature of magic with Magic Might that can be created at high levels of Creo Animal, requiring requisites for its powers and a Vim requisite for its magical nature.

label: Magical (Being) Companion
summary: Minor Story Flaw: the character is accompanied by an intelligent magical being it must look after; generalizes Magical Animal Companion.

label: Magical Blood
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue: exposure to the Magic realm improves the character's true form, giving -1 on Aging rolls, access to Magic Lore and a minor physical advantage; sometimes called faerie blood.

label: Magical Champion
summary: Minor Social Status Virtue for magic characters regarded as the particular representative of a small group due to their magical nature.

label: Magical Companion
summary: Virtue listed in character statistics in this text.

label: Magical constructs
summary: Non-human servants at Ungulus, including human-form constructs, self-working animated brooms, knives and pans, warning bells, and invisible bound spirits serving as guards and messengers.

label: Magical Covenfolk
summary: Free Social Status Virtue for a magical being accepted as an equal by the people of its covenant.

label: Magical Defenses
summary: Limited hedge defenses that grant a bonus or penalty in an area of specialty, equal to Art/5 or Ability score.

label: Magical Disaster
summary: An overwhelming eruption of Magic that can transport wielders, objects or whole regions into the Magic Realm.

label: Magical Fascination
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is intensely interested in supernatural and magical phenomena to the exclusion of other motivations.

label: Magical Fish of St. Corentine
summary: Regenerating fish with Divine Might 2 that fed St. Corentine.

label: Magical Fortitude Charm Against Lightning
summary: TuMa 5 charm adding +8 Soak vs magical lightning.

label: Magical Friend
summary: Minor Social Status Flaw: the character is considered less than human but favored by a human, e.g. as pet or familiar.

label: Magical Gloves and Sword of Degare
aliases: Magical Gloves and Sword of Degare
summary: Gloves and broken-pointed sword left by Degare's faerie father.

label: Magical Heating
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: heating is provided magically, functioning as Superior or Excessive Heating without space and Upkeep cost.

label: Magical Investigation Specialist
summary: Guernicus magi called in to support investigations with specialist magic, often endorsing testimony.

label: Magical Lighting
summary: A Free laboratory Supernatural Virtue: lighting is provided magically, functioning as Superior or Excessive Lighting without space and Upkeep cost.

label: Magical Lineages of Cats
summary: Three families of cats tracing descent to the familiars of the Founders or their earliest apprentices, each with its own oral history and culture.

label: Magical Master
summary: Major Social Status Virtue: the magic character is recognized as a higher power by a large group, which may venerate it.

label: Magical Meditation
summary: Supernatural Ability for Magic Might characters: a trance to recover Might Points and resist Acclimation in a Magic aura.

label: Magical Meditation (Quality)
summary: Major Quality giving the Supernatural Ability Magical Meditation at 1.

label: Magical Memory
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue allowing a magus to reproduce magical creations without keeping laboratory texts, getting the benefit of a Lab Text from memory.

label: Magical Monster
summary: Major Social Status Flaw for a magical being with no strong connection to human society; most Beasts of Virtue have it.

label: Magical Mount
summary: A Minor General Virtue granting a mount or beast-of-burden with Cunning and a Magic Might Score up to 25 that obeys simple verbal commands.

label: Magical Oven
summary: A Creo Ignem 20 enchanted device shaped as an iron box encased in fire-brick whose interior becomes red-hot on command to cook food.

label: Magical Qualities and Inferiorities
summary: Purchased features of magic characters; elementals' Characteristics are bought with matching Qualities and Inferiorities.

label: magical raven cloak
summary: A magical cloak carried by the Skinchanger spouse covenfolk character, associated with her raven Skinchanger form.

label: Magical Resistance
summary: Virtue unavailable to gruagachan.

label: Magical Seabirds
summary: Magic Animal birds arriving at the Farnes from March, whose overwintering location is unknown.

label: Magical Sensitivity
summary: Ability appearing in character or creature statistics in this text.

label: Magical Shepherd's Pipes
summary: Pipes played by the tityroi.

label: Magical Silver
summary: Magically created silver, which Redcaps refuse and which the Stonehenge Tribunal limited after it caused inflation.

label: Magical Teasel
summary: Pixie-grown teasel giving +2 to thread-crafting and containing Herbam vis.

label: Magical Technology
summary: The use of Hermetic enchantments as technology to transform Mythic Europe.

label: Magical Tether
summary: Mystical link that anchors an aura; created by rituals of level 45+, age of structures, or natural beauty.

label: Magical theurgy
summary: Secret lore by which each manifestation of a spirit is called an Aspect.

label: Magical Travel
summary: Travel through boundaries or vestiges, requiring Magic Might or powers like Second Sight, rolled against a level-based Ease Factor minus Familiarity.

label: Magical Truffles
summary: Truffles with Magic Might that guard truffles and trees in Magic forests; in the regio they come as workers, drones, daughters and the Matron.

label: Magical Warder
summary: A Major General Virtue giving the character a magical being, such as a ghost, that watches over him and comes to no harm; designed as a magic character.

label: Magical Wolf
summary: A magical creature (Magic Might 20, Animal) resembling a slightly large gray wolf that watches over all wolves in its range, can split into a pack of duplicates, and instantly slay any wolf it strikes.

label: Magicam
summary: Learned magician Form governing magic, protection from hostile magic and magical powers; corresponds most closely to Vim.

label: Magician's Boost
summary: SuMa general charm increasing a just-cast charm by 5 levels.

label: Magician's Desire Denied
summary: Nain power making objects appear as vis.

label: Magician's Second Wind
summary: SuMa general charm increasing a charm's Duration (or Range/Target) by one.

label: Magister et Artibus
summary: A Major Social Virtue (university master of arts) listed as a high-Resistance social status on the Resistance of Agents Table.

label: Magister in Artibus
summary: A Major Social Status Virtue for one who has incepted Master of Arts at a European university and completed compulsory teaching, entitling them to teach anywhere in Europe.

label: Magister in Medicina
summary: A Major Social Status Virtue for a character who graduated from a higher university faculty; the highest educational license in Mythic Europe, granting 300 experience points and Academic Reputation 3.

label: Magistrate Bayne
summary: Author of Civitas Orleans.

label: Magistrate's Court
summary: Orleans court where Jean the Wise uses Dowsing to find stolen property.

label: Magitech
summary: Anachronistic modern-style technology realized through magic.

label: Magna Carta
summary: The great written charter of English liberties, settled at Runnymede; its 1217 reissue is enforceable in court even against the king and constrains royal power.

label: Magnantrum
summary: Covenant founded around 1111 in a cave under Salisbury Plain; disintegrated in 1187 due to internal disputes.

label: Magnate
summary: Great noble with a sphere of influence, retinue, tenants, and affinity.

label: Magnitude
summary: One-fifth of a magical effect's level, the Hermetic in-character measure of power.

label: Magnus Barelegs
summary: King of Norway who acquired the Western Isles in 1098 by dragging a ship across Kintyre.

label: Magnus Gizurarson
summary: Bishop of Skalholt whose son is slain in the killings; he leads a delegation to Rome petitioning the Pope against the Order of Hermes and chairs the settlement.

label: Magnus the Quaesitor
summary: A Quaesitor investigating a Hermetic maga suspected of diabolism who asks veteran magi to help pursue the criminals into the Cursewood.

label: Magpie
summary: Talking pet bird with game statistics.

label: Magus
summary: A fully trained Hermetic wizard and member of the Order of Hermes; the central player-character type of Ars Magica.

label: Magus errant
summary: Tradition of young magi adventuring abroad for vis and renown.

label: Magus Orbus
summary: A magus whose House of origin is unknown or lost.

label: Magvillius
summary: Place Promethea went to await the end of the struggle.

label: Magvillus
summary: Domus Magnus of House Quaesitor in the mountains of the Kingdom of Sicily, founded A.D. 830; heart of Hermetic law, riven between Traditionalists and Transitionalists.

label: Magvillus Council
summary: The governing council of House Guernicus with inner and outer tiers, which reviews vetoes, appeals of penalties and Quaesitorial conduct.

label: Magvillus Warehouse
summary: Large Venetian warehouse owned by Magvillus where Tribunal meetings are held, rumoured haunted.

label: Magyar Shamans
summary: Pagan Hungarian shamans with the full taltós powers, including immortality until their Mystery passes on.

label: Magyars
summary: Nomadic Hungarian raiders of northern Italy; small enclaves remain.

label: Mahdi
summary: Messiah who will appear at the end of time.

label: Mahonin
summary: A maggot demon of the Tempters that deludes victims into eating inedible objects as luxurious food; driven away by fennel seeds.

label: Maiden Castle
summary: A large set of hilltop earthworks south of Dorchester in Dorset, seemingly deserted but said in local tales to be a faerie stronghold where the fay may be met on the correct night.

label: Maiden (foreman elf)
summary: A beautiful golden-haired foreman elf.

label: Mail
summary: Chain mail; mail shirts ancient, full mail early medieval.

label: Maimonides
summary: A Jewish philosopher who wrote The Guide for the Perplexed in 1190, a great summa on Jewish philosophy infused with Aristotelian ideas, sparking the Maimonidean Controversy.

label: Maine
summary: County/duchy forming part of Anjou; capital Le Mans.

label: Mainland
summary: Name of the largest island in both Orkney and Shetland.

label: Mainland (Orkney)
summary: Principal island of the Orkneys, site of the Stennes stones.

label: Maintain the Demanding Spell
summary: A Vim spell cited as not eligible for the Rebuttal Mastery special ability.

label: Maintaining the Demanding Spell
summary: A Rego Vim spell that automatically maintains a concentration-requiring spell already cast for the duration of this spell, without the caster needing to concentrate.

label: Mainz
summary: Formerly the Roman city Moguntiacum, raised to an archbishopric by St. Boniface; its archbishop is Archchancellor of the Empire and primas germaniae, and its see is a Holy See with a Divine aura of 7.

label: Mairi Falt Ban
summary: Wife of Donncadh Mac Calum and unofficial leader of the women of Clan Mac Gruagach, a calming influence with considerable say in clan matters.

label: Mairi Sean
summary: Maga Ex Miscellanea of Mac Gruagach, a spirit mistress trained in Greece (Thebes tribunal) who summons ghosts of the Picts and is fixated on the Broch-builders.

label: Majarida Mountains
summary: The mountains around the Wolf's Court, home to unusually bold wolf packs that include Wolves of Virtue.

label: Major Breakthrough
summary: A significant advance in Hermetic theory; the Aegis of the Hearth was a Major Breakthrough, while inventing variant parameters of it would require at least a Minor Breakthrough.

label: Major Flaw (Inferiority)
summary: Major Inferiority granting a Major General or Supernatural (Magic) Flaw.

label: Major Hermetic Virtue
summary: Category of Virtue, e.g. Diedne Magic and Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic.

label: Major Magic Deficiency
summary: Flaw appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

label: Major Magical Deficiency
summary: Major Flaw with an aett.

label: Major Magical Focus in Spirits
summary: A Major Magical Focus developed by Titanoi magi during apprenticeship, applying to all supernatural entities with a naturally insubstantial form including ghosts.

label: Major Orders
summary: Clerical grades of sub-deacon, deacon, priest and bishop, who are celibate.

label: Major Rune Focus
summary: Virtue giving a vitki a focus in a category of rune magic, e.g. Sigrunar.

label: Makatiel
summary: An Avenger of Evil whose angel-like name means Plague of God.

label: Make a Liar of the Boastful
aliases: Make a Liar of the Boastful
summary: Bomburkhan's Power granting someone a talent contradicting a boast.

label: Make the Miser Generous
summary: TaBl 30 spell eliminating a Major negotiation-related Virtue (or equivalent) from the victim until he behaves honestly.

label: Maker of Textured Vessels
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue allowing a character to craft vessels with impressed mystical patterns that grant a +3 bonus in a single Ability to their owner.

label: Maker of Water Vessels
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue allowing a character to make magical water vessels whose drinker may swap an Ability score for the crafter's Craft: Potter score.

label: Malachi
summary: A nine-year-old devil child in a young man's body, son of the demon Abrigor, who travels Europe seeking objects of power while unknowingly releasing imprisoned demons.

label: Malak Ta'us
summary: The Peacock Angel of the real Yezidi religion.

label: Malandanti
summary: The 'bad walkers', evil nightwalkers (usually Infernal witches, sometimes unruly ghosts) who oppose the benandanti, fighting with sorghum.

label: Malchut
summary: Sefirah meaning 'Kingdom', level 1 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 1.

label: Malcolm Big-Head
summary: Ancestor of the current Scottish royal line, who defeated MacBeth.

label: Malcolm Canmore
summary: Duncan's son raised in England who killed MacBeth with the aid of two mysterious magi and brought English influence to Scotland.

label: Malcolm II
summary: Scottish king who defeated the Angles at Carham in 1018.

label: Malcolm IV
summary: King called 'the Maiden' for his vow of celibacy; traded David's southern gains for Huntington.

label: Malcom Ceann Dubh
summary: Son of the chief and tanist of a clan, leader of a cattle drive to Aberdeen.

label: Male Guild Sponsor
summary: A free General Virtue allowing a female character to participate in any guild by attaching to a male relative's name on the roster.

label: Malediction
summary: A Flaw a sahir might acquire from botched dealings with jinn during apprenticeship.

label: Maleficia
summary: Infernal effects resembling Hermetic spells, cast with a Method plus a Power: stress die + Characteristic + Method + Power + aura.

label: Malevolent aura
summary: A corrupted aura of sentient cruelty tarnished with sins of violence and perverted appetite, adding its strength to damage and botches.

label: Malfalla of Portugal
summary: Future mystic who is an infant in 1220.

label: Mali non valde
summary: The not completely evil, whose destination is Purgatory.

label: Malignant Magus
summary: A Minor Story Supernatural Flaw where a Twilight-loosed piece of the magus's psyche manifests as an adulteration that attacks his enemies without his consent.

label: Malik ibn Anas
summary: Founder of the Maliki school (d. 795).

label: Malikis
summary: Madhhab founded by Malik ibn Anas, followed by most Sunni jurists under the Almohads.

label: Malingreux
summary: A court of Parisian argotiers who fake a dreadful disease with fat and ashes.

label: Malleus Epistula
summary: Chain letter from the 5th century instructing inquisitors to torture and burn witches; a summa (Quality 26) on the Witch-Hammer Favored Abilities.

label: Malocchi
summary: A tradition of Italian magi within House Ex Miscellanea who practice the magic of Entrancement and are believed to bring terrible luck with their gaze.

label: Malta
summary: Island ruled by a count owing fealty to the King of Sicily.

label: Mamluk
summary: Minor Social Status Virtue for a former military slave trained at a military school, educated in Islam and freed at adulthood; grants Martial Abilities and Theology: Islam.

label: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away
aliases: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away
summary: Meditation Intervention effect (Level 20) creating the appearance of a human being.

label: Manannan Mac Lir
summary: Irish faerie sovereign and wizard-king, once god of Irish sailors and the Isle of Man; a shapeshifter with Faerie Might 55.

label: Mandeans
summary: Monotheists in Iran with a Dominion.

label: Mandrake
summary: Magic Thing root with Might 5 whose deadly scream kills those who hear it; may be Enriched to grant Premonitions or bonded as a homunculus familiar.

label: Maneuver
summary: Battlefield event component: Defend, Attack, Run the Gauntlet, Take, or Heroic Gesture.

label: Manfred
summary: Bastard son of Frederick II, possibly demon-spawned, who took Sicily's crown before being killed.

label: Mangonel
summary: A tension-powered catapult throwing stones on a low trajectory, used to bombard walls and gates.

label: Manichaeism
summary: Older dualist heresy resembling Catharism.

label: Manichees
summary: Dualist sect, succeeded by the Bogomils and Cathars.

label: Manifest Sin
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which a past sin stains the character's spirit and is manifest to those who can perceive hidden things, penalizing social interactions.

label: Manifestation
summary: Faerie power manifesting consciousness among animals and plants within its glamour, simulating CrAn, ReAn, CrHe or ReHe effects.

label: Mannanan Mac Leir
summary: Magician-king, arguably Bladud's grandson, fought by Saint Patrick on the Isle of Man.

label: Mannaz
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Man" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of mankind and cooperation; usually linked to Corpus and used to target persons with other runes.

label: Mannus
summary: Son of the god Tuisto, from whom the word 'man' derives, who sired the fathers of the three German tribal groups.

label: Manor
summary: The basic fief for game purposes: the land (around six hundred acres) traditionally required to maintain a knight, his family and household retainers, yielding about twenty pounds a year.

label: Manor Court
summary: Court dealing with lesser matters like assault, minor thefts and disputes between villeins, convened by the steward.

label: Manorial Roll
summary: The parchment rolls recording manorial court decisions, onto which special decisions and retirement contracts are sewn.

label: Manorial Rolls
summary: Long records of previous cases and debts kept by the court clerk.

label: Mansur
summary: The Muslim emir of Semita Errabunda, used as an example of invoking God's aid in combat.

label: Manticore
summary: A creature with which Demons of the Fifth Trump are often mistaken; manticores are not demons.

label: Mantle of Nerius
summary: Mantle made by Verditius magus Ceylan for Nerius, letting the wearer survive without food; Faith 3, Divine Might 30; now lost.

label: Manufactured Ignorance
summary: A Minor Story Tainted Flaw in which a group of minor demons sustains the tainted character's delusion by arranging supporting fortunate occurrences.

label: Manumission
summary: The freeing of serfs by lords, favored by Church teaching but rarely practiced by senior Churchmen; costs six to ten pounds for a player character.

label: Many Marriageable Daughters
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character has many daughters and must participate in stories to marry them off suitably.

label: Manzikert
summary: Where the Turks routed the Byzantine army in 1071.

label: Mar
summary: Northern Lowland region with many recumbent stone circles.

label: Mara ex Miscellanea
summary: A young maga of Ex Miscellanea, Regulus' amica and proxy holder of his sigil, author of Curses and Corruption.

label: Marbaid of Flambeau
summary: A magus of House Flambeau whose wizard's sigil is connected to an obsession with blood, turning his water spells into gushes of blood.

label: Marbhairn na Gearr-fhiadh
summary: Mungan Mor's familiar (Hare Killer), an old grizzled deerhound with a long rivalry with Fiacail Geur.

label: Marbode of Rennes
summary: Bishop who wrote the 11th-century Lapidary.

label: Marcandiers
summary: A court of Parisian argotiers who pretend to be robbed merchants.

label: Marcelo of Verdi
summary: Magus of Verdi who has long tried to fathom the magic of the Roman roads.

label: Marcher Lord
summary: Lords placed between England and Wales after the Conquest, with near-royal rights to build castles, levy taxes and make war.

label: Marcher Lords
summary: Anglo-Norman lords holding land in or along the borders of Wales, including the Marshals, de Braoses, Mortimers, and Bohuns, whose lordships function much like palatinates.

label: Marchio Liutpoldos
summary: Nobleman made overlord of the East March in 976, progenitor of the Babenbergs.

label: Marco
summary: A disreputable Redcap, frequently described as a liar and charlatan, who reports many strange tales of covenants.

label: Marcus Antonius
summary: Former chief priest of the luperci.

label: Marcus Navicularius
summary: A Follower of Verditius (age 58) and the foremost shipwright in Lübeck, a master of Terram who enchants extremely large items such as ships for sale to other covenants.

label: Marcus of Paris
summary: Redcap majordomo of Mathieus who sells intelligence about Paris and recruits servants for covenants.

label: Marcus the Valiant
summary: The ghostly gladiator leader (Magic Might 20) who haunts the Trier amphitheater, equipped as a hoplomachus and challenging visitors to duels to the death.

label: Maren
summary: Verditius who made great weapons for kings before the Treaty.

label: Margaret, Maid of Norway
summary: Granddaughter and heir of Alexander III, who died crossing from Norway in 1290.

label: Margaret of Beverley
summary: An English-born pilgrim who disguised herself as a man and helped defend the wall when Jerusalem fell to Saladin in 1187, later becoming a nun at Laon; an example of a woman warrior dressing as a man.

label: Margrave
summary: A count with fuller legal powers over a difficult border (markgraf, marchio).

label: Marguerite of Flambeau
summary: A beautiful but rude maga of House Flambeau, sole inhabitant of Fengheld's Fengheld House chapter in Cherbourg, who considers mundanes beneath her.

label: Mari Amwithig
summary: An example Merinita maga used to illustrate Charm Magic, Story Magic, and Symbolic Magic, who modifies spells with charms and tricks faerie lords out of their treasures.

label: Maria
summary: A young woman near Mount Etna who has the Visions Flaw, feeling an empathy for fire and able to predict the volcano's eruptions through her dreams.

label: Maria of Constantinople
summary: Mater of Mathieus.

label: Marie de France
summary: A twelfth-century poet whose twelve lais are the best-known examples of that form of courtly-love poem.

label: Marie-Morgane
summary: Evil siren, formerly Dahut, who drowns sailors to people sunken Is.

label: Marie of France
summary: Poet who versified the tale of the knight Owein's journey through purgatory.

label: Marie of Oignes
summary: One of the founders of the beguine movement (1176-1213), a mystic who lived in poverty near the priory of Oignes, conversed with her guardian angel and had insight into the hearts of others.

label: Mario of Tytalus
summary: Luctatio magus on the Council of Milan.

label: Mario (Shadow Senator)
summary: Slow-witted Shadow Senator.

label: Marius
summary: Legendary British king, son of Arvirarous, who killed Sodric and gave the Picts Caithness.

label: Marius of Tremere
summary: A magus of House Tremere whose version of Ball of Abysmal Flame causes the ball to make a loud bang on impact; his magical sigil is a gaudiness in his spells.

label: Mark Anthony
summary: Octavian's rival in the civil war during which Julius' temple was destroyed.

label: Market Fair
summary: Fair held on the lord's demesne where surplus is exchanged for manufactured goods, typically twice a year.

label: Market Guild
summary: Guild of faerie merchants that sets and enforces the Devil's Lane market rules through a council.

label: Marking the Territory
summary: A ReCo 15 Scent-Target spell that bars Corpus-associated intruders from a warded area marked by the caster's scent.

label: Marla
summary: A grog patrolling a covenant hallway who interrupts a fleeing intruder in an example.

label: Marmoutier
summary: Monastery by Tours' gate where St. Martin lived.

label: Marne
summary: River near Reims on whose banks lies Matilda's vineyard.

label: Marriage
summary: Sacrament joining two people against temptation, granting both a Faith Point and a holy connection.

label: Mars
summary: The Roman war deity; the Resting Place of Mars is speculated to be the sleeping place of such a war god.

label: Mars incised with a square
summary: House Tremere's symbol; the square represents a Roman road flagstone.

label: Marsebilia
summary: Companion of Clare who started a new Poor Sisters group in Foligno in 1217 as its abbess.

label: Marseilles
summary: Port to which Mathieus sailed after Constantinople fell.

label: Marshal (Virtue)
summary: Minor Social Status Virtue for the specialist in charge of a noble's stables; grants 50 extra experience points.

label: Martial Abilities
summary: Category of Abilities that masters of kennels and marshals may take freely.

label: Martial of Tytalus
summary: A magus of House Tytalus who collects turtle shells inscribed with bellicose Latin quotations.

label: Martigny

summary: Cycle of Arthurian tales.

label: Matter of France
summary: Cycle of Charlemagne and paladins.

label: Matthew

label: Matthew II

summary: Chanson de geste hero.

label: Maurillac

summary: Birthday of the Prophet holiday.

summary: Scottish unit of value equal to 2/3 of a pound, with no coin.

summary: Vessels of Iniquity who encourage young men to seek pleasure regardless of consequences, using intoxicants and illusions.

label: Mesen
summary: Flemish cloth fair town.

label: Meshabber
summary: Angel of punishment who punishes incest.

summary: Grog vocation: carries messages between a covenant and its interests across Italy.

summary: Minor Heroic Virtue to recall any short message word for word.

label: Mews
summary: House for falcons and hawks.

label: Mezuzot
summary: Phylactery cases bound to door posts.

label: Mice That Burned the Barn

label: Michael (demon)

label: Michael Psellos

label: Michael Scot

label: Michaelmas

label: Midday/Midnight (Duration)

label: Midgard

label: Midrash Tehillin

label: Midsummer
