label: Scinnfolk
summary: Gifted Companions in the Order, herb-wives and faerie doctors with eclectic natural magic and faerie charms passed down orally; not a true systematic tradition.

label: Scintilla of Flambeau
summary: A Flambeau maga who came to Burnham from eastern Europe, rumored to be a powerful fire maga but has done nothing noteworthy in Stonehenge.

label: Scissor
summary: The certamen School of Carvers, which skips an attack to deliver a crippling deep attack in the following round.

label: Scitalis
summary: A large slow-moving Magical serpent (Might 5, Animal) with spectacularly colored scales that can stupefy onlookers with its Dazzling Appearance and whose fangs drip venom; its hot blood keeps it active in winter.

label: Scivias
aliases: Know The Ways Of The Lord
summary: Hildegard's tractatus on Theology recording her visions (Know The Ways Of The Lord).

label: Scone
summary: Where Scottish kings are enthroned.

label: Scorpio
summary: Sign of the Zodiac with its own element, temperament and decans in astrological correspondences.

label: Scorpion's Tail
summary: Demons of the Fifth Trump venomous tail attack.

label: Scotland
summary: The realm covered by the Loch Leglean Tribunal, settled over centuries by Broch-builders, Picts, Scots, Vikings, Britons and Saxons.

label: Scots
summary: Irish tribe (Scotti) that settled in the southwest and conquered the Picts, giving their name to Scotland.

label: Scots Penny
summary: Silver coin introduced by David I, equal to the English penny.

label: Scottish Church
summary: The Celtic Church of Scotland, independent of Rome, emphasizing Love; its sites generate a calming Divine aura that augments rather than hinders magic.

label: Scottish Dominion
summary: The Divine aura of Scottish Church sites, focused on the founder's bell and staff; it dampens Passions and Personality Traits and lets acclimated magi cast as if in a magic aura.

label: Scottish Isles
summary: Where Hadrianus's body washed up and haunted.

label: Scottish (language)
summary: Southern language mixing Anglian, Norman French and Gaelic.

label: Scottish Temper of the Dominion
summary: Special aura quality in Scotland whose benefits gruagachan cannot gain.

label: Scottish Wildcat
summary: An untameable, solitary Scottish cat said to foretell weather and call wind and rain; favored by shapeshifters.

label: Scourge the Spirits of the Night
aliases: Scourge the Spirits of the Night
summary: Cockerel of Virtue's crow causing nocturnal spirits to flee.

label: Scourging of Snakes
summary: Saint power expelling all snakes from an island up to the size of Ireland.

label: Scourging the Infernal
summary: Relic Power radiating an aura harmful to demons whose Might is lower than the relic's Divine Might.

label: Scouring
summary: Summoning a non-specific spirit from the surrounding area.

label: Scouts
summary: Tremere explorers and information gatherers.

label: Scribe Arabic
summary: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

label: Scribe Greek
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

label: Scribe Latin
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

label: Scribe the Perfect Circle
summary: Re(Cr)Te 4 spell that scribes a perfect circle for a magus to trace for circle spells.

label: Scribes' Guild
summary: The guild responsible for producing parchment for books, referenced in the seasonal production chart.

label: Scriptorium
summary: Monastic room where books are copied, overseen by the chancellor.

label: Scrofula
summary: A Serious Melancholic Disease from cold dry city winds; said to be cured by the touch of the Kings of England or France.

label: Scroll of exorcism rites
summary: Received by exorcists at ordination.

label: Scrying
summary: Magical remote observation of others; the Haunt of the Living Ghost spell is noted as not constituting scrying by magic since others can see the caster.

label: Scrying Device of Magvillus
summary: Rumored ancient device able to spy through the most powerful wards and Aegis spells.

label: Scrying Mirrors
summary: Distant viewer devices used by rulers to address subjects and displayed publicly for art.

label: Scrying Office
summary: A basilica office containing a damaged shallow pool connected to the aqueduct, a component of the Scrying Pool ritual.

label: Scrying Pond
summary: InAq 35 spell known by Whitburh.

label: Sculpt the Living Water
summary: A Muto Aquam spell (MuAq 20) created by Falke that allows the caster to mentally mold water as if it were clay for Sun duration.

label: Scutage
summary: Fee paid by vassals instead of mustering, allowing the lord to hire mercenaries; kings also demand scutage from lords.

label: Scutum
summary: Convex rectangular shield of the Roman legionary.

label: Scylla
summary: A horrendous monster living in a rock off Italy.

label: Scythian torc
summary: Torc of teeth of a Scythian chieftain and warriors, made by Kore, summoning thirty-four ghostly horsemen.

label: Sea Giants
summary: Norse giants who can breathe underwater.

label: Sea nymphs
summary: Nymphs that sun themselves on island beaches in the Thebes Tribunal.

label: Sea of Marmara
summary: A busy sea near the western end of the Silk Road where Bear Island lies and where the halcyon's vis source is hidden in coves.

label: Sea Runes
summary: Vitkar magic focus on ships.

label: Seahouses
summary: Fishing village on the Northumberland coast where a boat can be hired to the Farnes.

label: Seal
summary: Mundane animal whose statistics serve as the alternate form of a selkie.

label: Seal of Quaesitorial Authority
summary: Seal Whitburh gives investigators granting quaesitoris authority for the dream investigation.

label: Seal of Solomon
summary: Solomon's seal which bound the Spirits of Solomon; a gemstone inscribed with it is abhorrent to them.

label: Seal of the Templar Master of England
aliases: Seal of the Templar Master of England
summary: Seal bearing the Agnus Dei.

label: Seal Skin
summary: Skin whose theft binds a selkie wife.

label: Seal the Breach
summary: CrTe 20 ritual conjuring a section of wall that knits with existing fortifications, restoring up to five damage levels.

label: Seal the Earth
summary: A Creo Terram spell that creates enough dirt to fill in a pit up to 6 paces across and 3 paces deep.

label: Seal the Wounds of Impetuous Youth
aliases: Seal the Wounds of Impetuous Youth
summary: Lost Child ritual power permanently healing a Light wound.

label: Sean Beg
summary: Ringleader of the clansmen who raid another clan's herd during the drive to Aberdeen.

label: Seanachaidh
summary: Clan storyteller and historian office, held by Lachlan Mac Calum.

label: Search
summary: Ability listed in a Roman Tribunal vocation template.

label: Searching the Haystack for a Needle
aliases: Searching the Haystack for a Needle
summary: A Rego Mentem spell granting +3 to sight-based Perception rolls for a specific object or quality, often used to locate vis.

label: Season
summary: Unit of time used for work and study; Tribunal meetings last about a Season.

label: Season (character)
summary: Life-stage classification of magical characters (Spring, Summer, Winter) affecting experience.

label: Season (Duration)
summary: Faerie ritual Duration running from one equinox or solstice to the next; same level as Moon.

label: Season (magic character)
summary: Statistic replacing age for magic characters: spring, summer, autumn or winter, determining starting experience.

label: Seasons of Service
summary: Punishment in which a convicted magus serves Mercere or Guernicus magi, e.g. enacting longevity rituals, investing devices or copying records.

label: Sebastian
summary: An eighth-century hedge wizard who joined the Order as a Flambeau magus despite Deficient Arts, developing a combat method based on his only strength, the Form of Aquam; namesake of the Schools of Sebastian.

label: Sebastian filius Luise
summary: Magus listed in the index, filius of Luise.

label: Sebastiano
summary: Lion of Mithras and Mystagogue at Darius's Initiations, with Presence +3 and Lore 7.

label: Seclusion
summary: Church Boon for a church in a secluded location, such as a covenant chapel in a shaded glen.

label: Second Crusade
summary: Crusade after the fall of Edessa in 1144 that accomplished little besides the capture of Lisbon.

label: Second Heaven
summary: Location of the Jewish Hell where Moses met the five angels of punishment.

label: Second Life
summary: Folk witch initiation script requiring a cloak from a Beast of Virtue's hide; grants Shapeshifter and Age Quickly.

label: Second Ring of Solomon
summary: Grants 100 experience points in Theology and +3 Intelligence; recited in Winter.

label: Second Sight
summary: A supernatural Ability for seeing through illusions and the supernatural; True Sight Criamon magi may use Enigmatic Wisdom as if it were Second Sight, and spectral travelers can be seen by it.

label: Second Working
summary: Scroll inscription in a strange language and mystical ink that can be cast and provides Insight.

label: Secondary Insight
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue making magical study versatile, granting bonus experience in several Forms when studying a Technique, and in Techniques when studying a Form.

label: Secret Hiding Place
summary: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Secret Hiding Place).

label: Secret Master
summary: Sole Green Cockerel Initiate to have completed the Great Work, never seen by members; gender disputed.

label: Secret Masters
summary: Conspiracy that Children of Hermes claim controls the Order.

label: Secret Name
summary: A Bjornaer Minor House Mystery that severs and reforges a magus's sympathetic name, expiring all old Arcane Connections and invalidating all Sympathetic Connections against him.

label: Secret Runes
summary: Minor Virtue: hide runes.

label: Secret Vis Source
summary: Virtue appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

label: Secretive
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character keeps secrets from his sodales, rarely explaining what he is doing or why.

label: Secular
summary: Worldly as opposed to religious; Hermetic magic is secular because Bonisagus removed invocation of names and powers from the Techniques and Forms.

label: Secular Canons
summary: More lax chapters of canons who may eat meat, wear linen and own property.

label: Secular Clergy
summary: Clergy administering to human society from within it (bishops, priests, deacons).

label: Seculars
summary: Games celebrated every tenth Decennial with extra pomp.

label: Secunda Provincia Lugdunensis
summary: Roman province corresponding to Normandy, whose chief city was Rotomagus.

label: Secundus
summary: Fifth degree of the Fraternity of Samos, rumored to teach Inscription on the Soul, Hermetic Theurgy or Theurgic Spirit Familiar.

label: Secutor
summary: Tremere conciliarius who wins the right to assess the Primus's competency and may challenge the Primus.

label: Seduce the Innocent Heart
summary: Enchantment/Beguile 30 rite filling the target with curiosity and carnal desire until sunrise.

label: See in Darkness
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a character see in complete darkness, though without more acute or longer-range eyesight than normal.

label: See the Paths through the Void
aliases: See the Paths through the Void
summary: InAu 20 spell revealing Auram boundaries and vestiges and allowing passage into the Twilight Void.

label: Seed of Betrayal
summary: A Muto Mentem 15 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that turns a target's emotions toward his masters into contempt, making him readily betray them.

label: Seed of Creo Vis
summary: Seed of vis that grows instantly into a fruit tree.

label: Seeker
summary: A Minor Personality Flaw in which the character is a self-proclaimed member of the Seekers, a loose organization of competitive magi searching for ancient magic and arcane artifacts.

label: Seekers
summary: A loose organization of competitive magi searching for ancient magic and arcane artifacts, detailed in Houses of Hermes: True Lineages.

label: Seelie Court
summary: The nobility of the faerie race, who live in knowes, love mortal music and poetry, ride in rades, and sometimes kidnap mortal musicians.

label: Seelie faeries
summary: Bands of benign faeries of the Lowlands who appreciate talented musicians.

label: Seething Resentment
summary: Bael's Power magnifying resentment into all-consuming hatred.

label: Sefer ha-Bahir
summary: Book of Illumination by Provencal kabbalists; Tractatus on Kabbalah and Ceremony.

label: Sefer ha-Chayyim
summary: Book of Names in which those meriting another year are recorded.

label: Sefer ha-Masa'ot
summary: The Book of Travels; Summa Mediterranean Lore.

label: Sefer ha-Razim
summary: Book of Amulets revealed to Noah by Raziel; tractatus on Craft Amulets, Merkavah, Ceremony and Dominion Lore.

label: Sefer Raziel
summary: Book of sorcery on astral forces; Summae on Gematria, Merkavah, Intervention and Transcendence.

label: Sefer Yetzirah
summary: Foundational kabbalistic text describing creation from numbers, writing and speech, and the ten Sefirot.

label: Seferiel
summary: An angel of the Divine realm (Divine Might 50, Corpus) with special responsibility for Hermetic magi, sometimes drawing them closer to God and sometimes acting as the instrument of God's vengeance. summary: Greatest Eastern theologian (670s-760s), outlined Orthodox Christianity.

summary: Apostle whose apocalyptic revelations close the New Testament; greater saint and patron of Asia Minor, friendship, and writers.

label: St. Maelrubha
summary: Saint associated with Applecross (601).

label: St. Magloire

label: St. Martial
summary: Converter of the Limoges region, buried at the abbey bearing his name.

label: St. Martin of Tours

label: St. Mary's Day
summary: August 15 feast by which the harvest is normally over.

label: St Matthew
summary: Apostle whose lost head-relic at St. Matthew's Point quells storms.

label: St. Matthew's Point
summary: Abbey site.

label: St. Maurice

label: St. Mellon

label: St-Èmilion
summary: Wine town ruled by the Jurade with an underground church.

label: St. Molaug
summary: Saint of the Isle of Lismore (562).

label: St. Mungo

summary: Founder of Hautvillers in 660.

summary: Founder of the Premonstratensian order.

label: St. Patern

label: St. Peter's Basilica
summary: Seat of Dominion power in Rome, aura 5-10.

label: St. Philibert
summary: Founder of the abbey of Jumieges in 634.

label: St. Piat
summary: Converted Tournai.

label: St-Pol-de-Léon
summary: Bishopric.

label: St. Remigius
summary: Bishop of Reims who baptized Clovis; patron saint of Reims, born in Laon.

label: St. Renan
summary: Town.

label: St. Riquier

label: St. Samson
summary: Welsh saint commemorated at Dol, where a cathedral to him is built.

label: St. Symeon
summary: Saint whose site of martyrdom is a possible pilgrimage goal.

label: St Thomas a Becket
summary: Area saint, patron of Canterbury.

summary: A ReMe 40 spell that calls a spirit of wrath to the magus's location via an Arcane Connection or its full name, inflicting a Warping Point on the source of the anger.

label: Summoning the Spirit of Fire
summary: ReIg 40 calls fiery spirit.

label: Sundering of House Tremere
summary: Historical punishment of House Tremere questioned by Children of Hermes.

label: Sundering of Tremere
summary: An event that reduced House Tremere's power, after which Blackthorn's influence in the tribunal was diminished.

label: Sunlight Without Flame
summary: Level 15 variant of Lamp Without Flame.

label: Sunna
summary: Actions and sayings of the Prophet and companions as examples of good behavior.

label: Sunnis
summary: Mainstream Muslims whose doctrines follow al-Ash'ari and al-Maturidi; they recognize the caliph in Baghdad.

label: Superb Scrinium
summary: An enchanted walnut writing desk that copies and binds an entire book in hours.

label: Superior Armaments
summary: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

label: Superior Construction
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Virtue: the lab benefits from distinguished construction techniques or materials (+1 Safety, +1 Aesthetics).

label: Superior Decoration
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is luxuriantly decorated, e.g. with fine tapestries (+1 Upkeep, +2 Aesthetics, +1 Imaginem).

label: Superior Demonic Familiar
summary: Virtue of Lord Goulis.

label: Superior Equipment
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab has higher-quality equipment such as Venetian glassware (+1 General Quality, +2 Upkeep, +1 Safety, +1 Vis Extraction).

label: Superior Heating
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab has superior heating facilities so the occupant is never chilly (+1 Upkeep, +1 Health, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Ignem).

label: Superior Lighting
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is very well lit so things are easy to find and books easy to read (+1 Upkeep, +1 Aesthetics, +1 Texts, +1 Imaginem).

label: Superior Tools
summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab's tools were produced by master craftsmen (+1 Upkeep, +1 Safety, +1 Items).

label: Supernatural Ability
summary: Non-Hermetic magical abilities that many Gifted children possess; they raise the Intellego Vim Lab Total needed to Open the Arts and can be destroyed, kept, or converted into Hermetic Virtues.

label: Supernatural Agility
summary: Personal power allowing minor supernatural feats with the Athletics Pretense.

label: Supernatural Beauty
summary: A Major Supernatural Virtue of mystical beauty that calls royal power, folk magic, and heroism to its defense, letting the player request a fortunate coincidence once per story.

label: Supernatural Horse
summary: Horse of Mythic Europe that may have higher Intelligence than its rider and decides action order.

label: Supernatural Nuisance
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which supernatural entities interfere in the character's life in minor ways, without long-term plans, whenever he is around them.

label: Supple Iron and Rigid Rope
summary: A Muto Terram spell that makes a flexible object stiff or a stiff object flexible, with appropriate Form requisites.

label: Supplies Roll
summary: Roll of Siege Conditions Bonus plus stress die against an Ease Factor based on garrison size and years under siege; failure reduces the castle's supply quality.

label: Suppressed Gift
summary: A Major Hermetic Story Flaw in which the character has The Gift but cannot access its power, temporarily unable to perform Hermetic magic, improve Arts, or use Parma Magica.

label: Suppressing the Wizard's Handiwork
summary: A Rego Vim spell that cancels one of the caster's own active spells for as long as concentration is maintained, with effects returning when concentration breaks.

label: Sura
summary: Babylonian yeshivah city where Saadia Gaon was Gaon.

label: Sure Strike of the Sword
summary: ReCo 20 spell of Edwin's granting +2 weapon skill.

label: Sure Traveler
summary: Minor Heroic Virtue: never lost on known routes and unhindered by travel conditions.

label: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew
aliases: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew
summary: Meditation Transcendence effect (Level 30) letting the caster pass through nonliving obstacles.

label: Surface Form
summary: Inherited Atlantean Virtue, a version of Skinchanger.

label: Surgical Empiricus
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw for a chirurgeon trained in only a single aspect of Chirurgy, granting the usual +1 to that surgery but halving Chirurgy for any other application.

label: Surrey
summary: English region of Sir Jehan's claimed origin.

label: Sursum
summary: Covenant founded in 875 on the north coast of Cornwall, destroyed during Athelstan's campaigns in 931 amid evidence of Tytalus diabolism.

label: Survival
summary: A General Ability covering finding food, water, shelter, routes, and safety in the wilderness, including building fires and cooking without implements.

label: Suryal
summary: One of the five archangels who refused the sinning Watchers readmission to Heaven.

label: Susanna
summary: The liberal-minded mater of Petrus Virilis, who researched fertility and the Gift and has since entered Final Twilight.

label: Susannah
summary: Carmine's Flambeau parens.

label: Susceptibility to Faerie Power
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character is especially susceptible to the fay, becoming disoriented in Faerie auras and having Magic Resistance halved against faerie effects.

label: Susceptibility to Infernal Power
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character is especially vulnerable to dark powers, risking illness in Infernal auras and having halved Magic Resistance against infernal effects.

label: Susceptibility to Magic
summary: A Minor Curse (Rego Vim effect) that strips a victim's natural resistance to magic, imposing a -3 to resist spells and supernatural effects.

label: Susceptibility to Sunlight
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which direct bright sunlight causes the character pain and exhaustion, giving -2 to sight rolls in bright environments and Fatigue loss outdoors.

label: Susceptibility to Warping
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character gains an additional Warping Point from each Realm whenever he gains one in a year, without contributing to Twilight.

label: Susceptible to Deprivation
summary: Minor Supernatural Flaw: the faerie suffers human consequences without air, food and water.

label: Susceptible to Divine Power
summary: Flaw appearing in character statistics or rules in this text.

label: Susceptible to Infernal Power
summary: Flaw.

label: Suspirium
summary: A ninth-century Bjornaer magus, the most recent common ancestor of Stellatus and Lacerta, after whom their sept was renamed.

label: Sustain a Spell of Fire
summary: Example ReVi(Ig) container ritual.

label: Sustain a Spell of (Form)
summary: ReVi General Ritual binding a spell to a container.

label: Sut
summary: Son of Iblis with dominion over lies.

label: Sutherland
summary: Remote region where isolated clans speak Gaelic with Pictish elements.

label: Svantovit
summary: A four-faced Slavic sun- and war-god worshipped at Arkona, whose Faerie aura lingers despite the temple's destruction; opposed to the Queen of Winter, granting Falke's ritual a bonus.

label: Sven Svennson
summary: Powerful Norwegian duke, uncle of Eirik Svennson, who placed soldiers and builders under his authority.

label: Svetlana
summary: Maga making late-night journeys to Gallows Wood, supposedly harvesting vis.

label: Swabia
summary: The duchy surrounding the Black Forest, extending to Bavaria and the Alps, whose recent history is dominated by the rival Zähringen and Hohenstaufen families.

label: Swallow Assault
summary: Baal-Peor's Power to swallow mundane attacks harmlessly.

label: Swallowed Alive and Sent to Hell
aliases: Swallowed Alive and Sent to Hell
summary: Saint curse opening a chasm that drops the target into Hell.

label: Swan Clan
summary: The smallest Crintera clan, comprising crafts-folk and companions with non-shapechanging magical powers; led by Janis, contact with the pagan Forest Brothers of Rügen.

label: Swan Maidens
summary: Faerie beings featuring in stories of the Faerie Realm.

label: Swanmaiden
summary: Close cousins of the selkies who can be trapped by mortal men as brides.

label: Sway the Hearts of Man
summary: Principality power inculcating a temper in many minds under a Divine aura.

label: Sweated Shillings
summary: The shifting gaggle of young magi living with Mathieus, named after clipped coins.

label: Sweeping Prohibition
summary: The broadest geas prohibition (+4 magnitudes, like Year Duration) or the easiest-to-lift limit on a blessing or curse (+1 magnitude).

label: Swift Assarting
summary: Story seed about brigands claiming to be former assarting workers of a covenant that actually assarted magically.

label: Swift Knives, Invisible
summary: A Perdo Animal 40 spell with Rego requisite that reduces a dead animal to its components, such as wool, hide, meat, organs, and skeleton.

label: Swift Wings of Timeless Days
summary: ReVi 20 spell reducing the caster's Twilight Void journey by three steps.

label: Swim
summary: A General Ability for propelling oneself through water quickly and efficiently, with specialties in long distances, diving, and underwater maneuvering.

label: Swimming
summary: Ability for swamp swimming.

label: Swiss Gateway Lake
summary: A lake in Switzerland said to have a gateway to Hell, actually created by a magical battle after the fall of the Western Empire.

label: Sword from the Unseen Scabbard
summary: A CrTe 15 spell that conjures a steel longsword lasting about two minutes; it must penetrate Magic Resistance to harm magic-resistant opponents.

label: Sword of Bruncvik
summary: The legendary sword that St. Wenceslaus is foretold to take up when he rises from the dead to lead his army.

label: Sword of Moses
summary: Theurgic book naming angels and demons; Summa Infernal Lore and insight into Canaanite Necromancy.

label: Sword of Tytalus
summary: Legendary Hermetic heirloom said possessed by Rothelin.

label: Swordbrethren
summary: German crusading order being absorbed by the Teutonic Knights.

label: Swords of Silver and Moonlight
summary: Muto Mentem level 40 spell (Terram requisite) making a ghost's metal accouterments solid so it can use its entire kit.

label: Swordsmiths' Guild
summary: The craftsmen's guild of swordsmiths; Klaus the example craftsman is a master of it.

label: Syagrius
summary: Roman king from whom Clovis took the Oriflamme at Soissons.

label: Sylvan Sanctity
summary: Boar King power revealing the location and number of human intruders in his forest.

label: Sylvester of Assisi
summary: Founder member of the Franciscans, a priest and cousin of Clare, who dreamt of a cross from Francis' mouth putting a dragon to flight.

label: Sylvester of Sées
summary: Bishop of Sées elected 1201, formerly archdeacon; historically dies in 1220.

label: Symbol (Faerie Parameter)
summary: Faerie Range, Duration, and Target using a symbol of the target, each requiring 3 points of applicable Sympathy Traits.

label: Symbolic Interpretation
summary: Non-magical interpretation of dreams' symbolic meaning rolled with Intelligence + Divination (Dream Interpretation).

label: Symbolic Magic
summary: A Major Folk Mystery (Virtue) encompassing laboratory activities with charms and symbols, allowing charms in invested devices and talismans and new Symbol Range, Duration, and Target for ritual spells.

label: Sympathetic Connection
summary: A magical relationship drawn from symbolic correspondences, used in charms and Synthemata Magic; severed and invalidated against a magus by the Secret Name Mystery.

label: Sympathetic magic
summary: Magic using connections and multipliers; Euclid's postulates provide it via Geometry.

label: Sympathy
summary: A combined natural principle of affinity and similarity through which objects resonate, e.g. a bloodstone resonating with wounds; basis of many Shape and Material bonuses.

label: Symphony Of The Harmony Of Celestial Revelations
aliases: Symphony Of The Harmony Of Celestial Revelations
summary: Hildegard's collection of music, a tractatus on Artes Liberales.

label: Synagogue
summary: Gathering place for Rabbinical Jews to hear Torah readings.

label: Synesius
summary: Stated that Pseudo-Democritus' work was in four books.

label: Synod
summary: Meeting of clergy convoked by deans, archdeacons, bishops or archbishops.

label: Synod of Ancyra
summary: Church synod whose material fed a penitential punishing those who practice auguries and pagan divination.

label: Synod of Whitby
summary: 664 council declaring only the Roman Church should hold sway in the British Isles.

label: Synthemata
summary: Signs, symbols, or passwords that link a magician to a supernatural creature, used in theurgic incantations; any being with a Might score has them.

label: Synthemata Magia
summary: Major Supernatural Mystery Ability, the non-Hermetic predecessor of Hermetic Synthemata, letting a magus intuit a being's synthemata using (Realm) Lore.

label: Synthemata Magic
summary: A Mystery whose practitioners, knowing a magus's secret name, gain an advantage when casting spells against him.

label: Synthemata of (X)
summary: MuVi Mystery spell unique to one named being, adding its level to the caster's Penetration for the next spell against that being.

label: Syria
summary: Where Francis met crusaders and Elias led the Friars Minor in 1219.

label: Szarlen
summary: A demon who operates a lead mine for the Polish town of Beuthen in return for services such as appropriating the Church's tithe or requiring worship.

label: Szekeley
summary: Hungarian mounted archers.

label: Tabanus
summary: A Quaesitor of House Guernicus, trained at Magvillus, sent to police the Rhine; a strict, meddlesome peregrinator who recently occupied a sanctum at Triamore.

label: Tablets of the Testimony
summary: Tablets Moses carried down from Mount Sinai.

label: Tablinum
summary: A storehouse of information and artefacts in the Transylvanian Tribunal under the control of House Tremere, existing across numerous regiones entered only via spells requiring Arcane Connections held by its curator.

label: Taboo
summary: Rules within a faerie's glamour forbidding or requiring actions; humans breaking them owe redress. Detailed as Flaws.

label: Tabula Geographica Magica
summary: The Gazetteer of Magic, a catalogue of magical sites and regiones kept at the Great Library of Durenmar in Trianoma's Cipher.

label: Tacitus
summary: Roman author of the Germania, listed as a period source on the Germanic lands.

label: Tackle
summary: Maneuver causing attacker and opponent to fall prone.

label: Tactical Movement
summary: Rules for walk, hurry and run movement rates on the battlefield.

label: Tadhkirat al-Awliya'
summary: Biographies of Muslim mystics by Farid al-Din 'Attar, with altered sources.

label: Tafl
summary: Popular Norse board game of defending a king.

label: Tagelyn
summary: A covenant that, with Blackthorn, excavated caves in the Black Mountains over two centuries; its magi were driven out by Blackthorn and founded Ashenrise in Hibernia.

label: Tainted Characters
summary: People whose conception or upbringing demons meddled with, making them tools for Infernal schemes.

label: Tainted Offspring
summary: A Major Story Tainted Flaw in which the character has a child marked for great but unpleasant things by a powerful demon, requiring struggle against the demon's servants.

label: Tainted Treasure
summary: A Minor General Tainted Virtue: the character has inherited or acquired vast cursed treasure that brings harm and only allows itself to be spent sinfully.

label: Tainted Virtues and Flaws
summary: A category of Virtues and Flaws associated with the Infernal realm, gained through demonic corruption; Supernatural abilities they grant are always Infernal powers.

label: Tainted with Evil
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which an air of corruption surrounds the character, making others ill at ease and making positive Reputation impossible.

label: Take
summary: Gruagach Technique for removing things from a target, covering nearly every Hermetic Technique.

label: Taking the Cross
summary: Committing to a crusade in exchange for a free indulgence and a temporary Faith Point.

label: Taking the Cure
summary: Rules for spa treatment relieving minor physical afflictions for three years.

label: Taklamakan Desert
summary: A desert where Infernal storm spirits such as the Buran of Yenghissar are likely to be found.

label: Tales of Power
summary: Ars Magica supplement containing the Encroaching Dominion scenario.

label: Tales of the Ashes
summary: An Intellego Ignem spell (Level 5) that lets the caster see what touched ashes originally were and how and when the object was burned.

label: Talhaearn Tad Awen
summary: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

label: Taliesin
summary: One of the five great Welsh poets believed by the Order to have left Daimons behind after death.

label: Talion of Flambeau
summary: An ancient Flambeau magus, second oldest in the tribunal, who became praeco after Immanola was disqualified; renowned for mastery of Perdo.

label: Talisman
summary: Falke's talisman, a silver anklet-ring of watery crystal and amber attuned for +5 water effects and +3 Corpus, enchanted with Perceive the Change, Change Size, and Perceive Motives effects.

label: Talking bears of Berne
summary: Bears of Berne folklore led by a talking bear who saved a prince.

label: Tallage
summary: A lord's levy on his peasants, described in Chapter Six: Manorial Fiefs; lords demanded heavy tallage to fund crusades.

label: Talmud
summary: Book of interpretations of Halakha and cultural wisdom; a Summa on Judaic Lore, Theology: Judaism and Rabbinic Law.

label: Talon of Criamon
summary: Member of Sansaron.

label: Talons of the Wind
summary: MuAu 20 Potent spell, Potency 8, fan made from ship's sail.

label: Talons of the Winds
summary: A Muto Auram spell (Level 20) that transforms a wind into an abrasive medium that tears at everything in its path, inflicting +4 damage from cuts; requires an existing breeze.

label: Talos
summary: A bull-headed bronze statue (automaton) made by Hephaestus that guarded Crete.

label: Taltos
summary: Wizards among the Magyar people of Hungary who use herbcraft to boost their physical characteristics and martial skills and to heal; many have Skinchanger; a Pharmocopoeian variant.

label: Talus of House Merinita
summary: Prankster magus slain by Gravis after changing his voice with a spell.

label: Tame Nobleman
summary: Covenant Boon: a nobleman fronts for the covenant's rule over its lands.

label: Tamed Magic
summary: Major Hermetic Virtue granting Harnessed and Tethered Magic without drawbacks, usable with spontaneous spells; requires Mutantum Magic.

label: Tamgor of Quaesitor
summary: Quaesitor who journeyed through the Roman Tribunal's covenants to gather information ahead of Jarane's triad, recording his findings in a journal.

label: Taming
summary: Seasonal activity accumulating points against a creature's Might to tame it.

label: Taming Creatures
summary: Seasonal activity accumulating Intelligence + Animal Handling points to tame an animal.

label: Tanaiste
summary: Heir-designate of a Highland clan chief, held by Raibert Mac Donncadh.

label: Tanakh
summary: The Hebrew Bible, comprising Torah, Nevi'im and Ketuvim.

label: Tandaline
summary: A Follower of Bonisagus of Trianoma's lineage, a master of Muto and Auram, closest confidante of Murion and a Tenens Occultorum who maintains the House's correspondence.

label: Tangential Magi
summary: Criamon magi who have faded peacefully into Final Twilight and dwell in the Hypostasis outside time, sending visions through the Axis to their mortal successors.

label: Tangle of Wood and Thorns
summary: A Rego Herbam (ReHe 15) indirect spell that immobilizes a magus with wood without touching him, completely effective in bypassing Magic Resistance.

label: Tannhäuser
summary: A young 13th-century knight and poet of legend who discovered Venus's subterranean home, the Venusberg, and later sought absolution from the Pope.

label: Tapestry of Mythic Europe
summary: Huge tapestry in Verdi's tower that tracks a person via an Arcane Connection and Imágonem vis.

label: Tarantism
summary: A condition that works wholly differently from a disease, stemming from a faerie curse.

label: Targe
summary: Typical Highland shield of two layered planks covered in studded leather, often with a boss spike.

label: Target: Group
summary: Hermetic target of a continuous group of up to ten individuals, raised to 100 with one magnitude to affect a separated unit.

label: Tarith
summary: Ex Miscellanea member of Vardian's Tomb.

label: Tarlan the Wolf
summary: A faerie wolf (Might 20, Animal) that exists to hunt people, marking them as quarry and harrying them to exhaustion; he cannot enter holy ground and never hunts children or the Gifted.

label: Tarnished Aura
summary: An Infernal aura bearing a resonance for a particular sin, represented as a sinful Personality Trait affecting all within it.

label: Tarnkappe
summary: A magical cloak of darkness taken by Siegfried from the dwarf Alberich, used to render him invisible and substitute for Gunther in the contests with Brünhild.

label: Tarragona
summary: Spanish archdiocese.

label: Tarsus
summary: Home of Paul, near the Lake Acherusia regio.

label: Tartaran Regiones
summary: Infernal regio reflecting the torment of Hell, filled with fuel-less hellfire whose damage increases with the victim's sinful traits.

label: Tartarus
summary: Scriptural term for Hell as a place of hell-fire and brimstone and eternal torment; named after the Vale of Hinnom.

label: Tartessos
summary: An ancient rich port at the edge of the world whose faerie gods may rouse when a new rich port is built.

label: Tarus of Bonisagus
summary: Author of Politics of the Order, musing on the Arch-Magi.

label: Tasgillia
summary: The fourth Prima of House Tytalus, despised for her selfish nature and puissant in spirit magic; she was executed for diabolism in 961 AD after summoning demons using Guorna's lore.

label: Task-Setter
summary: Dramatic role that poses challenges for the hero to pass to win the princess, distinct from donor and villain.

label: Taste of the Dulled Tongue
summary: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 5) that hides the taste of any substance, liquid or solid.

label: Taste of the Spices and Herbs
aliases: Taste of the Spices and Herbs
summary: A Muto Imaginem spell (Level 5) that makes a setting's worth of food or drink taste and smell exactly as the caster designates.

label: Tattoo Magic
summary: Gruagach tattoo-based magic not practiced by trollsynir or kolduni.

label: Tattoo Mastery
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue reducing vis cost of gruagach tattoos by Pictish score.

label: Tatzelwurm
summary: An Alpine dragon two to six feet long with a catlike head, lizard body without hind legs, and toxic breath.

label: Tatzelwurmli
summary: Monstrous limbless land dragon in the Aare Gorge whose lair no covenant can harvest.

label: Tavant
summary: Village with a painted church, the only remnant of the covenant of Sinapis.

label: Tavistock Abbey
summary: Abbey in Devon that owns the Scilly Isles and founded a monastic community at Tresco.

label: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies
aliases: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies
summary: Meditation Understanding effect (Level 15) giving a Common Sense-like vision.

label: Teaching
summary: An Ability that adds to the Source Quality when a character teaches; the maximum number of students equals the teacher's Teaching score times five.

label: Teaching Source Quality
summary: Communication + Teaching + 3 + bonuses; compared to a Target Level when teaching a Hermetic Virtue.

label: Tear of Christ
summary: Relic with Faith score 3 donated to the Abbey of the Trinity.

label: Tears of a Rhinoceros
summary: Rare item that Raisa retrieved from dreams to defeat the faerie drake attacking her covenant.

label: Tears of Sandalphon
summary: Two powerful divine relics, tears shed by Sandalphon at the death of Muhammad, sought by an angel and by a diabolical coven wishing to use them as arcane connections.

label: Teasels of Somerset Levels
summary: Vis of the Poisoned Battlefield.

label: Teeth of the Earth Mother
summary: A Muto Terram spell that springs twenty sharp white marble pillars from the ground in a circle, able to cage, wall, or skewer enemies for +25 damage.

label: Tefillin
summary: Leather boxes containing the Shema; those owned by a Tzadik Nistar act as a relic.

label: Teind
summary: Tithe of one mortal soul every seven years a Spirit of Deceit convinced a faerie court it owes Hell.

label: Telechines
summary: A small group of titans, wizards and smiths who fought for the Olympians, made Cronus' sickle and Poseidon's trident, then created a deadly poison.

label: Teletarch
summary: Master of Perfection: powerful Daimon embodying a concept or phenomenon.

label: Tell of the Forged
summary: InTe 45 spell like Stone Tell of the Mind that Sits but usable on metal objects.

label: Tello
summary: The Bishop of Palencia who works with the king to stabilize the university, allowing the masters an advisory council under the chancellor.

label: Telramund
summary: A rebellious vassal of the late duke of Brabant who sought the dukedom and Elsa's hand and was defeated by Lohengrin in single combat.

label: Temenos of Dindyméné
summary: A sacred grove atop Mount Dindymon ringed by oaks and chestnuts, with a Magic aura of 3, leading to both a Faerie and a Magic regio.

label: Tempelburg
summary: Future Templar site in Prussia.

label: Temper
summary: A particular aspect of the divine invoked into a Dominion aura as a Personality Trait, aiding compatible acts and hindering opposed ones.

label: Temperament
summary: Dominant temperament of animals and people (choleric, melancholic, phlegmatic, sanguine) linked to elements.

label: Temperance
summary: Moral (Cardinal) virtue that moderates inappropriate desire; chosen by Arshaq ibn Kareem in the Divine Unity example.

label: Temperate
summary: Flaw typical of Ikhwan as-Safa' or Tulab Ibn Sina members owing to their devotion.

label: Tempering an Aura
summary: Divine rule similar to Care of Souls.

label: Tempest of Needles
summary: Group version of Shower of Needles known by Ragoneda.

label: Tempestaria
summary: A tradition of Saxon-associated weather witches within House Ex Miscellanea who summon rain, fog, and especially wind beyond Hermetic capacity, using sympathetic tools.

label: Templar Administrator
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a brother of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon who administers the order's holdings rather than fighting; available only to male characters.

label: Templar Ciphers
summary: Encryption ledgers protecting Templar communications, kept secretly in provincial commanderies.

label: Templar Commander
summary: A Major Social Status Virtue for a commander of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon with authority over a province or preceptory, also granting Temporal Influence.

label: Templar Confrere
summary: New Templar Virtue for lay associates of the Templars.

label: Templar Confrere or Consoeur
summary: A Free Social Status Virtue for an associate member of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon who has taken one or two Templar vows.

label: Templar Office Holder
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character holding a position in the local hierarchy of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon, such as deputy commander or marshal.

label: Templar Prestige
summary: A Minor General Virtue: a member of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon who enjoys great respect among fellow brothers, starting with a Reputation of level 4 within the Templars.

label: Templar Prisons
summary: Secret Templar prisons across Mythic Europe.

label: Templar Rule
summary: The strict rule governing Templar organization, hierarchy, penances and tactics, in seven sections.

label: Templar Servant
summary: A Free Social Status Virtue for a servant working at a Templar commandery, supported and protected by the order's papal bull.

label: Templar Sign Language
summary: Limited hand signal language of the Templars.

label: Templar Specialist
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a skilled employee of the Poor Knights of the Temple of Solomon filling a crucial role such as craftsman or translator.

label: Templar Treasury
summary: The fabulously wealthy Templar temple in Paris operating as an early bank.

label: Temple in Jerusalem
summary: The Temple built by Solomon, destroyed in 587 BC, rebuilt as the Second Temple and destroyed by the Romans.

label: Temple of Apollo in London
summary: Lost temple in New Troy (London), founded by the Hyperboreans, where Bladud fell to his death and is buried.

label: Temple of Isis
summary: An abandoned but well-repaired Roman temple within a magical regio in Florence's Piazza San Firenze, a potential covenant site holding relics of the Cults of Isis and Mercury.

label: Temple of Jupiter
summary: Ruined temple at Montjoux, repeatedly ransacked during the barbarian invasions, which the maga Lucia sought.

label: Temple of Jupiter Ammon
summary: Lost temple in Cyrene in the Libyan desert, source of true Sal Ammoniac.

label: Temple of Nodens
summary: Temple in the Stonehenge Tribunal near which Cara was born, bearing rough drawings of piests.

label: Temple of Solomon
summary: Site on Temple Mount granted to the first Templars, source of their name.

label: Temple of the Hesperides
summary: Temple where the Dragon slept.

label: Templeštejn
summary: Future Templar preceptory in Moravia.

label: Temporal Influence
summary: A minor general Virtue granting influence in mundane government or institutions; raises an agent's Resistance Strength, as with the merchant Godfroi.

label: Temporary Magical Might
summary: Quality whereby wounds reduce the elemental's Might pool.

label: Temporary Might
summary: Magic Inferiority always possessed by Magic Things: spent Might recovers slowly and injury separates Might as vis.

label: Tempter
summary: A kind of demon busy in nunneries, using those without real vocation to spread sin.

label: Tempters
summary: Ninth and largest demonic order, evil spirits propagating sins of incontinence, the rank-and-file of Hell; Might up to 20.

label: Tempus
summary: In the Pages of History theory, a location in the Magic Realm that is a specific moment in history.

label: Ten Commandments
summary: Stone tablets received by Moses at Sinai.

label: Tenants-in-Chief
summary: Powerful families holding land directly from the king of England in exchange for military service, forming England's upper nobility.

label: Tenens Occultorum
summary: A House Bonisagus office held by Tandaline, appointed by Murion, involving keeping written contact across the House.

label: Tenentes Occultorum
summary: Inner Circle of four magi Trianomae ('Tenders of Secret Lore'), named for the seasons, who keep Hermetic secrets from mundanes.

label: Tentare
summary: Scribe of Harco.

label: Terafim
summary: Small pottery figurines used in divination and witchcraft, giving +5 to Understanding or Cursing amulet effects.

label: Terce
summary: Canonical hour of the Divine Office: Morning service at 9 am, followed by the chapter meeting.

label: Terentia
summary: A powerful demon of rage and war whose diabolist followers slew Regulus with an infernal artifact.

label: Tereus
summary: King of the birds of Nephelococcygia, an epops who nests atop a thousand-foot spire said to hold records of prayers.

label: Terious of Flambeau
summary: A magus of House Flambeau who walked the Path of Energy, became a living embodiment of the genius locus, and contributed the spell Replenishing the Fount of the Magus to the Great Library.

label: Terith of Jerbiton
summary: Jerbiton researcher who seeks evidence of a diabolic pact tainting Italy and theorizes the Mercurians turned to diabolism.

label: Terra Nullius
summary: An area of another realm home to no conscious thing, which faeries sense and may enter freely.

label: Terrae Cult
summary: Terram-focused cult tradition within House Guernicus, possibly colonizers of Confluensis.

label: Terrae-magi
summary: A small earth-wizard lineage descended from a Mercurian priest, knowing spells of earth and metal conjuring; Guernicus was its last member.

label: Terrain Bonus
summary: +6 bonus to a native prey's Evasion Total, reduced by the relay and hunters.

label: Terram
summary: Form governing earth and solid inanimate materials.

label: Terram Magic
summary: Earth magic cast spontaneously by trow; disliked by Am Balla.

label: Terram province
summary: The Terram-aligned province of the Twilight Void: precious gems and metals shine like the sun; buried treasure is easily spotted.

label: Terrar
summary: A monastery's land agent responsible for estates, tithes and accounts.

label: Terrestrial Demons
summary: Demons who never knew Heaven: infernal ghosts or progeny of demons, including the Nephilim.

label: Terret
summary: Ring on a jess slipped over a perch or finger.

label: Terrify the Unbeliever
summary: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

label: Terrifying Howl of the Wolf
summary: Power of the interloping wolves whose howl overcomes hearers with fear.

label: Terrifying Roar
summary: Lion of Virtue roar freezing hearers in terror.

label: Territorial Advantage
summary: Difference between the two sides' Deployment Totals, added to Event Totals; magic affecting terrain adds its magnitude.

label: Terror of the Charging Boar
summary: Power of the Wild Boar of the Woods that overwhelms anything he charges with mortal fear.

label: Terschelling (island)
summary: A Friesian island on a deserted coastline that is home to the Waddenzee covenant and thousands of seabirds.

label: Tertiaries
summary: Laymen following the Franciscan lifestyle without clerical vows, living with their families, under a rule of 1221.

label: Tertius
summary: Fourth degree of the Fraternity of Samos dealing with metempsychosis and geometric solids, initiating Hermetic Architecture.

label: Tertius Quid
summary: A forest where the Old Ones are said to sleep.

label: Tertullian
summary: Quoted authority on initiation rites.

label: Test of Faith
summary: An ordeal that can raise a character's Faith Score, such as a year spent on the Bush.

label: Test of Fastness and Fading
summary: An Intellego Aquam 5 spell that confirms the quality of a container of ink, dye, or paint, verifying it will not fade, flake, or eat through parchment.

label: Test of the Boiling Water
summary: Ordeal of removing a stone from a boiling cauldron.

label: Test of the Cold Water
summary: Most common ordeal: the accused is thrown into water and floats if innocent.

label: Test of the Flames
summary: A CrIg 15 spell filling a circle with waist-high flames doing +5 damage per round; of ancient Cult of Mithras origin, once used by Flambeau magi as an endurance test alternative to certamen.

label: Testament of Solomon
summary: Text listing the names of the 36 decani and the angels designated to counter them.

label: Testimony of Testimony
summary: Written testimony read out by a principle at Tribunal on behalf of an absent witness.

label: Tests of Faith
summary: Trials or ordeals by which God assesses a follower's devotion, often suspending Faith Points or Holy Virtues until fulfilled.

label: Tether
summary: An object or circumstance of magical significance that attracts fluid vis to pool around it, forming the basis and center of a Magic aura.

label: Tether Strength
summary: Value tied to spirit Might used in the Formation of Magic Auras.

label: Tethered Casting
summary: Mutantes mastery ability passing control of a spell to another person or object.

label: Tethered Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus pass control of non-Ritual spells to others or tether them to objects, at the cost that all his spells become Arcane Connections to him.

label: Tethering
summary: Mutantum technique passing control of a spell to another or to an object.

label: Tethys
summary: Titaness who is the power of the waters under the earth.

label: Tetrabiblos
summary: Ptolemy's astrology text, translated 1138.

label: Teutonic Knights
aliases: Order of the Teutonic Knights of Saint Mary
summary: German crusading order formed around 1198 from the German hospital of Saint Mary, famed for strict discipline and turning toward the pagan lands of Eastern Europe.

label: Teviot
summary: River north of which Lord Goulis rarely hunts.

label: Thabit ibn Qurra
summary: Arabic writer (836-901) of a formula to rid a place of scorpions.

label: Thales of Miletus
summary: Greek sage whose ghost haunts Kyzikos.

label: Thamik of Verditius
summary: A young Verditius magus among the members recruited to Nigrasaxa.

label: Thamus Collis
summary: Bonisagus Primus during the Schism War who abdicated.

label: Thamyris
summary: Blind bard after whom amber-eyed children in Transylvania are often named.

label: Thanatoi
summary: Leti of peaceful death, led by Thanatos.

label: Thanatos
summary: Leader of the Thanatoi.

label: Thann Chapel
summary: A chapel west of Mulhouse in the southern Vosges, built over a miraculous holy staff containing the ring and thumb of Theobald of Gubbio; has a Divine aura of 3 and is a place of pilgrimage.

label: Thaphaboath
summary: A mazzik (Tempter) with the head and hindquarters of a bear, typically drafted as 'muscle' for more powerful demons.

label: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption
aliases: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption
summary: Meditation Intervention effect (Level 25) letting the caster perceive the stain of sin on people.

label: Thaumaturgical Transformation of Plants to Iron
aliases: Thaumaturgical Transformation of Plants to Iron
summary: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 20) with a Terram requisite that makes any plant as hard as iron, up to the size of a small tree.

label: The Abandoned Corpse
summary: Premnemosyne's Power to leave a fake corpse behind.

label: The Abandoned Shrine
summary: Scenery story element: a standing stone carved with glyphs where a slumbering god can be woken by innocent blood.

label: The Ague
summary: A Major Phlegmatic Disease (Severity 14) caused by bad air around sewage and tanneries, marked by continuous fever with chills.

label: The Alder Prince
summary: The compassionate, secretive faerie ruler of the western Alder Forest among the Courts of the Seasons, strongest in spring, who woos and is repeatedly entrapped by the Willow Maiden.

label: The Ambulatory Laboratory
summary: A Rego Terram 30 spell that transports a chamber's movable contents to another room via Arcane Connection, used by magi to move their labs without mundane effort.

label: The Ancient Wall
summary: Example Eudokian story element doubling as Guardian of the Threshold, which must be climbed properly.

label: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them
aliases: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them
summary: Purity Adjuration effect (Level 25) making non-divine beings perceive the character surrounded by holiness; demons must flee.

label: The Animal Powers
summary: Ancient mysterious entities that ruled the Stubnitz region before the Bjornaer; revered at Crintera as animal-shaped fetishes said to house primordial spirits of nature.

label: The Animal's Tongue
summary: Dindyméné's ritual power granting the Animal Ken Virtue.

label: The Annals of Mercury
summary: Book recording the temple's history, ending 'We thought that we would go on forever.'

label: The Antigones
summary: A new generation of interventionist Jerbiton magi ('those like their ancestors'), trained after the fall of Constantinople, who favor political engagement, aggression, and large House covenants.

label: The Apple of the Kyffhauser
summary: A magic spirit (Magic Might 70) manifesting as a withered apple tree at the base of the Kyffhauser, guarded by men-at-arms, that grants victory and lordship to whoever hangs their shield on it.

label: The Apple That Etches
summary: A Creo Herbam 20 ritual that creates 100,000 oak galls used for ink, useful to covenants closed off from the mortal world with abundant Herbam vis.

label: The Application of Vim to the Supernatural Humors
aliases: The Application of Vim to the Supernatural Humors
summary: Diatribe tractatus on Magic Theory by Conciatta of Bonisagus opposing research of new Arts for each supernatural realm.

label: The Apprentice's Delight
summary: CrHe 3 cantation that creates a ripe apple lasting two minutes, sweet but not nourishing.

label: The Appropriate Attire
summary: MuAn 4 cantation that changes the color and cut of leather, wool or fur clothing, giving +1 to Etiquette or Charm.

label: The Aqueduct Spring
summary: A distant mountain spring feeding the aqueduct; an Aquam vis source yielding vis in the first gallon at dawn of the Summer Solstice.

label: The Arcane Tool
summary: Summa on Vim by Vries van Breinermoor of Tremere, Quality 9 Level 6.

label: The Archpoet
summary: An anonymous bawdy twelfth-century Latin poet and famed leader of the Goliardic tradition, rumored to have been a magus, whose poems a Bonisagus magus claims encode Mentem lore.

label: The Art of Magic
summary: Bonisagus's epitome concerning Magic Theory, etched by later magi into 36 six-foot clear crystals at the Forest of Shining Stone, Durenmar.

label: The Ash of Nortorf
summary: An infernal entity (Infernal Might 15, potential 60) manifesting as an ash seedling in the churchyard of Nortorf; prophesied to grow into a tree that will bring a king with fell powers if a black horseman defeats the white horseman.

label: The Assembly
summary: Hunt breakfast where huntsmen present droppings and the prey is chosen.

label: The Auberge
summary: A long-forgotten Mercere way station on a river island, accessible only through a Roman ruin's doorway into a Magical regio; its three spirit guardians give departing magi food containing Vim vis.

label: The Avariciousness of the Ptolemies
summary: A Rego Animal 4 ward that prevents those lacking Magic Resistance from removing a book across an inscribed circle or doorway.

label: The Babble Within Thought
summary: Summa on Mentem by Hicuccus of Criamon owned by the Tribunal.

label: The Baltic Sea
summary: The sea across which Baltic trade ceases each winter when the Queen of Winter freezes it; a ritual at Arkona must be performed to thaw the ice.

label: The Bears' Cave
summary: A hidden primeval cave in the northern Harz (Magic aura 3) strewn with ancient bear bones that may be harvested for Animal vis; secret vis source of a Bjornaer bear lineage.

label: The Beast
summary: The Beast from Beauty and the Beast, initially a threat, then needing help, then giving rewards.

label: The Beast Remade
summary: A Muto Animal spell (Level 25) with a Corpus requisite that gives a land beast a human form while retaining its intellect and some animal feature.

label: The Betrayal
summary: The event in 961 AD when Kalliste exposed Tasgillia's diabolism publicly, shaming House Tytalus; Tytali view it as Kalliste betraying the Founder's principle of putting nature before custom.

label: The Bible
summary: Christian Scriptures of Old and New Testaments; a Summa on Theology (Level 10, Quality 3) and Church Lore (Level 3, Quality 3).

label: The Birds
summary: Play by Aristophanes, a tractatus of Quality 5 in Magic Lore, describing Nephelococcygia as intercepting communications between earth and heaven.

label: The Bishop's Mistress
summary: Folk story of a priest's hearth mate who shamed a bishop; in the story seed a bishop finds everyone believes he has a mistress and a nursery is filling his home.

label: The Black Fir
summary: A sinister magical fir tree near Durenmar's Great Library, key to a faerie revenge plot; it slowly inches toward the Tower of Bonisagus as part of the King of the Black Mountain's scheme.

label: The Black Horse of Busha
summary: A proud black stallion seen as a figure in black shale in the Howgill Fells, said to travel the mundane world under cover of storms with purposes that bode no good.

label: The Blacks
summary: Radical Guelph faction of Florence that blackmails magi into service.

label: The Blinded Sentry
summary: A Perdo Mentem 5 spell invented by Imanitos Mendax that renders a target insensate for a moment, registering only the initial touch.

label: The Bloodcaps
summary: Societas Merceris lineage descended from a Mercere adoptee's daughter and a violent border faerie; they dye their caps in blood.

label: The Bohemian Forest
summary: A massive forest, safe from man due to harsh climate and peat bogs, haunt of lynx, wolves, deer, and giants; home to Irencillia and (in its south) Fenistal.

label: The Book of Beasts
summary: InAn 10 book whose pages are Arcane Connections to beasts.

label: The Book of Four Masters
summary: Chronicle recording a 160-foot mermaid corpse washed ashore in AD 887.

label: The Book of God's Way
summary: Elizabeth's summa on Church Lore warning against sins.

label: The Book of Learning by Example
aliases: The Book of Learning by Example
summary: Work by Usama ibn Munqidh quoted in Understanding.

label: The Book Of Life's Merits
summary: Hildegard's tractatus on moral philosophy and Theology.

label: The Book of Mundane Beasts
summary: A free Atlas Games supplement describing beasts of Mythic Europe, on which the Virtuous Hound, Familiar Cat, and skinchanger's raven form are based.

label: The Book of Nimiane
summary: The legendary journal in which Nimiane recorded Merlin's secrets and three great names; sought in the Stonehenge and Normandy Tribunals.

label: The Book of One Thousand and One Nights
aliases: The Book of One Thousand and One Nights
summary: A collection of stories begun in the ninth century around which the Keepers of the Thousand Tales formed; they believe several of its characters are magi who have passed into Arcadia.

label: The Book of Poisons
summary: A book by Ibn Wahshiya, quoted for a recipe to make a poison from a scorpion-stung mouse, hellebore, and other ingredients.

label: The Bookstand of Hespera
summary: A wooden lectern enchanted (ReHe 15) to follow the magus around the lab, holding a Lab Text and adding two points to a Texts Specialization.

label: The Bountiful Feast
summary: A Creo Herbam ritual (Level 35) cast at noon the day after the winter solstice to ensure crops within its target grow healthy and fruitful.

label: The Box of Unguarded Thoughts
summary: A small silver coffer inlaid with mother-of-pearl that collects nearby stray thoughts and distills them into silver coins containing Mentem vis, potentially serving as Arcane Connections.

label: The Boy Made from Iron
summary: Further idea for an actor story element.

label: The Bremen Town Musicians
summary: Fairy-tale figures cited as examples of faeries who are the heroes of stories.

label: The Bridges
summary: Inner Farne features (with Solan Rock and Knocklin Ends) forming a crescent island at low tide; Aquam vis spume collects here on Saint Cuthbert's feast day.

label: The Brocken
summary: The highest peak of the Harz and one of Germany's most potent supernatural sites, topped by the Witches' Altar and a focus of Walpurgis Night witchcraft, with a Faerie aura.

label: The Brushstrokes Revealed
summary: An InIm 10 spell that makes species cast by an object within a circle more vivid, revealing tiny details otherwise invisible, used to investigate artworks and creation.

label: The Buran of Yenghissar
summary: An Infernal desert storm spirit and corrupt jinni (Might 25, Auram) that manifests as a vortex of black sand, plaguing the village of Yenghissar and now bound within a sahir's ancestral sword.

label: The Bush
summary: Paired islets with Divine aura 1 where Saint Cuthbert meditated for a year underwater; a site for a Test of Faith.

label: The Buskam
summary: The largest of Rugen's mysterious findlinge boulders, partially submerged off the Monchgut peninsula and a site of Slavic worship; said to be left by giants from an epic battle.

label: The Cabal of Erigone
summary: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a triangular clavicula, determined to prevent Caecilius of Durenmar from becoming praeco of the Rhine Tribunal.

label: The Cabal of the Broken Ocean
aliases: The Cabal of the Broken Ocean
summary: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a clockwise turbo of four lines, that provides covert support to the pagans of Lithuania against the Teutonic Knights.

label: The Cabal of the Lance
summary: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a helix made from chain, covertly shielding a newly formed covenant from the intrigue of its Tribunal for an unclear purpose.

label: The Cabal of the Shining Eye
aliases: The Cabal of the Shining Eye
summary: A House Tytalus cabal, symbolized by a concha with an eagle at the center, dedicated to maneuvering the Roman Tribunal into colonization of North Africa.

label: The cage of every unclean and hateful bird
aliases: The cage of every unclean and hateful bird
summary: Incantation/Diablerie 50 enslaving a supernatural creature.

label: The Call to Slumber
summary: A Hermetic spell, cited in Touch/Eye Range versions as a subtle urban spell and as a template for spells that manipulate mental states.

label: The Captive Princess
summary: Actor: a maiden imprisoned by her parents, guarded by an ogre, dragon, or thorns.

label: The Captive Voice
summary: An Imaginem spell that a magus can vary to collect a poet's spoken poem, the captured words acting as an Arcane Connection to the poet until the spell ends.

label: The Carnal Wolf
summary: An adulteration caged within the Cave of Twisting Shadows, a great wolf with jaws too large to close, embodying the carnal urges of Demetrius; used to teach apprentices about spiritual impurity.

label: The Carpenter's Keen Eye
summary: An InHe 15 spell (Voice, Momentary, Group) by which a magus learns whether wood is suitable for carpentry and what treatment it needs.

label: The Celestial Hierarchy
summary: Summa on Dominion Lore describing the nine angelic choirs, attributed to Dionysius the Areopagite.

label: The Cerne Giant
summary: A blatantly phallic figure carved on a Dorset hillside, said to be the lingering presence of a giant who terrorized the area before being slain; barren women who sleep on the phallus may conceive.

label: The Chameleon Cat
summary: MuAn 5 cantation that changes a beast's color, even to unnatural colors; green cats are a favorite at Durenmar.

label: The Chariot
summary: Cherubim power used by four cherubim to bow the heavens and purify a target, removing Warping, Decrepitude and Aging Points.

label: The Chariot of Zeus
summary: MuCo(Au) 30 spell transforming the caster into a thunderbolt to travel instantly to any visible location.

label: The Chirurgeon's Healing Touch
summary: A Creo Corpus spell (CrCo20) that magically closes wounds; under Unnatural Magic, wounds it closes reopen because the magic lasts only a moment.

label: The Church
summary: The dominant religious institution of Mythic Europe, headed by the Pope, the Bishop of Rome, and backed by the Divine. It structures medieval life around the seven sacraments, canon law, and a hierarchy of bishops, priests, monasteries, and parishes.

label: The Church (supplement)
summary: Ars Magica supplement supporting common ground between magi and the Church and originating the Proctor of Hermes seed.

label: The Clandestine Mask
summary: A MuIm 4 spell that blurs the caster's face and distorts her voice so she cannot be recognized; the disguise's form is determined by the caster's sigil.

label: The Clean Slate
summary: A Perdo Mentem spell that wipes the target's memory clean, removing identity, Academic/Arcane/Martial/Supernatural Abilities, and all Arts.

label: The Cleric's Pate
summary: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

label: The Cloudless Sky Returned
summary: A Perdo Auram spell (Level 45) that clears the sky within the caster's vision of clouds and meteorological activity short of a hurricane or tornado.

label: The Collegium
summary: A Hermetic societas of about a dozen Platonist magi from different Houses, founded by Xenophon of Bonisagus, dedicated to investigating the nature of magic through experimentation and Philosophiae.

label: The Command of Every Beast
summary: ReAn 20 Boundary ritual letting the magus give a one-sentence command to every beast on the island.

label: The Comprehensive Epistle
summary: Al-Risala al-Jami'a, key to the Epistles; a Philosophiae summa and summa for Philosophical Refining.

label: The Congregation
summary: Rank-and-file Neo-Mercurian Initiates who recover lost secrets of ancient temples and serve the Priests.

label: The Conquered Bastard
summary: Infernal Lore tractatus (Quality 6) describing the demon in William's corpse.

label: The Conquest
summary: The Norman Conquest of England. It shaped English nobility, reduced women's rights and led to the counties palatine and the marcher lords.

label: The Constant Expression
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw: the maga perpetually casts non-fatiguing Spontaneous magic effects, losing a permanent long-term Fatigue level and making laboratory work risky.

label: The Cook's Revenge
summary: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

label: The Copyist's Critical Eye
summary: InIm 10 spell revealing where a second text differs from the first.

label: The Copyist's Puissant Quill
summary: ReAq 5 craft magic spell making ink form words and images on a page along guidelines.

label: The Courts of the Seasons
summary: Four intrinsically linked faerie woodland courts (Holly, Alder, Oak, Willow) tied to the passage of the seasons, formed when one forest spirit splintered into four and each allied with a faerie lord.

label: The Couturier's Art
summary: Miklos's spell creating a complete set of clothes with accessories.

label: The Creation of a Forest
summary: CrHe 40 ritual that creates a thousand mature trees.

label: The Creation of Acorns Aplenty
summary: CrHe 20 ritual that creates a vast pile of acorns totaling 1,000 cubic paces.

label: The Creation of Verdant Grassland
summary: CrHe 10 ritual covering about 1.25 acres with thick grass a pace high.

label: The Crintera Schism
summary: A saga concept revolving around the troubles within Crintera: the shapeshifter feud, the Harmonist-Wilderist split, and the Rügen crisis, culminating in the covenant being sundered and warring domus magnae.

label: The Crone
summary: An aged, respected village woman with the Unaging Virtue whose menstrual blood contains Creo vis; though not Gifted, she knows something of magic and serves as a vis source near a covenant.

label: The Crow's Song
summary: Power (PeCo 40) that forces an Aging Roll with +5 on a target the next time he sleeps.

label: The Crown of Hermes
summary: An elaborate jewel-encrusted golden crown (Cr(In,Mu,Re)Me 50) whose creator is lost to memory; it lets its wearer enter a trance to create and work in an imaginary laboratory, inflicting Warping points.

label: The Cruel Stepmother
summary: Further idea for an actor story element.

label: The Crystal Dart
summary: A Muto Terram spell (with Rego requisite) that transforms a stone into a 10-inch crystal dart that flies at a target for +5 damage.

label: The Crystal of a Hundred Candles
aliases: The Crystal of a Hundred Candles
summary: An enchanted crystal embedded in the ceiling of Arliandus's sanctum that blooms into light to illuminate the whole chamber when the door opens.

label: The Cult of Mercury (book)
summary: Fenicil's ninth-century tractatus on Organization Lore: Cult of Mercury, Quality 8.

label: The Cult of Orpheus
summary: A Mystery-Cult-like tradition of magi (magoi) descended from worshippers of Orpheus and Hermes, who practice emotionally-connected magic and revere the legend of Orpheus.

label: The Cult of Vesta
summary: A Merinita cult founded by magae of Brittany who venerate faeries as household gods (lares), adopt Vesta as patron, and take vows of chastity in exchange for faerie powers.

label: The Curse of Diana
summary: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

label: The Curse of Poseidon
summary: Polyphemus' power (ReAq 50) making the ocean the victim's enemy until Polyphemus or Poseidon is appeased.

label: The Dancer's Dame
summary: A cantation (low-level formulaic spell for apprentices) listed in the book's contents.

label: The Dancing Place
summary: Grass circle with Faerie Aura four where faeries dance each spring equinox and may answer a question.

label: The Dark Places
summary: Places of ancient evil within the Faerie forest, locked away by Shen.

label: The Daughters of Echo
summary: A Jerbiton league interested in magical methods of recording and reproducing events, led by a Merinita maga near Burnfoot in Hibernia.

label: The Dead of Ascalon
summary: The cursed corpses of a Muslim fleet defeated off Ascalon in 1123; their skulls, smuggled aboard rival ships by a merchant house, cause every cursed voyage to end tragically.

label: The Dead That Walk Again
summary: Revener Power animating unburied corpses.

label: The Death of Vermin
summary: A Rego Animal 20 enchanted box that fills specific vermin with a desire to enter it, gathering them to be destroyed.

label: The Demand of the Frustrated Scholar Soothed
aliases: The Demand of the Frustrated Scholar Soothed
summary: A Rego Animal 40 spell that teleports a book within 500 paces to the caster's hand via an arcane connection; higher-level versions reach up to seven leagues.

label: The Devil's Eye
summary: Folk witch initiation script requiring an Arcane Connection to an invisible creature; grants Second Sight and Missing Eye.

label: The Devil's Penance
summary: Medieval German folk tale of a devil refusing humiliating penance.

label: The Discerning Eye
summary: Enhanced InIm spell detecting created or altered images and areas of Magic Resistance.

label: The Dismal Itch
summary: Summa on Corpus by Azenis of Tytalus.

label: The Donar Oak
summary: A divine spirit (Divine Might 40) at Geismar, formerly the focal point of the pagan power of the Hercynian Forest; its acorns are worth Creo vis and can tame animals and forests.

label: The Donatores Requietis Aeternae
summary: A young, secretive necromantic tradition of House Ex Miscellanea with religious backgrounds who ensure the spirits of the dead reach their final rest using the Banishing Ability.

label: The Door of Deimos
summary: An enchanted iron door created by Arliandus and named after the son of Ares, embossed with faces and skulls and invested with effects that recognize and repel intruders.

label: The Dove Hat
summary: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

label: The Dragon-Maiden
summary: Asturian girl turned into a cuelebre by a nymph.

label: The Dragon of Brünn
summary: A dragon that lived in a cave by the River Svratka near Brünn and devoured townsfolk, until a travelling butcher killed it with a lime-stuffed ox pelt; its stuffed carcass hangs in Brünn's town hall.

label: The Dragon's Tongue
summary: Prop: eating it grants powers like speaking with animals; proof of slaying the dragon.

label: The Dream Landscape
summary: Dream realm described in the Mysteries of Dreams chapter.

label: The Dreamscape
summary: Rumored shared dreamland beyond and between dreams where spiritual travelers meet; no direct path back to the waking world.

label: The Drudenbaum of Harberg
summary: A mythical tree spirit (Magic Might 30) atop the Harberg near Nuremberg where wizards meet; its golden drops are Creo vis and its milk is Vim vis, and it possesses trees to assume its form.

label: The Dull Knife
summary: Prop: a crude blade that may cut the uncuttable or rust when another is in peril.

label: The Dumb Waiter
summary: A Rego Terram level 35 enchanted device that instantly transports food and dishes from the kitchen to specified places in the covenant within 50 paces.

label: The Dutiful Shepherd
summary: Saint power sending an image of the saint to lead a lost petitioner to safety.

label: The Dying Lady
summary: Eudokian example ancient ash tree, source of the forest's antagonism.

label: The Ear for a Distant Voice
aliases: The Ear for a Distant Voice
summary: InIm 12 effect letting the user hear the voice of a person to whom she has an Arcane Connection.

label: The Ear for Distant Voice
summary: InIm 20 spell.

label: The Ear for Distant Voices
summary: An Intellego Imaginem spell (Level 20) that lets the caster hear what is happening in a designated place to which they have an Arcane Connection.

label: The Ear for the Distant Voice
aliases: The Ear for the Distant Voice
summary: Spell (InIm 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

label: The Earth's Carbuncle
summary: A Rego Terram spell (with Muto requisite) that turns a 1-pace circle of ground into jagged stone that bursts upward, throwing those standing on it.

label: The Earth's Riches
summary: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

label: The Earth Split Asunder
summary: A Rego Terram (ReTe 30) spell opening a chasm; Magic Resistance does not protect against falling in, but does against being crushed when it closes.

label: The Eastern Marches
summary: The wild northeastern reaches of Germany between the Elbe and Oder, roamed by werewolves, witches, and giants, where pagan Slavic beliefs linger; claimed by the Rhine Tribunal.

label: The Ecclesiastical History
summary: History by Orderic Vitalis including Area Lore summae and a Civil and Canon Law tractatus.

label: The Ecclesiastical History of the English People
aliases: The Ecclesiastical History of the English People
summary: Encyclopedia by Bede of four tractatus of Quality 9.

label: The Edges of the World
summary: Four regiones corresponding to the four elements and humors to which a spirit-traveling Criamon magus is sequentially drawn, and from which he must escape back to his body.

label: The Elfin Baker
summary: Spell or effect listed in the contents of Transforming Mythic Europe.

label: The Elfin Brewer
summary: Similar spell creating 12 dozen pints of ale.

label: The Empty Forest
summary: Example Eudokian story element: a forest villain whose trees resent animals.

label: The Enchanted Chef
summary: A Rego Herbam (Animal, Aquam, Ignem) 45 enchanted pot that processes and transforms food into a described dish as if cooked, substituting Communication + Finesse for Craft: Cook.

label: The Enchanted Porter
summary: A Rego Terram 15 enchanted glove that lifts and pushes an inanimate object while the user holds and moves it; based on The Unseen Porter.

label: The End of Hatred
summary: A PeCo 50 Orphic spell that instantly slays a target against whom the caster has the Enemies Flaw; used only once in the Cult's history.

label: The Endless Summer
summary: Empathy/Weal ritual giving a bonus to Aging rolls (and penalty to Recovery) for a year and a day.

label: The Enigma's Gift
summary: A Creo Vim spell that inflicts four Warping Points on a target and forces a Hermetic magus to check for Twilight.

label: The Epicurean
summary: Masked figure who always leads the Cold Iron Vexillation; in Arcadia a continuing entity.

label: The Eternal Parry
summary: Enchantment/Ware 25 rite giving +3 Defense while the caster brandishes a blade after a dance.

label: The Ever-Watchful Turb
summary: A Perdo Mentem spell that prevents a target group from falling asleep by quelling the inclination to rest.

label: The Evil Twin
summary: Further idea for an actor story element.

label: The Exsules
summary: A small band of fewer than a dozen renegade House Merinita wizards based at Fenistal who rejected the Order; they know imperfect Hermetic magic and Parma Magica and prefer to turn nature against their enemies.

label: The Externsteine
