summary: An Intellego Mentem spell (Level 25) that lets the caster understand the speech of those within the target area, including misused language.

label: Thrace
summary: Region raided by Asen.

label: Thracian Harbor
summary: Bear Island harbor with a perpetual inward wind; Magic aura 2.

label: Threat Level
summary: Classification of obstacles (Trivial to Overwhelming) setting the Ease Factor of creativity offers.

label: Threatening a Saint
summary: 'Humiliation of a saint': Presence + Leadership roll forcing a miracle after a failed invocation, risking curses.

label: Three Ages of the World
summary: Joachim's teaching of the ages of Father, Son and Spirit.

label: Three Cords
summary: The golden, silver and bronze cords of a familiar bond, renamed Hermes, Isis and Hekate Cords for spirit familiars.

label: Three-Field Rotation
summary: Agricultural system in which wheat or rye, a secondary spring crop, and fallow rotate through three fields; the two-field system alternates fallow and crops.

label: Three Great Spirits of Ushant
summary: Three mighty spirits bound into Fudarus's walls as genii loci, protecting the covenant.

label: Three Spears
summary: Legendary flaming spears of Vendôme, Arcane Connections to each other that drip Divine-tainted Ignem vis when reunited.

label: Three Wise Men
summary: The biblical magi Caspar, Melchior and Balthasar, revered by the Magoi of the Star, whose relics lie in the Shrine of Kings at Cologne.

label: Threshold
summary: The simultaneous attraction and repulsion between Faerie and the mundane world; entering Faerie requires Threshold points equal to Threshold strength.

label: Threshold faerie
summary: A faerie that mediates Eudokian stories governing a life transition and sends characters home with Spirit Away.

label: Threshold Guardian
summary: Faerie role controlling access to Faerieland.

label: Thresholds
summary: Borders of life, social class, time and space that faeries inhabit.

label: Throne of God
summary: God's Throne in Araboth, which Hell seeks to overthrow.

label: Thrones
summary: Angelic Choir of Camuel, Munkar and Nakir; pious kings are placed among them.

label: Through the Aegis
summary: An Ars Magica supplement containing five fully developed covenants, one for each season plus one that returned from Winter to Spring.

label: Throwing Axe
summary: Thrown slashing weapon.

label: Thrown Weapon
summary: The missile-combat Ability used for thrown weapons such as the throwing axe, javelin, knife, and sling.

label: Thrym
summary: Villain of the Theft of Thor's Hammer, cited as an example of the villain role.

label: Thunderbolt of Virtue
summary: Pointed stone that falls in thunderstorms, containing 1 pawn of Auram vis; Enriched it wards against Demons of the Air as a Greater Power.

label: Thunor
summary: An old Germanic thunder god worshiped by the German tribes.

label: Thurgau
summary: Kirburger territory.

label: Thuringia
summary: A landlocked upland region of the Rhine Tribunal bounded by the Kyffhauser Mountains and the Thuringian Forest, quaint rather than bustling.

label: Thurisaz
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Ogre" used as a vitkir Art. Negative rune meaning giant or ogre (or thorn), used for shapeshifting and against supernatural creatures (Vim) and thorny plants (Herbam).

label: Thurkell
summary: Subject of a medieval otherworld vision.

label: Thurydices
summary: Example Redcap whose fate is the subject of a divination example.

label: Tiana
summary: Tremere member of Postestas.

label: Tibalt
summary: Cat Reynard races.

label: Tiber
summary: River near which Vardian's Tomb lies.

label: Tiberius
summary: Younger noble son guided by a demon posing as his grandfather's ghost, designed by Valefar as a snare for magi.

label: Ticino
summary: Valley region.

label: Tickling the Humors
summary: Andru's cluster of CrMe variants of Rising Ire instilling other emotions.

label: Tie the Threads That Bind
summary: A general-level Rego Vim ritual formulaic spell used uniquely to unite an automaton's magic into a cohesive unit, requiring a level equal to the construct's Magic Might + 15.

label: Tiercelin the Raven
summary: Raven whose cheese Reynard seeks.

label: Tierent
summary: A 12th-century Verditius magus who adapted the Bind Magical Creatures Mystery to affect creatures with Faerie Might.

label: Tiferet
summary: Sefirah meaning 'Beauty', level 5 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 5.

label: Tillitus Bonisagi
summary: Magus Bonisagi of Semita Errabunda attempting to break the Limit of Vis.

label: Tillitus of House Bonisagus
summary: A magus of House Bonisagus of the covenant Semita Errabunda who invents Rego Vim warding spells against magical creatures in a spell-invention example.

label: Time of Power
summary: Virtue appearing in faerie statistics in this text (Time of Power).

label: Time or Place of Power
summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue making Might 10 higher at a time or place linked to the faerie's role.

label: Time's Former Glory
summary: Pasiel's power reverting himself to restore Might or cure wounds.

label: Time Unmans All Foes
summary: Andru's variant of Rusted Decay of Ten Score Years with Group target.

label: Time Waits for No Man
summary: Pasiel's power inflicting aging on living things.

label: Tincture of Parsley
summary: A Theriac of Level 10, Potency Strong, a herbal infusion that acts as an antidote to any serpent bite when consumed immediately after the bite.

label: Tinderdry
summary: A Level 5 alchemical Reagent, a wool-like substance that when rubbed over damp wood dries it enough to be lit with flint and steel.

label: Tines
summary: Tremere term for a magus's preferred certamen arts.

label: Tintagel
summary: A near-island stronghold off the coast of Cornwall, the seat of Gorlois and later King Mark, and the site of Arthur's conception; it may be detached from the mundane world, with a chapel of St. Juliot helping keep it from reappearing.

label: Tinted Aura
summary: A Faerie aura given Personality Traits by tinting, imposing temporary traits on all within it.

label: Tiny Eggs
summary: Story seed in which a faerie makes every egg on a manor thimble-sized, disrupting dues and prompting witchcraft accusations.

label: Tip of the Tongue
summary: A Perdo Mentem spell (Level 5) that causes the target to forget one word of the caster's choosing for the spell's duration.

label: Tir
summary: Son of Iblis with dominion over fatal accidents.

label: Tiranova rebellion
summary: Rebellion of 1185 that led to independence for the Bulgarians.

label: Tireless
summary: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

label: Tirnova
summary: Place near which the Asen brothers were minor lords.

label: Tiro
summary: Term meaning young soldier or beginner, used by apprentices for each other and derisively by older magi.

label: Tirocinia
summary: Tournaments for younger, less-experienced knights.

label: Tisha B'Av
summary: Fast commemorating destruction of both Temples.

label: Titahion
summary: Jewish degree of Hell, the Filthy Mire.

label: Titan
summary: Primordial beings such as Dindyméné, imprisoned by Zeus.

label: Titania
summary: A faerie queen who gifted the King of England a hippogriff that fell ill from London's strong Divine aura.

label: Titanoi
summary: A Mystery Cult lineage within House Tytalus, heirs to the goetic and spirit-summoning magical tradition of Guorna and Tytalus; nearly destroyed during the Betrayal and revived after the Schism War.

label: Titanoi Cult Lore
summary: A cult lore Ability taught to magi raised in the Titanoi Mystery Cult of House Tytalus.

label: Titanomachia
summary: War of the Titans in which Faerie gods ousted the Magic spirits from the thrones of the world.

label: Titanomachy
summary: The war of the Titans and Greek Gods; a place of power from before it holds magical weapons.

label: Tithe
summary: One tenth of everything a person gets, owed to the Church; divided traditionally into quarters for rector, curate, church fabric and the poor, effectively taking twenty percent of peasant income.

label: Tithe of Vis
summary: Story seed in which a bishop's representative inspects a covenant to tithe its vis, books and magic items.

label: Titias
summary: A male Idaian Daktyl who remains on Bear Island and seeks the magi's help.

label: Titus Herennius Vespillo
summary: Tenth-century necromancer magus of Rome who pioneered Hermetic spirit magic and founded the Disciples of the Worm.

label: Tityroi
summary: Satyrs that play magical shepherd's pipes.

label: Tius
summary: The battle god of the Germans, worshiped by Hermann and the Cheruski, whose priests' magic aided the tribes at the Teutoburger Forest.

label: Tiwaz
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Tyr" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of Tyr, truth and battle; primarily associated with Mentem and justice.

label: To Break a Kelpie
summary: Story seed in which a Highland clan chief commissions a magical bridle to capture a kelpie, risking breach of the Peripheral Code.

label: To Know the Owner as Might His Hound
aliases: To Know the Owner as Might His Hound
summary: InAn 25 spell letting Kentigern sense what an animal senses.

label: To Mark with Umbrage
summary: Creo Imaginem level 30 spell marking up to a thousand people with the caster's sigil so friend can be told from foe in battle; a level 25 Voice version affects about ten.

label: To See as Others See
summary: Intellego Animal level 40 spell (Rego requisite) letting a magus read an animal's thoughts and direct it as a spy, perceiving through its mind.

label: To Sin in Dreams
summary: Patarus' power altering memories to suggest mortal sin.

label: To stir the spirit, heart and fear / A shadow phantom hunts in here
aliases: To stir the spirit, heart and fear / A shadow phantom hunts in here
summary: Level 40 maleficium sending a phantasmal creature into a victim's mind.

label: Toad of Virtue
summary: Toad from whose living head the Bufonite of Virtue must be removed for Enrichment.

label: Toads
summary: First Green Cockerel degree: calcination, Saturn, black, lead; learns Planetary Magic.

label: Toasting Ritual
summary: Rite by which a Hound of God passes his power to one who toasts his health, blowing three times across the bottle.

label: Tobias
summary: An example swineherd whose body Antigone inhabits during a psychodramatic Quest on the Avenue of the Unexpected Pages, charged with delivering a candlestick.

label: Toframanna Saga
summary: Saga setting from Land of Fire and Ice centered on Vindolanda.

label: Toframenn
summary: Icelandic term for the magi of Vindolanda.

label: Toga Praetexta
summary: Seamless toga with a purple stripe worn by apprentices and Quaesitores on formal occasions.

label: Toga Virilis
summary: Roman garment listed in the index alongside praetexta, stola, and trabea.

label: Token of the Star
summary: An example item whose acquisition by the characters could act as a story's trigger.

label: Tokens of War
summary: Tokens dispatched when declaring war, when some aggressive magi don the pulla.

label: Tolas
summary: Tremere member of Postestas.

label: Toledo
summary: A Spanish town whose charter requires a man's wife to live permanently in the town for him to gain citizenship, preventing itinerant merchants from claiming multiple citizenships.

label: Tolente
summary: Vanished town in a regio.

label: Tolosa Paratge
summary: An ancient covenant in Toulouse in the Provencal Tribunal, completely split between two factions, the White and the Black, a rivalry that may bring it down.

label: Tom the Cutpurse
summary: An example agent of Carolus, a thief with a Bond of Gratitude who is asked to steal a mayor's signet ring using Dexterity plus Legerdemain.

label: Tomar
summary: Portuguese town founded by the Templars, with their chapterhouse at castle Cera.

label: Tomb of Ibn Sina
summary: Site in Hamadan where supplicants of the Rite of Opening the Mind fast.

label: Tomb of the Shadow Senate
summary: Hidden tomb beneath Pietro's house with an Infernal Aura and an unholy shrine.

label: Tommaso da Capua
summary: Cardinal-priest of Saint Sabina (1216), appointed penitentiarius in 1219.

label: Tomorrow's Bounty
summary: Saint Power available through invoking Muslim holy forbears or relics.

label: Tomte
summary: Powerful Scandinavian brownie believing itself the spirit of the person who cleared the land on which the farm stands; aids fertility and cares for horses.

label: Tongue of the Beasts
summary: Spell (InAn 20) known by Amberitus.

label: Tongue of the Birds
summary: Spell (InAn 20) known by Amberitus.

label: Tongue of the Folk
summary: Spell (InMe 20) known by a template magus or referenced in the text.

label: Tonic of Gold
summary: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Weak, made with minute quantities of gold, that restores a Winded character to a non-fatigued state.

label: Tonsure
summary: The ring of hair left when a monk's head is shaved on taking vows.

label: Topaz of Virtue
summary: Gem containing 1 pawn of Mentem vis that when Enriched grants Puissant Leadership.

label: Torah
summary: First five books of the Tanakh transcribed by Moses; a Summa on Theology: Judaism, Judaic Lore and Rabbinic Law.

label: Toranos
summary: The Pictish thunder god.

label: Torch of the Realm-bound Reveler
summary: MuIg 25 spell letting the target affect fiery objects with Magic Realm Magic as if it had Ignem Might.

label: Torhout
summary: Flemish cloth fair town.

label: Tormenting Familiar
summary: Bartholomew (Mengalaz).

label: Tormenting Master
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character's master does not believe he passed the apprentice's gauntlet and periodically troubles him with political moves; applicable to magi.

label: Torrent from the Lungs
summary: Faerie power, as Curse of the Desert, drawing water forth from the body for +15 damage.

label: Torrent of Flame
summary: Varkos' power to belch a 30-pace torrent of flame.

label: Tortoise Game
summary: A children's game described by Errina based on a faerie that possesses mothers to kill babies.

label: Tortoiseshell Lineage
summary: Cat lineage associated with Celtic spellcasters, split after the Schism War with kings in Scotland and the Rhineland, known for predicting the future.

label: Torture Chair of Zeus
summary: A mechanized chair Hephaestus made that Zeus used to torture Hera; rediscovered by Milo and prize of the first Verditius Contest, won by Gelon.

label: Torven
summary: A reclusive young hedge wizard of Waldheim with Latent Magical Ability who befriends forest creatures and is accompanied by the faerie wolf Red-Hame.

label: Touch of Death
summary: Leti power acting as Clenching Grasp of the Crushed Heart at Touch range, costing 6 Might.

label: Touch of Faerie
summary: Condition gained by children who survive being stolen or raised by faeries.

label: Touch of Midas
summary: A ritual Creo Terram spell that creates a roughly spherical lump of gold about six inches across, enough wealth for a peasant family for centuries.

label: Touch of the Goose Feather
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell (Level 5) that causes the target to let out a loud sneeze, disrupting concentration and activities.

label: Touch of the Merciless Lover
summary: Empathy/Woe 25 rite making the target waste away and die until the duration ends.

label: Touch of the Mermaid
summary: White Lady power acting as Kiss of the Mermaid.

label: Touch of the Pearls
summary: An Intellego Aquam spell (Level 5) that tells the caster whether a touched liquid is poisonous, like a pearl, without tasting it.

label: Touched by (Realm)
summary: Major Supernatural Virtue letting crafters make wondrous items without vis.

label: Tough
summary: A Minor Virtue acquirable by a Bjornaer inner heartbeast and suitable for beasts such as the bear, boar, and wolf; stacks with Thick Fur and Tough Hide for Protection.

label: Tough Hide
summary: Animal Quality listed in the seal statistics (Tough Hide).

label: Toul
summary: A venerable city forty miles up the Mosel from Metz, formerly Roman Tullum, surrounded by tall white stone walls and remaining loyal to its duke.

label: Toul Goulic Gorge
summary: Gorge with genius loci.

label: Toulouse
summary: A location in the Provencal Tribunal where the covenant of Tolosa Paratge resides.

label: Touraine
summary: County forming part of Anjou.

label: Tournai
summary: Seat of Flanders' bishopric.

label: Tournament
summary: Mock-war event of the 13th century offering experience, reputation, and ransom wealth.

label: Tournament Enchantments
summary: Minor enchantments sold by Verditius agents, such as reins that cannot be cut and saddles that grasp their rider.

label: Tours
summary: City on the Loire with the Basilica of St. Martin, site of the Redcap Mercer House Alcuin's Auberge.

label: Tower Keep
summary: Keep usually four stories high, mostly built in the 12th century.

label: Tower of Ashes
summary: Chapter house of the Covenant of the Icy North that is home to Archmaga Jacinta filia Nicoli of the line of Apromor.

label: Tower of Babel
summary: Tower built by Nimrod with help of the Nephilim.

label: Tower of London
summary: A London fortress whose grounds contain the Royal Menagerie housing exotic animals gifted to the King of England, including the ailing faerie hippogriff.

label: Tower of Notatus
summary: A tower at Durenmar conjured by and named after the first Primus of House Bonisagus; it houses most Bonisagus magi and Murion's sanctum.

label: Tower of Skulls
summary: The fate of solitary magi who slide into horrific Corpus craft, which Ragoneda fears.

label: Tower of Trianoma
summary: The youngest of Durenmar's three towers, named in honor of Trianoma; its basement houses one of the Rhine's official Mercer Houses.

label: Tower of Whirling Water
summary: A Rego Aquam spell (Level 35) that forms a waterspout under the caster's mental direction, damaging and potentially drowning those it hits.

label: Town
summary: Settlement granted rights by an overlord in a charter, whose residents are free of villein service; an average town has perhaps three hundred people.

label: Town Charter
summary: Grant allowing town burgesses to elect mayors and hold courts in return for collective tenure; many Norman towns have them.

label: Town Crier's Guild
summary: Guild formed to announce news using civic Specula.

label: Town Foundation
summary: The practice of counts declaring villages to be towns, granting privileges and tax exemptions to attract settlers; a craze in full swing in 1220.

label: Town Magistrate
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue granting a position of judicial responsibility in a town with a small staff of officials, requiring citizenship and a score of 3 in Civil and Canon Law (or Common Law).

label: Town Senex
summary: Covenant closest to a town (by loudest church bells) with superior rights there.

label: Townhouse (Reims)
summary: Haunted ramshackle townhouse in Reims' poor quarter where Eliza lives, haunted by the burned witches' ghosts.

label: Toxic Visage
summary: Telechine power whereby those who see the creature's true face die.

label: Toy Soldier
summary: Foot-tall wooden faerie soldier guarding a sleeping child.

label: Tréguier
summary: Town with the Church of St. Tugdual.

label: Trôo
summary: Village with cave homes in the Loir valley.

label: Trabea
summary: Purple imperial toga no Alpine magus will wear.

label: Tracing the Trail of Death's Stench
aliases: Tracing the Trail of Death's Stench
summary: A spell used by Donatores to locate the corporeal remains of a spirit from the location of its death or gravesite.

label: Track
summary: Ability appearing in character or creature statistics in this text.

label: Track the Heavens
summary: ReTe 28 enchantment linked to Know the Heavens that keeps the armillary sphere adjusted to current local astrological time.

label: Track the Presence of Vis
summary: TaVs 5 spell in which the gruagach's fetch locates nearby vis and vocalizes where it is.

label: Trackless Step
summary: A Rego Terram spell that leaves no tracks in the earth until the caster stops; draws on pre-Hermetic traditions.

label: Tracks of the Faerie Glow
summary: A spell used in a Performance Magic example; its Hunter's variant is cast by Harold using Performance Magic (Hunt) to gain magically enhanced vision while hunting.

label: Tractatus
summary: A short book conveying an author's insights on a subject, studied once for experience; breakthroughs and encyclopedia volumes are disseminated as tractatus.

label: Tractatus de Purgatorio Sancti Patricii
summary: Latin account (c.1160) of Owain's Vision; tractatus on Area Lore: Purgatory Q7 and summa on Theology L3 Q8.

label: Trade Policies
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

label: Traditional Ward
summary: A taboo that a faerie may not touch with its glamour; it cannot regenerate Might in the ward's presence and is harmed if forced to touch it.

label: Traditionalists
summary: Faction within House Guernicus holding that local Tribunals govern only their Peripheral Code, that the Order is a loose society of equals, and likely opposing a Fourth Estate.

label: Tragedy of Hubris
summary: Consequence suffered by kabbalists who overreach, e.g. attempting to create a second golem for a community already protected; also triggers golem madness rolls.

label: Tragedy of the Commons
summary: Later idea popularized by the Enclosure Movement that commons are destroyed by overuse, which the book says does not apply because greens are regulated.

label: Tragic (Characteristic)
summary: Minor Heroic Flaw imposing a specialty in a negative Characteristic that subtracts three and adds a botch die in that circumstance.

label: Tragic Life
summary: A Major Story Tainted Flaw in which the character's life has been manipulated by demons so that she will act to her own detriment at a pivotal moment of destiny.

label: Trail of the Lost Ways
summary: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

label: Trained as a Gruagach
summary: -4 Hermetic Flaw: mistakenly trained as a gruagach for a year, giving -1 to Parma Magica and Art scores.

label: Trained Assassin
summary: A Minor General Virtue available only to characters with a Nizari Social Status Virtue, granting 50 experience points in Martial Abilities, Athletics, Guile, or Stealth.

label: Trained Group
summary: A group that has practiced fighting together for a season (or less with accelerated training) and functions with the trained group rules.

label: Trained Group Combat
summary: Rule letting Templars who train a season fight as a trained group.

label: Training
summary: A method of instruction for Abilities only, not needing the Teaching Ability; counts as a season of one-on-one instruction.

label: Training with Primi
summary: Listed in the Tribunal index.

label: Traitor's Key
summary: Magical key borne by the Traitor since Tasgillia, rumored to weaken Fudarus' defenses.

label: Trajan Decius
summary: Roman emperor under whose persecution (250 AD) Origen was imprisoned and tortured.

label: Trajan of Tytalus
summary: Magus who constructs an arena making combatants fight in berserk rage.

label: Trajan's Arena
summary: CrMe 25 Hermetic Architecture enchantment by Trajan of Tytalus using eight stone pillars to make combatants in an arena fight in berserk rage.

label: Transcendence
summary: Power bringing spiritual changes to mind and body, allowing spirit travel and bodily endurance; used with Meditation and Purity.

label: Transference
summary: Act in which the hero is transported, delivered, or led to the object of his quest, often by magical means.

label: Transfix
summary: A Wolf of Virtue's power that leaves prey unable to move or speak while the wolf keeps eye contact; it fails if the wolf is seen first. It is ReCo(An) 20.

label: Transform
summary: +3 Gruagach Exceptional Talent allowing gruagachan to change the shape of others.

label: Transform into Animal
summary: Personal power transforming the character into a specified land animal; faeries retain speech.

label: Transform into Bird or Fish
summary: Personal power transforming the character into a specified bird or fish.

label: Transform into Coin
summary: Power the Privy Counselor uses to spy as a coin.

label: Transform into (Environmental Effect)
summary: Personal power transforming the character into a wave, breeze, cloud, fire or similar nebulous thing.

label: Transform into Human
summary: Power for non-human faeries to take human shape; the Ghula uses it to switch between human and feasting form.

label: Transform into Impenetrable Fog
summary: Manannan's power to become a great cloud hiding the island.

label: Transform into (Solid Object)
summary: Personal power transforming the character into a specified object capable of speech and limited movement.

label: Transform into Thunderstorm
summary: Manannan's power to become a vast bank of thunderclouds driving winds and hail at foes.

label: Transform into Tide
summary: Manannan's power to become the upper layer of the sea, carrying boats as he wishes.

label: Transform into Wheel of Flame
summary: Manannan's power to transform into a wheel of flame, his most dangerous physical combat form.

label: Transform into Whirlwind
summary: Południca's power to become a dust devil.

label: Transform to Water
summary: A spell whose constant effect is mimicked by the Water sample elemental form of a Bjornaer chimera or anima heartbeast.

label: Transform Victim into (Animal)
summary: Faerie power turning a target who hears the faerie's voice into a land animal for Sun duration.

label: Transform Victim into (Bird or Fish)
summary: Faerie power turning a target who hears the faerie's voice into a bird or fish.

label: Transform Victim into (Object or Plant)
summary: Faerie power turning a target into a solid inanimate object or plant.

label: Transformation
summary: The gruagach equivalent of Wizard's Twilight, replacing normal Warping rules; accumulated Warping slowly turns a gruagach into a troll, complete at Warping Score 10.

label: Transformation of Flesh to Spirit
summary: CrVi(Co) 60 ritual in which the caster kills herself to increase the aura.

label: Transformation of the Living Ghost
summary: General Mystery Ritual defining a Living Ghost's Might Score, limited by the magus's best Arts.

label: Transformation of the Ravenous Beast to the Torpid Toad
aliases: Transformation of the Ravenous Beast to the Torpid Toad
summary: A Muto Animal (MuAn 25) spell known by the Bjornaer template magus that transforms an animal into a toad.

label: Transformation of the Thorny Staff
summary: A Muto Herbam spell (Level 10) that causes a length of wood to grow thick sharp thorns; adds +4 damage if cast on a staff.

label: Transformation points
summary: Points accumulated by successful Transformation rituals toward a hierarch's ascension.

label: Transformation Prone
summary: Major Supernatural Flaw: roll for transformation on a single botch; gained via Vision initiation.

label: Transformed Animal
summary: An animal Warped by magic whose magical qualities relate to the transforming event; it gains no Magic Might.

label: Transformed Beast
summary: Magical beast with powers beyond its species' perfection, often from failed Hermetic attempts to create Beasts of Virtue.

label: Transformed (Being)
summary: Major Supernatural Virtue: the character is transformed by Magic into a supernatural being with Might 0, gaining Qualities by taking Inferiorities and an Essential Trait.

label: Transformed Humans
summary: Humans transformed by magic into beings of the Magic Realm, losing their humanity.

label: Transformed Thing
summary: Virtue (Realms of Power: Magic) granted to the wagon by a botched transportation spell, turning it into a Magic Thing.

label: Transitionalism
summary: Tremere political priority for Code changes compelling magi to assist the Order.

label: Transitionalists
summary: A philosophical faction within House Guernicus, started by Simprim, that believes the Code should be revised and seeks greater legal powers for the Quaesitores.

label: Transitions of Maturation
summary: Three liminal stages (ages 8, 15 and 21) during which a young character may exchange Virtues and Flaws of equal value.

label: Transmission
summary: The process by which a Criamon magus passes learned wisdom on to other members of the House, sometimes encapsulating it perfectly into a place or object upon entering Twilight.

label: Transport the Devout
summary: Samuil's power to carry a person anywhere, even beyond the Lunar Sphere.

label: Transubstantiation
summary: Miraculous replacement of the substance of wafer and wine with that of Christ at the words of consecration.

label: Transvestite
summary: Flaw held by a high number of faerie doctors, reflecting their oath to wear women's clothes.

label: Transylvanian Alps
summary: Holdings granted to the Teutons in 1211.

label: Trap of the Entwining Vines
summary: A Creo Herbam (CrHe 15) indirect spell whose vines surround and prevent a maga from moving without completely immobilizing her.

label: Trap the Treacherous Tongue
summary: ReCo 15 spell of Edwin's holding the target's mouth shut.

label: Trapped Vendée Demon
summary: Demon trapped in a sea cave by St. Hilary, bellowing at high tide.

label: Trapping the Fire
summary: A Muto Ignem spell (Level 25) with a Terram requisite that turns the heat and flames of a large campfire into a small hard object such as a gem; breaking the object releases the flame.

label: Travel Lore
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in this text.

label: Traveller's Respite
summary: CrCo 30 ritual restoring one Long-Term Fatigue level to up to 10 individuals.

label: Traverse Mother Earth
summary: Personal power of awakened truffles to burrow through the earth as fast as walking.

label: Treading the Ashen Path
summary: A Perdo Herbam spell (Level 30) that withers and destroys plant material in front of the caster as they walk up to 7 miles; invented by a magus of House Flambeau.

label: Treasure of Chalus
summary: Golden treasure found at Chalus that lured Richard to his death; possibly diabolical.

label: Treasure of King John
summary: King John's baggage train lost in the Wash; a small gold crown fragment may serve as an Arcane Connection to the rest.

label: Treasure of the Nibelungs
summary: The great treasure Siegfried won from the Nibelungs, later sunk in the Rhine by Hagen and lost forever after the tragedy of the Nibelungenlied.

label: Treasure Trove
summary: Valuable buried objects collected by the coroner.

label: Treasurer
summary: Guardian of the lord's wealth and treasury.

label: Treasures of Britain
summary: Legendary set including a magical chessboard sought by Jerome.

label: Treasures of Manannan
summary: Manannan's four or five magic items, which he may lend and which return to him if lost.

label: Treasury of the Four Winds
summary: Sample celestial regio (level 7) storing all winds, guarded by servants of Metatron, Kemuel, Nathanael and Gabriel.

label: Treaty of Chinon
summary: 1214 treaty giving Chinon to Philip II.

label: Treaty of Meersen
summary: 870 treaty dividing Lotharingia.

label: Treaty of Perth
summary: 1266 treaty recognizing Man and the Western Isles as Scottish.

label: Treaty of the Roman Tribunal
summary: 1068 treaty regulating Roman magi's dealings with the mundane world; part of the Peripheral Code but with no force outside the Roman Tribunal.

label: Treaty of Verdun
summary: 843 treaty dividing Charlemagne's empire.

label: Trebizond
summary: Tiny kingdom at the edge of the Hermetic world through which ivory enters Europe.

label: Trebuchet
summary: Counterweight siege engine lobbing stones in a high arc from a sling.

label: Tree Falling in the Forest
summary: A Pe(Re)He 35 spell that instantly cuts down a tree in a chosen direction; with an aiming roll it can fall on a creature for up to +18 damage and bypasses Magic Resistance.

label: Tree Guarded by Michael
summary: Sample Empyreal aura: a sacred tree from Eden (Divine Might 50) on a mountain, likely in the Caucasus, radiating aura 5; its seedlings' fruit grants Joyful and slows aging.

label: Tree of Knowledge
summary: Tree from which Adam ate, giving rise to the qlippot.

label: Tree of Silver
summary: Story element from which an arrow to kill the Rye-King must be fashioned.

label: Tree of Virtue
summary: Vis-bearing trees (beech, hazel, oak, poplar) in the truffle regio; each contains two pawns of vis whose Art depends on the tree type.

label: Trembling Rock
summary: Rocking stone.

label: Tremere Architect
summary: Tremere magi specializing in fortification magic, creators of A Window of Singular Direction.

label: Tremere Assessor
summary: Tremere magi who use The Face in the Mirror briefly for urgent tasks in cities.

label: Tremere Decennial
summary: Periodic Tremere gathering; the most recent was in 1218.

label: Tremere Doctrine
summary: House Tremere's method of war and philosophy of living, emphasizing coordinated soldiers.

label: Tremulous Vault of the Torch's Flame
aliases: Tremulous Vault of the Torch's Flame
summary: A Rego Ignem spell (Level 5) that causes a fire to quiver and then leap up to 10 feet in any direction; a Targeting roll is required to hit a specific target.

label: Tres Ex Miscellanea
summary: A rustic magus tried at the Provencal Tribunal of 1214 for interfering with mundanes after declaring Wizard's War and destroying a rival covenant's tower with an army.

label: Tresco
summary: Island in the Scillies with a small monastic community founded by Tavistock Abbey.

label: Trethevy Quoit
summary: A group of standing stones supporting a capstone, believed to be the home of a powerful faerie who does not like to be disturbed.

label: Trevelyan
summary: The first Trevelyan, the only man who escaped the drowning of Lyonesse by riding his white horse ahead of the flood to St. Michael's Mount.

label: Treverorum
summary: A former covenant in the city of Trier dedicated to recovering lost Roman secrets, approved in 1095 AD; abolished in 1172 AD after its magi repeatedly meddled in the affairs of mundanes and the Church.

label: Treviso
summary: Venetian city whose refugees founded Venice.

label: Trial by Combat
summary: Ordeal where accused and accuser fight; rare in 1220, seen only in lands of Saxon heritage.

label: Trial by Ordeal
summary: Court procedure invoking God's intervention to prove innocence; churchmen barred from it in 1215.

label: Triamore
summary: A covenant holding a castle and manorial estate by the river Meuse on the edge of the Ardennes at the western fringe of the Rhine Tribunal; led by Daria la Gris and embroiled in mundane politics.

label: Triamour
summary: Faerie Queen of Oleron who won Lanval.

label: Trianoma
summary: The maga and apprentice of Bonisagus who traveled widely to recruit wizards and negotiate the Oath of Hermes, becoming the driving force behind the founding of the Order. She declined to be one of the twelve Founders.

label: Trianoma's Cipher
summary: Secret shorthand code of magi Trianomae derived from Trianoma's Lab Text abbreviations.

label: Trianoma's third filia
summary: Reference duplicates Irmele.

label: Trianomans
summary: Wandering magi who politically defend certain sites of mystical significance across Mythic Europe.

label: Triath nan Leathad
summary: Iain Mac Gabhan's billy goat familiar.

label: Tribunal Coffers
summary: Tribunal funds kept by the Praeco, receiving fines and paying Quaesitors' investigation costs.

label: Tribunal Field of Durenmar
summary: The traditional grounds at Durenmar where the Rhine Tribunal gathers, containing the Forum and the ancient seat of Bjornaer; site of the Order's initiation ceremonies.

label: The Greater Alps Tribunal
summary: The Alpine Tribunal of the 'Sanctuary of Ice', a region of mountain covenants and hidden magic.

label: The Hibernian Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of Ireland, the 'Contested Isle', shaped by its native traditions and tense relations with newcomers.

label: The Loch Leglean Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of Scotland, the 'Lion of the North', a wild and contested land of Highland magic.

label: The Normandy Tribunal
summary: A competitive, resource-poor Tribunal where covenants vie for vis through the system of redes and fairs.

label: Tribunal of Novgorod
summary: A Hermetic Tribunal whose covenants often take advantage of the great fair of Thessalonica (the Demetria).

label: Tribunal of Transylvania
summary: A Hermetic Tribunal whose covenants frequent the great fair of Thessalonica for its eastern goods.

label: The Provençal Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of southern France, of 'Faith & Flame', set against the upheaval of the Albigensian Crusade.

label: The Rhine Tribunal
summary: The tradition-bound Tribunal of the Holy Roman Empire's heartlands, the 'Guardians of the Forests'.

label: The Roman Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal centered on Rome and Italy, ancient seat of Hermetic and mundane power.

label: The Stonehenge Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of England, the 'Heirs to Merlin', rich in ancient magic and Arthurian legacy.

label: Tribunal Summons
summary: A formal summons to a Hermetic tribunal that Redcaps must deliver at least six months before the tribunal takes place; rigorously enforced.

label: The Theban Tribunal
summary: The Tribunal of the Greek-speaking world, governed by Hellenic custom and the 'sundered eagle' of a divided empire.

label: The Transylvanian Tribunal
summary: The eastern Tribunal dominated by House Tremere, organized and hierarchical, standing 'against the dark'.

label: Tribunal Treasury
summary: Tribunal funds controlled by a Mercer House, which reimburses Tribunal expenses and collects fines.

label: Tribune
summary: Local Tremere advocate who speaks and votes for the House at Tribunal.

label: Trickery
summary: Act in which the villain deceives his intended victim to take possession of him or his belongings.

label: Trident
summary: Ancient piercing weapon.

label: Trier
summary: The oldest German city (Roman Augusta Treverorum), ruled by its archbishop; site of Roman remains, the Porta Nigra, the Cathedral of St. Peter, and the underground former covenant of Treverorum.

label: Trigger
summary: The precipitating event of a story's plot, dependent on the characters' actions or external to them.

label: Trinitarians
summary: Order known as Red Friars, founded in 1198 in France to ransom Christian captives.

label: Trip
summary: A Brawl maneuver wolves use to knock prey down during the kill.

label: Tristan
summary: Lover in the romance of Tristan and Iseult, whose adultery brings disaster.

label: Triumphal Arch
summary: Ruined Roman arch bearing carvings of Augustus and Mercury that must be rebuilt to enter the temple regio.

label: Trivia
summary: Threefold goddess of the roads, whose marble statue stands in a redcap exchange regio near Eisenstadt.

label: Trivium
summary: The first stage of medieval learning, taught to future lawyers and clerics.

label: Tro Briez
summary: Pilgrimage visiting the eight Breton founder-saint cathedrals.

label: Troad
summary: Area in which Bear Island sits.

label: Troche of Colocynth
summary: A Theriac of Level 5, Potency Weak, a compressed pill that causes violent bowel evacuations and can purge retained humors from a patient with a melancholic disease.

label: Trochilus
summary: The scatter-brained small brown wren who keeps the single gate of the city of Nephelococcygia.

label: Trods
summary: Special pathways that lead into and out of Faerie, connecting regio levels to each other and the mundane world and even leading to Arcadia; Arcadian Travel lets Merinitae create them at will.

label: Trojan War
summary: Legend more popular than the Golden Fleece.

label: Troll-wife
summary: Often beautiful female ettins who take heroic husbands and bear powerful magicians, or steal Gifted children.

label: Trolls
summary: A term with divergent meanings: a barrow-faerie ancestral spirit, a shaggy solitary giant of northern Scandinavia turned to stone by sunlight, or a small social faerie of southern Scandinavia.

label: Trollskap
summary: The magic of the trollsynir, performed like gruagach magic but using the Jotnar language and no tattoo magic.

label: Trollsynir
summary: Wizards said to live in Scandinavia and Iceland who claim descent from giants and bear the power to curse their enemies; a Damhadh-Duidsan variant.

label: Trondheim
summary: Norwegian archiepiscopal see, now Trondheim, claiming authority over Scottish bishops.

label: Tropaeum
summary: Normandy legal category of vis source, such as the Grove of St. Lie.

label: Trotula of Salerno
summary: A famous recent example of a female physician (medica) practicing medicine in Mythic Europe.

label: Troubadours
summary: A type of minstrel from southern France whose courtly love poetry, inspired by Arabic neighbors, is being destroyed by the Albigensian Crusade.

label: Troublesome Aura
summary: Minor Site Hook: a covenant aura whose alignment hinders activities.

label: Troupe
summary: The group of players of a saga, who choose which optional rules to use.

label: Troupe Upbringing
summary: A Minor General Virtue for a character raised among entertainers, granting +2 to rolls involving abilities in a selected area such as acrobatics or storytelling.

label: Trouvères
summary: A type of minstrel from northern France, concentrating on Arthurian poems, of whom Chrétien of Troyes is the most famous.

label: Trouvere
summary: Romantic troubadours of the Normandy Tribunal who sing tales of Charlemagne and Arthur.

label: Trow
summary: Faerie beings who live below the earth and cannot return home if caught above ground at sunrise; they may cast spontaneous Terram spells.

label: Troy
summary: City destroyed by the Greeks in the war before Ulysses' voyage.

label: Troyes
summary: Champagne fair city with Jewish community, home of Chrétien de Troyes and Rashi.

label: Truce of God
summary: Church proclamation restricting war on Fridays, Sundays, holy days and Lent.

label: True Cross
summary: Relic of which Henry I of Cyprus carries a fragment with 2 Faith Points.

label: True Faith
summary: A Divine blessing limited to beings not already part of the Divine Realm; creatures with Divine Might cannot have it, and Baal-Peor's vomit cannot touch those who possess it.

label: True Faith Magic Resistance
summary: Magic resistance derived from True Faith.

label: True form
summary: A magic character's essential qualities and shape: animal, human, spirit or thing.

label: True Lineages
summary: One of the three groups of Hermetic Houses (Bonisagus, Guernicus, Mercere, Tremere) made up entirely of those descended in training from a single Founder; cannot be joined later.

label: True Love
summary: A Minor General Virtue: the character has found the one person meant for them, giving +3 to appropriate Personality Trait rolls; the True Love must be another player character with this Virtue.

label: True Merinitae
summary: A cult and House lineage following Mendalus's effort to reconstruct Merinita's nature Mysteries, who claim to learn Nature Lore directly from the Founder via Agnes.

label: True Name
summary: A secret name expressing a being's spiritual essence, serving as an indefinite-duration Arcane Connection; demons, angels, jinn, and Daimons all have one, learned at a cost of 5 experience points.

label: True Naming
summary: Virtue first taught to Philosophers of Rome Initiates.

label: True Rest of the Injured Brute
aliases: True Rest of the Injured Brute
summary: A Creo Animal spell (Level 20) granting an injured animal target a +9 bonus to all Recovery rolls while the spell is in effect.

label: True Sight
summary: Example Greater Benediction seeing through glamour and shapechanges.

label: True Sight of the Air
summary: An Intellego Auram spell (Level 15) that lets the caster see clearly through smoke, fog, and dust, even if magical.

label: True Sight of the Air (cat power)
aliases: True Sight of the Air (cat power)
summary: Personal cat power, a version of the spell True Sight of the Air.

label: True Thomas
summary: Struck dumb by the faerie queen.

label: True Torah
summary: Primordial Torah of black fire on white fire residing in heaven.

label: Truffle Council Chamber
summary: Interior of the holt where roots form seats and a dais and the Truffle Matron hears the pleadings of her subjects.

label: Truffle Daughter
summary: Awakened truffles of Magic Might 20 who present issues to the Truffle Matron and can create Earth Elementals.

label: Truffle Daughters
summary: Offspring of the Truffle Matron.

label: Truffle Drone
summary: Awakened truffle warriors and guards of Magic Might 15, usually mounted on Boars of Virtue; the lowest social stratum of the regio, who do not vote.

label: Truffle Drones
summary: Inhabitants of the Truffle Regio.

label: Truffle Fields
summary: Second level of the truffle regio (Magic aura 5), where awakened truffles tend their crops among rings of awakened trees.

label: Truffle Holt
summary: Third level of the truffle regio (Magic aura 7): two concentric circles of awakened trees on a low hill where the Truffle Matron holds court.

label: Truffle Matron
summary: Awakened truffle of Magic Might 30 who rules the Magic creatures that cultivate truffles throughout Mythic Europe, holding council in her regio and rewarding helpers with vis.

label: Truffle of Virtue
summary: Unusually large vis-bearing truffle that can be Enriched by being eaten by a Magic creature; otherwise worth two pawns of Creo Herbam Dedicated vis.

label: Truffle's Healing Touch
summary: Ritual power of awakened truffles that instantly heals a plant of any injury, poison, or disease.

label: Truffle Worker
summary: The weakest and most abundant awakened truffles (Magic Might 10), who tend the fields and burrow away from danger.

label: Truffle Workers
summary: Inhabitants of the Truffle Regio.

label: Truffles
summary: Rare vis-bearing fungus containing Herbam vis.

label: Trun
summary: Small chartered forest community in Normandy.

label: Trust Me
summary: ReMe 20 spell counterbalancing the effect of The Gift on a mundane's attitude, not counted as scrying.

label: Trust of Childlike Faith
summary: A Perdo Mentem spell that destroys adult judgment regarding truth and falsity, used as a template for spells diminishing other mental capacities.

label: Trust of the Childlike Faith
summary: PeMe 10 effect in Hervé's enchanted devices.

label: Trust of the Innocent
summary: A demonic Mentem power making the victim believe a single plausible lie until contrary evidence appears.

label: Trutina the Quaesitor
summary: A beautiful mature maga and quaesitor who joined Burnham in 1195, says little, and instructs an unGifted Redcap to vote with Iudicium; wears the badge of House Guernicus.

label: Try Using the Other End
summary: Optional rule giving a -1 Attack penalty when a weapon deals its secondary damage type.

label: Tuareg
summary: A North African people with designated religious tribes; the Ineslemen Social Status belongs to one of these tribes.

label: Tuatha Dé Danann
summary: Powerful faeries replacing the Idaian Daktyls in the Hibernian variant, enslaved by Conaing.

label: Tuatha De Danann
summary: Irish mythic beings who fought the Fomorii.

label: Tuatha de Danu
summary: The fair folk of Ireland, said to be the children of the faerie goddess embodied in the Danube.

label: Tubuas
summary: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

label: Tubuel
summary: Angel named in Aldebert's heretical prayer.

label: Tueor
summary: Learned magician Technique ('I guard/protect') whose charms defend a target from specific harms; loosely analogous to Hermetic Rego.

label: Tuisto
summary: The earth-born god of Germanic legend whose son Mannus sired the three ancestral fathers of the German tribes.

label: Tulab Ibn Sina
summary: Students of Avicenna: elementalist tradition of accomplished Islamic physicians teaching Medicinal Summoning and Divining.

label: Tulgank
summary: An ugly mountain-spirit faerie melded forever into his cavern floor by the Seelie he loved; his petrified hand still nurtures a rose whose petals yield Herbam vis.

label: Tumiac Tumulus
summary: Tumulus.

label: Tundal
summary: Subject of a medieval otherworld vision.

label: Tunis
summary: Place near which the last Hermetic covenant in North Africa was founded.

label: Turati of Tytalus
summary: Luctatio magus who sets the rules of the covenant's game between Milan and Pavia.

label: Turb Trained
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character raised at a covenant and trained to fight in the turb, allowed to learn Martial Abilities at character creation.

label: Turba Philosophorum
summary: Translation of an Arabic alchemical work using the marriage simile.

label: Turbary
summary: The right to cut peat.

label: Turbulence
summary: An uncontrolled magical outburst of a Gifted child's Gift caused by strong emotion or a botched magical activity.

label: Turbulence Prone
summary: Major Child Flaw for Gifted characters: must check for turbulence on every potential magical botch.

label: Turcopoles
summary: Levantine mounted archers.

label: Turcopolier
summary: Official responsible for mercenary cavalry and brother-sergeants.

label: Turks
summary: Asiatic nomads who use the composite bow.

label: Turn the Man into his Appropriate Form
aliases: Turn the Man into his Appropriate Form
summary: TaSh 20 spell turning a human into a land animal mirroring his Personality Traits, e.g. a liar into a snake.

label: Turnis
summary: The second Primus of House Verditius who developed the ritual allowing other Hermetic magi to join the House and set the rules of the Contest.

label: Tursus
summary: Almost a faerie god of northern merfolk, lord of seal beaches, likely to accompany invading Norse; Faerie Might 40.

label: Tursus Auvekoejaks
summary: Supernatural being listed among island inserts.

label: Tuscany
summary: Region where magi reputedly serve on councils.

label: Tusculum
summary: Cardinal-bishop town.

label: Twelve Apostles
summary: The apostles who spread the story of Jesus Christ after Pentecost.

label: Twelve Laws of Love
summary: Rules of love listed by Andreas Capellanus.

label: Twelver Shi'is
summary: Most numerous Shi'i division, recognizing twelve imams, the last in occultation until he returns as mahdi.

label: Twilight
summary: The mysterious altered state magi enter from excess magic; prolonged exposure leads to Final Twilight, removing a magus from the mortal world.

label: Twilight Avoidance
summary: Roll to avoid Twilight, also used to avoid magical disasters.

label: Twilight Comprehension
summary: Roll (Intelligence + Enigmatic Wisdom + stress die) used to navigate and comprehend experiences in the Twilight Void.

label: Twilight Mastery
summary: A new Major Hermetic Virtue letting a magus choose the effects of Wizard's Twilight and induce Warping in others; the second Fruit of the Path of Warping.

label: Twilight Prone
summary: Hermetic Flaw compared to the monistic mystic's susceptibility to Divine Ascent.

label: Twilight Scar
summary: A lasting supernatural mark left on a magus by Twilight episodes; Philippus Niger bears many, including one that causes only male children to be born where he lives.

label: Twilight Void
summary: A part of the Magic Realm fundamentally different from the rest, a timeless place connecting other places, reached through boundaries or vestiges and divided into provinces by Form.

label: Twinning the Quill
summary: ReAn 19 effect in the Quills of Arcane Correspondence that mirrors the movements of one quill in the other.

label: Twinning the Tome
summary: CrAn50 Boosted Ritual creating a near-perfect copy of a book.

label: Twist
summary: Story component, especially important in intrigue stories, in which things are not what they first seemed.

label: Twist of the Tongue
summary: A Perdo Corpus spell that twists the target's tongue into a spiral, destroying the ability to speak; a grave offense to a magus.

label: Twist the Living Tree
summary: A Rego Herbam spell (Level 25) that bends a living tree into unusual positions to form a cage, shelter, or wall while the caster maintains concentration.

label: Twisted Spine
summary: A Minor Curse (Rego Corpus effect) that twists the victim's spine grotesquely, imposing -3 to social rolls.

label: Two Borders
summary: Faeries that exist simultaneously on physical and developmental borders.

label: Two-Handed Mace
summary: Ability appearing in character or covenant library statistics in the Roman Tribunal.

label: Two-headed Hound
summary: A corrupt beast (Might 10, Animal) appearing as a huge two-headed dog whose heads hate each other; able to spit fire, created by a diabolist as a sanctum guard.

label: Tyne River
summary: River along which Horsingas lies.

label: (Type) Controlling
summary: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Controlling 0.

label: (Type) Divining
summary: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Divining 0.

label: (Type) Refining
summary: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Refining 0.

label: (Type) Summoning
summary: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Summoning 0 for a type.

label: Typhon
summary: Mythic being temporarily imprisoned in Cehennem before Mount Etna.

label: Typical Source of Income
summary: Income level granted by some Boons.

label: Tyr
summary: Norse god of justice, truth and battle who sacrificed his hand to bind the Fenris wolf; Tiwaz is his rune.

label: Tyr's Aett
summary: The third aett of the Elder Futhark, named after Tyr, containing Tiwaz through Othila.

label: Tyre
summary: City where Origen's tomb is honored, a site of importance to the Magoi of the Star.

label: Tyrrhenian Sea
summary: Sea into which Verdi's stream eventually flows.

label: Tytalan Ink
summary: A charged item in the form of colorless ink that becomes visible (turns black or another color) upon a command word, used by Tytalan magi for secret writing.

label: Tzadik Nistar
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is one of the Tzadikim Nistarim, the 36 hidden righteous on whom the world's continuation relies, destined to face a moment of moral decision.

label: Tzelmoth
summary: Jewish degree of Hell, the Shadow of Death.

label: Uamh na Croig
summary: Covenant destroyed by giants in 977 after its magi hunted the giants for sport.

label: Ubertino of Verditius
summary: Verditius who made the three swords Faith, Love and Truth.

label: Uierna of House Bonisagus
summary: Bonisagus magus whose quoted account describes the gruagachan and their magic in Scotland.

label: Łuków
summary: Future Templar site in Prussia.

label: Ulaid
summary: Irish region covered in The Contested Isle; Brother Bressal's Gaelic specialty.

label: Ulf
summary: An example Bjornaer magus with a wolf heartbeast who communicates with his Great Beast ancestor and is initiated into the Mystery of the Anima, gaining a shadow-wolf inner heartbeast.

label: Ulm
summary: A city on the northern bank of the upper Danube first settled by Jews in the 9th century, declared a Free Imperial City by Frederick Barbarossa in 1164 and known for linen weaving.

label: Ulster
summary: Region in the Hibernian variant, between Lough Neagh and the northern coast, where the Cursewood could be set.

label: Ultima Thule
summary: A far-northern region where the walking dead are prevalent, leading Donatores there to concentrate on Corpus.

label: Ultor
summary: A Summa on Penetration (Level 5, Quality 11) by Elaine, emphasizing penetrating the Parma Magica.

label: Ulysses
summary: Greek hero who blinded Polyphemus on Sicily's east coast returning from Troy.

label: 'Umar
summary: Second caliph, entombed at the Mosque of the Prophet.

label: 'Umar ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz
summary: Umayyad caliph (r. 717-20) credited with the pact of the dhimmis.

label: Umayyads
summary: Caliphal dynasty (r. 660-750); the Umayyad caliph's forces killed al-Husayn.

label: Umbria
summary: Region of the Roman Tribunal containing Gubbio.

label: Umno
summary: Previous Primus of House Tremere, now governing the Burning Acorn Vexillation.

label: Unaffected by The Gift
summary: A Minor General Virtue: the character is not affected by the negative effects of The Gift or Magical Air in others, even a Blatant Gift.

label: Unaging
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: the character does not suffer the effects of age, with aging points only building up Decrepitude points rather than reducing Characteristics.

label: Unbaptised
summary: Major Story Flaw among the new Christian Flaws.

label: Unbaptized
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is a Christian who has never been baptized, often due to a supernatural background, and does not benefit from the sacraments.

label: Unbearable to (Beings)
summary: A Minor Hermetic or General Flaw in which one of three classes of beings is extremely disturbed by the character, adding -3 to social interactions; only for characters with The Gift or Magical Air.

label: Unbound by Land
summary: Folk witch initiation script requiring a season above ground; grants Flight and Arthritis.

label: Unbound Tongue
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: when transformed into a non-human form, the character may speak any human languages he knows without impediment, and a magus may still cast spells with his voice.

label: Unbridled Emotion of the Masses
summary: Malachi's Power seizing up to a hundred targets with his current emotion.

label: Uncertain Faith
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which doubt stands between the character and the Divine, giving -3 to holy influence rolls and a +1 Personality Trait that demons exploit.

label: Uncle (foreman elf)
summary: A portly, hedonistic foreman elf.

label: Uncontrollable Strength
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character doesn't know his own strength, requiring a stress roll against Ease Factor 6 to avoid overdoing delicate tasks.

label: Undecorated
summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab has spartan or absent decoration, making it uninspiring (-1 Upkeep, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Under-Marshal
summary: Brother-sergeant supporting the marshal.

label: Undermining
summary: Siege attack in which miners dig a supported tunnel under a wall and burn the supports to collapse it; resolved with Profession Sapper.

label: Understanding
summary: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability gained by a vision before a Byzantine crucifix at Saint Damien.

label: Understanding (Virtue)
summary: Major Virtue and Supernatural Power of Understanding associated with True Faith mystics.

label: Underwater
summary: A Minor laboratory Supernatural Flaw: the lab is filled with water instead of air, causing breathing and movement difficulties (+2 Safety, +1 Warping, -2 Aesthetics, +4 Aquam).

label: Underworld
summary: The realm where the gods of the dead imprisoned the titans, the resentful spirits Tytalus sought out and forged pacts with to oppose Guorna.

label: Undine
summary: Courtly faeries inhabiting rivers, especially boundary rivers, progenitors of mortal lineages like the rulers of Lusignan.

label: Undine Blood
summary: Faerie Blood variety from river courtly faeries granting underwater bonuses.

label: Undoing the Stonemason's Handiwork
summary: A PeTe 15 spell that smashes masonry or pavement into component stones; used by School of Vilano followers to produce loose stones for ammunition or to collapse structures.

label: Unease of the Still Forest
summary: A Mentem power of the bockman faeries that radiates an aura of unease up to 100 paces, silencing birds and instilling growing dread and paranoia in those within.

label: Uneven Floor
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab has a wonky or dangerous floor, e.g. a cave or sand-covered floor (-1 Safety, -1 Health, -1 Aesthetics).

label: Ungulus
summary: A declining 'Winter' covenant in a carved tower in the Lake District, founded by House Flambeau and later home to a productive Verditius line; filled with magical treasures.

label: Unhappily Married
summary: A major Story Flaw where a merchant has married for money rather than love and seeks solace outside the marital bed, hiding affairs from spouse and family.

label: Unholy Methods
summary: The Infernal 'Techniques' of maleficia, Debauchery and Incantation, describing what the infernalist must do.

label: Unholy Powers
summary: Category of Infernal Abilities (Consumption, Diablerie, Effusion, Malediction, Phantasm, Psychomachia).

label: Unicorn
summary: A legendary horned beast whose horn provides Shape and Material bonuses to healing (+8), poison detection (+10), and fertility (+11).

label: Unicorns
summary: Fifth degree: fermentation, Mercury, white; ambassadors who learn the Lesser Elixir.

label: Unimaginative Learner
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character has trouble figuring things out, subtracting 3 from rolls when studying from raw vis.

label: Uninspirational
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is bland and boring; Presence and Communication may not exceed 0, and social Abilities used to impress suffer -3.

label: Unique Quest
summary: A very specific Quest that no similar Quester could repeat, such as bringing the head of the Minotaur; grants +6 instead of +3.

label: Universally Liked
summary: Example Greater Benediction giving social bonuses.

label: Universities
summary: Studia generalia of masters and students organized like guilds with four faculties.

label: University at Stamford
summary: University of necromancers founded by Bladud at Stamford and later suppressed by the Church for heresy.

label: University Dean
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the character is the head of a university overseeing internal and external affairs; requires the Doctor in (Faculty) Virtue and age 40+.

label: University Grammar Teacher
summary: A Minor Social Status Virtue for a character employed by a university to teach grammar to younger members, able to purchase Latin and Artes Liberales.

label: University Lore
summary: Lore Ability of the Franciscan Teacher template.

label: University of Arezzo
summary: A small student-run Italian university south of Florence, founded in 1215, offering faculties of law, medicine, and the arts.

label: University of Naples
summary: A planted university to be instituted by Frederick II of Naples in 1224, drawing masters from Salerno.

label: University of Palencia
summary: A royal Spanish university founded by King Alfonso VIII of Castile in 1208, with faculties of arts, canon law, and theology, overseen by the Bishop of Palencia.

label: University of Paris
summary: An influential medieval university that in 1220 has banned teaching the New Aristotle under threat of excommunication, with its bans echoing throughout northern Europe.

label: University of Reggio
summary: A small student-run Italian university northwest of Bologna teaching law exclusively, founded by departing Bolognese scholars.

label: University of Salamanca
summary: A royal Spanish university founded by Alfonso IX of León in 1218, notable for offering a music degree and admitting women scholars.

label: University of Vicenza
summary: A short-lived Italian university swarmed from Bologna, lasting from 1204 until scholars returned to Bologna in 1210.

label: Unknown Letters and Unknown Language
summary: Hildegard's writings in her own devised script, Dominion Lore tractatus, possibly Enigmatic Wisdom.

label: Unlucky
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character is exceptionally unlucky, getting -1 to -3 on rolls in luck-based situations.

label: Unmaking
summary: Butchering of the slain prey, followed by the curee, the rewarding of the dogs.

label: Unmarked Passage
summary: Cat power, a version of Trackless Step.

label: Unnatural Magic
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which none of the character's Creo rituals have permanent effect due to the illusory nature of his magic, and he cannot extract vis with Creo.

label: Unpredictable Magic
summary: A Minor Hermetic Flaw in which the character always rolls a stress die when using magic and must always roll at least one botch die, even with Mastered spells.

label: Unquiet Spirit
summary: Ghost power (ReTe 25) for telekinetic flinging of objects.

label: Unravel That Which is Cast
summary: Tractatus on Vim by Dairmuid of Ex Miscellanea, Quality 10.

label: Unraveling
summary: A new Mastery special ability applicable to Perdo Vim spells, adding three times the Mastery score to the spell's effective level for destroying magic.

label: Unraveling the Fabric of (Form)
summary: A Perdo Vim 20 spell enchanted into Philippus Niger's talisman with ten related effects, one for each Hermetic Form; basis for Shattering the Malicious Rune.

label: Unraveling the Fabric of Imaginem
summary: A Perdo Vim (PeVi 20) spell that dispels Imaginem (image) magic.

label: Unravelling
summary: A Mastered Spell special ability for Perdo Vim spells, adding three times Mastery score to the effective level when destroying a targeted magical effect.

label: Unravelling the Fabric of Aquam
summary: PeVi 40 effect in Regulus' Staff cancelling Aquam effects; similar effects exist for Auram, Herbam and Terram.

label: Unravelling the Fabric of (Form)
summary: A Perdo Vim spell that cancels the effects of one spell of a specified Form; ten Form variants exist plus rarer non-Hermetic variants.

label: Unrelenting Struggle
summary: Camuel's power to fight all night without Fatigue.

label: Unruly Air
summary: A Minor Supernatural Flaw in which the character's presence subtly pushes others to extreme behavior in social situations; those with Magic Resistance are unaffected.

label: Unseat
summary: Non-lethal special effect dragging a rider from the saddle; possible with halberds, pole arms, nets and whips.

label: Unseat Rider
summary: Maneuver to pull a rider from his horse.

label: Unseelie
summary: A dark faction of faeries; an Unseelie faerie lord holds a melancholy feast on the last day of winter at which a doomed mortal is danced to death, leaving footprints where destroying angel mushrooms grow.

label: Unseelie Court
summary: The dark faeries, mostly solitary in Scotland, who lurk in streams, pools and ruins and often kill mortals.

label: Unseen Arm
summary: A Rego Terram spell (ReTe 5) used to hold an object in the air without concentration; moving the object still requires concentration.

label: Unspecialized
summary: A Minor General Flaw in which the character does not have any specialties for any of her Abilities.

label: Unspunnen
summary: Castle overlooking Interlaken.

label: Unspunnens
summary: Noble family that ruled much of the Oberland, ending with the heiress Ida.

label: Unstable
summary: A Free laboratory Structure Flaw: the lab is prone to movement, e.g. on a ship or earthquake-prone, causing occasional accidents (+1 Upkeep, -1 Safety).

label: Unstable Magic
summary: Minor Supernatural Flaw: folk witch lab creations decay after a year and a day.

label: Unstructured Caster
summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw in which the character casts all Formulaic spells as Ritual spells (including needing vis) and may not learn Ritual spells, but casts Spontaneous spells normally.

label: Unterwalden
summary: Region where Tarragon Vale is perched on a misty hilltop.

label: Until (Duration)
summary: A Duration lasting until a certain thing occurs; treated as equivalent to Year but not requiring a Ritual.

label: Unusually Fecund
summary: Example Lesser Benediction ensuring conception.

label: Unveiling the Tempest
summary: Summa on Auram by Daniel Tonatris.

label: Unyielding Earth
summary: A Rego Terram spell that compacts the ground surface in a 15-by-15-pace area, making it more solid.

label: Upper Lorraine
summary: A duchy that came into existence on the division of the Carolingian empire, a moderately populated rolling plain bounded by the Vosges, Rhine, Ardennes, and Argonne; its seat is Nancy.

label: Upside
summary: One end of Devil's Lane; those who know how can walk to its end to enter the Faerie Realm.

label: Uranus
summary: Primordial sky god, father of Dindyméné.

label: Urban (Church Hook)
summary: Covenant Hook: covenant based in a town, whose protections extend to mundane neighbors.

label: Urban Parish
summary: Example church in one of the larger towns of a diocese, with canons, a guild altar, a Jewish minority, and a Divine aura of 5.

label: Urbastis cult
summary: Cult known through Legend Lore to the familiar Crucifixio.

label: Urchin
summary: Sample eleven-year-old grog, daughter of a branded outlaw living on city streets who aims to lead a gang of child thieves.

label: Urd
summary: The Weaver, representing time and fate, of Ymir's second brood.

label: Urgen
summary: An Archmage of House Bjornaer (heartbeast of a bear) holding the Seat of the Bear at Crintera; former Primus (1165-1203), leader of the Hawthorn Gild and the most influential Wilderist.

label: Urgen of Crintera
summary: Leader of the Weissdorngilde (Hawthorn Gild), a follower of House Bjornaer from the covenant of Crintera.

label: Uriel, the Angel of Punishment
summary: The 'fire (or light) of God', a Seraph and Archangel of the Presence, Patron of Prophecy and Angel of Punishment who watches over the torments of Hell; removed from the Western Church's list by Pope Zachary in 745.

label: Ursula Densacer
summary: Clan Chief of Clan Arelie, a wolf-heartbeast maga acclaimed for erudition and poetry, and a friend of Prima Falke.

label: Uruz
summary: Elder Futhark rune "Auroch" used as a vitkir Art. Rune of the aurochs, symbolizing strength, stamina and the wild; targets wild or magical animals (Animal) and wild weather (Auram).

label: Usama ibn Munqidh
summary: A historical author (d. 1188) quoted from The Book of Learning by Example describing an angelic rescue on a mountain, illustrating the angel Nasir.

label: Usul al-fiqh
summary: The principles of jurisprudence: Qur'an, Sunna, ijma' and qiyas.

label: Usurer
summary: A Minor Social Status Flaw in which the character lends valuables at abusive interest rates, earning about ten pounds of silver yearly but holding a poor reputation at level 4.

label: Usury
summary: The Church's moral crime of charging interest on loans, which Redcaps avoid the appearance of when lending vis.

label: Uswaurpa
summary: A byname ('reject') for a Bjornaer magus known to have shapeshifted before Initiation, who acquires the scorn of his peers.

label: Uther Pendragon
summary: Brother of King Aurelius who led fifteen thousand knights to Ireland with Merlin to fetch the stones of the Giant's Ring; he later fathered Arthur at Tintagel while magically disguised as Gorlois.

label: 'Uthman
summary: Third caliph who dropped the Prophet's seal ring down a well in 650 and was later assassinated.

label: Vörys-mort
summary: An enormous, extremely swift giant who can look over the forest and sometimes drives animals toward hunters' traps on the Volga.

label: Vésone
summary: Sacred spring source of Aquam vis.

label: Vézère
summary: River valley with Magic aura and painted caves leading to a regio.

label: Vézelay
summary: Benedictine monastery with relics of Mary Magdalene.

label: Vagi Scholares
summary: 'Wandering scholars', a lesser chapter of the Ordo Vagorum centered in Austria and the eastern Alps.

label: Vagrancy
summary: The low crime of lacking a House or residential Tribunal, which can lead to a March if uncorrected.

label: Val Fanes
summary: Faerie valley in Ticino where Andru fought a faerie king.

label: Val Gardena
summary: Valley in the Dolomites where the Rosegarten can be seen at dusk.

label: Val Negra
summary: A lost covenant of the Provençal Tribunal, one of the first covenants of the Order founded by Flambeau himself, which suffered in the Schism War and whose location is now lost.

label: Val-Negra
summary: The original domus magna of House Flambeau in the Pyrenees, founded by Flambeau against the sahirs; it has since sunk deep into Winter and lost Elaine's library.

label: Valdemar I
summary: The Danish king whose invasion of Rügen in 1168 surprised the Bjornaer covenant of Crintera and triggered its crisis.

label: Valdemar II
summary: The King of Denmark, relatively secure with Schleswig and Holstein under his control, who in the historical timeline grants Kolding a full charter in 1230.

label: Valdus
summary: A magus of House Tytalus charged in 1109 AD by Treverorum for theft of vis from a site outside Trier; fined one pawn of vis and ordered to seek permission before harvesting again.

label: Vale Galina
summary: Vale with a dragon hoard.

label: Vale of Angels
summary: Site on the Circuit of Saint Patrick.

label: Vale of Hinnom
summary: Valley by Jerusalem once used for child sacrifice to Molech; a powerful Tartaran regio with temples to the Devil.

label: Valefar
summary: The Thief's Demon, a Tempter appearing as a large hairless lion with a man's head, who aids thieves, teaches making hands of glory, and hates Hermetic magi.

label: Valerian
summary: Chief hoplite of Normandy, Terram master reputed to be in the Terrae cult, with an invisible spirit familiar.

label: Valerius
summary: Archmagus and current Secutor of House Tremere whose mind was damaged in a faerie forest.

label: Valerius Flaccus
summary: Plagiarist author of a dull but accurate Latin Argonautika.

label: Valetudo
summary: The sixth astrological house.

label: Valhalla
summary: Norse hall where Valkyries act as serving maids.

label: Valkyrie
summary: Faerie minor goddesses of the Norse pantheon (Might 20) who ride wolves above battlefields to select the worthy dead for transformation into einherjar; they also serve as maids in Valhalla.

label: Vallegloria
summary: Monastery at Spello in Umbria where Balvina became abbess.

label: Valley of No Return
summary: Valley holding the unfaithful.

label: Vallombrosa
summary: Motherhouse of the Vallumbrosans in the mountains near Florence.

label: Vallumbrosans
summary: Small, rigorously enclosed and ascetic order founded by Saint John Gualbert, with strong papal influence; possibly secretly diabolist.

label: Valnastium
summary: The domus magna of House Jerbiton, a secluded valley covenant in the Greater Alps founded by Iconophiles to store icons and relics; filled with alien ancient art and home to the cats of the Black Lineage.

label: Valor Passion
summary: Passion usable in place of Brave against The Ring of Terror.

label: Valoran
summary: Student/filius of St. Nerius, rumored founder of Cunfin's monastery and believed parens of Angelus.

label: Valvasore
summary: Catalan noble with a retinue of five knights, similar to a banneret.

label: Vambraces
summary: Arm armor.

label: Vampire
summary: A type of dark faerie found in the Transylvania Tribunal that returns from the grave, fathers dhampirs, and has varied vulnerabilities such as crossroads and church bells.

label: Vampirism
summary: Babhan sith power to suck the blood of her dancing partners, draining body levels.

label: Vanaheim
summary: Legendary land existing in Faerie only within stories.

label: Vanasalus of Criamon
summary: A young, friendly Criamon maga of Semitae who believes magic reflects one's personality and follows Gerfallon to understand the Enigma.

label: Vandals
summary: Germanic invaders who sacked Rome and conquered Sicily and Sardinia.

label: Vanguard
summary: The member of a group whose statistics drive its attacks; a group with no vanguard can't attack and the leader may designate a new one as a fast action.

label: Vanir
summary: Norse gods allied with the Æsir against the Jotnar.

label: Vanishing Away
summary: The unexplained disappearance of Tarragon Vale's magi and covenfolk twenty-two years ago.

label: Vannes
summary: Town used as a reference point for placing the Cursewood in the Normandy Tribunal.

label: Varator
summary: Demon of vengeance tied to the hedge wizard refugees plotting against the Order.

label: Vardian's Skull
summary: Ancient artifact of three hedge wizards destroyed by Flambeau; its power created the Magical Aura of Vardian's Tomb.

label: Vardian's Tomb
summary: Unrecognized covenant in a forgotten catacomb south of Rome near the Tiber, fractured between Jerbiton founders and Ex Miscellanea necromancers.

label: Variable Power
summary: A Minor Supernatural Virtue: one of the character's magic powers grows more powerful over time based on age, Might, Warping, or an Ability score.

label: Variola
summary: A Serious Choleric Disease from putrid choler accumulating in the skin; highly contagious and disfiguring.

label: Varkos
summary: A misshapen fire drake living in a mountain cave who desperately wants to be seen as a fearsome dragon.

label: Varriar
summary: Demon Lord of the Avengers of Evil and Lord of Discipline behind the corrupt Vallumbrosans, posing as Abbot Curtaigne; true form a huge angel of blue flame with a whip.

label: Varstus
summary: An Italian Alps wizard skilled in sympathetic magic whom Flambeau confronted with the words 'Join us or die!' in 771 and slew when he fled.

label: Varus Disaster
summary: Roman defeat killing 60,000 legionaries whose ghosts routed Diedne magi.

label: Vassalage
summary: Feudal bond between lord and vassal providing resources, advice, and warriors.

label: Vast Sanctuary
summary: Minor church Hook: by custom anyone may seek sanctuary within a wide area around the church, often putting the priest in conflict with the sheriff.

label: Vatican
summary: Papal residence where Francis requested an audience with Innocent III.

label: Vedast
summary: Bishop of Arras who restored a blind man's sight.

label: Vederis
summary: A famous magus of House Criamon who wrote The Travels of Fedoso, a classic work of esoteric lore.

label: Veil All Eyes
summary: Lesser non-Hermetic ReMe ritual letting participants pass unnoticed.

label: Veil of Fire
summary: Carmine's sigil, an orange-red bridal veil embroidered with the hourglass of Flambeau, kept by Andru.

label: Veil of Invisibility
summary: A Perdo Imaginem spell (Level 20) that makes the target completely undetectable to normal sight regardless of what it does, though it still casts a shadow.

label: Velitus
summary: The certamen Style of the Spear, which wears down an opponent's magical resistance, potentially making their Resistance Total negative.

label: Velox
summary: Magus of Mercere at Harco maintaining defenses and making items.

label: Venafro
summary: Italian Redcap who harvested vis in lands left by the Diedne into chess-pawn tokens, giving rise to the 'pawn' unit.

label: Venatores
summary: A loose group of demon-hunting magi from any House who pass their knowledge through an advanced apprenticeship; poorly regarded in the Order.

label: Venatus
summary: An eighty-year-post-Gauntlet Collegium-turned-Lyceum magus of Trianoma's lineage who discovered the New Aristotle at Bologna, split from the Collegium to found the Lyceum, and still teaches at a university.

label: Vendée
summary: Thinly populated northwest corner of Aquitaine of forest, moor and marsh.

label: Vendôme
summary: Town on the River Loir with the Abbey of the Trinity.

label: Vendetta
summary: A Major Story Flaw in which the magus is engaged in one of House Verditius' vendettas, often inherited from his parens, against another Verditius magus; restricted to Verditius magi.

label: Venditor
