label: Wyrd
summary: One of the six known lands of Arcadia: the land of the air.

label: Wyrms
summary: Creatures found in dark places.

label: Wyzwanie
summary: A powerful daimon and genius loci embodying the Cursewood's hostile forest, who tests intruders and guards the infernal artifact; Magic Might 40 (Herbam).

label: Xanten
summary: A town on the west bank of the Rhine, formerly the Roman colony Colonia Ulpia Traiana, birthplace of the hero Siegfried and former capital of Nibelungland.

label: Xantippes
summary: A magus of House Jerbiton who helped found Treverorum to recover Roman secrets, later found guilty of meddling with the mundanes of Trier using his own Mentem magics for personal enrichment.

label: Xaphan
summary: Forge-man of Hell and chief stoker of Hell's fires, an Aerial Power of brass with bellows, who suggested burning Heaven during the rebellion.

label: Xavier
summary: A Gifted magus of House Mercere, the Rhine Tribunal's only Gifted Mercere and its archivist, who dwells at Durenmar at one of the two official Mercer Houses.

label: Xavier of House Mercere
summary: Archivist of the Rhine Tribunal, attributed as the source of an in-world quotation about the Bingen Hole.

label: Xenophon of Bonisagus
summary: The Bonisagus magus who founded the Platonist Hermetic societas the Collegium, believing the Founder had stripped Hermetic Theory of any inquiry into magic's nature or origin.

label: Xerxes
summary: A hoplite magus who took Uwe as an apprentice and trained him to become Darius, a hunter of evils within the Order; he is now too frail for combat.

label: Xoanon of Dindyméné
summary: A wooden effigy carved by Argos with Magic powers to create a bear or lion, command beasts, and summon a storm; required to wake or sleep Dindyméné.

label: Y Gododdin
summary: The single famous poem by which the Welsh poet Aneirin is known, praising the war band of Mynyddawg Mwynfawr sent to recapture a Roman stronghold from the Saxons.

label: Yallery Brown
summary: Faerie released from under a stone who worked in gratitude, then tormented his master to death after being thanked.

label: Yan den Houtkapper
summary: Giant of Steenvoorde who made everlasting boots for Charlemagne.

label: Yanartas
summary: A site near the Antalya Gulf in Asia Minor, where the mythical Chimera fell and fire leaps from the ground, location of one of Hephaestus's forges.

label: Yannes
summary: Parens of Darius.

label: Yarrow of Corpus Vis
summary: Yarrow vis (soldier's wort) that heals wounds completely.

label: Yaudet
summary: Hilltop with a regio.

label: Yearly Aura Modifier
summary: The annual sum of effects on an aura; values beyond +/-3 trigger rolls on the Aura Strengthening or Weakening Tables.

label: Yenghissar
summary: A small village along the route to Khashgar plagued every seven years by the Infernal storm spirit known as the Buran.

label: Yeshiva
summary: A Jewish school where students learn grammar and Jewish instruction by studying the Talmud and Mishnah from the local rabbi; large ones are in Cordoba and Granada.

label: Yeshivah
summary: Advanced school where learned rabbis teach.

label: Yeshivah shel Malah
summary: Celestial level 5 regio where the dead study the True Torah under Zagzagel.

label: Yesod
summary: Sefirah meaning 'Foundation', level 2 on the Tree of Life; understood by a kabbalist with Kabbalah 2.

label: Yetzirah
summary: Third of the Four Worlds (Formation), considered Arcadia or the Invisible World of angels and spirits.

label: Yeun Elez
summary: Peat bog.

label: Yezer ha-ra
summary: The evil inclination within every person upon which a shedeh feeds.

label: Yezer ra
summary: Jewish term for the inclination towards evil, dominating demons.

label: Yezer tov
summary: Jewish term for the inclination towards good, absent in demons.

label: Yezidi
summary: Real-world Kurdish religion venerating Malak Ta'us, the Peacock Angel, oppressed as devil-worshipers; distinct from the Mulhidun.

label: Yfel spirits
summary: Malign landvaettir whose lords take captured Julius for amusement and who can suppress a captive's Gift.

label: Ygerna
summary: Gorlois's wife, sought by Uther; she received the disguised Uther into her bed at Tintagel and conceived Arthur.

label: Ymir
summary: The Protogonos of the Norse lands, a primordial giant slain by the gods whose body formed the world; progenitor of two races of kosmokrators.

label: Yofiel
summary: The Prince of the Torah, an angel summoned after forty days of fasting in the Ma'aseh Merkavah.

label: Yom Kippur
summary: Jewish holy day; atonement between it and Sukkot drives demons from a household for a year.

label: Yonec
summary: The son of a hawk-knight and an imprisoned lady in a Lai of Marie de France; he avenged his father by killing the jealous old lord and took his father's place as king.

label: Yonec's ring and sword
summary: Gifts the dying hawk-knight gave his lover: a ring ensuring her husband would remember nothing, and a sword for their son Yonec to avenge him.

label: Yonnlius
summary: Bonisagus magus, a Master in the Rhine Tribunal, who caught and studied the cat-fish.

label: York
summary: The largest town of northern England and seat of the second English archbishop, a port on the River Ouse, site of the 1190 massacre of the Jews.

label: Yorkshire
summary: Region with a tale that revenants are destroyed by stakes through their hearts.

label: Youdig
summary: Entrance to Hell in Yeun Elez.

label: Young Henry
summary: The eldest son of Henry II at whose court William Marshal served, leading his mesnie at tournaments; he died of dysentery having taken a crusading vow.

label: Young Ladies
summary: Some 30 standing stones near Langon.

label: Younger Futhark
summary: A condensed 16-rune variant developed in Denmark and Germany; less versatile than the Elder Futhark.

label: Your One True Friend
summary: Patarus' power causing trust in an authority figure.

label: Ypres
summary: Major Flemish cloth and linen city.

label: Yr (Futhorc)
summary: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Bow", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

label: Ys
summary: A kingdom destroyed by the Red Knight after its princess gave him the key to its sea defences.

label: Yselt filia Rosalia
summary: Ice-distorted, faerie-blooded senior Merinita maga who leads the Covenant Where Journeys End and holds a veto; her sigil is the icicle.

label: Yuval
summary: Senior Redcap of the Mercer House in Barcelona, which is named after him.

label: Yuval's
summary: Informal name of the Mercer House in Barcelona, named after its senior Redcap and reputed as a wealthy, slightly sinister house of magic and vice.

label: Zähringen Family
summary: Noble family of the Alps who began the craze of founding new towns to consolidate their lands into a continuous bloc and serve as points of military strength.

label: Zachariel
summary: Ruler of Raqia.

label: Zachiel
summary: Ruler of Zebul.

label: Zadkiel
summary: An archangel listed by Dionysus the Areopagite among the archangels.

label: Zagzagel
summary: Angel who presides over the Yeshivah shel Malah.

label: Zahid
summary: Mythic Companions who are exceptionally ascetic Sufis, often shaykhs, able to work miraculous karamas and synchronize followers' efforts.

label: Zakat
summary: Alms-tax; Infernal creatures cannot handle goods given as zakat.

label: Zalambur
summary: Son of Iblis with dominion over mercantile dishonesty.

label: Zanzibar
summary: A rich city, reachable by circumnavigating Africa, where gold is traded by equal weight for salt; a potential reward for an insured speculative covenant expedition.

label: Zara
summary: City captured in the Fourth Crusade.

label: Zawiya
summary: Sufi home at a saint's tomb.

label: Zebul
summary: The Sixth Heaven of icy storms, home of Cherubim and Phoenixes, ruled by Zachiel and Sabath.

label: Zelos
summary: The Daimon of rivalry, envy, and competition, appearing as a winged Greek youth with a laurel crown; he propagates contention but never helps resolve conflicts.

label: Zephyrus
summary: Air elementals composed of chains of octahedral corpuscles, encompassing wind, cloud, and lightning forms; utterly restless, highly perceptive travelers that crave the dissolution of barriers.

label: Zerachiel
summary: An angel named in some lists of the archangels.

label: Zeus
summary: The god who raised Orpheus's lyre into the stars, taken by the Orphic cult as a sign of Orpheus's apotheosis.

label: Zita
summary: Future mystic who is an infant in 1220.

label: Zlatorog
summary: White chamois with golden horns on Mount Triglav in Slovenia that tricks hunters into falling over precipices and heals by eating the red flower grown from its blood.

label: Zmey
summary: A variety of dragon native to the Transylvania Tribunal that guards villages against evil spirits, flies, shapeshifts and charms young women; females are zmeyitsas.

label: Zodiac
summary: The 12 great constellations whose signs, decans and houses form the basis of astrological correspondences.

label: Zora
summary: The faeblooded priestess who leads the priesthood of Hertha; she gives Crintera Creo vis yearly and is the lover of Istvan Padas.

label: Zoroaster
summary: Prophet who founded the Persian faith on monotheism and revealed the Gathas.

label: Zoroastrian Mysteries
summary: Mysteries (Realms of Power: The Divine) from which Mithraism is rooted; indifferent to the Legion.

label: Zoroastrians
summary: Mystery cult of Christian astrologers, the Order of Hermes' greatest astrologers, who use astrology to overcome planetary influence and exercise free will; organized into seven degrees.

label: Zosimos
summary: Late third-century alchemist whose Visions identify the alchemical process with Christ.

label: Zurenzialle
summary: An unremarkable magus of the 1100s who vanished from his covenant in the Greater Alps; his sodales discovered he had never been human but was a faerie being impersonating a magus.

label: Zurich
summary: City listed in the Tribunal index.

label: Zwergenstimme
summary: A Magic spirit of an echo (Might 15, Imaginem) that lurks in caves and ravines, can mimic sounds, hurl rocks, and collapse cave roofs; its name means 'dwarf voice' in German.

label: Zwin
summary: Estuary opened by the 1134 tidal wave.

label: Zwin Sea Dragon
summary: A sea dragon that created the storm carving the Zwin channel near Brugge in a secret agreement with Derrick of Alsace, now demanding accumulated tolls via drowned-sailor emissaries.
